If you opt to not add any hot sauce, this should be one of the best Polish Boys you can find anywhere.  Stefanie C. mentioned that their fried chicken is A-MAZ-ING, but I was unable to try it.  If you are in the area on either Euclid, Carnegie, or Chester, you definitely need to stop by.

You've probably driven past their hideously ugly pink and blue building hundreds of times and have never stopped in. Well, you should remedy that. 

I'm not big on this type of food at all. I would never in a million years order ribs because I don't like to get barbecue sauce on my face. I like healthier more inventive food, snobbier food maybe? But damn, Hot Sauce Williams is good. KFC or whoever has NO business using "finger lickin' good" -- I think HSW should steal it. 

My family was all about going to the rib cook-off yesterday. When it started to pour nobody wanted to go anymore. Hot Sauce Williams was our next choice. We were very happy that it rained. 

I ordered the fried chicken and rib dinner. I couldn't NOT have ribs at HSW. It came with 2 sides. I chose collard greens (of course) and cole slaw. My brother and I also split a pork shoulder sandwich (cuz we're fatties). Yep, the one that was featured on No Reservations. Everything was very tasty. The fried chicken was the best I'd ever had. I can't say I've actually eaten that type of fried chicken many places before but it was so effing good that I wanted to make out with it. 

My only complaint with HSW was the girl working the register. She could have been more polite, maybe even a tiny bit personable, or perhaps ... I dunno....helpful? and not a complete bitch? We were almost afraid of her. 

I'll be back for sure. I just hope the Trunchbull isn't working.

I have to admit that I am not one to line-up to sample any food described as "spicy" or "hot." Luckily, Hot Sauce Williams signature bbq sauce is not spicy as the name originally suggested to me.  I had the ribs, coleslaw, and french fries, all drizzled with the mild bbq sauce. As you might expect, this was a generous portion of smoky ribs and I did not even come close to finishing the meal. This was fine with me, because now I have leftovers for lunch! The rib dinner, combined with a Pepsi, totaled approximately $10. My friend purchased the chicken dinner (fried chicken) with mac and chees subbed for the coleslaw. Substitutions are a slight up-charge, but it seems worth it to me for home-style mac and cheese. She chose to have her bbq on the side. You must request this, otherwise that ladle of sauce drops on the fries and all. The three of our meals totaled around $30, and if I could make one suggestion to anyone reading this, it would be to try the "family meal" which seems to include an insane amount of food (I guess enough to feed a family) at only $28. It is probably a good thing that the 3 of us chose not to share the "family meal" as I don't think any of us need that much mac and cheese, ribs, and fried chicken! I was going to suggest that anyone thinking of ordering food for the first time visit the Hot Sauce Williams website but as I write this entry, their website does not seem to be active. Ordering may be a little confusing for a first time customer stepping up to the register as their menu is not clearly visible. However, if you come armed with the information I have given you, you should be all set. Get the family meal if you are ordering for a group ($28? Why not!). And if it is just for you, try the chicken dinner, coleslaw, and mac and cheese (slight up charge for the mac and cheese) with sauce on the side for approximately $10. Enjoy!

Hey now...this is good BBQ...for Cleveland!  It's definitely a down-and-dirty BBQ joint.  The interior is pink and blue--not exactly the most appetizing colors.  If they bother you that much, there's always the drive-thru.  When you walk in you tell the lady at the counter what you want (from the single sheet of paper on the counter that shows the menu).  She takes your money, and then you pick up your food at the other end of the counter.  It's kinda like a school cafeteria--food is under hot lamps and kept hot in foodservice trays.  Just about every booth in the restaurant has ripped and patched "pleather."  Classic.  Service is very sllloooowwwww.  

I had the pulled pork sandwich--tender pork nestled in between 2 slices of white Wonder bread and topped with a slathering of Williams' own bbq sauce and coleslaw.  And I got a small side of macaroni and cheese.  Both were very tasty.  We also got some fried chicken and that was damn good.

The first time I had hot sauce Williams I didn't understand the sizes. So between 3 people we ordered like $40 worth of chicken on our way from cleveland to Columbus. By the time we got there, all the chicken was gone. I have never eaten a tastier chicken in my life
I enjoyed the fried chicken and found the ribs to be rather tasty. I love soul food!

We've driven past Hot Sauce Williams any number of times, always on our way to some other event, always promising that we'd stop "next time."

Well "next time" finally arrived. And we are kicking ourselves for taking so long. The fried chicken was the best I've ever eaten - juicy and tender on the inside, crispy on the outside. The ribs were tasty, as was the sauce. The macaroni and cheese is only beaten by the memory of mac-and-cheese from a sadly defunct soul food restaurant (it was so good we called it "crack-aroni and cheese"). The yams and baked beans were also excellent.

The restaurant is counter service, with a spacious, beaten-up dining room. Considering that the dining rooms in the soul food restaurants where we ate in Atlanta consisted of picnic tables and benches, the decor seems fitting. The service was perfunctory, but not rude. 

In sum, delicious food that's SO bad for you - definitely not daily fare, but the choice for soul food here in Cleveland.

This place was pretty awesome, it is in a pretty bad neighborhood and the dinning area isn't the most up to date. But the food definitely saves the day. If you are looking for a mounted menu, you won't find one. They have a paper menu on the front counter that has seen better days. The prices aren't bad and the selection is your standard, when it comes to a soul food spot. I ordered the 2 piece fried chicken meal, with sauce on the side (because I'm not the biggest fan of spicy). The chicken almost feels as though it was made tempura style, the crunch is very different but very good at the same time. The fries are your traditional crinkled cut, no standout seasonings were detected. I am not a fan of cole slaw so I donated mine to the trash can (seeing as though you cannot substitute sides). When I asked how much the can sodas were, the cashier replied "man these suckers are expensive $1.50 a can." Being that I am a punk when it comes to spicy foods I had to purchase one. I was pleased to learn that the sauce isn't all that spicy and I could tolerate it with the help of the expensive soda. I will definitely be back the next time I'm in Cleveland. Fried Chicken 1-5=5. Fries 1-5=3. Sauce 1-5=4.

I waited for so long to try this place, and completely hyped it up for myself. I had only heard good things, and had imagined the best BBQ and fried chicken of my life, with comfort food abound!

Sadly, it did not live up to my hopes. We went through the drive through. I got the polish boy, which was admittedly pretty good. But their mac and cheese was abysmal. It was plain noodles with cold cheese on top of it, not saucey at all. I am unashamed to say that I eat a TON of mac and cheese, and I couldn't eat this at all. 

I am willing to try it again. I think I'll opt for the fried chicken next time. Here's hoping it's better next time!

Although the outside is a little scary the food is to die for. I ordered the family meal and it was absolutely amazing!!!!! The fried chicken with the sauce poured on top was enough to satisfy even the bigger BBQ fanatic the ribs were amazing and the Mac n cheese is baked and very good as well. One of those places you'll become a regular.

I've never had anything here other than the fried chicken but the fried chicken is great. Good price, too. It comes with a "hot sauce" that really is more tomato based than spicy. The building/location is kind of tacky/ratchet.

I'm not sure what to do with this place... A couple of my friends took me here; they said they come here every now and then and enjoy it. But...

when they took my friend and I, I was a little less than underwhelmed. We were the only four people in the place (except for one guy who came in and tried to sell us pirated DVDs) and I was the last to order, but by the time my catfish dinner arrived everyone else had already finished their food. It took them almost 25 minutes to make my food. So for 25 minutes I had a good long look at their heat lamps. I watched several flies and fruit flies land, fly around, and then re-land on the coleslaw and fries. Needlessness when my food actually did come up, I was in no hurry to eat either of those two sides I had gotten. I will admit that the catfish itself was tasty, but the atmosphere completely took my appetite away. The one garbage can in the dining area was overflowing with food bits and dozens of fruit flies, so when we decided to leave (about 5 minutes after my food came), I had to take mine to go, but then my friends had to just set their garbage next to the overflowing trashcan because there were no employees in sight. Also, the parking lot and surrounding area was super sketchy. If the catfish hadn't have tasted alright, this place would have only gotten one star.

My friend and I were talking about this place and we decided to get a quick take out order for lunch.  He hadn't been here in years and I haven't been here ever so we headed out.  I was curious because it was on Man vs. Food and if Adam liked why shouldn't I?  Inside the restaurant I saw pictures of celebrities that have visited which included Samuel L. Jackson, Robin Williams and other celebs hanging on the walls. 

I tried the po'boy and chicken/rib dinner.  The BBQ sauce was tasty with initial sweet and then hot tones, slightly delayed.  As you get more into the meal the heat starts to build up.  It was good and probably the best part of it all.  The same sauce was used on basically everything that is served there.  

The po'boy was a mess so I used knife and fork to eat this.  The sausage reminded me of polish kielbasi which had snap and nice flavor.  You either like it or not and for me there was a lot going on.  You have french fries, BBQ sauce and coleslaw happening at once. Have a flexible pallet if haven't had this before.  I thought this was good.

The ribs were okay, maybe on the tough side  Did we get leftovers from the day before?  As we were leaving, we didn't see the smoker in use at the back part of the parking lot. The chicken was tasty and was slathered with the same sauce.

They charge you for every part of work that needs to be done, but in the end your shoes will look like new. So worth the slightly higher than average cost!

I took 2 pairs to be repaired one of which were my favorite Jimmy Choo boots that have both suede and leather - thrashed to HELL. They rebuilt the heel among a bunch of other things and I couldn't be happier! 

By my NYC shoe repair standard, this place is Top Notch.
They always do a great job on my work boots for my tree service. I have taken several pairs there over the years and am very happy with the quality of work and the people are nice
Awesome job on my cheapo yet comfy Forever 21 work shoes. Took about a week for them since they were no rush. Would definitely come back, great service and location!

Luis is hands down one of the best leather specialists in the country! He regularly repairs $30,000+ Hermes bags etc. A true master at his craft. He did some work on a couple of extremely vintage dress shoes of mine and the results were spectacular! My advice is pay him what he wants and you'll be happy you did, as I was and I'm extremely hard to please. Can't wait to come back with more projects for him. Awesome work Luis...thx a billon!!

I was going to give it only 4 stars because they weren't able to fix the squeak in my husband's leather loafer, but I brought the shoes back to Luis less than a month from when he first worked on them, and he didn't charge me anything to fully diagnose and fix the problem.  (As it turns out, the squeak originated from the sole and not the heel.)  

Go ahead and take your shoes there and Luis will take care of them for you.  Yes, even your expensive shoes.  Just be sure to call them ahead to make sure they are ready to pick up if your shoes are going in for major surgeries, like my husband's did.

Such a great time! A few friends and I just tried 2 of their rooms and I would highly recommend it to anyone that would like a good challenge. The Bio room was a little more on the difficult side so if you do this make sure you have a little brains on your team. I will definitely be back to do the zombie room. Thank you Escape Or Die for making such a great establishment!

Super fun! 
Make it an anniversary date and bring some friends!!




gr8 host 
ThankU again Devon
Super fun! Owners are great! The hours are cool. It was easy to get to. Rooms were clever. Very cool. Check it out!

We were greeted by the door at gun point. This place was very interactive and the people were nice. We did the next civilization room. It was an intermediate level. My group had 4 people and we were joined by 2 other people. I do not like that our group couldn't be by ourselves. With two different groups together, some people dominated the puzzles more then others due to the fact of not knowing each other. Overall this was still a fun experience and would definitely do it again. I also liked the bathroom and you could write on the walls
Excellent puzzle solving, excellent adventure fun! Definitely would go again! Staff is friendly and great!
Such a fun activity for a team building event!!! Would recommend it to everyone!!! The staff is super nice and accommodating for large groups.

I've done about 30+ escape rooms around the US and abroad, and I have to say that Escape or Die is probably excellent compared to other Vegas rooms, but pretty mediocre overall. We tried the Zombie Virus room and the Biohazard rooms.

PROS: The ambiance here is EXCELLENT. The employees here stay in character from the moment you see them, and they really go out of their way to freak you out. The rooms all have ambient sounds and smells in addition to the standard environmental elements that really add to the experience. There were some moments when we were REALLY freaked out!

Plus, I absolutely loved the photo experience at the end. They have a great assortment of props that allow you to capture your escape room experience in a fun photo. ^_^

CONS: No hints! SUPER retarded and frustrating, especially since we got stuck on the 2nd puzzle in the Biohazard room, and essentially sat on the ground and waited for the next 45 minutes until we lost the game. Seriously? That is NO fun. They could have had a walkie talkie system, or could have added hints as notes through a cubbie hole. There were some audio hints that were randomly dropped through the speakers, but there was SO MUCH DISTORTION due to all of the scary background noise introduced through the speakers that most of the time we had NO IDEA what they were saying through the speakers, and had to wait 15 minutes for the next hint to be mumbled through the speakers. 

The worst part was the randomness of the clues as compared to the solutions. One of the clues encourages you to do the OPPOSITE of what you actually had to do to solve the puzzle. There were also red herring clues, and just trial and error searches that didn't require any brainpower...just persistence to keep searching and trying random things until something worked.

Also, there was very little creativity with the locks themselves. Maybe I'm a bit spoiled going to rooms that have locks triggered by RFID placement and order, voice recognition systems, or even physical wire placement. These locks were simple number combo locks or keys. The rooms have some very creative storylines, but the experience adds up to just "unlock a bunch of padlocks."

So, I'm highly recommend it if you have NEVER done any escape room experiences before and have nothing to compare it to, or if you want to get really freaked out and have a great photo at the end to commemorate your experience. Otherwise...skip it.

This place was awesome!!! We had two groups of 5 which we did the battle of the sexes. Guys conquered the suspenseful zombie room in 29 minutes and beat the ladies who finished the harder Next Civilization in 31 minutes. All in all this was an an amazing experience. The photo shoot at the end was so cool and fun too!!!

We have a group of 4 that has done two rooms here now and really like the first, but felt the second needed just a bit of improvement with the actual puzzles unless it is geared towards "first timers". The rooms are easily solvable with just 4 in your group so highly recommended for smaller group sizes (whereas some locations are so unbelievably hard you cannot escape without having ten minds to work together and you feel completely frustrated). The "scary"/horror themes to the rooms are excellent as well. Both rooms we did were quite dark and we loved that setting. Gets you in the right mind for "escaping". 

We first did the Biohazard room which we loved. Without giving away much, it is very "engaging" and has a great horror movie hostage style theme to begin. The first part is pretty easy to solve and is more of a way to get you really involved in the theme. This is a multi room design and second portion of the game has a few different puzzles that are pretty easy if you do not overthink them. We tended to overthink, but if you just "put it together" instead of making complex math problems out of it they will be easy to solve. The props were excellent in this second portion of the room and really got you involved in the setting. We happily passed with time to spare!

On our second visit we did the Zombie Takeover room which we did not like as much. The set design of this room is excellent however and deserves a resounding A+. Uses technology mixed with active puzzle solving and "live action" work as well which gives every team member something to do. We just felt that the puzzles themselves were not quite as fun and we were able to escape without getting one final prop piece we needed because of a slight design flaw. It is possible to escape with the key without finding this final piece so we were a bit confused at that. Should have been setup in a way where you HAVE to find the final prop piece first before getting access to your exit key. There was really only one main puzzle that required a couple of steps but still just one giant puzzle. If you have a large group I feel like not everyone would have something to work on. We like a design where there are separate smaller puzzles so each person can have something to work on and shout about and feel accomplished when they get it. Makes it a bit more frantic and heart pounding. This would be a great room to do then if you have a smaller group that does not have much puzzle experience. It would give them a good confidence booster for being able to solve it. Also feel like "tweens" would love this game for actively involved zombie portion of the game. 

Great set designs, a lot of thought went into the concept so that you really feel "in" the game.
This place is Dope! Did middle and hard level. Middle is a lot more scary and more involved if with a party. Hard is definitely difficult but worth the challenge. Would definitely try again!
This escape room was super fun, challenging and a great relationship builder. We loved the challenge and made it out with 2 minutes to spare!
We just did the The Next Civilization room!  So much fun.  Time goes by faster than you think so be ready!  We will definitely be going again!

The ambiance was set as we stepped into the door...the owners explained in depth what to expect before we started on our escape adventure.  I tend to be claustrophobic and never did I feel anxious or nervous about the room! The clues were well written and together we worked through the clues and solved our escape!  Exciting, fun, and well worth the money!  Can't wait to get back!  Thanks for the adventure... We are now "Escape or Die" believers!!!

I had such an awesome time playing last night, I've been to only one escape room before and so I was super intrigued when I found this one in my city, if you ever want to learn about whether you and your boo make a good team or not, start here lol! (We got out Ha!)

If you're married and going through issues, who needs therapy? Discover if you can make it out of a locked room together! Jokes aside, good clean fun in Vegas, try it out!

This is one of the best escape rooms in Las Vegas. If you're going to only go to one come to this one the staff is awesome the rooms are set up very well you'll have a great time for sure make sure you do all three rooms!!!

My best friend and I have come to this place three different times, and we have a blast every time.  We've gone to different escape room experiences, and this one was probably one of the best.  We are happy that they will have a special of some sort, and we are very happy to know that they plan on changing up the rooms so we can keep coming back to them.  The rooms aren't overwhelming or difficult to solve (we've been to some where it's just impossible to solve), and we love taking a picture at the end of our escapes.  The only reason I'm not giving five stars is because the young lady who attended to us last time (not someone we recognized from previous visits) made it seem like she was doing us a favor by staying open for us that night, even though it was clear on the website that it was opened for reservations at the time.  The other young ladies we've met (the owners) were always super nice and friendly.

Just came out of there with my family, we've never done that before and we were amazed how fun it was. We never had to think so hard in our lives! Haha. We are for for sure going back and trying the harder level! And the people their were so nice!

We chose the new civilization, cuz I don't like scary stuffs. It's good that I got a chance to choose so I don't have to go to the room I don't like. You do have to be smart enough to solve all the clues and escape from the room. I guessed we are not smart enough cuz we failed to solve the last few steps

We went to Escape of die for little fun and to celebrate my friend's Birthday.  We had a blast!!!! We did the Biohazard room and died but mostly because we over thought the clues!!! I think everyone should check it and give into the fun.  We will be going back to check out the other rooms.
Totally fun. We did the first of the rooms, the least scary one and it was challenging but doable.

Fantastic! I had a blast!!! Challenging, scary, and fun!!! It's an experience from the moment you knock on the door to enter the establishment. I will definitely be back next time I visit Vegas! 5 stars!!!!

I found this place on Groupon and since we were going to be in Vegas, we decided to try it out. This was our first escape room experience and it was awesome. The girl who helped us, Jennifer, was really nice, funny and made the experience really fun. She explained everything really well and gave us clues when we asked for them. We were able to escape within the time allotted. Afterward l, they take a pic with you and you can use props in your pic if you want. The bathrooms are cool too...overall Jennifer made our first escape room experience really fun. I would definitely come back next time I'm in town and try a different room.
This was a fun escape room.  Pretty easy, but still fun.  There are better options in Vegas, but if you are close and can find a deal on this one you'll have a good time.

We got a groupon and did this for my sister's birthday. It was an absolute blast. First of all, the girls that work there are awesome and totally stayed in character. When we got in the room, my sister and I huddled in a group and screamed for the first 10 minutes (I do not do scary, so I was pretty petrified!) but our group completed it in time with no clues. It was sooo fun and I'm totally going to look for one of those again by my house in Cali :)

Did the Zombie escape room and it was awesome!!! The room was definitely creepy but, not too scary. Figuring it all out was the best part and super fun!! Definitely recommend it if you're into scary movies or riddles and decoding things. Shoutout to the two sisters who created it all on their own
Jessica was a super awesome host! Fun props, spooky atmosphere, and clever clues. Will definitely be coming again
This place is so much fun. it's not the biggest place because they are just starting out but they've done a great job so far. great for large groups!! I will be coming back many times :-)

First off the atmosphere right in the door is great. From the waiting room and the bathroom everything was in good taste and sets the mood up!
The employees where all great.

The group I went with did biohazard and it started off great and unique! (No spoilers) we did use our hints, I think some of the puzzles were worded oddly, after they gave us hints on them it was like "ohhhh that's how you interpret it?" The music set the atmosphere the whole time. More puzzles than hunting for parts? Which I wish there was a little more of but I would definitely do it again!

One of the most unorganized escape rooms I've ever played. The people working there are decent, but customer service could have been better. The room itself was not detailed and the woman even admitted at the end of the hour session the room was missing stuff because they were training new people WAIT WHAT !! LOL. The only cool part was the photo you take in separate room with some cool props.

I would not return at all to try the other options they have. Very disappointed.

What an awesome place. The moment you walk in it feels like you have entered the game. You have an hour to escape or die and they certainly do make that hour go by quickly. I really enjoyed the clues and having to use your brain to put it all together. 
It would be a good idea to bring as many friends with you as you can, because you have to work pretty closely together to figure it out, and if you have to deal with some rude strangers, it's not going to go smoothly.
Now go have some fun trying to escape or die.
Had a great time with my husband on our anniversary trip to Vegas! He was very hesitant but was the one who rocked it. We did the next civilization...super fun experience!!

Wow, what an experience. There were 6 in our group and it was fantastic! Staff was extremely friendly and the place looked amazing. My friends and I had the best time in the zombie room. We will be returning very soon to try others.

Wow.  That's all I can say after my first Escape or Die experience.  We had a group of 6 of us and conquered Biohazard with plenty of time to spare.  The establishment truly makes you feel like there is really a Zombie Apocalypse.  Without giving anything away, it's truly an INTENSE experience.  This is definitely NOT for the weak of heart!

After finishing Biohazard we tried our luck at the next room.  It was full of clues and puzzles that truly made you think.  Once again, without giving anything away, it was a pleasure to conquer this one as well.

Lastly, we decided to go for the 3-Peat and try to conquer the Zombie Room.  Words cannot describe the complexity and attention to detail that has been put into this room.  Our minds came together again to pull through this one as well.  My oh my, it's soooo hard to write this without giving away the details.  Tiana and her staff did an absolutely fantastic job to take care of us like we were VIP's.

There isn't a number that truly reflects this place.  5/5 isn't enough, it's more like 10 out of 5.  This is my 3rd Escape experience in Las Vegas and this one truly put the others to shame.  Well done, well executed, professional, and an extremely "REAL" experience.  A+++++.

Mediocre at best. Every escape room I've been to have had multiple rooms to unlock. This one only had one very small room. We collected all the clues in 5 minutes and we're out in less than 20. It was a complete waste of money. Don't waste your money.

Took my wife for her birthday. 6 of us and we survived the zombie apocalypse!!! It was so cool. Highly recommended! It was such a great experience and we all want to come back to do the other challenges.
there were 4 of us and it was pretty creepy. We survived getting out with 15 minutes left. lots of fun and challenging

Awesome experience!  Perfect mix of thrill and tension without being over the top.  And that's from a guy who normally doesn't even like scary movies.  It's just a really well done experience.  If you like escape rooms, you will definitely like Escape or Die :-)

I'll be back for sure!

The girls that run this place are really nice.  The overall theme of the place is good.  We were greeted at the door at gunpoint.  That was a fun surprise.  While we were in Vegas we did all 3 rooms at this location.  At the time of this posting the rooms were titled Zombie, Next Civilization, and Biohazard.  

We escaped all 3 rooms with no clues, before time was up.  

My favorite of the 3 rooms was Zombie.  I was disappointed that Biohazard wasn't more extravagant.  (They charge $10 more for this room).  Ironically, it was my least favorite of the 3 rooms.  This room is rated 18+ ... I thought this was ridiculous.  Anyone over 13 years old would be fine.  In the Next Civilization, we escaped the room without solving one of the coolest puzzles in the room.  This was disappointing and is the result of bad game design.  

I hope they keep improving this place.  There is a lot of potential here.

My wife and i wanted to make our Vegas trip something to remember, since we were celebrating her's as well as my oldest sons 18th birthday.  This experience definitely made for a fun and exciting evening.

We found escape or die las vegas through google searches of various room escapes and found that they had the best rooms and ratings.  I'm very happy we picked them.  The owner and her sister was extremely welcoming and was making every effort to make sure we were immersed in the scenario....we did the biohazard. (Fricken hard....and yes we died lol) 

The puzzles made for some great family bonding time.    If you live in Vegas or just visiting, escape or die is a definite must attraction.

Took 20 people to Escape or Die for a company teambuilding/fun event in March and we had a blast!  The workers there were very accommodating and helpful.  We rented out all 3 rooms at one time and each room was unique and properly described on their website.

We had a contest to see which group could escape the fastest and in the end all 3 groups escaped the zombie apocalypse.  The last group escaped with just 1 minute left on the clock!  

Some of the employees enjoyed the escape room so much that they are talking about participating in another escape room closer to home.

If you are looking for something different for your company to participate in, or if you are looking for something to do, come try out Escape or Die!
Just went with a party of four. Had the best time ever. We did the biohazard room, and solved it right at the deadline. We'll definitely be back!

We are a family of 5. We did the zombie apocalypse room. It was a fun experience. Our youngest was 10 and she was scared at first  (she's scared of everything) but she loved it in the end. Next time we are in vegas we are doing biohazard

Me and my sister went there last night and it was so much fun. We did the creepy escape room and had 1 hour to get out. That was a blast! We didn't make it out alive because divas never survive the zombie apocalypse...lol. 

The owners are 2 sisters who are so nice and they put a lot of thought and creativity into this experience. This is a definite must do and I will be back on my next visit.

What a fun experience! We had a group of 5 people (varying ages from 16 to middle aged adult) which completed the Zombie Escape. It was just creepy enough to keep us all on edge while also being challenging enough to keep us all busy. Fun time, great people, awesome experience! Will definitely go try new experiences soon. Highly recommend!!

Went with 2 friends and had the assumption we would breeze right through it. We chose the black out room. It didnt take long before our egos were deflated and we were fighting for our lives. I cant wait to go back and try the other two rooms.

Such a well thought out, witty and detailed experience. I've been to "live escapes" that didn't cut it but this business has gone above and beyond to make sure that every customer leaves with a thrilling, challenging and fun experience. This family owned and operated business is run by two sisters who really made sure to think of it all. Everything from the props, clues and space is amazing and they didn't skimp on any area. There's even a space to hang out and a full picture room with props of wigs and masks so your team can show their personality and take a funny or scary winning or losing team photo! If you and your friends are looking for a unique activity that forces you to use your brain then check out this awesome gem in Vegas!
-Sarah-

This was such a ball! If you're looking for something thats different in Vegas that's fun and exciting, then come to ESCAPE OR DIE!! We came for a friend's birthday and even though we technically "died", we still had a blast. Jennifer and Jessica were amazing!! They both went above and beyond in giving us the ultimate experience! We would definitely recommend it and come back next time we are in town!

Went with a group of co-workers prior to convention and booked a 630 appt. for Zombie virus.  We took Uber to get here and he had a tough time finding it since it was basically in a block of office buildings.  Not what I expected.  Im sure its more busy during the week but on the weekend, the area is a ghost town.   We were greeted at the door by gun point and it took a minute to realize it was part of the whole experience.  We finally get in and we had to sign the waiver through our cell phones. It was easy but there are still some people in the world who may not have one.  Waited another 10 mins and they asked us to put our belongings in this box outside the door, esp cell phones because you can't use it while in the room.  I was a little concerned about leaving my purse full of cash in this unmanned and unlocked box.  Other groups do come in this area.  Nothing was missing, but don't feel good about that part. 
We enter the room and it is hot and severely smokey/hazey using a smoke machine.  You can barely see much in front of you. Not good if you have asthma. Me and another person started feeling quite ill but didn't want to ruin it for the group so I was not very productive during the first 20 mins. Luckily, the smoke eventually dissipated and they turn on the air.   The room was much smaller than expected.  Every ten mins or so they slip you a clue through the door. You get an hour to complete the escape.  My biggest gripe other than the smoke is that one of the lock boxes was damaged so it was really hard to open even with the right combo.  We didn't make it out in time but would have if I had gotten off my lazy butt up to figure the last clue because I got it right when our time was up.  
It was a fun thing to do outside of work with co-workers but didn't feel the price (6 x $25) was worth the experience for an hour. A little bit cheesy.  Not scary at all.  Just a lot of Halloween props.  Finally, chill out with the smoke effect.  I know its in the disclaimer but crap, I couldn't breathe and you can't see a thing.

This was such a great time, my boyfriend and I did two of their escape rooms and had a blast. The two girls that own the place were amazing, they were nice and helpful. The way they decorated the building and the rooms were awesome. I would totally recommend this place, you'll have a great time.

So I was not sure what to expect going into this. I knew I loved getting scared and solving mysteries. And Escape or Die satisfied this combo to the extreme. I enjoyed this experience so much and would HIGHLY recommend this to everyone, for all ages. The best part is that you get to try to escape this with your friends so there is teamwork and communication involved. So much fun! The girls who run this, too, are amazing. Thank you!

Not what I was hoping for - especially since this was my first time in an escape room.

Went for a couples date night (4 of us) with a couple who has already been to a different escape room .. which they LOVED. So we were pretty excited to try this place out! We did the Zombie room, which I thought was cool for Halloween time.

When we got to the door, yes we were greeted at "gun point" but the girl with the gun almost looked embarrassed that she had to do this. It was obvious that it was totally staged. The building was decorated pretty cool.

The room.. pretty cool decor again, but there was I think 1 full zombie and 1 zombie head.. not quite the "zombie" vibe I was hoping for. No smog, no crazy effects like I was expecting. 

The puzzles were fun to figure out and we ended up completing it within 45 minutes .. no other rooms .. just you complete it &that's it .. 

Although $25/person doesn't sound too crazy .. $50 for a couples date night definitely was for the experience. I think $25/couple would be better off.

I would love to try other escape rooms but would not suggest this one.

Booked the Zombie Virus room as a surprise birthday present. It was a hit.  We had so much fun.   We made it with five seconds to spare!  The room is great; the atmosphere is spooky; and the clues are not easy. We met Devon, one of the owners, and she is awesome.  Definitely a great date night activity for two.  If you are looking for something different to do you cannot miss this place.

So my husband and I along with our two boys aged (7&9) decided to give this a go. We found a great deal on groupon for it but after doing it even at full price this is worth the money. We did the new civilization room and I expected my husband and I to be the ones to do most of the work yet it was awesome to see my kids really get into it and in the end each of us had been a key player in figuring out something to help us get to the end and get out in time. It was a great bonding experience and we thoroughly enjoyed it. I personally did it because I knew it was something my kids and hubby would like and it turns out I now can't wait for my next room!!! 
Such a fun time!!!!
My boyfriend and I were expecting more of a haunted house theme. It was not fun.

Best escape room in town. Fantastic props and a very cool story line. Not going to reveal much but let's just say that they do it right. 
We loved the hint system....

We did biohazard. Highly recommended!

It was a really neat experience! I've never done any like this before so I got a group of friends together and went into the zombie room. The props and decor of the room were excellent. I loved the room, I kept finding all the clues and it was fun to see the whole thing come together with a group of five of us working together and having a blast. The pictures we took at the end were an extra nice added touch to the whole experience. Writing on the bathroom wall was interesting and funny. We were so close to figuring it out but I think an hour is a good amount of time. Definitely going back and I'm bringing more people!

The Zombie Apocalypse one is definitely a good one to try!!! The decorations in the room are awesome! There were 7 of us and had an hour to escape the room which we finished in 36 mins! We had a blast! Can't wait to go back and try to Other ones!! Definitely a place to go if you want to have a great time with friends/family!
Came here with my two teenagers even Though we got infected definitely coming back #zombielife  Amelia is the best and thank you for saving us!

While on vacation in Vegas, my family did four escape rooms, and the Zombie Apocalypse was our least favorite. Compared to the ones we're used to doing in Southern California, it fell short in size, scope, and creativity. The room was super small - I have no idea how groups of 7 or 8 manage to move around in there (four of us kept bumping into and had to constantly sidestep around each other) - and it was just that one room; it never opened up to allow a change of scenery to push the plot/story forward.

Our main gripe was that the puzzles were one-dimensional. Solve for four numbers, four letters, and that was it. The entire experience was mostly a series of locks, combinations and opening boxes. In retrospect, that's all there was physical space for. We got out in time, but were fairly frustrated because we kept overthinking, looking for complexity and depth that didn't exist. One annoying feature of the room is the amount of instructions and writing that accompanied each piece of the puzzle. If you have to explain it, then you eliminate one of the most satisfying components of an escape room: finding objects (or making observations) and trying to figure out how to use them or what they're for. The solutions should evolve organically from the items presented by the plot or environment.

It wasn't all bad - one star for a couple of cool things (the one use of technology which added a unique component of pressure and thrill that supported the story, and a physical challenge of sorts that had to be completed simultaneously with the puzzles) that showed some thought and variety that I wish had been carried out in more elements of the room. And one star for the good service and the effort put into the apocalyptic atmosphere, set design and props.  If they had put as much effort and creativity into the puzzles as they did the environment, then this would have been a much better experience.

One of the worst escape rooms I've ever played. The people working there are nice enough, but the rooms themselves are a joke. The puzzles were insanely easy and underwhelming, the set decoration reminds me of a high school Halloween party, and the room with the ridiculous amount of fog made my throat hurt for hours afterwards. The only cool part was the photo op room where they have a wide selection of masks and some cool props to take pictures with.

These guys need to up the anti a LOT if they want to keep up with some of the awesome escape rooms in Las Vegas. Definitely not worth the money when there are such better options in town.

I went with three other friends and had the greatest time. The room we chose was spooky and challenging. It was a such a fun game to play with friends. I will definitely come back and do another room.

This escape room was by far the best I've been to yet in Las Vegas!! Went with a party of 12 and they split us up into 2 rooms, the biohazard  (the hardest) & the zombie virus. We found them both extremely fun and challenging but with just the right amount of scare factor. They also have a prop room complete with weapons, masks, hats, military gear, and even a lil 4x4 jeep with awesome backdrops to take pictures in so you can finish off your night in true apocalyptic style!! The owner Tiana was beyond professional and really made my birthday special! Thanks for being so patient with our group and can't wait to try out the other rooms!!

We had very high hopes for Escape or Die to be great and we were let down. We did their R rated escape room which sounded really cool. When we got there the beginning of room was actually very exciting however the beginning of the games was definitely the climax of the room and everything went downhill from there. Overall there was only about six or seven things to unlock, at other escape room places there was maybe 15-20 things to unlock. The room wasn't absolutely terrible but for the price which was more on the expensive side, there are definitely way better options for escape rooms in Vegas.

We did two live escapes tonight and this one was our favorite one! We did the biohazard one and will be going back to do the rest :) we did not get her name, but the gal who helped us was great ! We all made it and definitely had a blast !

So this was the first escape room we ever did, and I have to say it sets the bar pretty high.  I am a huge fan of the idea of escape rooms ever since I found out they were a thing, although as of writing this, I have only done one other.  But I will compare them all to this from now on, since I enjoyed it so much.  Without giving away any spoilers, we did the Biohazard with only 3 people.  I think you can have 8, and I can't even imagine the disaster it would cause having that many people together.  Not because of the escape room itself, but just too many thoughts and talking!!!  So I have to say we did embarrasingly bad on the "first" part; there were clues right in front of us we didn't see!!  So when we thought we were done, and there was still more, we panicked knowing we took too long, and rushed to get out within the time limit. (We had received a clue at one point without asking, but it was something I had already figured out, I just wasn't using it right.)   We made it out with only a few minutes to spare.  The girl there said more often than not, people don't solve it in time, so I feel pretty accomplished.  

The funniest part was there was a group of 6 kids doing the Civilization room, and they got put in before us.  Both rooms were an hour, but we were able to finish, and watch them bumble about for 10 minutes while the girl kept giving them clues on the radio.  They have a laptop with a camera on the inside of the room, and headphones, so friends and family can watch (and laugh) from outside.  

Please don't ruin the experience for yourself by bringing a cell phone in.  And you can ask for hints if you want, but where's the fun in that?  The girl there was super sweet, sorry I don't remember her name.  And the ambiance of this place is really cool.  It's hard to find, and I'm good with directions; we passed it twice since it was dark out!!! Don't be worried if the front door's locked, I think it's their way of providing safety since she's busy with the rooms and not able to watch the front.

Really cool experience. It was my first escape room and I can't wait for more. The only thing I didn't like is the room being hot. It gets warm in there. So dress comfortable. Other than that it's extremely fun and will test your survival skills.

Highly recommend making the trip off the strip for this escape room.  It's a very short Uber ride to/from there.  We had so much fun on our first room that we stayed for a second.  They gave us the Groupon price again too.  This was a lot of fun...we had two people and I thought that was perfect for the smaller rooms.
We had an awesome time. Atmosphere is just right while not being too overbearing. It was spooky and fun and the zombie virus was difficult but still doable. Awesome place!!

I visited Escape or Die for the first time today. Lots of fun! The experience starts from the moment you walk in the door. The place is very nice and well-kept and the owner is great. We did the medium difficulty room and it was challenging for my first escape room and very fun! I would definitely go back for another room. I've heard great things about the hardest room, Bioshock!

Wow, a must go for escape fans.  Bio hazard one of the most fun rooms I have ever done.  Jessica up front was awesome and both rooms were incredible.  Just waiting for the rooms to change so we can go again!
Awesome time!!! If you love solving puzzles and think you are crazy smart - give Escape or Die a shot. You will be mistaken - good luck. The escape room definitely won.

This was definitely different than any other escape room we've done!! We did the biohazard room and I can't say much but it's definitely a mind game. We had a lot of fun and deven (I think that's how it's spelled sorry if it isn't) she was a great host! Although it was $5-10 more than other rooms it was worth it for the different experience. I have already recommended this to another friend and will continue to do so! Thank you so much for the great time and understanding!

I'm not going to lie. I was really scared, but after a while it wasn't too bad. I went with my brother, sister and bf and we all had a great time.. The staff was great at playing the part. We did the zombie apocalypse during my birthday weekend. I may try the other ones sometime soon.

Had a great time. Three of us ran the Zombie Virus scenario and really enjoyed it. The staff was awesome and fun and the game challenging and engaging. I would recommend it to everyone. Go and enjoy!!

Other escape rooms, wack
Other escape room's customer service, wack
Other escape room's props, wack
ESCAPE OR DIE, TIGHT AF!!

A great experience and a lot of fun. The staff was great and we went into the escape room as soon as we arrived. We had so much fun trying to figure out how to escape but unfortunately we didn't succeed!! Lol but a lot of fun nevertheless and I would definitely go back and recommend anyone that is in Vegas.

Awesome! Did Zombie Virus and beat the room in 33 minutes. We were the last group of the night and the owners were still just as welcoming so late in the night. The room was really fun, atmosphere was immersive. We are coming back to do the other rooms very soon!
We had a great time playing the Zombie attack room. While we were visiting Vegas it gave us something to do with our teenaged kids other than walking the strip.

THIS PLACE IS AWESOME!
We did the zombie room and ALMOST finished. Super challenging and always kept us guessing. The atmosphere is on point! We will be back with a bigger group! We LOVED it so much!! Thank you for this amazing experience!

Super fun. My girlfriend and I had super fun with the zombie apocalypse package. It was definitely difficult to figure out. The clues that we could not figure out, they walked us through afterwards. Definitely recommend this place. The only thing I would change is to go with a larger group.

I was so frightened, I literally was about to back out and quit! I'm so glad I didn't! 

One of the best things I've ever done. 

If you're in Vegas and really want to get of your comfort zone, this should be on your list.

Don't wanna give out any details, just go with a group of friends and expect to pee in your pants lol. 

Setting is decorated crazy scary. Two awesome sister's own this place, extremely friendly and also the other ladies working there. Thanks so much guys for the experience! You guys rock!
This place is amazing I came here with a few friends to test our skills. This is a great place for family bonding and team building exercises!

Aside from never posting our photo on social media, my group of 4 had a blast doing the most difficult room. It's a hole in the wall type of place with reservations only, but a ton of fun & thrilling! What Do I Mean By That? You begin with a black sack over your head and handcuffed to a wall, but I won't spoil anything else :)! Ever get the chance to go, do all 3!
Great escape rooms. We've done 2 of 3 of their rooms. Well put together. These sisters have a love for the escape room business.

Soooo much fun! We did the zombie escape with our family. 5 cousins and 4 adults. We had a blast and want to try the biohazard room with the 18 and over in our family. The lady that was waiting on us was just as fun! Super friendly and played her part well.

This place was awesome.  Very well thought out.  Great for couples.  We wish we HD something like it in San Diego!!  We will have to try the Biohazard next time in LV.  We made it out of Zombie Virus in 42 minutes, only two of us!!!

Amazing. A very cool and well thought out experience for us. It was a great time with the room (biohazard) being challenging and thrilling. The employees are extremely nice and really add to the experience. I would highly recommend it.
By far the best way to spend an hour with a friend. If you love puzzles and thrilling saw-like experiences, this is for you!

This is my second time visiting Escape or Die and I haven't been disappointed! Not only are their games extremely immersive, but they are clearly and cleverly thought out. The first time I went I played Biohazard with people that did escape rooms often. It was fun, immersive, and difficult as hell (it is their hardest room) and.... We didn't make it out, haha.

Second time I went with friends that don't play many escape rooms. We did their Next Civilization experience and it is their medium difficulty room that isn't scary. I highly recommend this one as well if you're looking for something challenging!

The owner is very friendly and personable. They also have a cool picture room! Definitely go check this place out. I also found out that their group booking rates are more than reasonable. Call them now!!!

Good, solid new furniture at good prices.  For the money you pay, you're getting solid oak / mahagony / maple / etc. furniture that blows the B.S. stores (Levin Value City, etc.) and their pressboard/paper/cardboard pieces of crap away.

They don't make furniture here, just deal the Amish brands made in Amish furniture meccas like Holmes County.  As a result you can buy anything already in the store as is (great variety!), order one of those same pieces but in a different wood or stain color, or order something completely different in size, shape, etc.  The best thing is there is no custom charge - you pay what it costs extra for them to make.

Also accepts Visa/Mastercard.

This was our 2nd time to Yoder's Furniture and most certainly will be back.

We've bought several hardwood furniture pieces here. Very well made and absolutely gorgeous. 

You can buy some pieces from the store or customize an order. The store has a arrangement with a friend that will deliver for a very reasonable fee, or you can come back with a truck. Delivery is a great idea as they'll bring the piece right into your home.

The items we've bought (table/chairs) have held up extremely well. Finish stands up to wear. 

The owners are friendly but also give you space to browse.

We have purchased a hutch, dining room table, and chairs from Yoder's, and we absolutely love them!  I fell in love with the hutch, which was on the showroom floor, and then we ordered our table and chairs to match.........quarter-sawn white oak, and absolutely gorgeous!  We will definitely continue buying new pieces from them as our old stuff wears out.

This is my go to dog park in the summer. It has a great layout that doesn't feel like it has the dogs caged in. There is a water fountain and benches to sit on as your puppy plays.

One of the best in the city.
Great outdoor shinny in the winter, especially Saturday and Sunday mornings from 10-12.  See you all out there.

I have visited Ramsden Park a few times in the past, either to eat a sandwich from Black Camel across the street (see my separate 5-star review), or just to sit and relax on one of the benches. But last week was the first time that I had been there for ice skating, and it was quite nice, so I returned yesterday morning for another visit.

There are two skating areas: a full ice rink used for hockey and shinny, and a smaller ice pad beside it for leisure skating. The leisure pad is rectangular, probably about 2/3 the size of the standard rink, and it seems to be well-maintained. It was still in good condition last week with about 1/2-dozen people already skating around mid-day, and again yesterday it was still solid in all places although it was just around 0C early in the morning. There is an open changing area and washrooms in the nearby building, and I think they have helmets available to borrow. Overall a nice easy-going skate, and I am sure to return in the future.

As for the rest of the park, there is also a baseball diamond and a small playground, surrounded by lots of large trees with benches and picnic tables scattered around. There is also a dog off-leash area, and I have read that the ice rink is used for tennis in the summer.

I grew up next to Ramsden Park and have fond childhood memories here.

The park, which is a little run-down (yes, I'll admit, some patchy grass but Trinity Bellwoods suffers there too!) it still boasts some great benefits to its community, namely:
- kids wading pool (free grazed knees is a right-of-passage for all)
- off-leash dog park at it's West-end (close to Avenue Road)
- tennis courts which double as rinks in the winter
- re-vamped stair cases (formerly treacherous)

It's also a stone's throw from Rosedale Subway station.

A great alternative to the pack TB with many similar amenities without so much crowding. Very close by to some Yelp favourites including:
1. Black Camel Cafe (for java)
2. Rebel House Restaurant (for beers)

To clarify J.H.'s comment there is a full-sized hockey rink with boards, nets, and a great player's bench. Beside the rink is another ice pad about 3/4 the length and 1/2 the width of the rink. It's perfect for a skate while shinny is being played on the rink.

I've played about 4 times at Ramsden this winter and plan to go as often as possible while the ice is still available. It's zamboni'd often, the staff are courteous and helpful, the ice is great when the conditions are right (not too often in Toronto!) but you have to be careful when it's around 5C or above because it'll get really slushy in some parts.

Thanks to the Maple Leafs for sprucing up this rink a few years ago. Everything is top notch.

I always take Ramsden Park as a short cut whenever I need to walk from Rosedale Station to Davenport/Annex, really enjoyable walk doesn't matter what seasons.

Softball Diamond, Skating/Hockey Rink, Children's Play area and even Tennis Courts!

Great off leash dog park area with an active Dog Owner's Association.. you can find them on Facebook if you want to find some playmates for your dogs.

Activities for all ages and all seasons... 

Or you can just like me, taking a leisure walk is as refreshing!

The street parking across the tennis courts and skating rink is only 1 hour from 10 am to 3 pm, other time you will need a permit.... just in case you are driving down!

I think the service is great ; however, I give the pedicurist a 25 % cash tip and sign my credit card as such, then AFTER it is signed they add another 20% to the card. This is being investigated by my bank, I am not going back, ever.

I'm a regular at Venetian Nail Spa, but per a recommendation, I decided to try Liz Nails.  I got a gel manicure ($38.80) from a lady who I'm not sure has ever done nails before. The whole way that she went about things was weird, especially when she started trimming my cuticles - instead of trimming them, she started to dig in to the sides of my skin with the clippers and got me good (see picture). 

Everyone else getting their nails done seemed super happy though, so I have a feeling it was just her. So just make sure you don't go to the lady that looks like she is the younger girls' mom. Two stars because it was convenient and clean.
Great mani-pedis with a hot towel leg massage. The prices are decent and the staff is friendly. Most importantly, it's super clean. My new go-to for nails.

It was time to find a new nail spot in walking distance.  I called today at 4pm and asked for a 4:30pm mani+pedi (it's Friday even) and they accommodated me.  I was very happy with Hong, she did an excellent job.  She was the first manicurist to convince me to try shellac.  I will be back, no more venetian for me!!!!

ps- they prefer $ tips, not on cards.
This salon does a great job with pink and whites| shellac| and pedicures!  Love coming here.  Kudos to Kelly:)

One of the nicest people in the business. Some nail techs don't really talk much but they are always happy to be doing what they do best. Was just in for regular mani and polish change on toes. Did a great job on both!

I've recently become obsessed with Shellac - yes I realize this is not a new discovery.  I am too lazy too do my nails all the time and always mess them up, so I started coming here fairly regularly to get my nails done. 

I absolutely love it.  I am in and out in a half hour, the staff is nice, and the price is pretty reasonable.  One downfall is they lack a little in selection of shellac and be forewarned - the color on the tester DOES NOT always match the sample.  Be sure the color that the bottle is actually the color you want on your nails, not the one on the sample.  I got tricked once and walked out with almost black nails when that was not what I wanted.  

Other than that my nails always look professional - manicures are great and I have always met other very pleasant people on my trips.  

(It is also very close to the Rocky River Wine Bar - an absolute favorite of mine, look at my reviews) 

All in all a win win!

I have been a regular at Liz Nails for around 3 years. 
prior to that I have experienced many similarly priced nail salons. Liz nails is by far the best and more importantly the most consistently great nails salon in the Cleveland area. It is family owned and all of the staff are friendly and make you feel at home. I'm so glad to have found this place and could not imagine getting my nails done elsewhere every again.

This is a small no frills nail salon but has a large staff and you will never have to wait. Prices are competitive... they do offer gel mani's, but FYI they are gelish, not shellac or the OPI gels... I personally dont mind because I mostly get gel french mani's, so it doesnt matter if it is name brand or not. Go to Jason, he is THE BEST nail tech I have ever been to. Total perfectionist. My gels last 3 weeks with him. 

Clientele consists of Rocky River locals including "Miss Ohio"... I've seen her in there and also her pic in on the wall.

My only suggestion is to be clear about what shape you want your nails... because most of the staff speaks broken english... if I cannot get into Jason, I have found that if I dont specify that I like very square nails, I automatically get rounded nails.

Also, their BASIC pedi includes a lower leg and foot hot towel wrap, which is nice.

My first professional gel mani/pedi in probably about 5 years--I know... it was time.

Normally you're asking to be disappointed when you're rushing around before a trip and you drop-in to grab a quick mani/pedi. But not at Liz Nails! This place was not only recommended by the Yelp community, but also from my gal friends on facey-space. So I gave them a try on a Monday afternoon... when I was in a mad rush... right before I left for a trip. Yep, I did that to myself. 

But the Liz Nails folks handled it perfectly. I stepped in the same time as another lady looking for the same gel mani/pedi service. I mentioned I was in a big hurry and without a minute passing the had invited both this lady and I to the back to get our pedicures started. Without skimping on service, the gentleman helping me got me through a great pedicure without delay. In fact, the longest part of the whole process was picking out the damn nail color. Then my first gel manicure was a great experience! It went quickly and has lasted well over a week at this point. He did it perfectly and I can't wait to come back to get my next manicure. 

One thing I think that could be improved on is the color selection. It's not that they don't have a lot of colors, but normally when I've gone to nail salons they have displays out with new, relevant and seasonal color lines. This is helpful to those of  us who don't get our nails done often and are really indecisive. I think I'll just come in better prepared next time. 

The price was around what I remember when I used to get my nails done more often. I think next time I"ll just get my toe nails painted (not a full pedi) when I get my gel manicure. And hopefully the service always stays this good!
Pretty standard looking nail salon but they did a great job on my nails! I will return.

I asked my stylist where I should get a mani / pedi and she suggested Liz Nails. I took my cousin here last weekend before a wedding we were attending and we both got a mani / pedi. I made the appointment weeks prior and we were some of the first people there. We were given free bottles of water and we took our spot at the foot bath machine. 
It was such a wonderful pedicure! Hot towel leg massage made me feel like I was on some sort of Scandinavian spa vacation haha
I wanted black tips for my manicure (which was an extra $5, but I didn't care, I can paint them any old color, but I cannot do tips lol) and my cousin and I walked out of there feeling fresh and fabulous with 2 mani/pedi's for just under $100. I thought it was quite a deal and my cousin really loved it as well. 
One of the other things I enjoyed was that at my nail techs suggestion, I paid for our services before getting my manicure so I didn't have to weasel my credit card out of my wallet and risk ruining my nails. I appreciated her forethought since pregnant and not so much with the thinking...
Now that I am 5 months pregnant again and getting to the part where I cannot see my feet, I will be visiting there more frequently. Give them a visit. I think you'll be quite happy :)

I went to Liz Nails for a pedicure. Cindy did a wonderful job. (Middle aged woman with glasses and a chin length hair cut) I hadn't received a pedicure in many months and my feet needed it. Cindy took her time and was very thorough. I highly highly recommend her. I even asked her to buff my nails and she did a very detailed job. I can't say enough good things about Cindy. Her work is very thorough and I am happy to have found a wonderful nail technician.
I did not have an appointment & had no wait for a repair & fill. Jason was great, took his time and my nails look beautiful. I'll go back whenever I need to. They also do pedicures.

Okay so I've had acrylics for over a year. I took them off for a couple of months and yesterday i decided I miss them. The salon I used before, I felt was a bit sloppy and to give this salon a shot. Boy was I wrong about my previous salon...

Upon walking in someone says "what do you want"? I'm like huh? This was her way of asking if I want mani/pedi or etc? So I shake it off and reply I would like a full set of acrylics. She tells me to sit, walks away and brings a plastic container with files and a small bottle of water. I had pink polish on my nails, she did not fully remove that polish, instead was filing it away while doing the prep. When filing I felt a burning sensation numeral times. Also the little container with files, they were all used and dusty looking. The tips she put on looked way to big for my nails. The whole time she is silent. Not a word nothing. When she brings out the acrylic powder it looked dirty and gross. The application was quick, too quick. She filed for a few minutes leaving chunks of acrylic under my nails. The nails are thin but very wide. Like an ogre. Like I said I've had acrylic nails and they were never this wide. The ends and acrylic are wavy. Not flat and smooth. Supposed to be square yet i found her to be rounding them. Even after I told her she still rounded the square corners. This morning the sides of my cuticles are sore. I may have to file them myself. The other ppl smile at you but the tech I had must have came out of school recently. She had no manners as a professional. I won't be going back there and believe me this review is exact. I am a nice person and would never insult anyone. I just want to tell ppl of my experience. This is what reviews are for right? Check it out yourself if you like.

BE CAREFUL, MY NAIL TECH DID NOT DISINFECT HER EQUIPMENT AFTER A MANICURE!!!!   She drew blood during the manicure and after I noticed she just wiped off her tool and put it back in her drawer.  I have been to Liz's Nails many times before over the past few years with great results, but I never paid attention to their disinfectant methods.  It's been about 10 months since my last visit.  My manicure looks terrible and the shellac over the nail where she drew blood has dried blood in the shellac.  Manicure should have been discounted or I shouldn't have been charged.  In addition, they removed the sinks from in their salon and you have to wash your hands in the bathroom.  After seeing their lack of care for cleanliness, I won't be able to return.  It's a shame because they use to do a great job on my nails.

Gave this place a shot & wish I hadn't. My pedicure was completed in 15 minutes, barely even worked on my feet at all & was completely rushed through the entire thing & they weren't even busy, definitely not going back here again!!

Love this place!  I've been going here for close to 5 years.  They do a great job on my nails and their pedicures are awesome and priced very low for what you get!  They have massaging chairs that make the pedicures even more relaxing.
You can walk in and rarely have to wait.  I highly recommend trying out Liz Nails.

I recently moved to cleveland and was so nervous about trying somewhere new in fear of getting a bad set of nails . My experience with liz nails was brilliant.  I was taken immediately very professional and friendly.  I had a full set of acrylic pedi and a brow wax. All turned out amazing. Will definitely be returning! My nail technician was Hanna.

Went to Liz Nails for the first time today based on Yelp! Won't be going back. Surly young lady gave me a pedicure and manicure. Halfway through the pedicure she takes the towel that was under my feet, wipes the floor then attempts to put the towel back under my feet to finish. NOT! During the manicure, I had to have her go back over eachnail and paint the full nail - she missed the sides on every nail. As she was doing my nails, a woman came in with 3 girls whose nails had been done Thursday (2 days ago) and their polish was already off. $50 down the drain on a bad mani-pedi experience. I'll see how long polish lasts but I'm not hopeful.

What a great place!!!  Today, i had a new set of pink and whites put on at Venetian Nails and they were worse than horrible.  I was so upset and went to Liz's for help.  Having just moved here, i had no idea where to go (obviously, having gone to Venetians). They were so sympathetic and accommodating and Hanna did an OUTSTANDING job.  Poor thing had to try and get these horribly thick nails off so she could put a new set on.  My nails look so good.  I HIGHLY recommend this salon!!  Thank you for turning my really bad day around!!
A tiny spot that offers a rare combination of delicious and healthy food at an affordable price. The setting is unpretentious and welcoming with a homey vibe.

La dame derrière le comptoir est mignonne comme tout, et l'odeur de bon petits plats qui se dégage de la cuisine est alléchante, bien que je ne les ai pas essayé encore. J'y passe par contre de temps en temps pour me prendre un biscuit sur le pouce, et il faudrait bien que j'essaye ses pâtisseries aux dates aussi.. Mais c'est qu'ils sont tellement bons, ses biscuits! C'est tout petit, vous risquez de manquer la boutique si vous passez vite sur la rue, mais maintenant que vous savez que ça existe y'a plus d'excuses! ;)

Tout est délicieux, fait avec de bons ingrédients bio, charmante propriétaire, petit comme restaurant c'est plus pour acheter et emporter chez vous, je vous souhaite une belle continuité à votre resto, nous avons besoin de gens comme vous afin de continuer à bien manger.

Un peu difficile de manger sur place, mais j'adore leurs plats réconfortants à emporter froid ou chaud. Le seul endrois du quartier ou il est possible d'avoir un jus de carrote frais (à ma connaissance) et quelque viennoiseries à base de farine entière (épeautre).

This place was not very good. It was between here and Tao, & figured since it was in the Palazzo, must be decent & wanted to maybe find a diamond in the rough....didn't happen.

Do Not get the Pho (my mistake in the first place, I had a craving). My girlfriend got the Hong Kong Style Noodles which were so-so, but we could've gone to a cheap Chinese restaurant and gotten so much better. 

This place is a Chinese restaurant w/ less than desireable food for ten times the price. O, & they try to throw some Vietnamese and a few other asian dishes in the mix...my advice: find what you're good at, & stick to that.

Forgot to mention how the service was awful, slow yet impatient, & unpleasant. The large group of asian guys at the table next to us were unhappy as well. I heard them telling the waiter/waitress she got the order wrong, didn't bring out everything they had ordered, brought out wrong dishes, got the bill wrong etc.

Not worth it.

After all the Euro and American cuisine, Chinese food was a welcome change. 

Jade is one of the best in Vegas I've tried thus far.  Better than Noodles @ Bellagio, Red 8 & Wing Lei @ the Wynn.  

Ambiance is nice with comfy booths, dark woods and the hostess gals in the formal red chi paos.  

The bf LOVED the won ton soup, and I enjoyed the Beef Cilantro, which in some circles is referred to as Westlake beef.  Both are pretty small portions and pricey at $8 a bowl.  

Order the dim sum here.  The har gow was flavorful w/o being salty and not greasy.  

The pepper beef was SUPER tender.  It wasn't the pounded mushy sliced beef, it was like cubes of steak meat.  FANTASTIC.  

I would pass on the braised sea bass.  Basically it's a clay pot w/battered fish, fried tofu, shitakes & bok choy.  I don't like fish served this way.  The varieties of fish on the menu are lacking.  

Skip the tea.  LARGE pot, but NO leaves.  It was bland and NOT free.

The meal was over $100 for lunch, ain't cheap.  The server fumbled ONCE when she poured the Fiji water I brought in and left on the table and then charged us.  

I look forward to making many return visits here.

Note to self:  find out if the real way to have dim sum is via the menu, or via carts

At Jade...dim sum is ordered through the menu.  I have to admit, I was a bit skeptical about this place, when a friend suggested it.  However, it was really good!  My cousin and I shared the fried rice, and the chicken dumpling noodle soup.  We all shared some bao, and sio mai (sp?).  I don't know if it was because I was starving, or if it was the food, but that was the best chinese food I've had in a while.  

Reservations are probably best with them, as it does get crowded.

The service?  Well...it's typical.  It wouldn't be authentic, if it were otherwise, right?

It seems that this place is open again!

Noodles with beef and fried rice, can't go wrong.

Nice decor, decent food and prices.

Perfect for a quick bite in between parties or getting ready to go back home.

Cheers!

We had the prix fixe menu that was complimentary for my friends bday. This is some really Americanized Chinese food, which is fine if it tasted good, but extures and flavors were not good at all. The sake was was pretty cheap compared to the prices of the food. Maybe the a la carte items are better, who knows. 

Service was good, very attentive. The place looks nice but kind of too sterile, not much character or charm. It was dead when we were there for dinner and too quiet. 

I won't be back to this joint.

Ok Seriously, if I can give this place negative stars, I would.  We paid $50 for two dishes and they were absolutely horrible.  Mind you, it maybe because we are vegis and they didn't have much vegi options.  However, both dishes tasted exactly the same and it was just like they added steamed veggies on top of the rice & noodles and tasted yuckie. The guy came and asked us how everything was and we did say, horrible.  We barely touched any of our food and decided to get real dinner after we left this place.  I would never go there again because in all honesty, for the prices they charge, when a customer tells you that the food wasn't good, at least attempt to find out if you can fix the situation.  However, it appeared that they were only interested collecting the money, not really making sure they served food that was pallatable for their customers.

So, I would recommend to stay away if you want decent tasting food and good service.  Another thing.... this place really doesn't have "true" asian foods.. maybe has something to do with not having too many people there who know what real Asian food tastes like.  Thanks.

We ate here after the late show of Le Reve and I really enjoyed the food.  First, there are not many restaurants, other than the cafes, open after 11pm.  Jade was more than happy to seat us and we proceeded to order 4 different courses that we shared.  Each one was very tasty and I probably have to say that the black been and beef noodles were the best by far that I have tried in a long time.  The decor is calming with dark red walls and the wait staff was good.  While we were dining there was another customer who walked in, a bit drunk, and proceeded to yell at the waiter and then manager about wanting something unique from the kitchen, that was not on their menu.  Even though she made quite the scene, the staff handled the situation well.  All in all I was impressed and would definitely return.

I really like Jade.  I wouldn't say it's *traditional* dim sum as there are no carts or hard sales on curious looking dumplings - but the dim sum I did order was good.  The crazy thing about Jade is that it's not just Chinese food - they have about every kind of asian food you would like: Chinese, Sushi, Thai - you name it, it's on the menu.  I had a good meal, would have been better had the family at the table next door not decided it was a good idea to change their baby on the bench at their table.  For those of you who think it's cool to change your baby anywhere you are - think again.  It's rude, disgusting and tacky.  Poor baby...

As a brand new restaurant at a brand new casino, they did an "ok" job. 

The restaurant itself is attractive, dark inside with a lot of red accents, looks sort of like Tao inside. Comfortable fixtures and groovy serve ware. Chinese food just seems so much better when it comes on square plates! 


The food was pretty good as well... most everything that was ordered tasted good.. For a party of 5 we ordered a bunch of dim sum items which were all very tasty, chinese doughnuts, some fried rice and pho. The big mistake for the group was the pho noodles. Pho needs to be greasy and ghetto, the pho here is upscale and rather un-ghetto. The mango pudding dessert was excellent. 

The service was obviously new as they forgot a few items, but give them a little bit of time and they'll get it together. I'd go back~!

---------------+------------------
2/17/08 edit

So I went back for more. Much improved. Enough to earn the 4th star. Service was excellent this time around and the food was consistent. Nice job

$16 for a bowl of pho?  are you kidding me?

$14 for a bowl of wonton noodle soup?  (insert another angry comment)

$15 for a bowl of beef noodle soup?

someone take me back to monterey park. hacienda heights. roland heights. where i can get all of the above for less that $15, together.

dim sums are whatever.  
seating was easy at 1pm on a saturday (hmm...)
