One thing I noticed immediately was all the artwork inside. It's quite colorful and I loved it. I was immediately greeted by a staff member who politely asked how she could help me. I looked at all the flavors and was having a hard time deciding. I told her I love chocolate and cookies and asked for a recommendation. She promptly grabbed several tasting spoons and proceeded to allow me to sample many many flavors, including the vegan cookies and cream -- surprisingly delicious!

I went with the blue Cookie Monster ice cream. It's vanilla with lots of homemade, fresh cookies smashed in. To say that it "hit the spot" is an understatement. I got a waffle cone too, which was fresh and yummy. 

Overall, my experience was excellent because I got great customer service and an awesome ice cream. I will definitely be back to Two Scoops soon!

I got a double scoop, because... how can you not at "Two Scoops." Well done, my friends on convincing me to go the extra mile and indulge a little bit.
The staff were PHENOMENAL, and like Crystal H. noted, they were eager to let us sample and make an educated decision on which flavors we had to have. All their ice cream is made in house- you can watch it being made from the outside window.
I was a sucker for the Cookie Monster and as the name indicates, I had to have a dip of "you complete me." 
The scoops were more than generous, and what I loved most was that they packed the ice cream down to the bottom of the cone.

Oh, so yummy! There were three of us tonight so we had to order 3 different flavors and be nice and share. We ordered thin mint crunch, raspberry cheesecake, and Bartman. Of course each flavor had to come in a waffle cone as well! We pretty much fought over the flavors. Really really good ice cream. It has a rich flavor and I just wish that there was a location closer to me!

Honestly, this was a quick run in before work, and I had never been to Two Scoops. What am amazing quick trip! The flavors were varied and the service very friendly. I taste tested the Pralines and Cream, and immediately knew that was THE one. 2 scoops in a bowl later (devastated I had to drive so couldn't get a cone wahhh), the pralines and cream was perfectly creamy. It was full of fresh, tasty pecans, and it. was. delicious. There's was not a single thing worth complaining about at this ice cream shop, and most importantly...the ice cream was divine. I can't wait to come with my husband and be able to relax inside!

Really nice spot to get some homemade icecream , they have many flavors to choose from a various amounts of toppings as well  . I can't remember the icecream name I got , but it was something similar to butter pecan & OMGAHH it was delicious . They have a nice little spot outdoors where you can sit and eat icecream with a street view ! Prices are very affordable , got 2 double scoop ice cream waffle cones for $11 ! My only thing with this place is parking (unless) there was parking nearby that was bigger. But the parking lot is super tight with maybe 20 spaces maximum . Overall I liked this place , will be returning .
Two Scoops Creamery provides delicious homemade ice cream and offers a unique variety of flavors with a friendly and sociable atmosphere. Recommend the Cookie Monster flavor!

Since our mom has been in the hospital for the past four months, my brother and I have been coping with almost daily trips for ice cream after spending the day with her. Two Scoops is the best. I already feel better walking into the store seeing the creative wall artwork and listening to the awesome upbeat background music. The interior is bright and colorful, everything meant to cheer up and brighten one's day. There's a mixture of indoor high top seating, little tot seating, and outdoor picnic tables with benches.

Don't be alarmed when you see a line, that's a good thing, and it moves pretty quickly. The flavors change out regularly, if not on a daily basis. Hence my justification to get two scoops rather than one in case the flavor I'm interested in trying may not be there the next time around. Ok, that only happened once and I barely finished it off since they are pretty big scoops! There's so many to pick from and I haven't been disappointed with any that I've tried so far. Lots of fun and tasty combinations that incorporate pop culture references, e.g. Bartman is a concoction of chocolate ice cream and chopped Butterfinger pieces in honor of Bart Simpson. One of my favorites is the Cookie Monster, a blue ice cream with cookie dough pieces, crushed Oreos, and crumbled Vanilla wafers capturing the essence of my favorite blue Sesame Street cookivore. So so good. Their milk chocolate ice cream is the milkiest and silkiest I've ever had so any of their chocolate ice cream based flavors are excellent (Muddle has Oreos and salted caramel while the Chocolate Krazy Kake has chocolate cake pieces and confetti). I really enjoyed the Thin Mint Crunch which is a mint ice cream with thin mint pieces as well as the Cookies By the Sea, which has salted caramel with Oreos.

Staff are friendly and patient with people who are deciding what to order. Also thankfully nonjudgmental when we keep coming back regularly in frequent intervals...sometimes in stretchy pants. I skip the sampling since any flavor I get is guaranteed to be great.

There just really isn't enough ice cream in Charlotte. Weekend of warm weather calls for ice cream. They have some really cool flavors. I wanted to try something different but had to stick with the standby to make sure this place checks out-- mint chocolate chip. The ice cream is great! Boyfriend got the crunch dozer which has cinnamon toast crunch and our dog finished her vanilla scoop and begged for more. They have a couple of picnic tables outside, which is great.
Amazing!!! This is the best ice cream i have ever tasted! The place is also really nice on the inside, will definitely be coming back!!

The crazy cake was one of the best ice cream flavors I've ever had. The salted caramel was also amazing. I brought 2 friends and they were going crazy about how good the ice cream is here. And the staff are GREAT. This place rocks!

This Place gets an added star because I've been back 2 more times and it's always delicious and the guys behind the counter are friendly even when it's PACKED. Line moves pretty quickly and it's worth the wait.

Maybe I will change my mind after a couple of visits.
I felt the ice cream was lacking flavor (may be due to what I ordered).
Did try my friends ice cream and felt the same way about hers too.
Definitely not on Elizabeth creamery's level but it's a start.
Not bad not excellent

Best ice cream ever!  Fun creative flavors and delicious classics. My personal fave (so far) is Papi Crunch with Cap'n Crunch cereal. Soooo good!  My husband had good ol' classic chocolate and loved it.  Really cute spot, clean, and super friendly staff.  Awesome addition to the the neighborhood. We will be back a LOT!

I got the raspberry cheesecake, & beware one scoop is more than enough! The icecream was soo creamy and yummy! But I tried some of the Cookie Monster & IT WAS BOMB!! Love the fun blue color, & Must try!! They were so so busy, we didn't expect it to be so packed honestly. We had a really hard time finding parking because the lot was supper small, so a tip park across the street at White rabbit(: Really cute icecream shop, to hang out on a nice day & I love the wall art!

I gave up dairy and gluten almost a year ago at the urging of my naturopath. I did it grudgingly because it impacted eating out so much. And how was I going to survive an entire summer without ice cream??? It's un-American I tell ya. Fast forward 10 months and 30 lbs later I survived summer but had tried several store-bought coconut milk, cashew and other type of ice "creams". This is TMI so let me move on. 

So one night hubs wanted a cold sweet treat and we decided to try this new place which is just a mile from our new pad. We walk in to the warehouse-y feeling place and notice on the flavor board there are 4 vegan ice cream options using coconut milk and agave. Dude!! My arms shot up like we got a touchdown. I got to have a treat too. But to be honest I had limited hope that it would be good so I tried a couple. I tried the Sea Salt Chocolate and the Cookies and Cream vegan options. The Cookies and Cream was legit y'all. Seriously amazing. I decided to cheat on the GF because I'm less sensitive than dairy because this was seriously the best non-cream ice cream I've ever had. In fact hubs tried a couple regular flavors and ended up with something good but not as amazing as my Cookies and Cream vegan ice cream! He said he'd order it next time.  The consistency isn't as smooth as typical ice cream on the spoon yet in the mouth it's perfect. Also I've obviously had a lot of coconut ice cream before and this one tasted the least coconutty I've had. Sometimes I don't mind it if it goes with the flavor but this was perfect. Touchdown indeed.

I do have to agree with Camille that the lighting was a little freaky so it doesn't create an appetizing ambiance but that's OK because I'll get it to go or eat outside. We are totally going to be regulars.
I found my favorite ice cream place in Charlotte! Got the "not your mama's pumpkin pie" and it was amazing!

We visited on an early Friday afternoon. It looked closed but it was not. Very open space when you walk in. It is a bit disorienting as the set-up inside is not what you would normally expect for an ice cream place. Kinda has a warehouse vibe.

There is a slew of ice cream options. I went with what I like- chocolate. Dark Chocolate is what was available and I requested a scoop on a cone. My husband had it on a waffle cone. Total came out to $8 and some change.

It was good. I was not blown away but I did enjoy devouring my scoop. 

For those interested, you can submit an ice cream creation and name it for their consideration. A customer's idea was actually created and is now available for all to enjoy.

Definitely check it out.

this ice cream was FANTASTIC. you can tell that a lot of love goes into these ice cream flavors. we got the toasted coconut and the krazy cake. both delicious and creamy sweet treats. the scoops were huge for the price too, it was a great value. we can't wait to make this our weekly ice cream spot.

I've visited Two Scoops twice but I've only been able to enjoy their ice room one time.

The first time they were sold out and owner ran out to explain everything and was very apologetic.

What's to like:

The hours - they are open late!
Rotating flavors - my favorite on a recent visit was the rum raisin
Outside seating

There isn't a ton of ice cream in Charlotte and this is a welcome addition, plus the very friendly service is on point.

I've been here about a dozen times, and love it! 

The ice cream is fantastic! You can have unlimited samples to find your love. As for the decor the outside with the sign painted on the wall has improved  ten fold. It looks really good!! The inside seating and fun paintings are also perfect for this cute little place!  

My Selections:

Strawberry- Incredible and definitely my favorite

Toasted Coconut- incredible first bite, then I felt the coconut was overwhelming the ice cream and way too chewy. 


My friend's Selections:

Heath- completely Devine!! She loves the tinny bits of heath and finds happiness eating it!!

Oreo- Excellent!!
Love this place. GREAT ice cream with flavors my kids are always excited about. The service is always friendly. Thanks for setting up in the neighborhood.

Dear Two Scoops Creamery, thank you for helping to fill the cone shaped void of homemade ice cream options in this town.

This funky ice cream shop is owned and operated by three best friends. Christi K. and I stopped by this afternoon and had the pleasure of meeting one part of the trio, Marques- a lactose intolerant, vegan ice cream lover. Guys, I think he may be a unicorn. He's a really nice guy who learned how to make ice cream from ice family. 

If you're looking for a place that scoops up everyday vanilla and chocolate, this isn't it. The homemade flavors are all so creative and unique. I went with two flavors today- a coffee ice cream packed with oreos and a chocolate ice cream with thin mint cookies. THIN.MINT.COOKIES. Sky's the limit here. They even had an ice cream with crunch berries. Five year old Nikki would want that every single day. 

On top of delicious ice cream, the place is just adorable. The walls are covered with hand painted murals from a local artist. They also have a loyalty program, so be sure to sign up. I would give this place a bonus 6th star solely based on the fact that it's walkable and less than a half mile from my house. Welcome to the neighborhood!

I really hope to update this review soon, because I want to like this place so much! My husband and i came back for a third time (first two times we came, all of the flavors were "out" and the line was out the door-- BUT i will say, i know they had a rough first few days, so i don't hold that against them!)... When we were finally able to get some 'scream, it just seemed average. Especially considering the prices. The flavors weren't very inventive (sure "cookie monster" is a cool name, but i'd love to see chunky pistachio, bourbon caramel, lemon ricotta, etc... flavors that really pique our interest!), and the ice cream flavors my husband and I got were just okay. (Granted, we only had like 6 flavors to pick from)

They should wipe-away the flavor names on their black board and off the glass-freezer windows when they are out. It makes ordering really confusing and stressful, especially when there's so many people in line. 

hopefully these are just a few kinks that the owner will work out in time! (including maybe lowering prices! yikes)
This place is so amazing. The owner is super friendly, and the flavors are all unique and delicious. I will definitely be coming back!

I love this new local creamery! So many fun flavors and a few vegan options, to boot. Definitely try the vegan super dark chocolate. They use coconut milk and it gives the ice cream just a subtle hint of that beachy flavor. Can't wait to try all their flavors!
Love Two Scoops ! One of my fave ice cream spots in CLT ! My boyfriend had a coconut and I had chocolate chip it was sooo good plus what cute name !

The hubby and I stopped in here today for a sweet treat and oh boy, it was DELICIOUS!!!! The employees were so friendly and helpful. We must've tried 10 different flavors before deciding. He went with the Papi Crunch and Capt Jack. I had the Capt Jack and cookies and cream. This was probably the best ice cream I've ever had. Seriously. Do yourself a favor and go there!! You won't regret it!!
Delicious ice cream, but it seems like they are ALWAYS sold out of all the good the flavors!

There's something to be said for keeping things simple and doing it WELL. There's no hiding behind wacky combinations or trendy ingredients - Two Scoops' flavors carry themselves amazingly well without feeling the need to overcomplicate things. We'll definitely be back!
Was here 2 years ago. They've added a sit down bar. Interesting variety of unique salsa. Small place but not cramped. We all tried different tacos. Was fun .

Whhat? I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. It is by far, one of my favorite taco shops in all of Phoenix. Authentic. Quality. Delicious. 

When you first come in you get chips and can start experiencing the amazing salsa bar. Each flavor isn't just thrown together, but put together with thought and care. I have favorites, but they are all pretty tasty.

Follow that up with some amazing food (I personally love the Mayan Cochinita Pibil Taco plate with double rice). Then you can wash it down with a, not-so-traditional, but in a good way Horchata. 

They will then drop the bill off and you will be pleasantly surprised that you had such an delicious, fresh meal for such a reasonable price.
Fantastic, everything on the menu is great and the decor is very nice. Lots of salsas to choose from.

Solid offerings and an excellent salsa bar make this dive taco bar one of the places you must visit in Phoenix.  I haven't frequented other taco bars in the area so I can't comment on how it stacks up.  However, I think if you are charging higher prices for tacos they should include the rice and beans if you order two, or be packed to the brim with filling.  I must admit I was a bit jealous when my brother got his pibil taco, as this seemed to be one of the more filled-tacos on the menu.  The shark was outstanding and had great flavor.  Seating is at a premium so be careful with larger groups. You may just want to get them togo, sit on the curb outside and have yourself an authentic Mexican experience. I'll definitely visit again next time I'm in the area.  I could see myself pouring that Cilantro salsa on some fries to make for an excellent side dish.

Absolutely love this place! Tacos are amazing and salsa bar is creative and diverse (the cashew salsa is truly delicious and there are a number of options to choose from). The gaucho taco is a solid staple with charcoal grilled steak, sliced avocado and pickled onions, and the arrachera taco has subtle complexities of flavor despite its somewhat simplistic presentation. There are also an abundance of other delicious/unique menu options (such as the deep fried Quesadilla for example), and the wait staff is very helpful and kind as well. Would definitely recommend this place to family and friends in search of a local one of a kind hole in the wall Mexican restaurant. Definitely a must try if you are in the area.

OK so I came here to try the Horchata because I saw all the great reviews on it and I am glad I did because it is AMAZING!!! They put just the right amount of ice in it and the bottom has strawberries and it's mixed with a bunch of other yummy fruits such as mangos (i'm not entirely sure what else quite yet... still in the process of drinking lol) and then it's topped with just the right amount of cinnamon.  The only reason why I only gave them three stars is because I have yet to try the food but I will on my next visit and on top of that I tried to call multiple times to place my order and nobody ever picks up the phone which is a no go for me because I'm always on the run!
Best Salsa bar in the valley!  Very creative and delicious.  Just thinking about you guys makes my mouth water.
Shrimp Tacos are out of this world!!! So fresh and tasty. The horchata is great also!

I went here to use a Groupon a couple weeks ago (can't believe I forgot to review it!). We got there fairly early and the place was empty. I found that to be kind of awkward. Anyway, The BF and I both got taco plates. I got the pork and the gaucho tacos. The pork was alright, very tender and the flavor was decent - a little sweet a little spicy, but the gaucho was pretty not good. There was something incredibly sweet about it...I did not like it at all, and I love chimichurri sauce. Their salsa bar is fabulous! I liked the pecan salsa and the tomatillo. I thought the strawberry salsa was odd...not my cup of tea. The salsa was the best part of the meal. I also had the horchata.....I did not care for it. The fruit and nuts in it did not add to the flavor and it was served luke warm...not so good. I do not know that I would go back.

My parents came into town last month, and they always want me to take them out to eat.  I, however, don't go out to eat, so it makes it really hard.  La Condesa isn't far from our house, and I've been wanting to try it, so we went there.  The food was amazing!  Even my mom - who is the pickiest eater I know - liked it!  The different salsas at the bar are great, and the food is delicious.

Great tacos and especially salsas in a somewhat crowded small shop on 16th st. Maybe the best part of the experience is loading up on the salsas from the salsa bar and going to town on warm chips. (My favorite is the peanut salsa). 

They are also really are proud of the chocolate mole which is very unique and something I have not seen at other shops. They mole is great, very flavorful, but also very intense, so make sure you want a hardy meal before ordering a dish with it! Parking can be tight, especially if you come during the lunch hour as there are only a handful of spots outside the building.

The place is very compact. Way too small for my taste so it's not very comfortable to dine in. The salsa bar has good salsas but presentation make sit unappealing. Service took really long but all in all the food was ok. The horchata was really good!

Used to love this place but they expanded and apparently the kitchen can't keep up. I tried to call in an order but the phone just rang continuously. So I went to the restaurant to place my order to go and was informed their phone isn't working. I said I wanted to place a to go order and the guy points to the kitchen and says "see all those tickets up there (there were maybe 7) it's going to be a 45 minute wait for a to-go order." I worked in the food service industry. That is horrible customer service. He then told me I could place my order online through Yelp ($10 delivery fee). I was planning on ordering a mole bowl with a side of beans. All of those items are already prepared and take less than 5 minutes to put together. I took my business elsewhere. Learn how to speak to your customers.

Let me start by saying ..... This restaurant is hyped for NO reason. 
The horchata is definitely a fail in my books. There was too much going on in the horchata that I lost the taste with all the fruit in there including walnuts. It should just be called "Fruit Drink". You can't even get a sip with something coming up your straw. Also ABSOLUTLEY not worth 5$ !!!! FAIL

 To eat I got 3 Tacos (Carne Asada & Chicken Tinga) and rice and beans
The carne asada tacos were basic and tasted the same as any other place . I did enjoy the tinga taco it had a lot of flavor but nothing was good enough that would make me want to come back. 
My boyfriend got a deep fried carne asada quesadilla that he said was "good" but nothing amazing. 

All in All it's all hype 
You can get better tacos and Horchata at Ta Carbon!

I've lived in Phoenix for 19 years and this place is hands down one of the best burrito/taco places around. The Al Pastor here is to die for. Full of flavor and cooked to perfection, you will never be disappointed that you tried it! The chicken tinga is also delicious. The huge salsa bar is very unique and a fun way to spend your time by trying out the different salsas before your food arrives.

Yes, my 3 year old spilled salsa not once not twice but 3 times. Our sever happily cleaned it up all 3 times. 

Probably only 1 or 2 salsas that are mild enough for kids. Ours enjoyed the cliantro one and the Pico de gallo. She tried a few others but immediately downed water and her face turned a little red. She may have grown a little hair on her chest. Our favorite salsas were the peanut and guacamole. 

I had the street tacos. Carne Asada taco was on point. Ranking the 3 I had
1. Carne Asada
2. Al Pastor
3. Chicken

Wish I could tell you about the rice but the girl ate it all, so if she ate it I'm sure you will enjoy it too. 

Next time I need multiple margaritas. Happy hour, anyone?!?!

Nice place decor. Presentation is nice and ordering process is different. 

You grab a menu take a set if you need a moment like I did as a first timer and when your ready you order at the counter and pay which is good to get it done and not have to wait for your bill when your finished eating. 

The girl next to me had a quesadilla and looked good so I decided to try it. It's called la quencha and food presentation was nice topped with cotija cheese, red onions and avocado and green sauce but I did not expect the tortilla to be as thick as it was. It reminded me of a quesadilla chimichanga. I was full fast and the flavor was ok. I think for me next time I will try one of the specialty tacos. 

They have a nice salsa bar with a variety selection . 

Overall it was a nice experience and a nice first try

soOO yummy!! 
the best vegetarian tacos around!! 
fantastic salsa bar too  & the Horchata soOO delicious! mmmm

This place was a 3 until I ate there again this week....and subsequently had one of the best quesadilla's EVER! I had previously only eaten the cochinita taco which is good, but not out of this world. From now on everything I eat at this place will be in "quesa" form... 

This was unlike any quesadilla I've ever had. The tortilla was thick and crunchy and soft all at the same time and had a taste of sweetness to it. Oh man, Delicioso! The chicken tinga was a perfect compliment as well. 

The salsa bar is kind of BS, as there are only a couple of salsas worth your time. The peanut salsa? Give me a break, terrible! But the mexicana salsa is one of the greatest things ever. 

This is a "fine dining" type Mexican place that will knock your socks off and run you about 10 bucks. Check it out if you're in the area, it is definitely worth your time!

I was looking forward to trying this place and was disappointed. Apparently they have recently expanded and could definitely not keep up with the demand. My husband and I ordered two margaritas after we finally got greeted by our server. The margaritas took about 15 minutes to reach us. Food took a very long time also, the servers were doing what they could but they are definitely understaffed. If you are going to expand your location you should also hire more employees to keep up with the demand.

Definitely best gourmet taco place.  We tried street tacos plate and o.m.g., super good.  Thump up for salsa bar with variety of salsa choices. Some are very interesting combination.  House special horchata, one size only,  but worth to try.

The bomb! Huge selection of Sala on the salsa bar, fresh and cool. Some really different and imaginative. The pork was almost like a BBQ, delish The margaritas were delicious and very tasty! I will be back
Food is fantastic!  Service always stinks.  Will keep coming back though.  Food is too good:)
Small place. Great tasty food. Reasonable prices. Will definitely come back for the shrimp tacos!

Order at the counter and decided to try lots. Street tacos were good but not the best I've had. Quesadilla with shrimp and chilies was amazing. Chips and all the salsas were great and the guacamole with cranberries was also very good and a nice change. Margarita was very good. Downside was the paper lined baskets and plastic utensils for eating. I'd go back but didn't leave raving like so many others.

This place easily gets a 5 star for amazing authentic Mexican food - some of the best I've had.  We had a group of 5 and all ordered different dishes - all were extremely flavorful and well prepared - difficult to choose the one we all liked best.  The service was barely a 3.  People were nice but we didn't see our water much and took long to get a drink, the check, etc

Ok, I finally got a chance to come back with some coworkers. They changed their format. The first time I was there, it was go to the counter order and they give you a number. They have waiter service this time. I got the Sonora Arrachera Quesa (Oaxaca cheese & char-broiled Arrachera steak). It was so good and too much for me to finish. I looks at my fellow lunchers and their tacos looked so GOOD. The salsa bar is filled with all sorts of varieties. I tried the strawberry salsa, too sweet for my taste... but more to favors to try!

This place was great. Started with the guac which was probably the best I have ever had. The party I was with had a combination of tacos, burritos and sandwiches ... All which were winners. Too bad I love so far away it this would be a go to place.

Smallish, but very interesting tacos and burrito place. Larger portions than I expected - two tacos with rice and beans was plenty. But I forgot to post this when I first wrote it and I can't remember the details. But I really enjoyed it.
Cochinito tacos are so tender and tasty!!  Not your run of the mill Mexican.  This pleasures the palate!! Unique and fantastic.  I will be making the drive to La Condesa again!

Taco Tuesday !! Omg perfect .. Have the street tacos if you can't decide .. I had the cochinita pibil, al pastor and carne asada.. 

Loaded up at the salsa bar.. They have so many options and all were delicious.. Tried for the first time the strawberry salsa, which I drank like a shooter (yum!) and the jicama salsa was really good, you could eat this like a side salad, nice crunch!! 

Jamaica was served in a huge to go cup.. Thumbs up..

Get here early this place has a small dining area and it fills up fast !! Worth the wait though!!

Food if excellent; unique and yet authentic flavored. It's all oversized burritos and quesadillas (corn masa and fried, excellent!) as well as many variety of tacos. Well worth the $, and the margaritas are excellent to match with some unique offerings. The  tamarind is a good one.

Overall, a great experience. 

Friendly customer service. The server talked to us for a good while, telling us the whole Guy Fieri story. 

Good food. I ordered my usual Carne Asada burrito. No complaints there.

Fantastic salsa. Yes, a whole stand with several different and innovative salsas to choose from. From strawberry to peanut butter to mango, that really was the highlight of our visit.

I recommend this place to all Mexican food lovers.
Hands down, best tacos in town.  The salsa bar is the bomb!

I really wanted this place to be good, the reviews certainly make you think its going to be, we went here twice, the first time our food was under whelming and service was ok and the atmosphere was fun.  We always try and give a place two tries before never going back or writing a so so review, so visit two was actually worse than the first visit. Tried various street tacos, no seasoning, meats dried out, and service was so so.  This will not be a place we try a third time, there are to many other great places in Phx.  I wish them luck, I hope it was just two bad days, and we happened to show up both times.

Tried out this little place after trying their new location in Glendale. Man is this place small! There's limited parking up front and the whole restaurant can fit in my backyard. BUT the food is still as wonderful and delicious as ever! 

We arrived after going to Comicon and where immediately greeted and told the wait time. Once someone vacated a table, it was cleaned quickly for the next person. Our food came out at a reasonable time and so worth the wait! Our server was very friendly  and gave us some delicious suggestions. I would definitely come back! 

Just be careful where you park because during rush hour, you won't be able to get out easily.
Great stop after getting off the plane from the airport. We were looking for something casual and delicious and this place at the spot. Great mole tacos and gordito burritos.

So, mi media naranja and I were flying out of Phoenix early in the morning: we were headed to Boston for a couple of weeks. I didn't want to get up at the butt-crack of dawn to drive up to PHX from Tucson, so we decided to stay the night close to the airport. Of course the normal "what do you want for dinner" conversation started, and we decided we wanted some good Mexican food before we left the desert Southwest. Yelp led us here; when was the last time you saw a 4 1/2 star review with 500-some odd reviews?

Those 4 1/2 stars weren't lying. The salsa bar is ridiculously fantastic! Strawberry salsa? Yes please! I had four helpings of the robano pibil salsa. Chips were sorta warm, nothing incredible; the real star was the salsa. I ordered a couple of al pastor tacos and a Mayan Cochinita pibil. The pastor was delicious, and the Mayan taco?? The pork was mouthwateringly tender and perfectly seasoned. I felt sad when my plate was empty. 

My better half had the cabo shrimp taco, which she didn't seem super excited about. The mole taco, however, got her talking; incredibly, she shared a bite with me. I agreed; it was phenomenal. 

Service was fast and courteous. I'd take off 1/2 star for using the restrooms as a storage area for extra dining-room chairs. Kinda gross. Overall, though, it was excellent and I am glad we went!
I enjoyed this place.  Pretty good food and interesting decor.  Not the usual "Mexican" place so come in with an open mind.
Everything here is delicious...  from the salsa bar to the quesa to the horchata to the street tacos...  I don't think you can go wrong.

Yum, tacos... Ok the thing that stood out the most was how fresh everything was. The salsa bar..a definite plus... I love a good salsa... My favorite the Strawberry Salsa.  Wholy cow was that good! The quesadilla was bigger than I've ever seen I couldn't finish it!!  Loved, loved loved the artwork, The only negative I could find was that the furniture for some reason felt a little awkward like I was in everyone's way while they were trying to get in line to order, but that really has nothing to do with the food.  I'm givin' this place a thumbs up... authentic and delicioso!

The best horchata and salsa bar ever!! When you come here, you have to try the horchata, unique and oh so tasty. Also, I'm a salsa lover, I love to make it, I love to indulge in it, salsa is my middle name.  So when I come here, its always the best part of the meal. My favorite is the pecan salsa, so creamy and not what you would expect a pecan salsa to taste like.  The burritos are delicious as well and I've had the tacos too, everything is so eye appealing as well as tasty! I wish the restaurant was a bit roomier, but it stays consistent in the number of people coming in and doesn't get overcrowded. I wouldn't recommend to big parties. But overall I love this place and recommend you try it out.
Best Mexican food in town!! Their traditional Quesadillas are delicious and are the Chicken Mole tacos & Al Pastor tacos!!!!! This is making me hungry now!!!

Thee best tacos and salsa bar in Phoenix, hands down. Service, not so much. I went about an hour before they closed one night, completely full house cleard out about 30 min before closing. With 30 min till closing they started cleaning up, turned off music and brought us the check. Kinda irritating to feel kicked out after I spent money at your establishment....but ill just have to go earlier I guess.

We got there...there was a wait...it was so crowded that some people had to stand to eat their food and it was soooo damn worth it.

From the folk Mexican art depicting Santo and Freda Kahlo's uni-brow to the leather and rough wood La Condesa is as much a treat to the eyes as to the nose and mouth.

We are so used to fiery Tex-Mex here in Arizona that it is hard to believe that there is another side to good Mexican food....a delicacy of flavor that counts on subtle textures and refreshing herbs and vegetables to cool our palates and the heat of Southwest days.

I tried every one of the salsas available on Saturday and I can still taste the peanut salsa while I dream of the strawberry salsa (and the cilantro cream salsa and the chipotle...you get the picture).

We split the dogfish and carne asada tacos along with a mahi burrito and were too stuffed to make our way any farther down the menu, guaranteeing we'll be back for more.

Any complaints? Only the smallest of one....I actually prefer water to soft drinks with my meals and appreciate a reasonably sized cup (I promise I won't steal the Coke). I was given an 8oz styro cup filled with ice, necessitating several trips to the counter to ask for more. Totally rediculous since the soft drink dispenser is behind the counter and I couldn't rip them off if I wanted to ;-) ....and yet another styro cup waiting over a thousand years to biodegrade in a landfill.

La Condesa is what a good taqueria should be, just make sure to weedle a paper cup out of the cashier if you quieres agua.

La Santisma was our first stop upon arriving in Phoenix. It was over 100 degrees outside and my family, bf and I were hungry. I was craving street tacos and found this place on Yelp! The Argentinian steak and the dog shark tacos were my favorites. The salsa bar was awesome as I laid out different types of salsa in front of my plate. The best part was sipping on a huge drink of horchata! I also admired the Mexican paintings on the walls. The restaurant was small, packed, busy and worth the wait.

The Margaritas were delicious!!..but, I don't see myself coming back. We were a big party when we arrived but there were tables and chairs available to combine however, we still had to wait to be seated and there were no other new guests coming in at the time. Also, the wait to receive our food was WAAY to long. 

The food was overall pretty good but I didn't find it as "the best I've had" especially not for their prices.
I am a bean and cheese FANATIC and this place is it! I will absolutely be back and the servers were exceptional as well!

For those who are less adventurous I'm telling you to get over the rough look of the neighborhood and go eat!  The food is fresh and excellent every time.  Yummy horchata that my 2 year old loves.  The salsa bar is fun as well. This is our second time and we are already planning our next visit.

The food is excellent. The salsa game is strong. Do not go to this shop if you are in a hurry quality takes a little time.
All of their margaritas are $5 all day Tuesday. There house margarita is one of the best margaritas I have ever had.

Great food. Tiny hole in the wall. We went for our first time on a Sunday about 430pm. Didn't think it would be busy since it was a little to early for dinner and late for lunch but we're we wrong. Had to wait only a minute or so for someone to leave and a table to open up but this place had people coming in non stop. My wife and I split 6 different tacos that the waiter recommended. All very good. Favorite two were the steak called something else and the shrimp. Those two were unbelievably good. Steak was super tender and shrimp tasted very fresh. Very well seasoned. The other tacos we tried were all good too but not as good as the two listed above iny my opinion. We both also had their house Margarita which was fantastic. Definately will come back. My new favorite mexican place for tacos.
Been there not so much anymore s***** food was great people think they know what they're doing not so much

Now we're talking! There is a reason this place gets rave reviews and multiple "Best of" awards. This authentic Mexican food, no Tex-Mex here. Incredible offerings and a blending of flavors you'll be hard-pressed to find elsewhere.

We've been to both locations, but for whatever reason, prefer the 16th Street location over the Glendale location. Same food, same wonderful service - just personal preference.

Tacos: Al Pastor, Carne Asada, Oaxacan Black Mole, Chicken Asado. All excellent, super flavorful, seasonings not overpowering and well presented. The mole is probably the best I've ever tasted. Hint of cinnamon/spices, chocolate & chilies. Just the right blending of flavors to bring you back for more. Looking for something out of the box? Try the Arabe Burro. Al Pastor pork with hummus lettuce, cucumber and even some Tzatziki! Very refreshing. They also offer quite a number of vegetarian offerings.

La Santisima also boasts a homemade salsa bar unlike any you've seen. This really gives the customer the opportunity to try flavors and you just may find you've discovered a new favorite! The salsa made with peanuts is very good - really! And don't forget the adult beverage - the hand made house margarita is very good, too!

Restaurant is very unpretentious. Small in size. Glendale location has parking in the rear, street parking in Phoenix.

Neither location is close by our neighborhood, but worth the drive for great food.

I was totally blown away with La Santisima. 

The salsa bar was top notch. Over a dozen to choose from, each delicious. The pico de gallo was some of the best I've had. A creamy guacamole and a cilantro sauce were highlights as well. 

The tacos were phenomenal. Each topped with salsa and garnish that complimented perfectly. Even the beans and rice were incredible. So much flavor in such traditionally simple sides. 

The interior is fun and quirky, decorated with luchadors, sugar skulls and other interesting Mexican art.

I have enjoyed La Condesa numerous times. I am stuck on the La Condesa Shrimp tacos. Awesomely fresh and I love the spinach instead of lettuce. Beer is cold, service is slow, but very good. Before my trip last week I would have ranked at least 4 stars, but the shrimp were NOT deveined. Not only mine, but my friend who went with me. I had 2 shrimp tacos & she had one with a carne asada. She loved the carne asada. I don't know that I can eat the shrimp again...what a bummer.

Great Food! The numerous fresh made salsas at the salsa bar we all flavorful and tasty, even when they brought the heat.  That is how I judge a good salsa. If you bring the heat ... The flavor better be there too!  Really liked the Salsa Pecan!

The fried quesadillas are wonderful. Loved the Al Pastor.  The burritos are well portioned and full of meat 

They need to work on servers being more attentive.  Even when they are "in the weeds."  They were obviously down a person given the way tables were not getting cleared quickly.

Really great Mexican food in Phoenix.  I highly recommend that you visit.  Everything I tried was fantastic.  We shared the Queso dip with Chorizo (which came with thin "tortillas", which felt very traditional).  The 1/2 order of guacamole we shared was extremely tasty.  They throw in some dried cranberries to liven up the flavor and texture profile.  Per other Yelp reviewers' recommendations, we shared the giant horchata; 1/3 of an order was the perfect amount for me, and their twist of it with fruit bits was a nice departure from the traditional horchata.  

I ended up getting the gourmet Mayan Pibil taco and one of the food truck style tacos (but can't remember which protein).  They were both fantastic, and the perfect amount of food.  I really enjoyed the expansive salsa bar with over a dozen varieties of salsa.  It was fun to try most of them.  My girlfriend ordered the Quesa which was ginormous; with the chips and queso that we shared, she barely touched the quesa, it was so big, but it looked delicious.

I'd definitely come back to visit next time I'm in Phoenix.  I'm confident they won't disappoint!

This is the greatest Mexican restaurant I've ever been to.  The salsa bar offers more choices than I've ever seen.  The meat was perfect.  Even the rice was filled with flavor--which was a real surprise since I don't remember ever having rice I could actually taste.  And the margarita was much better than anything I can remember.

Outstanding food at reasonable prices  in a non-pretentious atmosphere.  What more could someobody want?  I'll certainly come here again the  next time I'm in the area.

After Dos Molinas (food is spicier) this is my second favorite Mexican Food place. Lots of variety.  I have only had real mole at two places, unfortunately, their version did not grab my taste buds (probably why there is your favorite potato salad (in my case my mom's) and everything pales in comparison). I avoid lines, by eating early say around 3pm.
My favorite place to take people for tacos. Great vegetarian options as well as great variety of traditional and contemporary Mexican food. It's small inside but the service is quick.

Is this real? Are they serious with this? The ambiance was small, cozy, and art was hung on the wall that was really very good. Unbelievable service and food. All the salsas at the bar were stellar and my shark tacos were dynamite. I'm kind of a sucker for rice and beans and I think it's hard to mess up but I've still had some awful rice and beans at some other spots. Luckily, this place had some of the best I've had in a while. The prices were great, helped by a wonderful happy hour. I will be coming back for more because everyone loves tacos and La Santisima does tacos well.

Have to eat here when I'm in Phoenix. Delicious, especially the salsa bar. I went back so many times, that I told the waiter just to bring me a soup bowl and a spoon. Who knew my favorite was the radish salsa? Not me.  The quesadillas are like none other: made with fresh corn masa, kind of puffy, and loaded with your choice of filling.  La Santisimima, mi corazon, I'll see you in November.

I went for breakfast on Sunday.  The huevos ahogados were an absolute life changer.  I recently relocated from Dallas to Phoenix, and was looking for a change of pace, as far as Mexican food is concerned.  This place is so authentic and the people there are really helpful.  

This place is now a staple in my short list of amazing spaces.

This place has at least 3 different names: La Condesa on Yelp, La Santisima on the front of the building, and Santa Santisima on the menu.  Call it whatever you want, just find the place.  It's so good, my friends and I came here twice during our trip, on the word of some locals we met at JoBot Coffee.  It's a really small place, so expect a wait unless you happen to get lucky and pop in at a slow time.  The guacamole is stupid good, as are the shark and pork tacos.  If you're really hungry, skip the 2 taco platter (just adds rice and beans) and get a third taco, or order the guac.

Good tacos that are large in portions and progressive on taste (not your typical sauces)  with an even better salsa bar.    Reminds me of a high end mexican place with the prices to match.   As a result, I would highly recommend you to visit this place for the food.

OMG! Second time I've been here and will try to go everytime I'm in Phoenix! Most incredible flavors, fresh, wonderful salsa bar - can't say enough about this little place that you could miss if you simply driving up or down 16th St.  Don't miss it!!

Had a wonderful lunch yesterday. My daughter who works at a hospital nearby took us to this small restaurant with great quality food. Try several different sauces that are available to choose from a "sauce bar".  I highly recommend the quesadilla which is more like what I call a Mexican calzone. You may have to wait for a table, but it is well worth it.

My husband's choice. He loved it.  I, on the other hand, thought it was just ok. For a taco shop, it's a bit overpriced.  I think our total meal came out $40-$50 and we didn't have any alcoholic beverages.  I've had better in Phoenix for the prices (Barrio Cafe) and would rather visit a real taco shop and eat for $10 than go back.  That being said, the staff is very nice and the food was good.  Their salsa bar is very enticing.

Really good food, decent sized portions and good customer service. A tad bit high priced, $30 for two people and only one beer. However the hotchata was so amazing it made it all worth it....there are nuts and fruit in it, what?! I can eat my delicious horchata as I drink it? Yes please.
Holy *%#*!!! The mole is legit! Best I've ever had. Everything else is also quite tasty, but the mole is what's to write home about.

I used to really like this place, But I always seem to get bad service. Now that they expanded it seems worst. I came to dinner tonight and it took 15 minutes just to get water and chips. We finally were able to order and we both had the quesadilla with meat. We had to ask for napkins, silverware and more water. Our food was made wrong, didn't have what the menus said it did. There was tiny pieces of meat. Not sure I could even use the word tiny. There basically was no meat inside. It was over loaded with cheese. There was No flavor to it at all. We were never greeted on how everything was. So I never got a chance to change my order. I was just greeted with the check faster then the service in this place. I was extremely unhappy to pay for shitty service and bad food.

This is one of the best mexican restaurant that I know of. I was visiting Phoenix for a week. I had bookmarked this place because lots of "vegetarians go nuts for it".

On the first night in Phoenix, my friend and I drove here for dinner at 8 PM. Neighbourhood is very quite/rundown/sketchy. However, the restaurant was fully packed. Just when we entered through the door, everyone looked at us. May be this is what people in Phoenix do. It felt a little weird as if we were crashing someone's party. We were seated at a table just emptied by someone else. That table was not very clean.

We got a basket of chips and started getting salsas. I was in salsa heaven. I like spicy food. This place serves it very well. We ended up ordering their La Santisima burritos and quesos. Another order of chips. Decided to come back again before we go back from Phoenix. I liked the burrito better than the queso.

I don't want to spend more time in Phoenix. However, this will be go to spot for one meal when I am there. Definitely worth the wait and experience. Price is very reasonable.

If you come to Phoenix and don't eat here you are missing out on life!!!! I have never had Mexican food like this. I had the shark taco and a Marlin burrito!!!! Life changing is not a bold enough statement. I'm a foodie and this place is incredible. Please come here!!!!!!  The salsa bar alone is worth the visit. It is cheap in price only. Everything about the place is magical. It looks a little scary from outside and at night the sign is not lite up but we took a chance, and it was one of the best choices in eatery I've ever made. Salsa Guacamole is to die for!!! THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING LA SANTISIMA!!!!!!!!
Really good street tacos, the spicy chicken and spicy pork were awesome! Def a true az Mexican taco shop! Will be back again for sure!
If you haven't eaten at this place, you're missing out! The tacos are some of the best in the valley. Not much seating and fills up fast, but well worth the wait.

we love fish tacos, but find it hard to find good, "authentic" ones near our house without paying scottsdale prices. i've heard of La Condesa, but since it's out of our "circle of convenient driving distance" we never think of it. 

thanks to the wife, we were all set to meet some friends here last night. we first noticed that is an actual sit-down restaurant. i assumed with all the hype, it would be a grungy, post-soviet area looking eatery (re: carolina's), but no....it was nice inside, replete with some beautiful dia de los muertos paintings. 

we had to wait about 30 minutes for a table to open up. once seated, we were brought a jug of water and some chips. then the fun began! trying out each one of the approx 15 salsa's at their salsa bar. i liked many of them, but wound up going back to the traditional salsa and pico. of note, the cilantro, pecan, and strawberry salsa's were good, but only for a few dips. 

i ordered one each of the shark, the shrimp, and the veggie tacos. they are small but packed with flavor. so juicy, they come stacked on 2 small corn tortillas. i actually savored the veggie and the shrimp instead of wolfing them down. both very tasty with that mexican sauce they put on them, and the fried shrimp were perfect...not caked in batter, but just a light dusting. i didn't get to the shark ones because i was so full, so it's in our fridge waiting to be eaten. i also ordered a margarita...it was rather delicious!

there are so many choices of tacos, burritos (with/without the tortilla) and fajitas...and several for veg heads. it's difficult to pick 2...which is why we must definitely go back!!!!!

My boss bought the office lunch today, and la Santisima was the chosen place.
I ordered the La Condesa Veggie Quesa. The portion is huge! It was pretty tasty. But I wish there had been far more veggies. I regret not asking for a side of salsa. 
While a deep fried quesadilla is a novel idea, it was just too heavy and greasy. We ordered take out so had I known it was fried, I would have picked something else. 
I'll definitely give it another try since all my co-workers loved their tacos and burros.

What a cute little place! It's hard to not notice it when driving by :) I had the shark and beer battered fish tacos and they satisfied my craving. First time trying shark though! Love the salsa bar! lots of variety to choose from. Would love to come back and try other options on their menu next time I'm in the area!
My only complaint was the guacamole was not how I typically prefer it. Otherwise, this was delicious food and we loved all the salsa choices! There were so many and each one was delicious.
The perfect place to introduce yourself to less well known dishes of Mexico. Leave the usual fajitas behind and take advantage of their varied menu. Everything on that menu is great.

I saw the good reviews on here and decided to try it today. I was not a fan of the food at all. I left hungry because I decided not to eat my street tacos, they were still bleeding from the meat. My 3 year old loved his quesadilla though. It can be that I'm use to more authentic mexican food. I would have rather stuck with my instinct and went to salsita or El Taquito. This food is for people who has never tasted good mexican food. I wouldn't recommend this place to a hungery latino. Also its not kid friendly. Very very small inside. Everyone that left didn't look happy for some reason.

I loved the ambiance and the different salsas but the food could've been seasoned a lot more. I ordered one of the veggie burro and it had great potential, just lacked seasoning until I added salsa. I will definitely be trying this again though.

Do like to try new salsas? Do you love Mexican food?? Well then this restaurant is the store for you. I came upon this hidden gem by mistake, what drew me in was the nice piece of art of a lady on the front of the restaurant. Walking in it's very small but, don't let that discourage you from eating there. Starting of they have different types of salsas the peanut salsa, pecan salsa, and many more. First I thought ewww peanut and pecan salsa?? I was so wrong don't judge a book by it's cover the salsas where delicious! I ordered the shark tacos omg they where yummy I was licking my fingers lol and didn't care who saw I was happy enjoying my plate. With the plate came beans and rice, the rice was moist and soft. One thing have to applaud is the lady that was our server I totally should of asked for her name she needs to be recognized on top of being a friendly employee she also has integrity. Let me explain, so I basically ate and left on my way home I was looking for my most precious thing ugh oh my cell phone where is it?? We all know that scary sad feeling. To make things short I went back to the restaurant and who was there at the cashier greeting me with a smile and raising my phone up high the wonderful employee! So YES I totally recommend going here the restaurant, the employees, and even the food totally 5 stars.
You can tell they take care in preparing the food here. The meats are tender and the sauces and spices are to die for!
Man this place is BOMB. They have a ton of salsas. I highly recommend it.

YOU MUST GO HERE. The salsa bar was so good! I kept getting up to try pretty much every one, and refilled on the strawberry salsa! My waiter helped me pick a combo if three different tacos and I really appreciated it because they were so good! Don't be deterred from the image of this place, its local, its homey and probably one of the best mexican restaurants I have been to - and I am from Texas!
Decent to good food but expect to wait and wait lol if I was only rating on service I would rate them a 1 star. I have been 3 times and I'm done !

Delicious margaritas, excellent salsa bar, local business.....the trifecta of restaurants.  I like that it is small inside and eclectic.  The guacamole is amazing as are the white fish tacos.  Really, you can't go wrong.  Close your eyes and point to a menu item....it will be awesome whatever comes out of the kitchen.

This place was difficult to find because it was night time and I believe their sign is suited more for the daylight. It is a small restaurant with some very authentic details, which were really cool. The door is the old Mexico style (very popular in New Mexico) and the bar is really beautiful carved wood. They restroom in the back have awesome art on them, and the door for the mens bathroom is labeled "Santos" with a painting of El Santo on it. (Old time famous Mexican wrestler my father looked up to and actually my Grandfather had the pleasure of wrestling many years ago.) This was very cool for us. 

The food is really REALLY good! I loved my tacos! I tried the Chicken Mole, and mine was some sort of slow roasted pork with a hint of sweet. (I can't remember the name, but it was toward the bottom of the menu.) 

The people were nice, but we waited a very long time for our food. My biggest turn off was that it felt a little TOO authentic when our food came to us on real traditional Mexican pottery style plates. They seemed to be very old terra-cotta with the paint chipping off the rim of mine. I couldn't help but feel that they might not be lead free. Don't get me wrong, I still enjoyed my food 100% but I think it would be a little better if they upgraded to some ceramic.

This is one of our all time favorite Mexican food restaurants and they recently expanded their menu to include a TON of vegetarian and vegan options, which makes me incredibly happy.
I have a soy allergy, so finding Mexican food that I can eat is difficult and so the fact they do not use it in their food (and they make their own tortillas!) is amazing enough, but the high quality of their options and the wonderful flavors they offer blows my mind.
Not to mention their huge salsa bar! We love spicy salsas and they do not disappoint. The strawberry salsa is game changing.

Absolutely amazing tacos here.  The best part is that you can order tacos a la carte, so you can try several types in one meal.  There is an option to do a taco llate, two tacos with a small side of rice and beans.  I'd skip this option.  The sides were quite small.  If you're hungry go for another taco or perhaps a side of chips and explore the free salsa bar.

You must order at the register.  You are given a number so they can bring out your food.  This is all fine and dandy until you have to find a table.  La Santisima is quite small and has very few tables inside.  We had to stand, basically hovering over people who were eating, and leap at the first table to open up.  I'd say it would be obvious to follow etiquette and let those who ordered before you grab a table first, but we all know not everyone is that poliet.  

They do offer to-go orders if you don't want to wait for a table. I'd also recommend that La Santisima invest I outdoor seating to aleviate some of the indoor congestion.  I'll keep my fingers crossed for my next visit.

There were 4 empty tables open......and plenty of people waiting to be seated......this lasted for over 20 minutes. The staff just kept staring at us, leaving dirty empty tables. 

We finally Sat down after an hour of waiting. No water for 20 minutes. They finally come by to give us 1 glass of water and chips (80% crumbs) and they didn't come back to take our meal order for 17 more minutes. 

Over 2 hours of being in the restaurant, they tell me they have no more horchata. Wtf.  8pm on a Saturday???? No sorry but we ran out of what you already ordered and have been waiting on.....nothing. Everyone around us had one. Even people who showed up after us. 

Finally gave us our food---which ended up tasting pretty good.....but NO UTENSILS. I had to get up, go to the front and ask for some. Duh. 

Then our bill came and they charged us for the horchatas that we didn't even get. 

Absolutely horrible. They were so rude. I will not be going back.
Their tacos are fantastic!  Margaritas fantastic.  Seating could use some help. Crowded, Too many taters in the bag.

Oh my. This place is delicious. The food was amazing and fresh. Legit mexican food. Food came fast and the quesadilla/queso thing will now be included on my last meal menu. The whole ordering/getting a table was confusing but we just followed the herd. Would def rec'd going off peak hours and don't come with more than 4 people.
Great food and salsa bar. Get there early or late for lunch. I've been there five times had different items each time and loved them. Mole is awesome.

Love love love this place..... I am in town with my fam vacating for a week... MY husband found this place in yelp. When arriving, didn't know what to think of it... From outside doesn't look that much of a restaurant and going inside it is too small of a space. Only 2 servers working 12 tables... 

I had Gaucho Burro, it was more than enough.. Perfect portion. And I recommend trying the horchata too. 

Authentic Mexican food!! Tasty food, and nice servers. Simply this place is officially my favorite new place...

I'm in town from a place where we don't have Mexican food (how could I live in such a place?). We went to three taco shops in three days. This was the best - rich flavors and tortillas which held up to salsa!! My friend had a Norteno green chile burro - she couldn't stop talking about it, either. I can't wait to go back on my next visit to AZ!

This place has to get all five stars. Ok, the area is a little suspect I will admit; that can be countered with the excellent food and excellent prices. This is the kind of food that goes for $12 - $15/plate if it were located in an upscale area.  They have done a great job with the interior and the food is really wonderful.

5 Top reasons I love La Condesa:
 ~ Beautiful food. Unique flavors. 
 ~ Great salsa bar: aver a dozen lovely hand made salsas; I liked them all
 ~ Price: you can spend under $7 and have a really good meal
 ~ Convelient: It is only a 2 minute drive from 24th & Camelback.
 ~ Atmosphere: the interior and the service create a great place to dine.

***We eat out several times a week, and this place is now at the top of the list for my wife and I both.***

My most absolute favorite place to eat! The chicken quesadilla is my favorite and pairs the best with an ice cold Corona and a handful of different salsas to dip their awesome chips in. I love the cilantro salsa as well as the chipotle, but they are all so amazing! 
The quesadillas are huge and I always have leftovers even though I stuff myself because it's so tasty. 
This place is one you cannot pass up!

BEST HORCHATA EVER!  I've never liked horchata, but I was told this was the best of the best and I absolutely had to try it.  So, I did and I am SO glad that I did.  I would go back for the horchata alone.  Amazing.  I'm already planning a trip back just for the horchata!

I get the 3 street taco combo with rice and beans.  I've had the carne asada, al pastor and cochinita.  The carne asada was delicious and the cochinita was good, but my absolute favorite was the al pastor.  It's the best al pastor taco I've ever had!

The salsa bar is awesome.  My favorite is the tomatillo and my friend loved the chipotle.  It has something for everything and it's all fresh.

All in all - a great little place (emphasis on little - probably not great for a large ground of people).  The food is authentic and very, very good - I'm pretty sure you can't go wrong here.

We were driving around starving and stopped here. Seems they are famous for salsa and tacos. It was really crowded. That's a good sign. The tacos were freshly made and good. The salsa was great. Wish I could take it home. We tried a variety of sauces and wanted to buy one of each. It was fun just taste testing. Worth the trip.

Excellent food.  We ordered 4 different kinds of tacos and all were simply superb.  You must hit the salsa bar in the back wow there are some great creations back there.  We must have made 5 trips.  Service is super friendly and fun.  Margaritas not bad.  Come for the food the decor is fun but overall not over impressive. When back in Phoenix I'll be back soooo good!
Amazing food. Everything we tried was good.  Had the best horchata of my life, which has fruit bits and deliciousness in it. Great salsa bar. All around goodness.

A coworker introduced me to this place.I went to their Glendale location. There are a lot of different types of tacos with very different types of fish and meats you just don't find anywhere else. The salsa bar has a wide variety of salsa's with varying amounts of heat. My only con and I took away a star for it was service. It was sooo slow. Even to pay the bill I eventually had to get up and find someone to get the bill. Overall I really like this place and would recommend it.
Unbelievable tacos... Some of the best I have ever tasted.  I recommend the pork and carbs asada.   Service and employees were friendly.   Highly recommend

Tried the tacos and their unique quesadillas. Two thumbs up - though my waistline might not appreciate too many of those fried quesadillas, lol. They'll have to be a treat - not a regular thing for me.

Their salsa bar is a lot of fun. Be prepared to spend some time sampling all of them.

Gotta love the dia de los muertos decorating. Unique!

Excellent stop for tacos and salsa's. Food is incredible - however I only gave one star due to price- probably because of the popularity and demand it is not necessarily cheap and there is no kids menu. But it truly excellent food and worth it. It could be inexpensive if you only by
one or two tacos a la carte. I didn't experience too long of a wait on my visit.
If this is ur first time, order the La Santisima Specialty tacos with carne asada. You're welcome. That salsa bar though....

Monday for lunch and people were waiting out the door. They mentioned 20 min, first time there not from AZ but BF said food is amazing.  We waited 10 min tops sat down.  Place is small but staff is working hard to get everyone in and served.  Right away you just notice how happy the people are to be there.  
I ordered the burrito special with shrimp and a Jamaica agua.  I was starving went I went in but could only finish half of the huge burrito. Partly because do the chips and delicious salsa bar.  Definitely coming back when back in town.

My favorite taco place in Phoenix! Some people complain about the prices but I'm from the east coast where the prices are similar and the tacos aren't even on the same planet as these.

You can definitely get buy with three tacos, four if you're super hungry like I always am and feast in all the deliciousness! The salsa bar is fantastic here as well as the guacamole. 

Ignore the fact that they've been on Food Network and have gotten a bit more touristy; the food is still legit and isn't that all that matters? So stop by, have a margarita and chow down on some delicious tacos.

This place is hands down a hidden gem. Food is always amazing. Don't forget to order the 
Horchata! It is the best in town.

A huge selection of gourmet and street tacos.  The variety of fish options appeared to be a huge hit with other options, but we particularly enjoyed the cochinita and carne asada tacos. Decent prices, and fun to try the different salsas from their large salsa stand. Beware it gets quite busy during Saturday lunch, and the seating is a small area. Prepare for a short wait during peak hours or go during off hours. We will probably be back again.
I grew up in Arizona and this is the best horchata I have ever had. Salsa bar is fun and free. Artwork is gorgeous.

Strawberry salsa?? I've never heard of such a thing....but damn it's good! It's like chips and salsa...for desert! Fish tacos were on point, flavorful and plentiful. Topped it off with a premium margarita and I tell you what, that was the best meal I ever had! Now, for a place that has such good food, they got no where to sit. There is like 4 tables here and the bar, so try and go here during a not-so-popular time during the day to eat. Being able to sit back and enjoy all the food here is well worth it. The art on the walls are cool too.

Simply my favorite tacos in Maricopa County. We've sampled several different types and they all were amazing! Great for lunch and we got quick service. They also took our large family group even though the space is limited. You should go.

This little Phoenix gem delivers everything you want from fine Mexican dining without all the touristy bullshit. The exterior has classic Dia De Las Muertas tile work and the interior is rustic, intimate and clean. The menus and prices are simple and excellent and the food is phenomenal.

The salsa bar is one of the best I have ever experienced. At least 12 different salsas. All different and all excellent, and I believe, made on the premises. We had, Pecan, Peanut Butter, 7 Chili, Mexicano, Pico de Gallo, and Cilantro salsa. If variety is the spice of life, what is a variety of spices?

The absolute, takes the cake reason for 5 stars is the Horchata! I am a fan of Horchata. I have never had Horchata like this! 32 ounces with what must have been muddled strawberries and apples and fresh ground cinnamon. So good, so good.

Not sure how to follow Julie P.'s epic review, but I thought I'd show some support.

La Condesa is a fantastic addition to Central Phoenix. Casual, nice people, amazing food.

Like other reviewers, I'm partial to the Oaxaca black mole chicken and the cochinita pibil. Everything is delicious in any delivery system -- taco, burro, or (gooey and vaguely depraved) quesa.

The salsa bar really gets me, though. Experiencing it is to suffer total cognitive arrest and disorganization; it's like love at first sight or stumbling upon a work of great art. Peanut, cilantro, de arbol... bring a sharpie so you can mark the little plastic cups and remember your favorites.

Bonus points: The server remembered that I'd asked for strawberry salsa (they were out) on my last visit eight days prior, and offered a totally above-and-beyond apology. Must be something in the mole that sharpens the memory. 

Great place -- a gem.

What can you say about a place that has already seen the stamp of approval from Guy Fieri? Well, the positives are quite clear, good food at low prices and an endless salsa bar that pushes boundaries with creations like strawberry salsa. But with this success the whole-in-the-wall charm has been lost. My visit became a transactional act due to poor customer service by the sole waitress attending to all the tables in the restaurant.

MUST go! So glad I found this place on Yelp, otherwise I would've never spotted it just driving by. The La Santisma veggie tacos are amazing! I tried the veggie tacos with the cactus too- also good but I preferred the others. Service was friendly and the food came out fast. Check out the salsa bar for a plethora of yummy salsa options. Can't wait to go back!

Thanks fellow yelpers. 
Heading home to Seattle from an awesome spring break with family needing some good Mexican before hitting the airport. 
This place delivered. Exactly what we were hoping for. Street Tacos were awesome, salsa bar a hit with everyone in the family and the guacamole with cranberries were legit. 
Thanks for keeping it real.

We visited here on a Saturday afternoon and we immediately knew this was a place that we would be returning to regularly. The food was wonderful and the salsa bar was just plain fun. The wait staff was extremely helpful in understanding their menu and her recommendations were spot on.  We're looking forward to working our way through their entire menu, one visit at a time!

The package is beautiful and the gift is thoughtful . The giant quesadilla is awesome to look at as it sits down in front of you but lack the big punch you would expect the dough lacks flavor . The salsa bar is large and has unusual salsas that are all good in there own way. The sandwiches are great the bread top notch. Hands down the tacos or at least the fillings are very very good wish they took the time to made a hand made tortilla to support the amazing fillings .
Yes!! Go here! Order anything and it will be delicious. Guacamole and horchata are highlights!
All I can say is SALSA BAR. I love this place. A little bit expensive for a taco place, but I'm not complaining. I'd recommend this to anyone who wants fresh authentic tacos

I know most people just love this place...I can't get into it...tried it a few times...always a stuffy vibe with a staff that stopped caring who showed up a long time ago. Great tacos are a dime a dozen in Phoenix...if you want to experience a better vibe w/o wondering why you are sitting on top of the table next to you there are several other great options.

Was driving by this restaurant and saw loads of cars so I figured it must be good and it was. The horchata was the best I've ever had (and I lived in Austin and ordered it frequently). It had a spoonful of sweetened strawberries in the bottom and loads of cinnamon on the top. Yum!  The chips were basic, but the salsa bar was a great surprise with some very unusual offerings (e.g. a creamy cilantro salsa, a pecan salsa, a jicama salsa). The burro was loaded w rice and chicken mole. The mole sauce was rich and complex, but I wish there had been more in the burro. As a final note, at lunch, you order at the counter and the line can be slow. So don't find a table and peruse the menu (like I did) or you might look up and find that the short line is now VERY long!!

Awesome Food.

Best salsa Bar.

They need a bigger restaurant to service more customers.
This place is amazing!!!!!! In my opinion, the best thing on the menu is the chorizo and potato taco!!! Can't wait to come back this place! Service was great as well!

I wanted to be blown away by a gourmet taco shop, but sadly I live in Southern California, and when you live there being amazed by tacos take A LOT. I definitely recommend this place, but it doesn't have the WOW factor.

The Pros:
Awesome Salsa Bar - about a dozen delicious salsas. The regular Mexican salsa was flavorful and spicy. Some nice rare options too.
Service - Our server was very nice and attentive.
The Al Pastor - I tried the premium carne asada, fish taco, and al pastor. This is the only one I would go back for - great taste and tender pork.

The Cons:
Price - Like double the price of what I'm used to paying for any kind of taco.
Pepsi brand soda - Hells to the no!! and they didn't have Mexican coke either (they were apparently out).
Bleh on the fish taco - again, I am spoiled because I only eat fish tacos in Baja, but the batter was very soggy and bland.

Small place and tight parking but it wasn't crowded on a Sunday.

First time here and it was very good!  The many different salsas at the salsa bar are very good.  My husband had their version of a "torta" I would recommend sticking with the tacos. The steak and white fish tacos are amazing!  

Only bad thing is it not very big and tables are close to each other.  Service was slow but the food made up for that. I would definitely return!

I like the Cochinita Pibil the best. Not a fan of the other tacos and I could do without the rice and beans. The horchata is something to write about. I have never had horchata with fresh ingredients...Very Tasty. The server was nice and quick. You have to get your own salsa so stock up. Would love to stop by again!

horrible.....
I went to la santisima on a friday after lunch time. it was not crowded but we still had to wait for a table, we got a table and the service was horrible, soda was flat, they sold my husband coke in a bottle and didnt even ask if we wanted fountain soda or that mexican bot
tle soda. taco bar was in Tupper ware and no big deal on flavors, my tacos carne asada was saltyyyy couldn't eat that sh.... husband burrito was salty and full of beans mind full that it was carne asada burrito. I would not go back or recomend to friends. need to get a bigger location and get rid of the dusty xmas tree and junk around it or take time to dust and clean.

Came in on a Friday 5-ish for an early dinner with my friends. The place is cute, few tables, it's got a bar and 2 bathrooms. Salsa bar was awesome! There's tons to choose from.. My favorite was the salsa picante, jicama and the cilantro.. Ahhh soo good. I got the fried fish taco plate, the shark taco on the side and I also tried their horchata! The tacos were great! I love the rice it's got flavor to it and the horchata was very delicious! It's got fruit, cinnamon and nuts on top. Ok, so I didn't know it was big! I think the cup was 32oz, it's good for 2-3 people!!! The down side was the service..I don't know if the lady was stressed out because there's a lot of people and there's only 2 of them serving.. But they need to add more server/waiter during peak hours.. The guy was doing 3 jobs, at the bar, cashier and serving as well. I feel bad for them. We were waiting for our food for a long time, probably 30-40mins. When we got out of the restaurant, there was a lot of people waiting.. I will definitely come back again, just not peak hours.

So myself and a coworker passed by this joint and loved the outside decor for the sign. Yelped it, and bamb! A whoppin 4stars huh, so today we stopped by to try it. 

Let's just start off with the entrance to the place. Line to the door. No tables open. One cashier, during the lovely lunch hour. 

The tables weren't bussed yet so we sat at a dirty table till it was cleaned. Can't blame them as the line never stopped from growing and to go orders were huge as people walked out. 

Food arrived and then the taste buds had an awakening. I tried the Cabo Shrimp taco, Mayan Cochinita Pibil taco, and Oaxaca Black Mole Chicken Shark Taco. All are very delicious just as is. Did not need the salsa bar they have but tried them for the chips the give while you wait. 

Only downside to the joint is the tortilla. The tacos seemed like they served them on some you get at Frys and or even a knock off, definitely nothing gourmet or authentic about those. 

Overall spent $16 on three tacos priced 3.99 each and a drink. Will I return??? Probably not, maybe to try others from the menu. But not worth the 4/5 stars!

Between the friendly atmosphere, the cost seating, and the to die for tacos - this place is truly five stars. You would be lost in Phoenix without their salsa bar. I absolutely recommend making your way to this taco haven.
salsa bar alone is worth visiting, types you wont ever see anywhere. the pork shoulder and quesadilla's are so good! enjoy

Great food. 
Only negative is the seating space. Very little, and what exists is very cramped, particularly the seating adjacent to the fixings bar area.
Get theire early for lunch or wait until after the lunch crowd has come and gone.

I absolutely love this restaurant! The food is delicious!  I've tried several of their different gourmet tacos,  and they do not disappoint!! If you're looking for variety,  great prices,  and good food, don't miss this place!

A great taco spot can be judged by the salsa. I pony up to the La Condesa salsa bar and prepare to judge. Today's salsa varieties included strawberry, cilantro, guac, and my fav a spicy salsa with tamatillios. Spicy, complex, AUTHENTIC, developed flavors exploded in my mouth as I sampled a rainbow of salsa with the chips that arrive before my tacos. Instantly, I could tell,  La Condesa Gourmet Taco Shop knows what they're doing in the kitchen, they care about quality, and are super fresh.
