I doubted Muncheeze Truck.  A grilled cheese truck?  Isn't grilled cheese one of the first things we all learn to cook ourselves when we're children?  And as we grew up, we threw more than just cheese into our sandwiches?  For me, a grilled cheese sandwich is a clean slate where you open up your cupboards and refrigerator, see what random veggies and meats you have, and throw them into your own creation.  Pickles, chips, bacon, tomato and whatever was laying around and doing a bad job at getting eaten.  Why would I pay someone else to make me a grilled cheese sandwich?

Because, unlike Muncheeze, I don't have what amounts to Pulled Porky (Slidin' Thru) ingredients in my refrigerator.  That, and my curiosity had to be quenched; this is the sister truck to Slidin' Thru after all.  I ordered $10 The Munchbox Combo (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/75lNzRwmjHpuMwSaNxrMBw?select=mpiJd-Oce51nSrAv40SWsw), which includes:

-Any sandwich; I went with the Piggy Mac (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/75lNzRwmjHpuMwSaNxrMBw?select=kzXgIx3n3pYd6YEX23Jobg): pulled pork with jalapeño, bacon, mac&cheese and BBQ sauce.  Think Pulled Porky slider with mac & cheese.  The one ingredient that fell short of expectations to me was the mac & cheese; it had that re-heated consistency where the macaroni appears to have absorbed the gooey cheese that you have when it is fresh.  I also don't think it's plausible to have a fresh batch of mac & cheese made for each sandwich, though.

-Six Mac Bites (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/75lNzRwmjHpuMwSaNxrMBw?select=YP__n0J35JtAdi4DlcdPOg): Little macaroni & cheese poppers that comes with a "holla-peno ketchup."  It was marinara sauce with a slight zing to it.  The bites themselves (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/75lNzRwmjHpuMwSaNxrMBw?select=VeHYtE8SFymSQHZrRjCKIA) suffered from the same critique I had of the macaroni & cheese in the Piggy Mac.

-A drink; I got a 700ml bottle of water.

If you go strictly by the menu pricing, the Munchbox combo saves you a dollar: $6 sandwich + $3 Mac Bites + $2 drink.  If you go by execution I think it falls a little short; I was hoping for more cheese!  A gooey Piggy Mac that struggled to stay together because the macaroni was swimming in cheese!  Mac Bites that burned the roof of my mouth with cheesy macaroni!  Maybe I was just a hungry kid that grew up putting way too much kids in my sandwiches.  But that is what I was hoping for.

Either way I will be returning to the truck.  I gotta try the Tomato Soup and Lobster Bisque; maybe even the Chi Chi and Sassperilla.  As for their Piggy Mac?  I'm honestly tempted to take home some Porky sliders and pair it up with some fresh mac & cheese for a homemade Piggy Mac...  Let's call it an optimistic three stars, with a guaranteed opportunity to get bumped up in the future.

I love cheese everything and anything.  I was so excited to hear about the Muncheeze truck, and when I tried it out- disappointment.

I had the OG and mac and cheese bites.  I would have ordered the lobster bisque (I LOVE LOBSTER BISQUE!) if it was available, but they didn't have any.

The OG was ok (I've had better grilled cheese sandwhiches at home) and the mac bites were greasy.

Sorry guys, I would do you dirty if I wasn't telling the truth.

I love to support the food truck scene in Vegas so when I heard about Muncheeze I had to check it out! A grill cheese food truck is brilliant and much more feasible. It definitely cuts down the waiting time you might encounter at the other food trucks. 

My co-worker and I decided to try this place during our lunch hour. First impression- great looking truck! The graphics were cute and so was the truck name...Muncheeze (genius)!

To be a fair judge as always we ordered quite a few sandwiches (Sassperilla, Chi-chi and Piggy Mac) to judge the quality of the sandwiches. I must say that I was impressed and thought that the Chi-Chi and Piggy Mac were pretty dang good. I prefer the Piggy Mac more over Chi-Chi. The bbq pulled pork was just right because it wasn't drenched in BBQ sauce and did not hide the taste of the other ingredients. The Sassperilla was drenched in A1 sauce and by the time I ate it, the sandwich was soggy. The Chi-chi was my second choice, great concept but it was a little dry. 

We also had a side of Mac bites and well I wasn't a big fan of the holla-peno ketchup. I think they should have a spicy ranch dipping instead or maybe just serve with a ketchup/marinara & ranch. 

My co-worker was a little disappointed that they didn't have the tomato soup on that day so another day that I went again they were out of soup...do they ever have the soup? 

For $10, you can get a sandwich, bites and a drink, this saves you a couple bucks, which isn't bad considering the prices of the food truck combos. 

Overall the experience is worth it. Some people get annoyed with the guys blasting the music with your favorite song or whatever they are in the mood to listen to and still they're still getting a hang of the biz but this shouldn't distract you from attempting it just once. C'mon Vegas support your food trucks! Follow them on Twitter, Facebook or their website to see where they end up next.

Muncheeze.  Wow, what a complete fail of a business.  It's like the guys that started this food truck only did it to find a place to hang out together and play annoying gangster rap music.  While I was here, I was reminded of not only the Dad's Grilled Cheese business in town that failed, but the show "America's Next Great Restaurant," where there was a contestant who also had a grilled cheese restaurant idea that was eliminated because there was nothing really original or unique about what he was doing.  Regardless, both Dad's Grilled Cheese and the contestant on TV do grilled cheese sandwiches better than the Muncheeze truck.  Hell, I do an infinitely better job at a grilled cheese than they do.  

Okay On to the food.

Basically, it is hard to excuse a place that supposedly specializes in grilled cheese sandwiches when they can't even melt the cheese.  Yes, both sandwiches that were ordered had no melted cheese, but were just a little warmed up.  And there was so little of it.  The quality of the bread (they only offer basic white and wheat) is also pretty flimsy.  Can I also mention that they served stale potato chips with these?

The mac and cheese bites were the neon orange mac and cheese straight out of the kraft box.  At least take the time to make your own mac and cheese from scratch.

And the soups - they were out of lobster bisque but I question their ability to make a quality soup after tasting the tomato soup.  It was worse than a canned campbell's soup.  It was like they bought it bulk from the Cash and Carry/Smart and Final store and served it up.  And the bread bowls they served it in were cold and there was no incentive to eat the bread after attempting to finish the soup.  Anyone that yelped  liked the soup must never get to eat homemade, from scratch tomato soup and knows what it tastes like.

I just can't believe how incredibly lazy the people that run this truck are and how they have the gall to call this actual food and serve it.  The only way I would ever eat this food again is if I was homeless,  but even then with the insanely high prices they are charging for this crap, I'd never be able to afford it.

Despite some of their first facebook reviews on the day of vegas streets, i think Muncheeze is delish!!! Their tomato soup defines what comfort food is.... i can eat this stuff every day!!!! YUMMMM... We took everything to-go, the Piggy Mac was so good, it reminded me of the Pulled Porky Slider..

Try it! If you love Slidin Thru and their quality of food, you wont be disappointed with Muncheeze!!!!.

****This review is only for the service, since it was so bad and we waited so long that we canceled our order, and 5 minutes later they bring out the order anyway while we wait to speak to the manager****

So before the Gazillionaire Elite Event at Caeser's my friend and I decided to go to Muncheeze for a quick bite due to our time constraints.  I personally think and hour at a casual dinning establishment is more than enough time to sit, eat, pay the bill and leave but I guess I was thinking the wrong thing in this instance.  

We were greeted by the hostess and seated quickly.  As we arrived we sat next to a couple who had just sat down and ordered, the waitress then took our drink order at the same time and I asked that a TV be put on a specific game.  We order our drinks and she gives us a minute to look at the menu.  5 minutes later the table next to us gets their drinks and she takes our order.  10 minutes after that we get our drinks (15 minutes just to get drinks?) and the table next to us gets their food.  15 minutes later the table next to us is done eating and are given their check (now in most cases the server would see that we are right next to them and we don't have any food AND the TV that I asked to be changed was never changed) another 15 minutes passes as we watch them pay leave and their table is bussed before the server comes back and says "you don't have your food yet?!?" in which I answered "no, and actually I have to be somewhere at 8pm, I'm going to have to cancel our order."  She said "OK, but I can check on it for you, do you want it to go?"  Now since I was going to an event I didn't want to have to carry this stuff across the Casino and then have to eat it while at the event.  So I declined and asked to speak to the manager.  Before the manager comes out the table the food comes.  Now I'm even more irritated.  We have already cancelled the food, obviously we were hungry otherwise we would not have been there, but to not have enough common courtesy to not put the food in front of me that I can't eat now because I have no time to so would be great.The manager seemed friendly enough though about the situation and was very sorry for the incident but the damage had been done.  He offered to get the tab next time we stop by but I'm not sure if I want to do that, I think they lost me at the 45 minute wait.

I SOSOSOSO want to give this a better review and hopefully it will change. Grilled cheese is/was my favorite comfort food as a child and now. We were also recently spoiled to have a visit Roxy's Grilled cheese truck from Boston visit Vegas so I got a chance to compare to what a true grilled cheese truck should offer. (I wrote a review for them in another entry)

Anyways Grilled cheese musts.....are CHEESE! GOOEY Cheese, Hot and not Burnt.
Well thankfully this sandwich was not burnt. I ordered the 3 cheese with bacon for $5. It came on standard white bread. The cheese inside was partly melted but not all the way. The Mac bites on the other hand $3 and 6 of them was excellent! It came with with Holla-Peno Ketchup and was well worth the $3. 

Muncheese is the sister truck to Slidin Thru and I know they start making some kickass grilled cheese after they start looking at the product better at the lab.
My only suggestion is using a thicker bread like a Brioche or Texas toast and unique cheeses like Brie, Maytag Bleu and Muenster. At least add thicker cheese and make sure it is gooey/stringy when pulled apart, I will keep visiting and I love the concept and will change the rating as I know you will get better,

This is good stuff no doubt. Same guys as Slidn Thru so you know the 
service is great and the food will be original and BOMB!!

I was so excited to try out the eats from here. And I finally got the opportunity at the last StrEATS. 

They didn't get off to a great start. Glitches prevented them from opening on time and left a few of us waiting in line for a long time salivating and exercising our patience. But hey, they're a newbie truck, so you have to cut them a little slack.

The lobster bisque (one of their soup offerings) was absolutely fantastic. It was served in a bread bowl and filled with all kinds of yummy. Temps outside may be rising, but don't pass up this tasty delight.

For a sandwich, I opted for the one with the pulled pork and mac 'n' cheese. It was good, but not great. It was missing the ooey gooey cheese. But props for an interesting combination.

All the sandwiches come with fries and a dipping sauce (like ketchup, but not). Hint: try dipping your grilled cheese in the dipping sauce.

My main complaint was that it was a lot of food. Especially in a setting with so much food goodness (in other words, so many eats I wanted to sample), the amount of food was overwhelming. It was also awkward trying to balance everything and eat so much while standing up. The portions and packaging didn't quite lend itself to street food. Offering half sandwiches and fries as an optional (not automatic) side would be nice.

The concept of this truck is awesome. The execution still needs a little work though.

I appreciate the trendy food truck craze that is currently overtaking every major city. I think it's awesome. Muncheeze menu is outstanding. There's a little something for everyone. You have the grilled cheese that includes pulled pork and mac n' cheese, or the one that has steak, or the classic ham & cheese, or a combination of cheeses and bacon. Everything in that last sentence flows so beautifully. I'm a cheese enthusiast, so if there is cheese on something I'm usually gettin down with the get down.

Unfortunately where Muncheeze falls short is the quality of the food. Unlike their sister truck Slidin Thru, they miss on a few key points. If I order a grilled cheese, there better be a lot of cheese on there. If I order your grilled cheese that includes 3 different types of cheese, THERE BETTER BE A LOT OF CHEESE. That was not the case when I ordered the Cheesy Lovers Delight (I selected American, Cheddar, and Mozerella). The cheese was barely noticeable, that was disappointing. If it had more cheese it would have changed my whole experience. I decided to get the combo meal, appropriately named the Munchbox Combo which included a tasty glass Coca-Cola and Mac-Bites featuring Holla-peno ketchup. The Mac Bites were a bit greasy and lacked a real cheesy flavor, so those fell short as well.

Another disappointment was that they were out of Lobster Bisque, or, they never really had any since we got to the truck 20 minutes after the windows opened. At first they weren't sure if they had Mac Bites as well. I thought the organization was a little all over the place this time around.

With the awesomeness of Slidin Thru I definitely had high expectations for Muncheeze. Unfortunately they fell short. Knowing that they are run by the iconic slider truck I will give them a second chance.

I've had second breakfast a lot since my first review. It's absolutely amazing! My go to is the breakfast sandwich! Simplicity = happiness. Bacon and 2 eggs served side side up on an amazing local bun. The duck fat fried hash brown is delicious as well :)

No joke, one of the best breakfasts I have ever had. The duck bacon was out of this world the sweet, salty, fatty taste was perfect. The hash brown cooked in the duck fat was great with the two perfectly cooked eggs over medium. I will try to stop by every time I am in Pittsburg can't wait to try the rest of the menu.
This place is no longer in the Pittsburgh Public Market.  I understand they now operate a food truck.
Too little quantity of ordinary tasting food. Neither fills your heart nor your stomach.

After 36+ years of stuffing food into my mouth (and a lot of it at that) I'm hardly ever surprised any more by "good food" but yeah, no, the food at Second Breakfast will stun you, it will awaken you, it will make you stop shoveling food into your stomach and convince you that you've found something to savor and to chew on for a little bit. The crepes, the waffles, the DUCK BACON!!!! Forget regular bacon, you don't need it, from now on you'll see pigs only as pets because the duck bacon is just that amazing. 

If there was one thing, any little thing to be critical of it's the very cool but not easy to use wooden flatware but the answer to that is to bring you own because a wooden fork should not stand in your way when it comes to this amazing and glorious food that will change your life in ways you can't even imagine.

UPDATE: The cool but not easy to use wooden flatware are gone replaced by compostable plastic-like flatware.

So when we went on a Saturday morning, just after they'd opened, they were out of crepes, duck fat, and several other items we had hoped to order. That said, the waffle was chewy, moderately sweet and delicious with maple syrup. My breakfast buddy and I shared some soft eggs and duck bacon, which were INCREDIBLE. Like, you should go right away and get some! Like right now! 

I took away a star because they were out of half the things we wanted, and because we had to wait 30 minutes to get our order...but man, SO good. I'll be back, and soon! Also, try out the juice company next door - the pineapple green juice was delicious and not-too-sweet, not-too-green tasting. A perfect breakfast combo.
The food was okay. I was expecting a lot because of the stellar reviews. I found the waffle very dry, and the hash Browns too greasy. The duck Bacon was delicious.

I have always been wanting to try this place and finally got my opportunity. Thom the owner was very friendly and allowed me to sample some of the food. He explained to me how the food is prepared and i was very intrigued!  i never thought I would like duck bacon but it is really good!!!

I also got to sample a part of a Belgium waffle topped with chocolate and blueberry sauce.

All the food here is organic and very healthy!

I decided to try a little something different by ordering the Tamagochi Japanese omelet. It is made with 3 eggs and he told me it would not be as filling as a traditional omelet. He was right!! I really enjoyed this omelet. Utensils are wooden but that did not pose a problem for me.

Prices are very reasonable and of course they offer free Wi-Fi. 

There is seating in the back so you don't have to walk around with your food.

Next time I return I plan to order complete versions of the other items I sampled. Second Breakfast is located inside the Pittsburgh public market. Off street parking is available and there is garage parking nearby.

I had not heard of Second Breakfast, but I was pleasantly surprised to find their food truck at Saturday's Brookline Breeze festival on the boulevard.  The menu looked great and I have always been a sucker for a good waffle.  The toppings ranged from traditional maple syrup to those appropriate to satisfy a dessert lovers sweet tooth.  They showed a peach and ginger topping, two of my favorite flavors but had sold out.  So, I decided on the bacon-brandy-maple syrup.  It was a great choice!  The syrup topping enhanced the waffle without taking anything from that crispy on the outside but moist and fluffy on the inside waffle.  Another patron had ordered ahead of me and his order of a fried egg and bacon with potatoes fried in duck fat smelled delicious!  Wanting another opportunity to try more from the menu led me here to search for a schedule for their truck.  Unfortunately, the website still shows the restaurant that was (from a comment by another reviewer) in the Pittsburgh Public Market and nothing about their switch to a food truck.  I will keep searching for more info, but hope that someone who knows will post new info here or let the owners know they need to update.
The Duck bacon is amazing!! Tastiness to the max. Fresh and local ingredients. You need to check this spot out!

This morning I was at PPM visiting a friend working the kombucha stand (check out Red Star) when I decided to grab some breakfast. Second breakfast is open all day which is great because I forgot to eat when I woke up and breakfast food is the only food that anyone truly needs, right? I had the special which was a ham, parsnip, cheese and spinach crepe. I don't remember what kind of cheese was in the crepe but it was creamy and delicious. The crepe was perfectly thin and beautiful. They also did not skimp on the ham. The food was good, fresh and fast.

I finally got to check out second breakfast as part of an event at the mattress factory today. I'm hoping it was just an off day for them, as our meal was fairly disappointing. By far the worst part was waiting about 20 minutes to order and another 45 for our food. They were also out of a few things (like bacon!! ) which is understandable but disappointing. The volume of customers didn't seem very high for how long it took, so I'm not really sure what was going on. All that being said, the waffles were pretty good and my eggs were cooked perfectly. I also really enjoyed the hash brown. The braised chicken for the chicken and waffles was a bit bland and left a lot to be desired. Again, I hope this truck was just having an off day as it seems like a great concept. In the end we wished we would have just eaten at the cafe at the MF.

These are not everyday waffles, they are outrageously delicious and wonderful. The chef has a lot of passion for preparing top quality food made from locally sourced ingredients. 

You have to try the duck bacon, it's excellent. 

You will be delighted by what you experience, everything is thoughtfully and skillfully prepared.

One of the great things about eating here is all the other things that are going on at the Public Market.  For example, I dropped in Saturday and they had live music, an old time jam session that was lots of fun.  There's also the opportunity to shop at all the other vendors.

I came here after hearing about their great service (which is sadly not common these days), and can't say that I was at all disappointed

The lady who helped me was extremely nice and helpful. She didn't get upset when I said I didn't want to buy a dress before looking at all my options (unlike at some other places that practically throw you out when they hear that), and even suggested giving me a call if any other dresses in the style I liked came in!

Only reason for the 4 star rating is because the selection of dresses is extremely limited. Otherwise, awesome service!

I was at the marion-nous exhibition and this company had a couple of dresses that I found mildly tolerable.  I was newly engaged and not-at-all in the know about anything having to do with a wedding.  The woman asked me if I had any appointments for dress shopping yet, and i said no.  She said "When are you getting married?" and I said "6 months?" and she said "girl, you are Late!"  so I panicked, made an appointment for the following saturday and went to have a mini-meltdown at home.

I was dreading my appointment to this boutique to the point that I was sleepless the night before and thinking of calling my 3 girlfriends up to cancel.   The woman from the shop had me go on their website and fill out some general information in advance and then print up some different photos of dresses I liked. I had NO idea what I liked.

anyway- I garnered some courage and met my girlfriends for my appointment at 10am. I walked in and the place was bustling!  cute young ladies in white and ivory Everywhere!  I picked 4-5 dresses with the help of an employee.  She came into the change room with my and helped get the dresses on and Io and behold,  the dresses were not hideous! I actually really liked one and almost considered buying it on the spot, on my first day of dress shopping ever.  They also have an option to rent for almost half the price of buying.   I can't remember the name of the woman who was helping me but she was outstanding.  Made me feel completely comfortable and helped me to figure out what it is I want in a dress.  Overall it was a great experience and I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a fun experience wedding dress shopping.

I had the pleasure to find my dress at Oui Je Le Voeux. It was the first and last place I visited. I had the luck to visit bridal shops in Canada, the USA and Ireland and this was my best experience by far. On my second visit, Marianne was lovely and she brought my about 10 dresses covering a great variety of styles, helping me to find my own. She was a great listener, super patient and her understanding of my needs was spot on. Thanks again!

J'ai eu le plaisir de trouver ma robe chez Oui Je Le Voeux. Ce fût la première et dernière place que j'ai visitée. J'ai eu la chance de visiter des boutiques au Canada, US et en Irlande et mon expérience à cette boutique a été de loin la meilleure. À m deuxième visite, Marianne a été incroyable et m'a fourni plus de 10 robes couvrant une large variété de style pour m'aider à trouver le miens. Elle a été très à l'écoute, super patiente et sa compréhension de mes besoins était dans le mille. Merci encore!

First off, I really miss Jasmine Shawarma.  

In our epic trek to find good shawarma, Mike S and myself had a few cheap lunches here at Pita Pure.  Mediocre at best, with a weird off taste with their pickled turnip.  Their shawarmas and falafels are cheap, less than $5 each, so if you're like that, you'll love Pita Pure.  

However, every morning, I walk up Bay St., there is a box full of pitas set outside of the door to this place.  How long it's been sitting there every morning is anyone's guess.

This is one of the best pitas I've had before！The chicken sharwama's chicken is well fried, and the tomatoes inside creates a fine balance. The samosa triangles are also outstanding! I highly recommend this shop, plus brownie points for the nice employees there;)

This place is right across the street from work, so I've been here many times. On days that I'm too lazy to pack a lunch, I'll do almost anything to avoid the food court at college park. Which isn't to say that eating here is an act of desperation - i've never been disappointed, but I'm not expecting much. Cheap (3.99 chicken shwarma), fast (though I once ordered the chicken gyro instead and that took substantially longer than the shwarma), and as yummy as any other standard shwarma place.

I also enjoy the selection of baklava and Turkish delight towering in the counter. I've never ordered those things, but seeing heaps of them makes me smile.

It's solid. I like it well enough. But if I didn't work right across the street and never ate here again, I wouldn't notice the loss.
Bah, don't bother. nothing is fresh

The food here isn't very good - but it's cheap (like 3 samosa for $1, 2 falafels for $5 and $5 daily shawarma deals cheap).  For those prices, you really can't go wrong.  It's an okay for quick cheap lunch...

... actually, scratch that.  It's okay for a quick cheap lunch when *you're at work*.  Otherwise, it's meh.
Great value. The falafel sandwich is delicious and a fantastic price. One of the better falafels I've had.

I was a loyal customer, several times a week for gas, cigs, etc. I was always friendly with the cashiers probably because I have been in customer service for many years. Until a run in with a nasty cashier.  Bottom line is a very nice new cashier waited on me as I prepaid cash for gas.  When the pump didn't turn on I went back inside and asked her to put  $20 on my pump.  Well another cashier decided to jump into the conversation without being asked to. Then his comment was "you have to pay first " and I said I did but he yelled that I hadn't.  The new cashier realized her error and fixed it.  But then the other cashier decided to go further and yelled at me as I was leaving "have a nice day lady! ". Now I emailed the store manager and got a response that she would get back to me.  That was in June!!!
I quit going there and I realize that my $100 plus won't hurt their bottom line the very least I think an apology is due.

I will probably never stop her again at this PDQ because it is not on my travels but I was pretty impressed with the store. PDQ was at this location was way more than the average gas station with a fresh bakery, walk in liquor cooler, fresh cooked pop corn, crapy hot food, mega coffee station, limited soda machine, isles of snacks, rows of coolers with drinks and food and pretty much a mini most everything you might need while traveling.

This was a travelers mini Walmart with a lot of thought put into the travelers want and needs and if your phone charger takes a dump they have it. This is a well thought out gas station and a great restaurant attached would have been the icing on the cake. 

I don't have any previous experience with PDQ stations because there just isn't any around me but I was very impressed with how well it was thought out because it's a destination/one stop place. I don't know if all PDQ stations are based off this model but while out if I need gas I will definitely look for a PDQ to stop at.

A quick and easy stop when getting on or off Stoughton Road. PDQ is on a corner with a light and doesn't require you to head onto a frontage road so that's a big plus during periods of heavy traffic in the area. The store is open early so we've used it for pre-work stops and to pick up snacks and beverages for road trips.

Carly is fantastic!  I have been going to her for years and she always customizes facials that are appropriate for my skin and leave me glowing!  I would definitely recommend Carly for any beauty treatment!

I received my facial as a gift at Carly's shop and  scheduled one  immediately.
From the moment I met Carly she made me feel very comfortable and her shop was adorable. I had a morning appointment and fell into a delicious dream state as she worked her magic on me. I was totally relaxed and comfortable and just listen to the sounds of the soothing music in the background and the wonderful aromas of the lotions and potions he used on my skin. I wish I had scheduled my facial at the end of the day because when I left I floated out the door and wished I could go home for a little nap. It was the best facial experience I ever had and would highly recommend her to any of my friends! I hope to see Carly again soon.
Carly was phenomenal, she is very professional and is super friendly. I felt so relaxed and my skin felt great!
Carly is so knowledgeable personable and professional!  She's been doing my skin for about five years now.  I would never consider anyone else!  She's simply the best!!!!

Carly is amazing. It's so soothing and comfortable- not to mention the hand, arm, face, back, shoulder massage. The whole experience was so utterly wonderful that I am hooked. My skin feels amazing and is glowing. Don't look anywhere else!

Saw Carly for the first time today for a signature facial. Her space is inviting and relaxing. She is very professional and customized my treatment for my skin and the issues I'm having right now. 

I'll definitely go back to her for additional services and regular skin treatments. 

Thanks so much for the special attention, Carly!
Carly was so sweet and professional! She took her time and made sure I was comfortable. Very relaxing! Definitely coming back.

If you want you hair to be hacked come here. Totally hacked one side of my hair - left side was shorter than the right. Also the left side was choppy and the right side was not. 

So if that wasn't bad enough, i was stupid enough to return for a recut. Now my hair is wrecked. Chopply all over and does not blend at all, looks like two cuts.  I have never had such a bad cut.

Both stlists did not listen to me and now i am paying the price.  My hair looks awful, no amount of curling, strightening, blow drying, or use of styling product has helped. TOTALLY HACKED. 

This salon does not conider hair type, texture, or desired style.  Just scissor-happy-one-stlye-fits-all approach here.

For me, if I can walk into a salon and get my hair done right without a scheduled appointment...that's already a plus.  There is actually a Pelusi salon that is much closer to me than this location, but my favorite stylist is here.  Even when my fave isn't available, I find that most of the other ladies here know their stuff and can pretty much give me the hair cut in the picture that I show them on my cell phone :)

As many times as I've visited Philip's salons, I just realized today that I have never done a review on them and I'm not sure why.  I fell in love with Pelusi's salons when I got my first hair cut outside of a black salon.  I remember it like yesterday...it was from a cute short Italian New Yorker that I secretly call "The scissor artist" because she's one baddd chic when it comes to cutting and styling hair.  When she finished my hair and gave me that mirror that reflected a brand new woman whom I had never met before...she had me.  :) Her name is Catie and I picture her cheeks turning bright red if she ever finds out about this review.  I outed her, but she's that good y'all. (And yes, I'm only talking about hair here!)  Lol

I find it difficult to find a good salon that consistently services ethic hair well so when I got that first cut about 7 years ago or so, they won over my heart.  The customer service is always good with a smiling face greeting me every time I walk in the door.  They take time giving you a thorough consultation before touching your hair.  I like that they encourage me to do bold new things with my hair styles to bring out the raging diva inside of me with that striking inverted bob, high stacked in the back, please and thank you very much!.  

Today, when I checked in I was told it would be a 15 minute wait.  After about 20 minutes, my designated stylist came over, apologized for the extra wait and assured me that she would be with me in another few minutes.  I appreciated that because it made me feel important and shows that they care.  Immediately after that, I was offered coffee or water and asked if I was okay.  Nice touch.

Some may claim that their prices are high and they may be depending on how much you value yourself.  For me, it's a welcome treat and a pat on my own back...which is priceless.  Check them out though.  Philip Pelusi stylists know hair and I've yet to be disappointed.

I walked in the morning of my son's wedding with no appointment. I can't even begin to thank the staff there! They were honestly the most caring,  wonderful amazing people! Me not being an emotional person at all had my first breakdown/panic attack EVER. They took care of me as though I was family and I will be forever grateful. Oh and my hair turned out better than I ever could have hoped for.

Clearly, I'm a bit oblivious.  I see Middle-Eastern options in Peoria and lose my mind.  That being said, this place serves hot dogs, and chilli dogs and the like (so the signage I spoke about is just fine).  It seems to me that this used to be a hot dog joint, and they decided to keep a lot of the menu options available so people would still frequent it.  It is still a solid three star, and something different in Peoria is a good thing.

This is my favorite place to go for Greek food. The owners are from Greece and frequently several family members are present.

The food is delicious, large portions, friendly service. I wish they were located in Surprise, but they are worth the drive.

I get to blame Ayesha for this one.  :-)  Once again I ventured alone into a restaurant that I had never had the style of food before and had no clue what it was supposed to taste like or how to properly eat it.  I too like non chain places if they have something to offer and she made it sound like it was worth trying.  I was out that direction to go to Walmart and put a stop here in the itinerary. 

Walked in just before 7 and the owner (?) was sitting with friends in the corner.  He gave me a minute or so to read the menu and came over behind the counter.  I said I would like the sampler platter appetizer ($6.49) and he looked at me strange and said "there is no meat in that".  This is something that is mostly a guy thing, When cooking for somebody else the meat is the signature of how many of us cook.  Doesn't matter if the rest of the food is under/overcooked or the cat stole the cheese, the meat better be right.  In a small restaurant like this where much of what is served has to come from purchased stuff with some seasoning modifications the only chance the cook thinks he has to show off is in the preparation of the meat entree and I had just taken that from him.  Never the less I stuck to my original order.

I was started off with a hot bowl of lentil soup, I don't think this was part of what I ordered but I was the only customer in there and he was bound and determined to find a way to show off.  The plate came and included hummus, baba ghanoush, dolma, falafel.  He took the time to explain what I was being served.  On the side was naan and a dipping sauce for the falafel.  On the plate was also tomatoes, cucumbers and lettuce.  The presentation was good enough it could have come on real dishes from a restaurant at a much higher price level, I know the dish could have been take out but a lot would have been lost.  Other than falafel all of the dishes were new to me and I had a fun time exploring the different tastes and serving combination's.  About halfway through the owner came over to see how I was doing and answered some further questions I had about what I was eating.  I only made it through about 2/3 of the whole meal before I was full.

I enjoyed the meal and clearly the owner is all about making the experience a good one.  If you are not familiar with the area it is easy to miss.  83rd Ave turns into W Lake Pleasant Pkwy at Beardsley going North and takes a gentle curve West.  Guessing, I took the first left into a strip mall I could and landed right where I wanted.  Not bad for a guy at night without a navigator. :-)

I used to work near Royal Gyros and went frequently for lunch. The owners are super nice and the food is great. He even brought some free lentil soup over a few times. Don't let the underwhelming exterior fool you, this food is delicious. Plus, there were always these same 2 dudes sitting at the front of the place reading newspapers, being awesome. I want to be those guys.

The Gyro is HUGE, piled high with meat, served with fresh tomatoes and onions and a just right tzatziki sauce.
I am a big guy and can eat my fair share but this is almost to much for me to eat in one sitting, you could easily split one in half and share it.
The staff is friendly and welcoming, while we were waiting we were given a sample of home made lentil soup that was simply amazing and a terrific start to a great meal. I wish other places had this level of quality and customer appreciation. Its a little out of the way for me, but well worth the trip every time. It tops the standard by which Gyros should be judged.

The sandwiches here are delicious! The tzatziki steak flatbread is surprisingly spicy and very flavorful. 

The smoothies are just okay; the one I got tasted like they filled the blender with ice and tossed in a couple of strawberries. Not bad, but unexciting.

Just okay for Tropical Smoothie, but when you're in the Excalibur and looking for something quick, you're left with fast food choices.  This location is upstairs with the rest of their fast food restaurants.  I am a fan of the Tropical Smoothie chain.  My order is the same almost everytime...their Pesto Chicken Flatbread.  Service at this location is not bad, especially since most people up here are hitting up the McDonalds or Krispy Kremes.

One plus...they are either open 24 hours or stay open really late.  I've been here after midnight and they are still open.

First meal coming to Vegas and I was craving a smoothie and decided to stop by here To grab a quick meal. Realizing that was one of the biggest regrets of my trip. Ordered a smoothie and Jamaican bowl. The Jamaican bowl was disgusting. Bland chicken with sauce that didn't taste like anything thing like Jamaican food. The smoothie tasted like a slurpee from 7/11 only 3x the price.

LOVE this place! I'm pretty picky with my green smoothies, but decided to go with the Island Green (spinach, kale, pineapple, mango, and banana). One of the best ones I've had especially for a reasonable price of around $7 including tax AND for a 20 oz. I promise you you can't taste the greens at all since the fruit takes over the flavor. Would definitely recommend.

The chicken salad sandwich was great!  I could have done without the smoothie.  I expected it to be better since smoothie is in the name.  I had the Mango magic and couldn't taste any of the mango.  This is located in the Excalibur food court and a good alternative to the fast food places on either side.

Pretty impressed. It was a 40 minute walk from my hotel and I was quite glad I did it. I got the pesto chicken flatbread sandwich and a 'kiwi quencher' (strawberry kiwi with yogurt) smoothie. 

I was mega impressed with the sandwich. It was so good how hot it came out and the pesto quality was quite up there. They didn't skimp out on adding the pesto either and the cheese and chicken were both nice. Reasonable value for it at $5.99 too. 

I got the smoothie added which made my bill ~$11.50 (tax included). The smoothie was huge! (Though I'm told portions are usually bigger in the US?) I missed seeing I could add health boosters for 99cents a pop and might have done that. The smoothie was on the sweet side but not too sweet. It was also nice that the kiwi and strawberry flavours were well balanced.

Putting Edge in Vaughan is a great place to bring your kids. My children absolutely love your glow in the dark mini golf! After having some fun, they  always look forward to playing some arcade games afterwards.

I thought your readers might want to take advantage of these great coupons!
http://bestprintcoupons.com/index.php?route=directory%2Fdetails&bid=5#.U3ZbK_ldXxB

One coupon is for a BOGO and the other is a coupon off your next birthday party booking.

Enjoy!

Putting Edge has everything you have ever loved: Mini Golfing, Glow in the dark and GAMES!

Been going to this location for a while and I am glad to say that this is always fun every time I go! Super friendly staff, colourful decorations and tricky course holes. Registering and booking a tee time is incredibly easy, but beware that on the weekend it does get busy due to families, birthday parties and first dates.

Only recommendation I do have is to change the holes once in a while. I do remember playing each one and although I have a lot of fun, I hope they change the holes :)

This place is super Fun. Its located to a zillion food and shopping options. Plenty of free parking :) 

The employees are friendly. You can a club, ball of your colour choice, & a glow stick for under $11 for 18 holes. Plus it's glow in the dark. If you're sneaky enough, there's a few make out spots too.

Came here close to midnight last Saturday with a friend, and first thing we did was sneakily try to get a discount by pretending to be students but unfortunately they said ID was mandatory. So we paid adult fare and put our names down and was asked to wait about 20 minutes before we could get in. We sat outside and amused ourselves by watching hordes of girls in skimpy clothing clumsily made their way to luxy night club next door in -5 weather... There was a small arcade where we could throw basketballs or play ice hockey while we waited, but we didn't have cash to play.

Once our name was called, we got our things and went inside. It was all dark except for the obstacles and walls. It was impossible to see the curvature of the carpet without walking over it and feeling it with your feet. If you're an avid golfer this may bother you... However areas around the hole were flat so it wasn't a big deal. It was very easy to figure out where everything starts and ends, and everyone seemed to be having fun.

A group behind us however looked like they were having too much fun - in more than one instance they hit a ball so hard it went flying and hit someone on the back of the head. It wasn't cool. They complained and staff kicked the hooligans out.

pros - customer service was great, mini golf course was very fun, glow in the dark was exciting, and the wait was short.

cons - it was a bit crowded and the arcade was limited in selection and took tokens. Also there was no coat check, just an unattended coat room.

Pretty fun indoor mini-golf place. Picture black lights with illuminating neon panted objects and you get the idea. They used every inch of the space available, and though it gets a bit tight in some spots like finding room off the course to stand when someone else is going, or even wait for the next hole, it works out pretty well for the most part. A number of the holes are really well designed involves some problem solving and skill to navigate.

Putting Edge is a fun, glow-in-the-dark mini putt playground suitable for all ages. I've seen kids as young as 5-years-old to couples as old as 60+ on a date! 

The price is reasonable, and you get a discount on the second round if you want a rematch. You get a stamp card for getting a hole-in-one putt on Hole #18. It's a bummer that you have to get that one-putt in FIVE times (5 stamps) just for one free game. I got one stamp so far! 

The holes are challenging if it's your first time here, but I've been here so many times that I know where the shortcuts are...etc. It's always fun when you bring new people, otherwise, I wouldn't come here so often. 

Nobody really plays in the arcade outside, and some machines have been out of order for a long time. The prizes aren't appealing - ie. pens, stuffed animals, candy - I'd only come here to mini putt. 

Tip: Wear a white t-shirt unless you want to see all the dust on dark clothing!

Good place. Went there last weekend with a friend. Was pretty quick for 2 people, we were done in 40-45 minutes, which I think was very quick. I wish there was more than 18 holes.
Great design of this place, everything is glowing (definitely for lovers of Tron or other futuristics), and interesting design of levels. 
 Definitely recommend this place.

Coolest place ever.  I am really glad I visited as it brought back a kind of nostalgia from my early childhood.  

I've been by this place more than I can recall and can't believe I hadn't gone inside and played a round.  

I can appreciate that there is also an arcade as you enter and an awesome display of prizes to be won or purchased.  

Glow in the dark adds to the game and makes for each obstacle just as interesting as the last.  

Will recommend to anyone.

It's a fun place to go to on a date or with kids. I decided to come here on a whim with my bf because he has never been before. 

We arrived on a Wednesday night at 8pm, one hour before closing so it was pretty much empty except for a family of 4. After paying, we were given glow in the dark bracelet and score card. In total there were 18 courses with varying difficulty levels and between the two of us, we finished all of them within an hour. 

Putting edge is glow in the dark mini golf with nice and eye catching visuals all throughout the place. But because the only light source is basically the glow in the dark props, be careful when walking through the course. There are some uphill and downhill slopes that you cannot see at all because the floor is black. 

I find putting edge a fun place to go to on a date or with family. The courses haven't changed since the last time I was here (4 years ago) so it's a place that I would go to every once in a while, like once a year.

Glow in the Dark Mini Golf!  I've been to this location MANY times in the past but it has always been a FUN time as long as you bring someone NEW everytime or else it can get OLD.

NEON Backdrop, Obstacles and Golf Balls glow for your entertainment as you will SHINE as well if you wear WHITE.  I guess if you can FIND neon clothes and accessories, then all the better.

There are different GREEN FEES you can purchase as well as they cater to PARTY groups as well.  I usually see a group of 4 at most and its not that common that you'll see more than 3 groups which means you have PLENTY of time to find your line.

There are RULES you have to obey of course, but in the past my friend and I have advanced to play the HOCKEY method which I will not advise anyone to do.  **SAFETY FIRST**

I was searching and searching for a place to organize a corporate event for approx 100 people.  When I contacted Putting Edge, the deal sounded unbelievable.... it was by far the cheapest quote and provided everything we needed... food, drinks, fun event, etc.  
The event went completely smooth... everyone had a great time.. no complaints at all.  The manager Pat took care of everything.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for group events.  
Hats off to Pat and the team at Putting Edge... Great Work!  Great Price!  Great Fun!

Unfortunately, our last one-day visit on September 17th to this property was marred because (1) our "Guaranteed" roll-in shower room was provided to another guest, (2) we were not notified in advance regarding this room issue, and (3) David (Assistant GM) refused to honor Fairfield Inn's "100 percent Satisfaction Guaranteed Policy."  As a result, my wife was unable to shower during our stay.  David's lack of compliance is particularly disturbing due to Marriott's "best in industry" long-standing policy to make special efforts regarding the accommodation of disabled guests.   Otherwise, our stay was fine - comfortable bedding, immaculate facility/breakfast area and a great pool/spa area.  A special acknowledgement is also extended to Jane (Front Desk) due to her stellar customer-centric skills and experience - she is an asset to the Marriott and H&A Group brands.

My husband and I stayed here last night.  The front desk clerk was very professional and personable on our rainy night in Phoenix.  The room was clean and nice.  The rate was great!  We were in Phoenix to go to Barrett Jackson car auction and many of the other hotels were price gauging.  This place was perfect.  The Waffle House next door truly hit the spot with great food.  We will be back. Thanks Fairfield staff.

The front desk staff has been very friendly and helpful, the service here is great. The hotel has a recently remodeled feel, the rooms still smell like new carpet. They are going for a very modern feel, which I thought was cool but my mom described as "funky".
They have complimentary breakfast and free wifi in the rooms (BONUS!) and ample parking. 
There was a significant amount of dust sitting on the picture frames, but most people wouldn't check there, I only did so cause I work in a hotel industry lol 
But I would definitely recommend this place, 
Also has a pool and hot tub! 
I would recommend getting some type of grip in the shower, since it was slippery enough for me to fall... I think it's hazardous. Overall... Great stay!

We found bedbugs. We went to the front desk and they removed the bug and offered to changed the linens. Our party was traveling with a large group and we had to double up. The area surrounding the "inn" offered streetwalkers, drug deals and a homeless camp all within 50 feet. DO NOT GO THERE!! 
Sometimes you cannot trust the brand name.

Verlinda, who checked us in on Saturday afternoon, was very nice and polite. We requested a king size bed and got it. 
The room was very clean and newly remodeled and painted. There was a hair dryer, iron and ironing board, refrigerator, microwave, flatscreen TV, and coffeemaker in the room. They also have a pool, sauna, and 24 hour exercise room. There were a lot of other people staying there and our room was perfectly quiet.
 I don't know where the so-called "shady people" or "bad element" types 
 were at, mentioned in some other reviews, because we never saw them during our stay. I felt perfecty safe staying here. 
At only $72 a night, this is a bargain, too! We will DEFINITELY be staying here again.

I felt this property deserves a five based on a comparable price and location. I stayed there the weekend of the Waste Management Open. 

Convenient location close to TPC at a reasonable price. Close to Happy Valley and 17 with many shops and places to eat. 

Every staff member was very friendly and helpful. Clean and each room had a microwave and refrigerator.

Great staff, newly remodeled so the rooms are great.

Close enough to the 17 to be convenient, and still no freeway noise.

Not a Marriott... I only stay at Marriotts because they are always wonderful...this one, you need to not walk, but run away from..... Only good thing was the Staff was great.... Hotel was bad... Roaches everywhere outside at night, so we couldnt use the pool or spa. The entire hotel smelled like a mixture of mildew and old smoke... The elevator was even worse...Breakfast was gross.... Eggs were microwaved and runny.... Bad bad bad....parking for our nissan titan was impossible, plus there were hookers out at night!!!!.. May as well stayed at a motel 6....

So convenient, right off the freeway.  Just be sure to check driving directions first, you can see the building but there is no roadway signage and it's not on the street.
Rooms are spacious, very clean, pool and spa warm and relaxing.  Breakfast can get crowded but plenty of hot food.  Centrally located so sports complexes are easily accessed, Luke AFB to the west or Davis-Montham in Tucson within driving distance.  And west Bell has just about anything you could desire to eat.  Your stay in the Phoenix area couldn't be better anywhere else.

For less than a $100, a night, you're getting a fwy close location with free wifi, and free breakfast.  The staff is always very friendly and helpful. The rooms are basic, but come with mini fridge, microwave, and coffee maker.  This is a really good value if you have kids because of the free breakfast. Although you're not close to downtown, everything is within 20 mins away in all directions.  This is our second stay here, and we choose this Marriott property for points and location as we visit annually for a sports event. The free breakfast buffet. has oatmeal, fruit, waffles, sausages, eggs, etc.  Not gourmet, but  since we sometimes have 8:00 games, the breakfast is so convenient as we don't have to go out searching for food.  There are two mall type areas nearby with a movie theater and tons of places to eat all over the area.

We stayed here and were pleased.  The staff -- from front desk to housekeeping and maintenance -- were all very friendly and welcoming.   The place was kept clean, though areas of the hotel are a bit worn (I think they are getting ready to do some renovations).  Typical free hotel breakfast, with waffle maker and microwaveable things.  The location was slightly off-putting / seedy, though great I-17 and 101 access.  Got the feeling the staff had to deal with people coming to the front desk from off the street with some regularity.  Within walking distance to Carumba's Mexican and a good Indian buffet.    The excellent staff and good proximity to Bell Road and highways made this stay a pleasant one.

My husband and I stayed at This Hotel while we were in town for my nieces baby shower and it was....
1)very Convenient- right off I-17
2) rooms were clean and cozy
3) friendly staff( especially Vicki in the breakfast area)
4)the food selection was great including hot items like make your own waffles and scrambled eggs, hard boiled eggs and sausage patties/sausage links.
5) grab and go Items for sale, the selection was great.

All and all an Excellent stay and price point. We will be back!! Thank You Vicki!!

Definitely not the greatest neighborhood, which made me uncomfortable, but when I arrived to hotel
customer service was amazing from the front desk to maids. 
Breakfast was great...on time and many options. 

I really enjoyed my stay.

We took a road trip and stayed at a few hotels along the way, this was probably my favorite. We almost stayed downtown, but there was some convention, and we got lucky this hotel had one room left, and honored our travel coupon. Glad we ended up here, it was very nice. The front desk staff was super sweet,  the room was clean, far enough from the freeway to not hear noise, and the bed was comfy. 
My favorite part was the breakfast the next morning. They offer a good free breakfast, seemed homemade, everything looked clean, and there was a waffle maker. 
It didn't see like there was a lot to do around the area, it's next to a waffle house, and it's kind of far from downtown phoenix, but it's worth it to stay here. pick up a travel book at  a nearby dennys or travel center and get a coupon for it. It made it 59$ instead of the normal rate of 89$.

Very friendly & helpful with dining suggestions. It's in a good location with a lot of anything you need or want close by. Very clean and comfortable beds. VERY affordable. I would recommend to anyone
This place is awesome the service is great the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable I've been here 4 times and every time we do its still awesome.

This place might not be in the nicest part of town but you would never know from inside of the clean fresh smelling room.
The lady at the front desk was kind and out going.
I would not hesitate to visit again.

HEY JW! Travelin Shoes likes this place! It's my second time here. it's got some usual Marriott accoutrements; it's clean, comfortable and a big breakfast that is awesome considering the under $70.00/nite rate. But JW, you know what makes this place stand above the rest? You know why I came back? It's the staff. I am treated like they would treat you JW. See you again!
This place is not up to Marriott standards.  Pretty gross.   Really uncomfortable beds and feels more like a motel 6.   Avoid this place.

I liked this Fairfield Inn. I could find nothing wrong with it. It was a clean room with a bed and all the things a person could need. However, if you are looking for a Marriott property to stay at for a similar price on average, The TownPlace Suites Phoenix North is only about 4 miles away and it is much nicer. For the same price you can enjoy better rooms, better customer service, and basically a better everything.

I'm not one to complain about hotels- but this place is not a place I would choose to stay again. The building is very old. Three floors a single shaky elevator, one ice machine on the bottom floor, no vending machines. About 10 minutes after checking in I went to the lobby to purchase a soda, the lady was just moving incredibly slow, and then asked if had my ID. I understand protocol but you literally just checked me into my room using the exact same card- I think I just stared at her, sort of ridiculous if you ask me. They've done a lot to modernize the interior, newer carpet and wall paper trying to capitalize on that retro, mid century modern feel. I wasn't a huge fan, can't disguise old. Also there was a guy sleeping in the grass outside on hotel property...

I travel a lot for business and I stay exclusively at the Marriott properties.  This one really just wasn't all that great of an experience.

First impression  of the place is that its in a not-so-great neighborhood and the way the road is laid out if you miss the turn in you have to go around and try again.

My company called ahead and made reservations with their credit card on file for payment, the lady at the desk was nice and to the point and thanked me for waiting and during the check in she asked for a credit card for incidentals which is typical and fine. 

I got my key and headed up to the room to drop off luggage and then head back down, immediately outside the front door I was propositioned by someone asking if I wanted a "date"  I declined, but I knew what was up. 

After returning with dinner I got comfortable and hopped int he shower, I'm 6'6" tall and my head was literally 3 inches from the ceiling in the shower, its an odd feeling some people may never experience. Overall the room was clean organized and typical, just had a dated and worn feeling. 

In the morning I packed up and headed down to get breakfast which is supposed to be served between 6:30 and 8 or so, unfortunately I guess the person who normally sets it up was not there so breakfast was not ready,  The manager was trying to get things together and was running around trying  to make it happen.

For anyone that stays at these hotels they give you a receipt under your door sometime during the night and I noticed that my credit card was charged for the full amount.  Since the manager was running around and I had to be out the door I didnt even bother trying to get this sorted out 

I'd suggest you stay at a different location if you have the option.

By far the WORST hotel I have ever stayed at. This location is a disgrace to the Marriott chain. The hotel itself is very old and dirty. The elevator doesnt look like it has ever been cleaned or vacuumed. The sheets on our bed were dirty when asked for a new set they gave us two flat sheets. Of course the sheets werent changed the following day.  Then my husband and I both forgot our phone chargers (iphone & blackberry) and of course they are no where to be found. So not only is this place a dump but things disappear! The customer service was terrible when I called about the chargers. I know typically Marriott properties are a safe bet but stay away from this one! It is terrible!

This place is good for the price. The only real downside is the location. This is our first trip to Phoenix and we knew nothing about what parts are good/bad. We made last minute plans and were on a budget. I felt totally safe inside but my husband was propositioned by a suspect looking female asking for a ride across the highway, someone's truck parked literally 20 ft from our car and room was stolen, and there were some other questionable looking individuals out in the parking lot (and adjacent lots) frequently. We have 2 kids under 4 so this is not ideal. All and all the staff is great, value is good, place seemed pretty clean. Probably won't return but solely based on location reasons.

I stay exclusively at Marriott for all of my business travels, and travel weekly for work.  Last week while in Phoenix I decided to give this property a try and stay here due to the great price.  When I showed up, the property itself was OK, but the location is sketchy at best.  There were two people sitting directly across the small lot from the entrance doing drugs, and a homeless man arguing with himself while ripping apart the dumpster behind the adjacent breakfast restaurant.  I called Marriott to change my reservation and tell them how surprised and displeased I was with this property, and it sounded like they were well aware of the issues, as they switched me over to the Happy Valley location no problem.

I would not recommend this location.......

Look elsewhere.

The good, the bad, and the really ugly.
First, the good.  The room was clean, the bed was comfy, towels were fluffy, and the free morning hot breakfast was decent.  The sweet lady who stocked the breakfast area worked her butt off. There were eggs, sausage, fruit, waffles, oatmeal, cereals. Terrific. 
Then, the bad.  The room we were given was right next to the lobby and breakfast room--really, this needs to be an area for housekeeping, not a hotel room--and so I was subjected all day and night to doors slamming, people talking loudly at the ice machine, the sound of the ice machine, and in fact, people talking loudly all day and all night.
The ugly.  There was some kind of middle school sports team the weekend we were there.  They were constantly out in the lobby, extremely noisy until fairly late at night, and this noise went on very close to the front desk, nobody--not the desk clerks, not their chaperones--suggested that they be quiet.  They were allowed to wonder through the downstairs area without any correction, run in and out of the doors, slamming them behind them.  Honestly, the noisiest room I have ever stayed in in my life. 

Update: I left a jacket behind and they were totally cool about it. Usually I never see stuff again when I leave it. Very nice people. (But seriously. Soundproof those rooms)

No complaints about my experience here. Hotel was clean in main lobby, corridors and in room. Room was perfect for business travel for I spent little time at hotel. Breakfast was typical Fairfield fare and nothing spectacular. However, the seating area for breakfast was nice. Convenient to freeway and shopping.

Clean, comfortable, free wi-fi and fairly inexpensive...that's all I ask for in a hotel. Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Free breakfast in the morning; Nothing too crazy, but it will get you through the day. Gym is a little small, but never anyone in there. My only gripe, neighborhood seems a little run down. Several homeless walking around outside when I checked in. Overall, I would stay here again. If you want the basics in a hotel, you will find them here.

Georgina was amazing! I have very problematic skin with acne and a lot of blackheads. I got a facial and microdermabrasion and my skin felt and looked really great afterwards. I would recommend her over any spa in Vegas. I'll be coming regularly!

I will tell everyone how much i love this place.  Georgina is very accommodating and gives the best facials ever!  Orsi is also excellent for facials.  My face has never looked better!  People that complain are just miserable and are going to always find something to complain about!  I have had nothing but amazing experiences here!  Thank you Georgina!

Amazing place to get a massage before your wedding! I got a full body massage and a full body wrap prior to the day of my most important day and have to say that treated me like royalty! They made a stressful moment for me into a very special situation. Thank you guys!

Took my daughter here as part of a 21st birthday weekend. Even though we were using a web coupon, Georgina and Pablo treated us royally, like full-price customers. Left totally stress free, and the skin issues I'd been battling for days cleared up practically overnight! Take a tip--get away from The Strip, visit Bella Vita, and get much better treatment at a better price.

came by and this place was closed during the day. Its a buy appointment only. It would have been nice to have more therapists working there like many other spas. I called and no one
picked up the phone either because there was only one person working there.

While in the Vegas area I wanted to treat myself to a spa experience along with my sister. My preference is small and personal, I did my research to find such a spa.  I chose the Bella Vita Duetto-couples package of a facial and massage (covers two people getting services at the same time in different rooms). Bella Vita Spa was very comfortable and pleasant. As it is by appointment, we were the only ones getting serviced and the personalized attention was wonderful. They give heavenly facials, and the masseuse is an expert. Robes and slippers were provided for us to go between rooms. We were both thrilled with our experience. After I purchased some luscious hand cream (all the products offered were very nice, and there was no heavy sales pitch that can occur in larger establishments) and enjoyed tea and light and healthy snacks made available in the waiting area. We would be happy to visit when we are in the area again.

My sister bought me a massage for my birthday/graduation. I never heard of the place so I was excited to try it. The spa itself is small, cute, comfortable. Everything a spa should be! Pablo was amazing! He educated on things as he did them and made me feel very relaxed and comfortable. I will definitely be back!
Had a great facial and waxing done here today by Georgina. Appointment only, very relaxing and calm location and is my new go to! Check it out!

I had a Groupon that I found for Bella Vita, and I'm so happy I used it when I did. I like when you can tell that a place is family-owned. The interior was so relaxing and calm right when you walk in. 

The customer service was genuine and the massage was amazing. Just what I needed when I went in. The pricing was competitive and really a great deal for the service provided.

I would rather go here than a chain or huge spa definitely.

Don't let those playful dark locks fool you, Pablo is seriously one of the best massage therapists I've had.  His attention to detail coupled with his experienced hands will melt the tension right off your body! 

The location is perfect because it's easy to find.  It's quaintly decorated inside giving you that luxurious spa feeling. 

If you're looking for a fabulous massage at a great price, look no further!:)

Nice place, very clean. Pablo is very nice, high energy, and knows his stuff. He is very confident in his abilities and is very talkative. Maybe a little too personal at times though.

Good massage and I really felt better afterwards. My only down point was that the massage only lasted about 45 minutes when I paid for 60. I always time my massage therapists and appreciate a full hour if that's what I am paying for. Will I go back? Maybe. Overall it was nice.

Georgina made me feel really good about myself & my skin concerns. I love how she customized my facial/microdermabrasion. & I feel confident that I will get my desired skin with her help. Definitely a returning customer :)

Pablo is the man. He's very personable and down to earth. We arrived 20 min late, but he was super chill about if. He really doesn't stress little things. But he was cool, offered tea and water. The place looks very professional. 

A little about Pablo, he was in a car accident years ago and thanks therapy and massage  for his ability to walk again. He's passionate about what he does, and it shows in his quality of work. 

So Pablo is very knowledgable about his craft. He walks you through everything he's doing. He basically gives you a quick 1hr educational lesson. 
He offers counter intuitive philosophies about his own massage.

For  a 50$ groupon definitely worth it. I would have paid far more. I would recommend Pablo to everyone who needs a massage. Cool guy with a quality massage.
Thank you Georgina & Pablo for taking care of us today; my husband and I loved both the massage and facial!! We are definitely coming back!

Wow. This place was a great start To a horrible day. It was supposed to be a girls vacation with our start here right from the airport. I scheduled the full treatments for me and bff but before we left from slc my bff was admitted to the er and was unable to attend. They were gracious about it and did not charge for the last minute cancellation and did their best to make me comfortable and relax without her. Needles to say I'll be back in a couple of weeks with bff in tow and I'll be using the services again. Thanks for making the start of my lonely vacation on a good note.

I bought a facial for my girlfriend on Valentine's day while I got to enjoy the best massage of my life! Who says guys can't enjoy Valentine's day too?! 

Pablo and Georgina truly take care of their customers and were the most genuine people we met on our vacation to Las Vegas. 

It is very close to the strip (we were staying at the MGM). I would definitely recommend coming here instead of paying more money for lower quality service at the hotel spas. 

We will definitely come back every time we visit!

What a wonderful and relaxing treat for me and my honey at the Bella Vita Spa!  We both got massages and facials, and we felt rejuvenated and refreshed after our 2 hour treatment.  My guy was skeptical about getting a facial, but was truly glowing (even with a beard!) after his facial!  The therapists at Bella Vita are professional, knowledgable, and really take an interest in accommodating their clients and addressing their areas of concern.  I could feel the stress melt away, and we were both feeling relaxed and rejuvenated after our time at Bella Vita.  A special thank you to Georgina...   you have a beautiful spa!!!

My friend and I booked a facial while we were in Vegas.  This was the best thing we did while we were there. The place is darling and very comfortable. Georgina makes you feel at home.  Her hands are Magic. She is so sweet and this was the best facial I have ever had.  My skin feels great.   If you are in Vegas get on her books.
A great facial!  What a lovely surprise. It was a highlight in my visit to LV and I will return each time I am in Vegas.
Such a great place for a facial. Georgina was amazing. She made my skin feel amazing  after. Can't wait till my next appointment!

I had a microdermabrasion with Georgina and it was amazing! My face was smooth and she was very careful with my face, which is sensitive. Georgina was informative, telling me what she was going to be doing throughout the facial. My bed was warm and toasty-- Bella Vita is a MUST! Also, they have some light snacks and beverages for their clients to enjoy in their lovely relaxation lounge portion.

Pablo is an excellent massage therapist.  He intuitively finds the spots that need attention and artfully helps resolve tension, applies a soothing touch, and generally makes you feel good all over.  I felt great the next two days. I will definitely go back for another.

Best Massage Ever! Pablo did an amazing job with my massage. Enjoyed every second. My favorite was the warm stone. The Spa is clean, smells good, and have relaxing music playing...highly recommend this place. If any of you are going to Vegas, You MUST stop by and get the best massage ever. He explains what's happening to your body.

Bella Vita is Awful ...

You don't have to read the whole review.  This place is unbelievably bad.  Scary bad.  I don't know if I can be more direct.  Do not waste your time or money - stay away.  The details ...

I planned a day for my wife to celebrate her 50th birthday.  Everything would have been perfect, if not for the Bella Vita experience.

This was a surprise for my wife - a day trip to Vegas to have a wonderful lunch, relax and see a show (neither of us are huge gamblers).  My wife had been under a great strain and I wanted her to get a really nice massage in between lunch and the show.  I researched a number of sites and they all ranked Bella Vita very high.  I booked an appointment online and called the establishment a day in advance to confirm.  Spoke to Georgina, one of the owners, explained my wife's stress and physical condition (she has some arthritis in her back/neck that flares up) so they could be sensitive to it.   Explained that we were traveling in for the day and were not local.  I was told to arrive at 3:45 for a 4:00 appointment so they could get everything ready, intake form, prepare my wife etc.

We arrived at 3:40 and found the door locked.  Kind of unusual, but after knocking for a while a woman came to open the door.  She was giving a facial and explained that the "massage therapist" would arrive "very soon."  At 4:00 - still no "therapist" and my wife was ready to leave.  We were again told that the owner was aware of the situation and the "therapist" would be "a little late."  I was optimistic - my wife not so much.

At 4:10 Kate (rhymes with "late") arrived.  I'll spare any editorializing, let's just say her demeanor and appearance suggested someone with a taste for the consumption of non-organic stimulants.  In short, there was not a chance my wife would allow Kate to give her a massage.  Ever.  Even if she had been on time.  Never going to happen.  Ever.

The biggest disappointment was the reaction of the owner Pablo.  He said this was it for Kate and she was being "fired after today" (great- she sucks but let's have her give just one more massage anyway - and her motivation would be...).  He apologized and defended his stellar management of the shop (by not being on-site and having this soon-to-be-fired independent contractor giving treatments?).  He offered to give my wife a free massage and facial on her next trip.  Great - I can fly her in with the expense of airfare (a few hundred), cab fare to & from his crappy shop - comparing that to the cost of just getting a massage in San Francisco - yea, thanks Pablo, but no.  Then Pablo waved the red flag in front of the bull.  He asked me to suggest what he could do to make it right.  To me, that is akin to having me experience the problem and then come up with the solution.  So sorry Pablo - you'll have to use those exemplary management skills you profess to have and figure out how to make this right all by yourself.

So Bella Vita, Kate and Pablo screwed up an otherwise amazing birthday celebration.  I was out $40+ in cab fare, lost over an hour of time, and my put my wife in a crappy frame of mind for the rest of the evening.  Thank you Pablo and Georgina.  Avoid this place, pretend it doesn't exist, be skeptical of the other reviews, spend your cash somewhere else.  In the strongest possible terms - this place just doesn't deserve your business.  Please don't make the same mistake that I made.

You need this, if you want a massage therapist with a great knowledge base and technique then look no further. I was a bit skeptical at first , but now after just a few treatments I feel so much better. I've seen several different people over the last several years , and Pablo has done more to solve my on going problems than anyone else. Seriously give him a try. He will explain everything he does and work with you on your own problem areas. Good people who actually care are hard to find.

Pablo is a very talented masseuse. I have been to many here in town, and he is the best, by far. Better than any chain or individual practice I've ever experienced.  He finds knots and tension in places I didn't even know were there!  And you don't experience any pain--during the massage or afterwards--no aches and pains from the pressure.  He is excellent.  I hold my stress in my neck and shoulders, and I deal with a lot of knots in there.  Pablo is a lifesaver.  I doubt I'll ever find anyone better.  He really is the BEST!!

At first when I pulled up, I got a little nervous since there weren't any lights on and the door was locked. I had made my appointment online so I was worried that somehow it didn't register. However, after a minute Remise came an unlocked the door and apologized for it being locked. She was the only one there working and I could understand why she would lock it if she has massages to do too.

I got the ninety minute hot stone massage and it did not disappoint! I always feel that with massages they focus on your back and everything else is an after though, but this was not the case with Remise. I was so comfortable and relaxed and had the right amount of pressure. I would highly recommend trying this place out. The prices are reasonable for what you get for sure; just make sure you make a reservation since they are an appointment only facility!

I had a facial from Georgina Poloni & a massage from Pablo Poloni, it was amazing! You do not need excessive words to describe the quality of service they bring to the table. The Spa's decor is very calm, clean, refreshing and most importantly professional and non-tacky. It exudes a luxury setting with sense of home and comfortability.

Thank you Yelp for the insights on this local, off-the-strip boutique spa. Wow. Ample convenient parking, nice decor, soothing music, comfortable heated bed, and great, caring service from Georgina the licensed esthetician. She was very thorough in her facial and utilized quality products. As a local I've been searching for a lower cost yet high quality boutique spa for facials and finally found it!
