Our server , though, was very good, and offered some recommendations to us first-timers.  Our drinks were good, reasonably priced at about $4.25 for call mixers.  I can live with that...

I had the Maffe with chicken, and while there was quite a bit of sauce, I thought it was a plus, since the rice soaked up the leftovers overnight and it was sooo yummy this morning!  The owner did make the rounds of the tables and seemed to really care what people thought of the food and the restaurant overall.

I would never ever in my life eat here. I would give it -100 stars if I could. Last time I was there for dancing there was broken glass all over which the staff refused to clean up. You think that's bad? There was also puke all over for the whole entire night that the staff said they weren't going to waste their time cleaning up until bartime. DISGUSTING. The bathrooms stank of piss (I believe it was all over the floors), the sink lever was busted, the towel dispenser was on the ground under the sink.... There was even a bloody tampon sitting on the sink!!!!!!!!! I am going to report this place to the Health Department as soon as I get a chance. How can you even operate a business like this and then refuse to take care of the mess after being asked numerous times? How can you just stand around when there are biohazards all over your damn restaurant? I think I've said enough...
The food is delicious. I like the variety in flavors. The service is a slower than I am accustomed to but that may simply part of the African culture (benefit of the doubt).

Just went this past weekend. Yum. My dad's a carnivore and I'm vegetarian - we were both very pleased with the food and service.

First, my drink. I think they mix even the virgin stuff, because I got a delicious, FRESH mango lemonade. SOOOO good.

Next, the appetizers. I got the fried plantain. I love hot sauce, so I was irritated at the small amount of it. Then I tried it. Let's just say a little goes a LOOOOONG way. Good =]

I had the Maffe - no meat, nor any mushrooms. I had it with rice. It was great, but I agree with the other reviewer - a lot of sauce vs. vegetable. Oh well. Still fantastic. 

I wasn't big on the "fufu". Reminded me of play-doh.

The flan was delicious. Small for the price, though.

My dad enjoyed his meal. He had the Nem (rolls, looked yummy but had meat in them :( ), Kedjenou, and couscous. The couscous wasn't his favorite, but that's just him. I tried it, the preparation was spot-on, just not his thing.

We went late in the afternoon, so we got there before the majority of dinner diners were. Service was good, keeping in mind that the bartender is also the server. Unless they have more employees on busy nights, I can see how service would be a bit slow.

All in all, very pleased with the service. Aside from a few minor pricing complaints and such, we enjoyed our dinner and will return.

My biggest complain was the service: slow with lots of mistakes. It took over an hr for our appetizer to arrive, while one party of 3 who came later of us already finished and left (and another party of 6 had their order 20min earlier).  We were too hungry, and we asked for bread. Took them in total 40min to get us the bread.

Water was never filled until we asked and it came 10min later.

There were about 5 tables at the peak time that night with 2 servers. Then there were the owner and his family. The owner came to apologize after us waiting for almost an hr, saying he'd check on the meals, but he never came back with a follow-up. At the end, he offered dessert on the house, but they were out of the one we wanted. He didn't offer to not charge our appetizer. Not sure how sincere he was about his apology.

Food was ok. Decor was ok. Due to bad service, I would not go back.

Mistakes they made:
(1) 1hr wait entree
(2) 40min wait for bread and appetizer
(3) water was never refilled
(4) entree were wrong

We went not long after they opened, so I could almost forgive the extremely slow service and our server's lack of food-related English vocabulary.  It takes awhile to learn.  But the food we (finally) got was inexcusable.

My dinner seemed to be chunks of vegetables stuck under a broiler until burned on the outside, nearly raw on the inside.  I thought African food would be spicy, but nope, just veggies.  My husband got fish that was so full of bones it was inedible.  Maybe there were other things on the menu we would have liked better, but we couldn't communicate with the server well enough to find out.

The glass of wine was so stingy, a modest-sized glass only maybe a third of the way full, that I sent it back and got a bottled beer instead.

We recently tried Africana on a Tuesday night.  The restaurant was packed with only two servers hustling about.  Our food was interesting which is why we chose to check it out.  However it wasn't memorable and my dish had way too much oil.  The owner/chef came out and personally asked us how our meal was -- which is always a nice touch.  It's definitely a break from the norm and the plantains were sooooo tasty.

I agree with the first reviewer on all counts. This restaurant needs to mature. The service took forever, and the food is indeed much too saturated with oil and sauce. However, the flavors are rich and new to us. For us as well, the owner visited our table.

I would like to see this restaurant offer smaller tapas like dishes for $5-8 at dinner. I think these would be more popular with the target audience. I am not sure how dishes are prepared in Africa, but it's hard to believe that this much sauce is the default.

I went here on a Saturday afternoon and sat at the bar.  The bartender seemed a little overwhelmed and it took me a little while to get his attention.

The decor is a little weird.  Mirrors on all the walls which I hate when I am eating, but other than that it was very nice.  Big TVs tuned to soccer so it would be a good place for that if you are a fan.

The jollof rice with chicken was very good.  The sauce had just a hint of spice and was very savory.

I went here a while ago and was not impressed. As many have mentioned, service was slow and inattentive.  The food that we had was just not flavorful and not memorable.

I do admit--I went to their webpage, and perhaps they have improved a bit. They now advertise stuff like free wifi and they also now have a lunch buffet, which would interest me more to see if it was just the dishes that we had that I disliked.

They moved my wife and I from an East York bungalow to the Beaches. I liked that it was a nice woman answering their phone and not the movers themselves mid-job. She was able to accommodate us on fairly short notice and quoted a good price.

Three movers came at 3pm as promised. They were nice and there was one older supervisor-type mover who ran the show and made sure everything was handled perfectly. We were running back and forth between the houses ourselves, leaving them to do their thing. I'm confident they worked hard the entire time.

Even though we were proud of ourselves for being packed ahead of time, there still ended up being some loose items around the house once the boxes were removed. They packed them up and handled it for us without problem.

The only thing I would say is that their trucks were mid-sized so if you're moving far with a large house, they're not for you. For our situation though everything fit. I was very happy with how they handled things, the service and the price. I would definitely use them again.

I booked this company about a month ago for a move from Toronto to Mississauga. They were diligent and made an appointment for me right away for a time/date of my choosing. They gave me service at $80 flat rate. 
I enjoyed the administrative side of this transaction. 
I was set to Move from a one bedroom apartment to a three bedroom stacked town house. A two man team showed up on time as promised- a younger gentleman and an older fellow. They were both very pleasant at the beginning but as the day progressed and tasks seemed a little more difficult, I noticed that the older gentleman's frustration levels were becoming high. I was spoken to with a direct harsh attitude and selective hopelessness ( deciding before they moved my couch upstairs that it wasn't going to make it and almost yelling at me for not knowing what to do. Sorry buddy I didn't get to pick what apartment I received: I couldn't make your life easy, just move it and stop being so harsh) which made an already stressful day even more so.  I ended up telling them to move it the best the can and my couch was ripped ( in all fairness they warned me) 
I appreciate the help. Please next time just watch the hostile behavior because it really doesn't help stress levels on a big day like that. 
All in all I had a pleasant move besides the harsh attitude, everything was moved. 
I would book this company again just without someone with attitude. It really doesn't help the situation when someone is frustrated moving your things. 
I tipped them both.

Hired this company at the last minute. They phoned on their way, showed up exactly on time and were super friendly and easy to work with. Can't beat the service. Thanks Eric and Ahmad for your professional and diligent work. I'd hire you again in a second. Highly recommended.
Great moving company. Honest and affordable. They were very accommodating and helpful. Ill definitely use them again

Calling and securing a date was quick and easy! held my spot with a CC- Once my movers showed up the move went quick and was painless! the guys really went fast and didn't damage anything.

I had Ikea deliver three boxes on the same day- the guys moved those items up for me as well. They were both friendly and a pleasure to work with.

Hired this company to move from my condo in downtown Toronto to a house midtown. When I called a sweet lady answered and gave me the exact time and date I requested. I got a flat rate and estimated amount of time it would take to get the job done, which was nice. The truck was big so it easily fit all my furniture. 3 guys came, an older gentleman and 2 young men, nice guys, to point but I didn't mind, I preferred that they were efficient. They asked that I stick around for the entire process to direct them, again I didn't mind because it sped up the process. They finished faster then the estimated time, which was a bonus. They were efficient and professional so I tipped well and I would definitely hire them again.

Great Toronto Movers finished my move today.  It was one of, if not, the best move experience I've had ever (and I've moved a lot).

Ahmad and his team arrived 5 minutes early.  They worked diligently to complete the move out of my Adelaide condo - and we only had the elevator for 2.5 hours. They worked none stop on the other end, taking the time to ask where I'd like certain things placed / paid attention to the box labels.  I really felt that things were well looked after, their pricing was fair and best of all, they made their pricing easy to understand up front- no surprises! no add-ons after the fact. 

Truly a great moving experience -  I would absolutely recommend them to my friends and use them again!

Angela

The lady in the office kindly held two spots for me until I could confirm my availability with work.

Prepare yourself, once you've booked a date and time and given your credit card details, they do not send a confirmation email with the date and time and rate per hour.
So, make sure you write down what you organize. I know I was booked for the day and somewhere around 2pm - although she said they would be there closer to 3pm. Would have been nice to have a confirmation email.

Moving day came. 

The movers arrived early to my surprise, around 1:55pm and were eager to get going. 
I helped stage all the items to be moved in the kitchen area to make it efficient for them and they basically had all of my boxes loaded within about  15 minutes. They even finished after 2 hours and 20 minutes. Charged for the full third hour, but that was to be expected.

The only thing I can really complain about is that the boxes were not placed according to their labels. Kitchen, Bedroom, Etc... 

I am, overall satisfied. 
They were quick, efficient and friendly. I cannot fault the personalities of the staff or the friendly demeanor.

On time, fast, friendly and reasonably priced. GT Movers takes the unpleasantness of moving away. Very professional, careful and deliberate in their work. I won't hesitate to hire them again. Highly recommend.

Follow up: further to my previous review, I was contacted by management to resolve the situation and discuss concerns. I was given compensation and overall felt much better after receiving an apology.

I totally agree with "Stephanie B".  I've raised two kids and have been in plenty of urgent cares over the past 30 years but this one was, by far, the best.  The staff was incredibly friendly - front desk, nurses and physician.  My husband got treated incredibly fast (as did all the others that needed care).  There were four other people who needed to be seen and by the time my husband was done (only a 30 minute total visit time) everyone else had already been treated.  I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND that if you're in the NE Phoenix/Scottsdale area and need an Urgent Care - definitely don't hesitate to go to this one.

Went in January 2013 for a diagnoses of sinusitis, spent 3 minutes with doctor, walked out with $315 dollar bill. (including 45 dollars in extra doctors fees) I disputed the 35 dollars in extra doctors fees and they wrote it off. Got the final bill. I paid the bill in full. Faxed copy of paid check two times to clear up billing issue. Got notice neg credit report!!

Came in last Thursday, sometime before 7 pm, and there was a mother with three children seated and waiting in the lobby before me.  I signed in (and wrote down the time), handed the receptionist my medical card, and grabbed a nose and mouth mask from the tray with a sign that asked all flu and possible measles carriers to wear them.  It took 15 minutes from the time I signed in to the time a nurse admitted me to one of the rooms in the back.  No vitals were taken, except for my temperature (wand under the tongue), and I was asked to do this myself, as the nurse didn't want to be contaminated, since she "sees a lot of patients."  I was running a 102.4 F fever...  She asked me what were my major complaints as far as symptoms were concerned, so I told her cough and congestion, muscle and joint aches, and fever.  Her internet connection apparently broke down, so she decided to just go and get the doctor.  I laid down to wait for the doctor, about five minutes, or so.

A masked doctor came in and waited for me to sit back up.  Approached me and said "Congested?  Muscle aches?  Running a fever?  Work at _______?  You have the flu."  I said "Yes, I know."  He said he'd write prescriptions for Tamiflu (one pill, twice a day, for five days) and a Z-pack (five days) and asked me if I knew what Z-packs were (yes) and had any trouble taking it (no).  I asked him if Tamiflu*** contained cornstarch, could he could ask the pharmacist to substitute something that didn't contain cornstarch, he said he didn't know.  (I asked him this, because another doctor of mine had prescribed Vitamin D gels for me to take that specifically didn't have corn fillers in them for me a long time ago, so I thought this doctor might do the same.)

There are Urgent Care clinics closer to where I live, but this specific one shares the same database as Scottsdale Healthcare (hence the name), which is why the medical clinic sent me here.  My sister in NC was surprised when the UC doc gave me an antiviral and antibiotic at the same time, and I told her it's standard whenever i get sick, due to my symptoms, medical history, and where I work.

First time here and it went well.  My copay was $25.

***Tamiflu is made with corn maltodextrin, which is pretty standard in pills gel tabs, and Walgreens pharmacist didn't know of any substitutions, nor the info.  I had to look up the ingredients online. The Z pack can irritate stomachs and thus your intestines, so make sure you eat something first, preferably oatmeal or something hearty.

I started feeling better enough to eat something heartier than spoonfuls of soup broth on day three.  Prepare to sweat a lot (I lost four pounds in water weight and muscle apathy), and I was glad to have our water cooler and all of the coconut water I bought from Costco (I had Vita Coco and Zico) for water and electrolyte rehydration!  Please take care of yourselves and your loved ones!!

#750

I went to the SHC Urgent Care Plus hoping the trip would be quick.  I was pleasantly surprised at how quick and great the service was.  I needed a strep throat test and felt horrible.  The staff was able to get me in and out within 15 minutes. The registration process was simple (3 forms...information sheet, pharmacy preference sheet and HIPAA) and the front desk staff was very friendly.  The nurse and physician were very professional and friendly.  The facility was clean and spacious.  I couldn't be happier and will definitely be back if needed.

Over Christmas most of my family ended up visting Scottdale Healthcare Urgent Care Plus.  It costs me $5 more than seeing a doctor in an office but well worth it.  As others on here have stated, the registration process was very quick and simple.  Staff was awesome.  The front desk girl is wonderful and my father loved the fact she recently moved from Florida as he was in visting from Florida.  I would highly recommended this urgent care facility.  We were in and out within 30 minutes as well.  Very professional and friendly staff.  I don't think you can go wrong visiting this facility if you are looking for an urgent care.

My wife went to this location at 7:40pm (open until 8) and the open sign was already turned off and the door was locked. Don't advertise you are open until 8pm and close early! Almost all urgent care locations close at 8pm and she did not have enough time to make it to another location. She ended up having a staph infection and needed antibiotics that she could not get until the following day.
Das traditionelle Eiscafé in Stuttgart, hier auch fast an seinem traditionellen Platz. Das Eis ist lecker, die Auswahl groß. Ideal für den Samstagseinkauf, falls man noch einen Platz bekommt.

Das Eiscafe ist sehr gut besucht und der Service wirkt leicht überfordert. Das Eis selber ist extrem lecker und die Kugeln auch sehr groß. Trotzdem finde ich 1,20 € für eine Kugel Eis ziemlich übertrieben!
Die Preise sind zwar gesalzen, dafür sind die Kugeln aber auch etwas größer als bei der Konkurrenz, das Eis ist das Beste Eis das ich in Deutschland gegessen habe!
Bedienung schnell da, mittelfreundlich. Eis schlecht.

Diese Eisdiele hat glaube ich fast ein Monopol  in der Königsstrasse ... an mehreren Ecken haben sie ihre Läden. 
Das ist lecker und schön creamig, die kugeln sind schön gross kosten dafür aber auch 1,20 ...
Kann ich nur empfehlen.

Freue mich schon auf laue Sommernächte und ein Eis im Eiscafe Santin. 
Die Auswahl ist gigantisch und die Bedienungen sehr nett.
Ach ja - das Eis ist auch sehr lecker!! Für mich der Klassiker in der Innenstadt.

Also das Eis ist gut und die Auswahl auch, keine Frage.
Aber die Preise!
Bei 1,20 für eine Kugel ist bei mir die Schmerzgrenze doch weit überschritten. Das seh ich einfach nicht mehr ein.

Passables Eis und große Auswahl. Muss eine Kugel Eis 1,20 EUR kosten? Größer sind sie nicht geworden. Klar, alles wird teurer. Aber 1 Euro bei "Normaleis" (Old-Bridge-Qualität ausgeschlossen) sind bei mir und vielen anderen Familien die Schmerzgrenze. Das und die Qualität der Bedienung (klar kann man auch ganz langsam noch die Maschinen zu Ende putzen auch wenn der Gast schon 2 x darauf aufmerksam gemacht hat, dass er gern zahlen möchte) lassen mich nur 2 Punkte vergeben - einen dafür, dass es hier die Eraclea-Schokolade gibt.

Hier gibt es ganz gutes italienisches Eis. Nach dem Umbau präsentiert sich das Eistaxi Santin schick und viel offener als zuvor.


 Außerdem wurde das Preismodell erweitert: es gibt Eisbecher jetzt auch als SB-Artikel in Plastikbechern, entweder zum Mitnehmen oder aber auch zum am Tisch Essen. Diese sind einiges günstiger und praktischer als die Glasschalen; und man bezahlt gleich bei der Bestellung/Abholung, so dass man auch bei wenig Zeit schnell und stressfei ein Eisbecher genießen kann - man darf dann ja gleich los und kann den Becher im Zweifel einfach mitnehmen


 Sitzgelegenheiten gibt es unter großen Sonnenschirmen viele wie zuvor.


 Außdem bietet das Santin auch einen Lieferservice gegen geringe Gebühr an, allerdings dann nur für "Eissorten" und nicht für Eisbecher.
ISta zwar ein bisschen teuer, aber das Eis ist einfach himmlisch, habe noch nie besseres gegessen!
venedig sensa giorgo no existe!!! de mendoza con amore

früher wurde man besser bedient. Heute scheint es nur noch eine Fabrik für Durchgangseisesser zu sein. Sehr teuer dafür aber auch sehr gut. Trotzdem stimmt das Preis- Leistungsverhältnis insgesamt für mich nicht (mehr)

Beim abendlichen Schlendern durch die mittlerweile auf gefühlte 40 Grad aufgeheizte Innenstadt hatte ich und mein Verlangen nach innerer Kühlung Lust auf ein Eis. Hurra, hier wurde die Schallmauer von 1EUR pro Kugel bereits weit hinter sich gelassen. Ja, wenn man bedenkt wie teuer so ein Eis in der Herstellung doch ist und das der Ferrari und das schnucklige Anwesen in Italien noch nicht ganz getilgt sind, mutet der Preis von 1,20EUR noch recht zaghaft kalkuliert an.

Neben mir standen ein paar Jugendliche die etwas erschrocken über die Höhe des Preises diskutierten. Es entbrannte eine rege Auseinandersetzung darüber, ob und 

überhaupt eine Waffel mit einer Kugel Eis gekauft werden sollte. 

Schade eigentlich, denn so ein leckeres Eis sollte doch für dieses Zielgruppe nicht zum Luxusprodukt mutieren, sondern eher ein erschwingliches Vergnügen bleiben.

Selbst musste ich auch, nach einer Bestandsaufnahme im Portemonnaie, es mir reiflich überlegen ob ich mich an diesem italienischen Investment beteiligen sollte.

Nun ja, kam schlussendlich doch noch zu einem durchaus leckerem Eis.

Die Auswahl an Sorten ist hervorragend und vielseitig. Geschmacklich standarisiert und akzeptabel, ohne nennenswerte kulinarische Ausschläge in mir zu wecken.

Die junge Damen hinter der Theke war freundlich und konnte sogar noch ein Lächeln in ihr Gesicht zaubern. Nicht immer selbstverständlich an diesen meist unterkühlten, eisproduzierenden Stätten!

Ganz kurz  für mich das allerbeste Eis in Stuttgart, besonders die Sorte Zartbitter ist göttlich!
Der Preis ist schon OK, da die Kugeln sehr groß sind und man woanders auch nicht weniger bezahlt.
Ganz tolles Eis. Traumhaft!

Ich habe schon mehrmals im Santin bei schönem Wetter draußen gesessen. Man sitzt recht nett, an einem ruhigen Platz ohne direkten Durchgangsverkehr. Der Service ist normal, wenn viel los ist dauert es eine Weile. Aber freundlich waren die Kellnerinnen meist schon.
Den Straßenverkauf (Auswahl, Preise) kann ich nicht beurteilen. Die Karte ist recht ausführlich mit vielen verschiedenen Eisbechern und sonstigen Eiskreationen. Da sollte für jeden Geschmack und jede Temperatur etwas dabei sein. Ich war mit meinen Eisbechern bisher jedes Mal sehr zufrieden. Sie haben sehr gut geschmeckt, waren ausreichend bestückt und das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis schien mir bisher angemessen. Auch Sonderwünsche (andere Eissorte, etwas weglassen) waren nie ein Problem. Meist werden in den Karten von Eiscafés recht ähnliche Eisbecher angeboten; im Santin hatte ich den Eindruck, dass auch Kreationen angeboten werden, die man nicht überall bekommt. Es gibt auch saisonale/wechselnde Eissorten, d.h. ein prüfender Blick vor der Bestellung lohnt sich.

I was really pleased with the burger combo with onion rings which I ordered. The burger patties had a great taste and were juicy not greasy, the veggies were fresh,  and the onion rings were crispy and not greasy. Everything was great, and the service was also very good. The young man was very courteous and you could tell he took pride in what he was doing. They do make everything fresh to order so I would recommend phoning in your order if you're in a hurry.  I will definitely be back and recommend this place to anyone that's in the Laveen area. Definitely a good local business to support.
The food was delicious.... I have a tear... mmmmmmm chicken wings on point 100%  watch out Marcias

My first choice for wings every time. A better taste for less money. I have JJ's on speed dial. The guys are always glad to see you and present themselves well. One would not expect such service from a drive through.
Simple, good food. No nonsense. I'm a fan. I will be going back today for dinner!

Great for lunch, burgers Fries, cooked to order so you will wait about 10 mins. It's a drive up window no inside eating. But our mechanics love to go there & grab a good big meal for your $. Better than little fast food BK burgers better price too. 

They have other food besides burgers but haven't tried them.
I have been here multiple  times and I love love love their wings. They have alot on the menu but been to addicted  to the wings to try anything  else lol
Hands down...the best drive through Iv'e ever been to...with the multiple windows there is never a wait for anything...a really well designed method..Good job

Was looking for a Really good burger so I saw this place on Southern. I decided to check it out on Yelp and decided to give it a try. A little confusing not knowing that it is "Drive Thru Only". When I ordered, a young lady came to the window and was very pleasant. She helped me with my ordering and repeated everything back to confirm order. There was 1 car ahead of me and it took about 15 minutes to get my double cheeseburger and fries. I also ordered a small soda and received a milk tanker as my cup. It was gigantic. The burger was very fresh and tasty. Worth the wait. You could taste the grill marks on the burger. Like dad used to make back in the 60's. Really good . 
My only negative was that the young lady who took my order, also was the cashier. She had food service gloves on which led me to believe she was cooking the food too. Since you cant see inside, you dont know if she was accepting cash and then handling food with same gloves on. Definitely a Health Department no-no. If she washed hands after she changed gloves, then I would say I will definitely be back. Dont know for sure. I have decided that she is a professional food service worker and understands that people can get very sick if they dont follow Health Department rules and guidelines.
Customer service is always great, definately the most organized drive thru in the area, good job guys, by the way my son loves the sucker he gets every time we go.

A very disappointing eating experience.  Had been excited to try a local place and now wish I had gambled with the 2 stars at Applebees.  Waited a long time in the drive-thru for our food and were told that the double cheeseburger had not been started yet, meaning that our plate of fried food was left sitting while it was made.  I was also surprised that the woman did not know exactly what kind of "fish" was in the platter.  When it arrived all of the fried items were soggy and barely warm and some were burnt as well.  All of the items, including the burger seemed pre-made and frozen from a package/box - nothing seemed fresh.  One of our items was forgotten.  Woman working was nice and apologetic but does not make up for the bad food and the wasted money.  I will not return and will not recommend this place.
Better than fast food! Has a home/picnic taste to it rather than a commercial taste, recommend.

I really wanted to like this place; I love hole-in-the-wall type places and the lady was really nice. However, it was extremely disappointing and I wish we could get our $30 back. The website promises fast drive through service, but we had to wait over 20 min for our food. The lady was nice and apologized for not having everything ready at the same time and offered us a refill while we waited. This would have been forgivable if the food was edible, but unfortunately it was not. The queens platter was soft and soggy (I had to throw it away). The fried zucchini was cut so thin it tasted like just over fried breading. Also, they accidentally forgot the nuggets for my two year old, which we had to go back for. Burger was just ok. The lady promised that it's not usually like this and to please try and come back, but after loosing 30 bucks, I wouldn't want to risk any more money.

I guess a good thing must come to an end. Got an order last week Queens Platter and 16 piece wings BBQ spicy with fries. I was completely disappointed with the whole order the queens platter was for my Mother my mom is old school so when she said the fish was smushy with no test I couldn't  believe it since every time we have gotten the fish it was great. I tasted the fish it was beyond smushy with no taste the shrimp was chewy and the wings undercooked.  My wings were undercooked and not seasoned  and were hardly sauces and the normally on no point fries were
a smushy mess. I reached out to the Grubb shack to voice my displeasure  and get my money back $30 with no response so very disappointed

I have been coming to Dancewear since I was a little girl and it holds a special place in my heart. 

A tiny little shop located on Rose Street, I still peer in the window at their displays every time I go past. Dancewear take care of all your dancing needs. They have every type of shoe you could imagine, from ballet shoes to jazz trainers. There is also a good selection of dance wear, again for most types of dance. There is also a good variety of accessories and gifts. Oh the gifts! Whenever I needed new ballet shoes and my mum took me here I always insisted on getting some sort of gift, whether it be a keyring or a ballerina teddy. I used to buy all my dancing friends presents here. 

Their pointe shoe fitting service is one of the best in Scotland. I have spent hours in here while they have tried fitting me and the range of stock is impeccable. The staff are very knowledgeable and well trained, which is super important when getting your pointe shoes fitted.

Great little shops for all those budding ballerinas.

A lovely small family run shop on Rose Street that caters for many differant dance styles. The have an on-line web site that you can order from or you can visit the shop.


 Many choice in Costumes and Shoes - Pointe, Ballet, Tap, Modern, Jazz, Highland, Irish, Scottish Country Dancing. They also stock a wide selection of the worlds premier dance brands including Bloch, Capezio, Danskin, Intermezzo, Le Papillon, Gamba, Repetto, Sansha, Dans-ez, Tappers & Pointers. There is also a loyalty card available to use on-line and instore for some great discounts.


 I have used this dance shop alot and always find the staff very pleasent and helpfull. They have some lovely dance gifts that would be ideal pressents for those little dancers. They always measure the childs foot and ensure the fit is correct before you purchase. They have a great returns service and will order items in for you if they are out of stock.

Whenever I walk past here I wish I hadn't given up dancing when I was younger, I used to love ballet but my teacher was an old battleaxe so ended up hating it, to be honest, the only reason I stuck it out for so long was because you got a lolly pop at the end of the class. Quite the reward, I thought.

This shop has a really traditional feel to it, probably because it's been there for years. You will find everything you need for beginners dance classes or more advanced ones too.  The staff are very knowledgeable so will be able to recommend what's best for you or your tots dancing needs.

They also have very cute teddies in the window with little dancing outfits on. This would have been perfect for me when I was younger as I think my mum wanted me to do dancing more than I actually wanted to so she could have definitely bribed me with a teddy. Maybe that's why they're there.

Okay I am not a ballet dancer and pink isn't my favourite colour. I had to go into Dancewear to look for a pair of Jazz shoes for other work I was doing. Despite reservations I was impressed with the service!

Dancewear is a dance shop selling dance shoes, clothes, bags and accessories.  The shop does sell mostly girls shoes and clothes, but it does provide for men too.

When I went in I was given a lot of assistance by the woman working there. The fitting service was great. She spent a lot of time with me until I found exactly what I was looking for. It seemed as important for her to be satisfied as me!

I'm not a huge fan of the aesthetic inside but I do think it is fitting.

Note that Dancewear is due for refurbishment during July. The shop also had a good online store for viewing and buying and general info.

A great little dance shop right in the city centre!

My daughter goes to The Dance School Of Scotland and we have been buying the vast majority of her shoes from Dancewear in Edinburgh for the last five years. They are absolutely terrific and well worth the trip from Dundee every few months. This is a family owned and managed shop and their experience is second to none. The staff have this amazing ability of simply looking at my daughters feet and they know what size and width of shoe she needs, very impressive! What they don't have, they will order for you and will even post them to save you making a return trip. The service they provide is first class and I can recommend them 100%. There is nowhere better I'm sure. Thankyou Dancewear!

I have been dancing for 5 years now and this is the friendliest dance shop I have come across (though this could be because the majority I have been in are in London). I normally dance in "dance trainers" but I wanted to buy a pair of proper shoes now that I am much more confident with the dance. The shop fairly busy when I arrived with a mix of both men and women and because of the snow only one assistant had made it in to work. The one lady that was there however was buzzing around making sure that everyone felt welcome and accommodated. She was very patient with me, asked me a range of questions and allowed me to try on many different pairs in order to find that perfect shoe. To give another example of their friendliness, I was even given a glass of water when I descended into a coughing fit at one point.


 I would highly recommend Dancewear on Rose Street. They also have a website http://www.dancewear-edinburgh.co.uk if you are wanting to buy something which doesn't need to be tried on or you can't get down to the shop.

A friend and I got a 60-min relaxation massage from there today.

The owner and massage therapists often talk in Russian.
But they all speak fluent French and ok English.

We had a positive experience. 
They assigned a therapist with a same gender, so I didn't have the same issue.
Our therapists didn't say much, only the necessary minimum. Mine only responded to my comments. 

It was relaxing, so we both fell asleep partly. 
It included head, feet, and hands. It all felt very nice. 

We bought a package including a sauna. However we got bad sun burn, so GM let us return for a free sauna in future. (He gave a card for it.) :-)

I like deep massages, so I might try their deep massage in future.

Who doesn't love being pampered and massaged at a day spa? Certainly not I!

Upon entering, we were greeted and given terry cloth wraps and sandals, and directed toward to changing rooms.  There's a variety of lotions and hair products available near the showers, should you need them.  

We started out with a short session in the sauna, which is pretty spacious.  I had a swedish massage and hand treatment.  The masseuse (male) was friendly and professional, and the music was soothing.  The massage was relaxing and thorough, though there was a strange brief armpit massage (it was, um, different..).  

The lounge area is comfortable, with lounge chairs and beverages (tea, water) available.  There's also a tank of fish.  The host, seeing our intrigued glances, put his hand in the tank, and invited us to do the same (after washing our hands, of course - don't want to feed the fish lotion!).  We decided to try a 20 minute fish pedicure.  For the first 10 minutes we were laughing uncontrollably - it's a very weird/ticklish feeling.   I can't say that I noticed a difference after the 'pedicure', but it was an enjoyable and fairy unique experience. And we bonded with fish ;)

I'm not the type to go for spa treatments, I tend to leave that to my wife. However I found a deal with Red Flag Deals and was stressed at the time and decided to pick up the offer as its close to my office.

Trying to book an appointment was next to impossible. They would never answer the phone. Their web site is outdated as the hours of operation are not at all up to date. I decided to go and pay them a visit to book my appointment. 

Once there, I would have to say everything was fine. The therapist was great as I asked her to focus on my shoulders. She was able to release the tension in my back and shoulder. I was happy with that.

Got an insurance form too boot.

I received a Groupon gift from my hubby for 6 Lipolaser treatments and 3 thirty minute infrared sauna sessions. It was cool because I've never had lipolaser before and I like trying new things, especially things that arguably slim you down!

There's one lady with long blond hair who I first met at the front desk who continued to speak to me in French when I was responding in English at my first appointment, which is generally a no-no when it comes to customer service. The man, who looks like the Owner, told me at the end of my appointment that I could speak English, when I was trying to make my next appointment. I *can* speak French fine, just when I am tired I struggle with it as it is clearly not my first language.... he could see that and hear my accent, so he finally helped to put me at ease in that regard.

The waiting area is really nice. The fish bath is so tantalizing and tempting. Walls and floors are wood. The women's locker/shower area is very private. They provide you I key with a # with it. You simply find the locker with the same # as on the key. Very secure for your personal belongings. Beside the locker room there are slippers for you to wear with or without socks, it's as you wish. 

The room for the lipolaser treatments could be nicer. A few of the ceiling squares need to be replaced because there is an ugly yellow / brownish stain which I see constantly because I am laying down on my back staring upward. The treatments are painless, although I haven't seen any *huge* effects... none at all almost, lol. It's fun to go regardless. I'd recommend this Spa to someone else.

I'll be experiencing the Infrared sauna for the first time on Thursday evening, haven't been there yet so I cannot comment but in general, definitely Return-Worthy!

Thanks!

Pshaw, groupons are SO last year I hear you say! 
Regardless, this poor student will do whatever it takes to get a good deal, and when I saw a Groupon for a half-price, 25 minutes fish pedicure, I was totally in!

The reviews below are right, their website is ancient, and they haven't updated since the new administration if I'm not mistaken..
So I showed up and was promptly given a towel and one of those embarassing towel-skirts. Being new to the whole Spa thing, I pretty much ran around like a headless chicken for 15 minutes ("What's THIS door?").

After I got "dressed" I was ready to step into my fish tank when, BAM, a couple who had just showed up had taken my place! I was a tad pissed given that I had a appointment and all, but the gentleman at the counter seemed really sorry, after all, they were having a couple's experience and I would have spoiled it whereas I wasn't too thrilled to be interrupting as well..
So he kindly excused himself for the inconvenience and suggested I take a 25 minutes rest in their sauna..on them! Now that's proper service (hence the forth star)!  The decor of the Spa is gorgeous, all wooden. You get more of a Thai feeling in the great common room, but the sauna seemed legit Scandinavian (they even have stones, but I checked and they're for decor only, no drenching them in water please, the electric heating is underneath!). I'm not used to saunas and I was really surprised to discover that, yes, everything's hot, even the benches. Darn, now where do I sit?
They have an extra hot room, a  bigger "sauna hot" one and a small, cooler one, which is a great alternative to an icy shower.

When my time was up, the employee came to alert me (how nice!) and gave me a little speech about the fish (they don't have teeth, relax) and left me to soak my feet in the little aquarium. 
And..oh dear...oh my god...it...IT TICKLESS!!  When he came back a couple of minutes later asking me how I was doing, I swear it took all my might not to burst out laughing in his face!! Ticklish beware!!
You do get used to it but don't stare, it really is weird watching fish eating your skin while you're feeling exactly what's going on..

My experience was really positive overall. I checked a summary of all their services while leaving and noticed they have some fancy stuff: massage under the rain, anyone? But, lo and behold, they have "vinthu" session. You mean flogging yourself with a branch of vinthu wood in the sauna, just like they do in Finland at Midsummer?, No perkele!!! That's one more step towards Scandinavia I hope to take if I get the chance to go back!!!

PS: They're UKRAINIANS, don't mix your soviets up!

Went to a new hair salon up near my house - and in Cave Creek, nothing is all that near! The salon is brand new, so I had the place to myself, and the full attention of the stylist.

Dawn cut and colored my hair - she did a super amazing job! So, honestly, I brought a magazine ad of Cher with some big gorgeous hair and bangs with this awesome lighting - at first she looks at me and thinks I don't even have the hair to do this. But then I take out my hair tie and she sees all my big curly hair fall out and she's like, ah yes, we can do that. And what do you know...she did it - she totally matched this hair-do that some super pricey stylist probably was hired to do on Cher for that ad. The cut, color, and style were all AWESOME!!

So I was on Skype later that night with my boyfriend - after a few minutes, he's like...
Did you get your hair cut? 
Yes. 
It looks longer! 
She only took off 3/4 inch
Wow - you took in the Cher photo, didn't you?
Yes - she matched it pretty well, eh?
OMG - it's so beautiful

Yes...I got 60 minutes of beautiful hair compliments. 

Anyways, if you have a boyfriend with super great taste in hair styles and you want to rock his world on Skype - go to Echo and ask for Dawn and bring her your best celeb ad - you'll love it.

A week ago Edward recommended and performed a Keratin treatment on my frizzy unruly hair. He showed extreme knowledge and professionalism in the process. The salon was clean, comfortable and welcoming and for being there 4 hours for the process, it was very enjoyable! His wife and other staff member (whose name elud...es me now) were fun to talk with and made the experience delightful. I have finally found a solution for my hair that is more affordable and less damaging than the Japanese Hair Straightening I've tried in the past. Edward will gladly provide a consultation and I believe show honesty in what to expect based on your own hair type.

Thanks Very Much and see I'll you soon for a color treatment and eventually a re-do of the Keratin Treatment.

This salon was an absolute nightmare....The owner, ED, was 20 minutes late and on our first meeting he did nothing but critisize my hair.  He cut and finished it and made me look about 30 years older. He did nothing but talk about himself and how he recently fired an employee the day before...Wow...what a horrible visit.  I do not recommend him to anyone.  If you live in Tramonto you are out of luck and will have to travel to get a good hair cut/color.

Got a flyer in the mail for this place. Says it under new management.  It also says they are opened 7 days a week with an exclamation mark. I called today (Saturday) and they were just about to close - called around 4 p.m.. The guy asked if I wanted to come on Monday.  When I asked him about Saturday, he asked someone and then told me that they don't always work on Sundays.  Apparently they only work occasional Sundays if there is someone who wants to work that day.  WHA??!!  Why advertise on a flyer AND website that you are opened 7 days a week when you really aren't.  Can't comment about the actual place but that as is wasn't a great starting point for them.

Went to Echo a while back and the owner, Edward colored my hair and proceeded to tell me what a great conditioning treatment he was giving me. Well when he combed my hair, it all fell out.
MY girlfriends dye job was horrendous and she too lost so much hair.  DO NOT USE THIS GUY!  Use the girl that is in there she is much much better.

Moved to the area, need a new stylist. I have been dying my hair for at least 5 year to be dark brown and my natural is light brown. I no longer want to dye my hair and wanted to go back to my natural color. I called to pull out the color from my hair and go lighter. I show up and everything seemed fine, my stylist was friendly. I tell her I no longer want dark hair, I want to go back to my normal color. My roots are coming through so she can see my natural. She holds the color swatches up to my hair and determines what color. I thought she chose one a little dark and that is not what I wanted so I questioned her choice. She told me that is what color my original color matched. I even showed her a picture of what my hair looked like when it was natural color. Ok, she knows better than I do so I let it go. I told her I was nervous to go back to my roots and that I didn't tell anyone I was doing such a drastic change. She acknowledged my comment and moved on. She prepared something in the back, my thought was it is what was going to pull the color out. Fast forward about 1 hour (color, waiting then rinsing) and I notice the only change is that the color is darker, not lighter. I thought it was maybe going to be a two step process, so I wait. She starts to blow dry my hair and that is when I realized that she misunderstood what I wanted. I mentioned it, told her that is not what I wanted, explained again that I wanted to Ok so my hair is pretty much the same as it was when I went in. Disappointing to say the least but not the end of the world. The main reason why I am giving this review is I was still charged $75. What!?!? I understand some sort of charge but full price? That is crazy. I was not vague in what I wanted, I even questioned her choice in color since I thought we were bleaching then re-dying to something close to my natural color. Before she told me my total we were planning my next visit and how we were going to pull the color out but since they aren't going to make today's visit right, I will not go there again. Bummer since I live down the street.
Natalie and Sherri are the best!!! Great cuts and styles, great energy and so comfortable to be around. I love coming here.

Lived here for a year and didn't even know that they were located here. I've been missing out!
Richard did a great job with my hair!  The place is very clean and super cool especially in this hot summer. 
Will defiantly make this my new go to!
Thank you

Great place for a hair cut.  Rosie, the owner is very nice and gives a great cut any way you want it.  She spends time with you and you never feel rushed. Give her a try.  You won't be sorry.  The price is right.  $10 for Seniors and the max for anyone is $14.

I reluctantly give a Yelp review for Rojas Barbershop because I want to keep the place all to myself. Rosie, the owner, is the best! I have been going here for years and she always takes great care of me and gives a perfect cut. The wifey also agrees and you know that means something. The shop is clean, cool, and has a couple of televisions which makes for a great experience. I highly recommend Rojas Barbershop but please do not got and make me have to wait!!!  :)

Best haircuts I ever had. Used three different barbers over the years, so consistency is good. Rosie currently cuts it, wife even takes notice when it gets cut. Highly suggest this place, never a long wait, only set you back $15.

Die Minibar hat erst vor wenigen Wochen aufgemacht und ist wirklich ein Kleinod im Stuttgarter Nachtleben. Zwar ist hier eher unter der Woche etwas los, aber wer nicht unbedingt immer in total zugerauchten, lauten und überfüllten Theodor-Heuss-Bars einen auf wichtig machen will, der kann in dieser schnuckeligen Bar direjkt unter der Paulinenbrücke (ok, sicherlich nicht der angenehmste Ort in Stuggi;-) einen wirklich netten Abend verbringen. Als Starter kann man sich die Minibar auf jeden Fall einmal antun. Positiv fallen auch die leckeren Snacks auf als auch das russische Bier. Schmeckt zwar nicht besonders, aber man kann zumindest am nächsten Tag was Interessantes herumerzählen.
Die Minibar ist klein und spartanisch eingerichtet. Klasse ist, dass man die Bar auch mieten kann.

Dem Vorredner kann ich nur zustimmen: schick, klein (geradezu "mini"), sehr angenehme Atmosphäre, freundlicher Service und gut versteckt vor der "Theo-Heuss-Possee". Ganz wichtig: exzellenter Danesi-Kaffee zu sehr moderaten Preisen.
Ein bisschen versteckt liegt die minibar. Doch das suchen lohnt sich. Sehr entspannte kleine Bar. Gute Getränkeauswahl und nette Leute. Am Wochenende kann man die Bar auch mieten.

Die Minbar ist echt ein Geheimtipp. Klein (wie der Name schon sagt ;o)) und versteckt nahe der Paulinenbrücke ist sie echte eine Bereicherung für Stuttgart. 
Die sehr stylische Einrichtung und die angenehme Atmosphäre machen sie zu einer meiner Lieblingsbars.
Das russische Bier und das sympatische Personal machen die leider etwas kurzen Öffnungszeiten schon fast wieder wett.

Sehr große Gin Auswahl aber dank klasse Beratung der Barkeeperin ist der favorisierte Gin mitsamt dem dazu passenden Tonic auch schnell gefunden.
Zudem gibt's hier Tegernseer hell und auch immer wieder mal Biere von kleineneren unbekannten Brauereien.

Immer wieder nett, die minibar. Immer noch ein Geheimtipp, die minibar. 
Sehr klein und minimalistisch, trotzdem gemütlich. Pfiffige Bardame, toller Espresso (1,- EUR, das ist knapp über Napoli-Niveau!). Und einer der wenigen Orte, in dem ein Tegernseer serviert wird.
Was auch sehr positiv auffällt: die unverschämt große Auswahl an unterschiedlichsten Sorten von Gin! 
Hier ist wirklich (fast) alles an wacholderbasiertem Gesöff zu haben!
Immer wieder hin, zur minibar!

Affordable prices and quality food. We ordered the best of both worlds with fries, a Chicago style dog ( on a poppy seed bun ) and a small italian beef sandwich dipped. 

Fries - okay. Could use more of something (salt, malt vinegar, ketchup)

Chicago dog - good dog and the toppings are like a mountain of deliciousness

Italian beef sandwich - only 3 inches yet flavorful and packed with beef! We got them dipped in the au jus which kept the sandwich warm and added a savory taste

Worth a trip out here.
Disappointed with the beef and definitely with the roll. The roll was supermarket quality.
Good food. Decent price they close way too early!!!

I've had a combo when I was visiting Chicago years back and never could find anything like it until I found this place. Pretty close to what I remember. Sausages are jucy, the beef is on point, and when they dip it in au jus it's like heaven. 

The wings are good but can't get over that they don't coat them in the wing sauce and just give it on the side.

This is the REAL Deal!! Until Windy City came you could never get a REAL Italian Beef Sandwich. I Would visit Chicago for 7 days and have over 20 sandwiches!!

Now I visit Windy City WEEKLY!! I have brought many people here, Chicagoans LOVE the place, non-Chicago people may not know any better, but they STILL love the place.

If you are from Chicago RUN do not walk to Windy City Dogs. It is truly a taste of home!!!

This is a wedge of Chicago in Las Vegas. I try to swing through once a week just to get a quick injection of cholesterol. The people are amazing EVERYTIME I've gone in. The fries are perfectly done each and every time. The Chicago style hot dogs are pretty close to what I had when I was a young man in Chicago. The main difference is that where I went in Chicago had wedges of tomato vs slices. Not a big deal, but you know... its kind of like "not how my momma made it" sort of thing. The italian beef is pretty close to spot on. Its a little less spice than Al's in Chicago. My recommended way of having it is "wet", with sweet peppers and I almost always add the melted cheese. Hopefully my cardiologist isn't reading this.

You know it's good when you 14 year old boy (born and raised here in Vegas) says he is having a "flavorgasm"
The cooks have been here for years and it shows in the quality of the food and service we get here.
Thanks again WVB!

I went here just for the Italian beef.  This place is easy to order from and I liked the service from the friendly staff. Apparently the place had a deal that if your name is mike you get a free hot dog....nice.  

The Italian beef came out dripping through the paper and it was awesome. Great flavor and exactly what I wanted.   The hot dog was authentic and yes had the snap. 

I will return again soon...

If you are anywhere near Windy City you owe it to yourself to stop in for lunch.  Incredible sandwiches, fast, attentive, friendly service, and surprisingly delicious old-school skinny fries! If you're a Chicagoan be sure to mark your home neighborhood on the board, and as always, remember to tip your server.  GREAT place!

Horrible service, food is good with a large order of attitude on the side the girl behind the counter bad for business not very friendly won't be back I've been a customer since the beginning second time I've been treated poorly

Four-star food. The hot dogs are comparable to hot dogs in Chicago.

However, the customer service at lunchtime is poor and not very accomodating for special requests. So, although the food is good and similar to the food available in Chicago, I can't give Windy City Beefs-N-Dogs a four-star rating.
.

I ordered #16 on the menu 5 minutes before 12:00 noon, the person on the phone asked me when will I be there, I told her in about 10 minutes,  I got there at 12:15, as I walked inside, I saw a long line of people. I asked one of the staff if I need to stand in line. I told him that I ordered my food ahead and picking it up. He rudely said "you have to stand in line". so I did, When I got to the cashier it was already 12:25 and told the cashier, I came to pick up my order. She said with a grin on her face that they have to cook the French fries. I said to her "I thought if you order ahead it will be faster". She said if they cook the French Fries ahead it will be soggy. So I waited some more, finally they called out my name at 12:30. I told one of the staff who handed my food that it doesn't make a difference if I called ahead or not, I still have to wait 15 minutes, more insulting grin from her. I love Chicago Vienna dog but if the service is bad, I am not going back there if I can help it. :(

This place is awesome!! The food is amazing and employees are very friendly! The elder gentleman who is the cook every time we come in, is probably the main reason we come back. As soon as we came in he knew that we were new and gave us some options and explained where they get all the products, A+ in my book.
My boyfriend and I got a Chicago dog which was really good but he also got an Italian beef sandwich and it was horrible! The prices where pretty good though can't beat it

Yaaaay! I did not drive across town in vain! This place is a keeper! Had the chicago dog with everything and the Italian  beef wet with gardiner ( I don't know how to spell that) and fries, everything was great.

I love love love this place.. As a lady from Chicago who has been moved around I have never been able to to find such an authentic place. It's not Portillos (my chicago people know what I'm talking about) but it's still fantastic. They're all from the area and aren't some lame posers (they even have Cubs stuff everywhere, even though I love the cards, I appreciate the authenticity) MUST TRY!
Really good stuff here. Great dogs and sandwiches. The peppers and relish are legit. A must for those that crave a "Chicago Dog", my favorite.  A lot of Chicago memorabilia.

I enjoyed the Spicy Sausage so much, I went to this place twice in one day. I just had to do it again! There was so much food to choose from, I wanted to taste it all.

When I first went in, I didn't think I was going to appreciate the food. It didn't look like I place I would eat at. The atmosphere was a bit uninviting. The place is really small and was quite packed, which was expected, being that it was lunch time.

I didn't have much time to decide what to eat because a older guy was behind me huffing and puffing because of the wait. I quickly decided on the Spicy Sausage Combo and a pizza puff. It took them about 12 minutes to prepare the food and pass it to me.

I took the food to go, so when I got home (a 10 minute drive) my food was still warm. I unwrapped my Sausage and bit into it. The peppers and grilled onions mixed with the Sausage took me by surprise. It was magnificently and pleasantly spicy and the flavor perfectly blended together to make a hell of a dog! It was damn near perfect!

The chili cheese fries were really good. They remind me of when I was a kid, eating Chili Cheese fries from Krystal's. They were a tad bit Floppy but I had to consider my drive home. But, even with the drive they were still delicious. I will get them again.

The pizza puff, on the other hand, were just decent. I've had better, in Chicago, that is, but never the less, it was refreshing to have a imitation pizza puff so close to home. I probably wouldn't order it again because it was the least favorite amongst the items on the menu. I appreciate that I had something to hold me over until my next trip to the actual Windy City.

My second visit back, I took my friend, a Chicago native. I had hyped her up about the food. I knew she wasn't going to be disappointed. It was around the closing time so the place had cleared out to comfort.

That time I had more time to study the menu being that there was no line. We ordered the Spicy Sausage, again, and the Double Dogs with regular fries that time. We decided to eat it there because there were a lot of open tables.

It took about 10-12 minutes for them to prepare the food. I'll say this, I don't like that they have full conversations over the food. A lot of people spit when they talk and its disturbing to think about the "what ifs".

Either way we got our food, said I prayer and dug in. The dogs were not as good as the sausage, but they were satisfactory. They went too quick, that I will mention.

The fries were better with chili and cheese on them. They were just fries, nothing special there.

The sausage was as good as it was before. We loved it.

In all, it was good. I've added this place to my "I know what to get when I go back" list.

Love this place for a quick bite at lunch time or on the weekend. Great food, good service with character. Good prices. Be sure to check out the specials calendar each month for fun promotions like free hotdog today if your name is Dan or Diane and awesome daily specials on food. Also they carry some Midwest soda a lot of people here in vegas have never had.

I had the basic hotdog (I think it's the #1), with various condiments and was unfortunately a bit disappointed.  I was looking forward to finding out what the big deal was about a Vienna hotdog, apparently made famous in Chicago.  Frankly, I couldn't see what all the hype was about.  At $4.50, I thought it was way pricey for what it was.  Not a bad dog, just nothing thrilling.  The dog didn't have much flavor or snap at all.  Buried under a lot of condiments it could have been any type of dog at all, no different or better than the average dog out there.  The bun was somewhat a cut above typical fast food, it had poppy seeds and was okay, but nothing particularly special.  

 It came with fries, which were good, although a tad salty, but still good with a somewhat different, fuller flavor than  fries I've had elsewhere..  I liked the cute little brown bag they are served in and they never got limp so that's a plus.  But getting back to the hotdog....I liked the neon green relish the best lol....but I didn't go for the relish, I went for the dog.  At $4.50 I won't be trying it again.  I don't know what I was expecting but it didn't send me to the moon or anything.  Darn!  Oh well, maybe other people have a different opinion and to each their own.  But the place is clean, looks well run and I guess is popular for certain sandwiches which run upwards of $6-8 which again is too much for me unless it's amazingly outstanding.   Judging from the hotdog which for me was "meh", I'd have to be seriously convinced to make another stop in here.

Consistent great food. Grew up with Chicago beef sandwiches. These are the best.  The hot dogs and beef products are straight from Chicago and don't disappoint. 
Each visit has consistent food quality, friendly staff and leave with a full stomach.

Im not from Chicago, nor have I ever been. I've seen plenty of shit on reality television shows to tell me Italian Beef sandwiches are awesome. I've been looking for a good one for awhile. I found my new favorite Italian Beef spot.
When you first walk inside Windy City its filled with banners for your favorite Chicago sports team and if the team is playing, then they'll be playing it.  Pretty nice for you Chicago fans. There are plenty of tables to sit at and a bar type seating at the actual kitchen. Good setup if you are going with small group of friends or just popping in by your lonesome.

Service? Fast and helpful. I've been once before and the 3 employees who were working, were also working today, which I assume are the owners. The cashier remembered me from my last trip and responded accordingly. My first time being remembered at an establishment, which tells me 2 things, 1. that was a very nice feeling to have and 2. if they remembered me they probably need more business. (and they deserve it)

What did I order?
the #4, Titled Best of Both Worlds. A chicago dog, a 3" Italian beef and fries. I asked them to chili cheese my fries because last time they were pretty good. Less than ten minutes after I ordered I received my special fat ass order.

How did it Taste?
You really cant go wrong with a Chicago Dog. Now again I've never eaten one from the Windy City itself, but this local joint is right up there with what I have had. Vienna beef dogs are fantastic and so are their poppy seed buns. The Italian beef, as I really have no Chi Town reference was tender and juicy. You can order it dry, wet or dipped in their homemade au jus. I ordered wet. If you go then you have to at least get it wet. ;) They will also offer you either peppers, cheese or giardinera for it. I, of course ordered Giardinera. If you've never put giardinera on any of your food, you're really missing out. Did I spell giardinera wrong? who the fuck cares because its delicious. The bread with au jus, the juicy beef, and the giardinera adds up to juicy, melt in my mouth good time.

Price? 
So a #4 which includes a Chicago Dog and a 3" Italian beef, upgrade to chili cheese fries, an extra side of giardnera and a diet coke comes to under $13. Trust me you can fill up for under $10, I just wanted to go over the top.

So my first Yelp review and it was long, but I wanted to write it because I want you to go to WIndy City! Enjoy!

I had the combo #2 it came with 2 Chicago dogs w/ fries for $6 , the dogs were very good . The dogs had a nice flavor, all beef my favorite. The price is right and service was very friendly and quick. 
     What more could you want from a hot dog place.

I have to give Pete a shout out for reviewing this place.
I haven't had a pizza puff in years. 
We havent found a goodChicago style restaurant here in Vegas. We use to go to another place which I won't name, but 
stopped going after my husband and I both
got food poisoning. Although nothing here
is good for my diet, it's a nice treat.
This place has THE BEST Chicago hot dogs in town. Fast service and very friendly staff. Enjoyable place to eat. Highly recommend Windy City!

I'm proud to say I'm not from Chicago, since I hate cold weather!
But what I can tell you is that this place has the BEST hotdogs I've ever eaten. In fact I never really cared for hotdogs until I came here! And the skinny fries are so Ono! I can't wait to get back over there for a chili dog! One day I'm going to be brave and try the Chicago dog!
Bon appetite!
Best Chicago dogs outside of Chicago.  Being from Chicago,  I know what good Chicago dogs taste like.  This the real deal.  Can't go wong here.  Loved it
Best hot dogs in town.  Great Italian beef.  Plus they sell Vienna beef products that you can take home and make yourself.

There's a popular Chicago style hot dog place in Honolulu but I have to say, Windy City serves up an undeniable beat down to that place with one hand tied behind its back.  The dogs at Windy City just taste better and have more of an "authentic" vibe to them instead of place like the one in Honolulu that's "trying" too hard to be a Chicago dog.

Stepping in here for the first time, I knew it was going to be good because for a cold, Tuesday evening, it was packed and with many walk in take out orders.  There was even one lady that came in to order a couple of dogs to go dressed in her house robe.  Like she was at home watching The Voice and decided she wanted a hot dog and walked over. ;)

The 2 things I've tried here...

The combo Italian beef and sausage sandwich (#13).  Large amounts of shaved beef piled on top of an Italian sausage (mild or hot) which is sandwiched in an Italian roll.  This thing was HUGE!  You can get other stuff added to it like Cheese (cheddar or mozz), Sweet peppers, and Giardinera.  I ordered mine with a spicy sausage, sweet peppers and medium giardinera...and with the whole sandwich dipped in beef jus!  It was hard to eat but I managed...hehe.

On the second visit, I had to try one of the dogs so I got the Footlong Vienna Maxwell Street Polish Dog (#16), another monster.  This polish dog is steamed then fried which gave it a nice snap when biting into it.  The dog is topped with grilled onions, mustard and sport peppers.  I got mine with nuclear green chicago style relish.  Super filling and delicious.  This one comes with fries as well! 

Mark H had the Chicken fingers on both visits and he said they're really good.  Service on both visits were super friendly and the food came out quickly.  

Wind City is a must come back to for me.
This place is great! Great food, great service and awesome menu... If u are looking for a good Chicago style place and haven't tried Windy City, I highly recommend u to try.

There is really nothing wrong with the place, the owners provide good customer service, the food comes out pretty fast and the food is good for a quick lunch. However, there is really nothing extraordinary about the place. I will say the best deal will be the hot dog with the 3" beef sandwich! I liked the fact that they give you different discounts depending on the day, for example if your address has a 3 you will get a free bag of chips!

Never been to Chicago, but if the dogs are anything like Windy City's dogs I'm missing out. Had the foot long Maxwell Street Polish and I have lunch for tomorrow! My kids got the burgers and those looked awesome.  Nice and messy and full of cheese.  Great prices and very friendly staff! I'll be a regular now that I've found this place!
It's weird to say but that was by far the best hot dog I've ever eaten. We had the Italian beef & a hamburger also but that hot dog....I almost bit my husbands finger to get another bite!!
The best place in town that really captures how Chicago food should taste like. I highly recommend the Chicago dog/Italian Beef (dipped) combo.

We have tried the chili cheese fries twice and today I got a 12oz chili cup with cheese and onions. The #1-Chicago style hot dogs & fries is their most popular and it is soooo good! I have also had the Italian beef sandwich-very nice. The chili cheese dog is a great choice as well. Lastly, we ordered the pizza puff for our four year old- he liked it and my husband ate part of it, too. We will be back and back again

Great Lil place especially if your a fan of good food from chicago. Staff was very welcoming and friendly and provide great service. The place was very clean. Kid friendly and all of the food was so so good. Highly recommend for a quick bite to eat.
Just stopped into this gem and what a great stop. Two Chicago dogs and fries. What a treat. They have a counter and tables with chairs and a small outside seating area. I'll be back.

Experience:  I was in between appts in the area, so I thought I'd try something new....looked on YELP and this had great reviews, so here I am!!

Facility:  Small joint with about 10 tables and 10 counter seats. Very clean, quaint fast food style with lots of sports memorabilia on the walls to keep your eyes entertained. 

Service:  I approached the lady at the counter who identified herself as Lindsay, and after finding out it was my first time, she immediately went into the description of what they offer and what is popular. She was so friendly and helpful!!!  You can tell she is someone who actually enjoys her job...management give her a raise!  ;)

Food:  together we decided on the #4, which had a Chicago style hot dog and a beef half sandwich, their two most popular choices. 
The Chicago style dog was loaded with toppings and delicious. I ordered mine with no onions.  
Then the beef sandwich was served "wet", which means they dip in it au jus for you. I got this with cheese and Papa's Giardinera hot pepper mix on top. Loved the sandwich and the peppers were just the perfect amount of spicy. 
The French fries were some of the best I've had in a long time. They were hot, freshly cooked shoestring fries with a mild seasoning salt. Just amazing!
Then to really put my experience over the top, they have a calendar with unique specials everyday.  Guess what today's was??  A free hot dog for anyone whose name begins with "L". Score!!!! 
So, I got that one plain and Togo for later. 

Overall:  just loved this little spot. Although I don't like to give a lot of 5 stars out to fast food...between the service, fries, and the free hot dog, how could I jot?!?!
It is kinda outta the way, but since I have appts on this side of town, I will be back again to try something new. You gotta try this spot too!!!!

Strolled by this place in the Vons shopping center several times. Finallllllly broke down and tried it one Sunday. 

So worth it. Got the italian sausage with peppers. so delicious and flavorful.
Fair prices great staff. I'll definitely be back.

From Chicago.....craving a pizza puff and fries, maxwell street polish, vienna beef sand??? 
This is the place to go....Super friendly staff who go out of their way to make you feel like your back home. 
Had my fiance try a juicy vienna beef sand with mozzarella and sweet peppers (as only a true chicagoan can order) he was hooked from the first bite. I had my fix of a pizza puff, left out with a big smile. Everything was great...
They offer daily specials like free dog if your wearing a cubs jersey, etc. Support a Chicago business and give them a try, I know you won't be disappointed..

I've never been to Chicago, couldn't tell you what a real Italian beef sandwich from there tastes like... Now I can tell you that the beef sandwich from Windy City is one of my favorite sandwiches I've eaten... I get mine wet with the medium gardinier(sp) and mozzarella... Such a great flavor combo!! The bread does get soggy, but that doesn't bother me one bit. Just makes you eat it faster. The service is top notch, the staff is always super friendly... Overall I highly recommend Windy City and will continue trying new things from there each visit... Did I mention they have frozen cheesecake on a stick??!!
I got the italian beef sandwich, dipped with sweet and hot peppers. Tender, messy and delicious! Great fries too! Staff was courteous and quick! Best sandwich in town!

The most awsome dogs in Las Vegas!  They truly make an authentic Chicago dog.  Their bags of fries come as an extra treat with your dog.  You must try their Italian beef (you can dip it yourself) and their gyros with homemade sauce. The burgers are huge.
   The chef is terrific as are the owners and staff.  They are tops on customer service and remember everyone's name even though they serve a high volume of people!
   Treat yourself to great food and go to Windy City Beefs-N-Dogs, you will love it.  You will even get a free piece of Double Bubble gum!!  You don't need to be from Chi town to enjoy this place.

I lived in Chicago last summer so I had to try out this place in Vegas. I only tried the Chicago dog but in true Chicago fashion I was not disappointed.  Now every time I have a craving for my Chicago dog I know where to get one

There is something just missing from this beef sandwich. I cant place my finger on it. It wasnt bad at all but its missing something. I had the beef sandwich wet, with cheese and peppers just how i get it at al's and its short.

I went in today to try the beef sandwich with the peppers and mozzarella I couldn't believe what I was eating this is the best beef sandwich I have ever had I was told it is very comparable to Chicago style in fact they nail it Kathy and Tim do a good job I recommend this place to everybody

I am born and raised in Chicago. So you can believe me when I tell you that  the food served at Windy City Beef N Dogs is "dead on!"  Feels and tastes just like back home including the Chicago Sun Times newspaper on the counter.

Oooo this place is trouble. And when I say that, I mean trouble for the other hot dog chains out there. this hot dog joint is more of a keeper than your mama's pearl earrings given to you when you turned 16.

There's nothing fancy about this place and its eats. And that's how a hot dog joint should be. Came in and it's a lil more spacious than your average hot dog stand on a street. i ordered my hotdog(#1) with some fries and a drink. my order came faster than i can take a picture for yelp. but of course not like a fast food chain. when the lady delivered my food, i can smell the freshness of the hot dog, peppers, mustard, even the poppy-seeds(jk). but the thin freshly fried seasoned(lowry's?) fries were double the amount of the hot dog, which was able to fill me up. it came in a basket, in your typical brown paper bag and paper wrap with no name. anti-fancy. thank you for that. did i forget to say how delicious the food was? yes, there's not much to do when it comes to hot dogs, just the hot dog, bun, and a bunch of toppings. but they fulfilled the meat's destiny just right. 

oh, you bet i'll be back.

Sooo glad we came here!  My husband wanted to go to that hot dog stand outside of Lowe's.. Well the guy wasn't there.. And we were down the street from this place. I have always wanted to try it since I've passed by several times. The menu is perfect!  Not too many items where you don't know what to pick.. And still a variety of options. I tried the maxwell street. Spicy and delicious!! My husband got the 2 hot dog deal and he loved it!  My son ordered a plain hot dog and we all got the pizza puff appetizer to share. This was the first place ever and my picky eater son was the last one eating and ate so much of the food!!  And to top it all off.. They offered him a free scoop of sherbet ice cream. The service was phenomenal!  They were all welcoming and friendly!  Can't wait to come back!

So this place has been on my bookmark list for quite sometime now and I actually had to plan my visit here considering I live on the opposite side of town. I was around the Summerlin area and said why not pay Windy City a visit. So I've been to Chicago and tried the Italian Beef at Portillo's, which was probably the best thing I ate there. The inside of this place is very mom and pop-ish, surprisingly they didn't have much bears or clubs memorabilia, it appears they are more oriented towards the blackhawks and bulls. Anyway onto the food I ordered the Italian beef sandwich combo, came out to $9 and some change (not bad). I ordered mine to be wet, because I felt like the dipped would be too drippy. The beef was pretty good for the most part, but the bread did not adsorb the liquid very well. I was honestly expecting this to taste a lot like Portillo's and unfortunately it did not. The bread really ruined the sandwich because it became really soggy. No, I did not wait to eat my sandwich it was already soggy by the time I got it. My friend who is from Chicago said the same thing, it's definitely a bread issue. He said they should have bread flown in from Chicago and that would do the trick, but realistically speaking that won't happen. I would suggest using Great Bun's French bread, but I don't know if that would be authentic Chicago style? But obviously the hoagie they are using now is not working. Next time I will order the Pizza Puff, since I've never had those before and the combo meal for that is only $4.50. Or maybe even the hotdogs considering that's part of their name sake.

I love the hot dogs at this place. The traditional Chicago dogs are the best in my humble opinion. Everything is authentic in this joint even the Mike dicka pictures and Chicago accents of a few of the workers their. I have also had the pizza puffs and the hot beef sandwiches which was also very tasty.

Every time I come here it's a good experience! Everything is delicious from the pizza puffs to the gyro and the dogs ! Would definitely recommend coming here if you want some Chicago style food ! 

And their cheese cake on a stick is amazing

Windy City Beefs-N-Dogs has the best dogs in town. The service is down home because the owners actually work the business which is hard to find these days! For an authentic Chicago Dog try Windy City I KNOW you'll love it.

Stopped in for the first time NYE & was pleasantly surprised.  Ordered a beef with mozzarella dipped & fries.  If you're from Chicago, you probably know about Portillo's which I have been missing the 2 years I've lived in Vegas and decided to hunt down a replacement. The beef / gravy was not quite the same flavor as Portillo's, but was still very good. It was also huge. The fries were skinny American style that were also pretty good, but not the thick crinkle cuts I prefer.  Service was FAST, I was welcomed when I walked in and was even wished a Happy New Year.  All in all, the food was good & the service was great. Recommend!

I usually eat at their other location near my house in Henderson which also serves Pizza, but this location is just as good, and 95% on the authenticity scale
