One more star off simply because there was one staff (masseuse?) who walked in to the tea room area fully had a loud conversation with her colleague for a solid 3 minutes - I guess the "shhh" sign was meant to indicate an optional quiet experience.  

The fourth star off because of the price. Simple way to expensive for what other places offer in the city. Its a shame I'm paying their staff and rent and getting such a non-hammam experience.  

I give one star because simply it exists as a spa place and some of the staff were friendly. But seriously there are far better places in the city if you want to dish out this kind of cash and get a tedious, stressful and blah spa experience. Oh. It has an online booking system which is nice but also terribly non-functional for changes or updated. In fact trying to reach their reservations desk was like calling them 2-3 times a day a week beforehand. 

Bottom line. There are other spas. Go there unless and until the owners make some real changes.

I have had a good number of massages, but this was the best, and well worth paying more than I have in the past. The spa is very clean without looking sterile, nicely decorated, and the music is just loud enough that you can listen if you want or tune it out. The used towels and wraps are taken away and fresh towels stocked every few minutes, but unobtrusively. The steam room was quite hot, but it was relaxing and warmed my muscles nicely before the massage. I had reservations about a steamy room with multicoloured LEDs, but it wasn't too psychedelic, and I actually found it pleasant and calming having the light gently shift in color in the room. There was enough steam that you could just see across the room, so I don't think a previous reviewer's worry that people could have sex is too serious (the room isn't that big, and you'd be able to hear, too :P). The wall with the door is all glass, so I didn't feel claustrophobic the way I have when I've tried to used enclosed wooden steam rooms/saunas.

After a while (with a short break for cold cucumber and orange water outside the steam room), the therapist came to the steam room, and my boyfriend and I were instructed to cool off in the showers and towel off. They then led us to the suite where couples massages take place. Each therapist spoke to us and figured out what we wanted (you can get any type of massage they offer within the couples massage, so if one person wants deep tissue and the other wants hot stone, that's okay). They left the room, we took off our robes, hopped under the blankets on the beds, and almost fell asleep just laying there for the therapists because we were already so relaxed.

My therapist was Amir, and wow. I have always felt sore the day after a massage, and a massage therapist friend has told me that means you weren't warmed up for the level of work done. I feel NO PAIN after this massage, but my back and neck felt amazing after the massage (I've already ruined it by carrying heavy things, so the tension is back, but no muscle pain from being worked on!). He was very good about checking in on how things felt, if I felt tenderness in certain spots, and if the work he'd done was sufficient or if I still felt tension or pain in an area. I was a bit confused when he did things like lift back my shoulder and just hold it for a minute or two, which I had never had a therapist do before, but OMG, the tension was gone after. He worked on my sore, stiff neck until the last possible moment to try to get the tension to ease up. I felt very well taken care of. He did give me a little reminder to work on my posture for improvement in neck issues, which wasn't the most spa-like, but also made me feel like I was being treated by an actual trained therapist who wants me to not be in pain, which I prefer to just relaxing and then going back to being in pain.

After the massage, we went back to the team room. I don't think they'll kick you out until closing if you really want to stay there and hang out. After the steam, we showered in the changing room showers, where they had soap, shampoo, and conditioner. They also have a variety of hair styling products, lotion, hair ties, q-tips, two hair driers (one with various defusers for different types of hair), and feminine products, just in case. I discovered that I'd forgotten the combination I'd set on the keypad locker with my things in it, but they were very friendly and just opened it up for me, no problems. Payment was fast, and we both were able to pay separately (same price per person for a couples massage as two separate massages) and get receipts for insurance. The service wasn't pushy, and you can pay the therapist a tip in cash with a little envelope or as part of the credit card transaction.

Overall, it was a really great experience, and I plan to do it again soon.

This is my favorite place to get a 'spa' massage now. I generally mix where I get massages for affordability, but when I splurge I'm never disappointed with Hammam. I have never had a Turkish bath there - I hear it's not exactly authentic, but the included steam room is still relaxing enough and the amenities are really nice and peaceful here. I've been to the Elmwood spa many times (downtown) and while it's bigger and has a pool, it's a little outdated and some of the spa services are just ok. Hammam is smaller, but it's never been crowded when I've gone. 

I had an amazing massage the other day, normally I go for longer ones, but I only had  45 minute one from Toby. He really took the challenge to make my time worthwhile and was absolutely amazing. One of the best massages I've ever had and I will definitely be requesting him next time. He had strong hands, and a great technique, constantly moving my muscles and lengthening them to get rid of stiffness. I can't wait to go back :)

Came here with my bff for there Turkish bath option and it was lovely! Very relaxing and soothing. I like how before your appt you have many options like enjoying tea or going for a steam. And the women who work there are very lovely and friendly. I felt so mellowed out and in another world after the session I didn't feel like I was dt Toronto. Such a great way to unwind and relax.

The spa is located in a basement. The change rooms are very small. The towels were dirty. Staff wear "Call of Duty" video game t-shirts instead of a proper uniform. No food for sale. Turkish delights only given to persons who do Turkish bath. Steam room is small, and the techno lights are not relaxing. No designated parking. No Lounge chairs. RMT was racist against white people saying white people don't have good restaurants and only Asian food is good.

Never... coming...back.

I came here for a spa day with my best friend! The services I chose were a 30 min massage, shellac manicure, spa pedicure, spa lunch - since I was spending over $150? we were offered complimentary use of the steam room.

Upon entering the spa you are greeted by a friendly receptionist who quickly tour the facilities and shows you to the locker room.  You will recieve a package of a robe, sarong, and slippers (available in all sizes).

The tea area has plenty of magazines, juices, water, tea, nuts, cranberries and fruit for use between your sessions.

First up: The steam room! Just wonderful! I personally can withstand lots of heat - so I didn't mind it. I really liked the cold iced eucalyptus washcloths provided, very refreshing.

Areas for improvement: please have additional sarongs available in this area, and ensure washcloths are restocked 

Massage: this was the best massage I ever received!  Request Emily as your RMT if you're ever a guest. 

The nail area is beautiful lots of real plants and they offer you tea - nice touch! The shellac manicure was great.

Areas of improvement: the spa pedicure is well below average.  My feet were dunked in cold water, and it's already chipping!   The technician did let me know they were having issues with water temperature. 

Spa Lunch: lunch is served in the tea lounge.  They mentioned that they get it catered from somewhere closeby. The facilities and staff are not designed for meal service.  I say skip it and enjoy a nice meal somewhere else in the village.

I was overall enjoying the experience, up until the last moment - where I had to take a cold shower because of the water temperature issues.  Not fun, I brought it up to a member of the team, but she did not know how to respond...

If it wasn't for the cold shower I would have probably been happy to give hammam a solid 4.

Update: went here for a second time and it's totally deserving of 4 now with the improvements in water temperature.  I will definitely consider coming back! :)

Hammam Spa used to be my favourite spa in the city.  Unfortunately, I need to find a new favourite spa.  I went on Friday evening, after work, with a few girlfriend's.  Our spa experience didn't start out very peaceful, as we had to wait to speak to the receptionist for about 15 minutes, and then when we went to change in the rooms, all of the lockers had not been stocked with towels or robes, so we had to go ask the front desk for assistance, and then wait another 10/15 minutes for her to restock the lockers.  When you arrive early to enjoy the steam, it's annoying that you're pushed back almost 30 minutes due to Hammam.  Moving on, when we finally went into the steam, which is normally my favourite part, it stunk so incredibly bad. It smelled like someone with bad BO on the subway.  

My massage, however, was amazing.  No complaints there.  But afterwards, when we went to relax in the relaxation room and to have some tea, they were out of tea.  They were just not restocking anything.  When spending $150 + tip (so $180 for a 1 hour massage), I expect to have a smooth process from start to finish.  And it was just a flop.

There are other spas in the city - I think I'll explore those ones.

Terrible customer staff! My therapist was okay but not worth enough to make me go back. The receptionist is rude enough to make you feel the opposite of relax. The tour was done almost in a running pace. Staff keep passing by our 'quiet zone' running. When you are in the room with the therapist you can hear people talking and doors getting banged. They don't have a pool nor a hot tube. On top of that, it's more expensive than majority of the spas that have pools and hot tube. Don't go there, use your money somewhere else.

Great staff and services. It's a lovely spa with good offerings. Although I found the 60min Swedish massage to be more expensive than other all-inclusive spas (and ones with pools) they do provide nice amenities like the eucalyptus towels and mixed waters.

So why the poor review? It's due to a poor choice by the owners - they facilities are in a partially below grade, basement of an old building. Mix in the hot steam room and you have a pretty ripe environment for bacterial growth. To their credit, staff reported that cleaners are employed to sterilize. However I found that the dim lighting largely hide the issues. From the outside of the steam room, you can see mold growing behind the glass where the benches meet it. While the front of the seats were quite slippery. Crossing the hall in the therapy room, you can see the old brick and window of the factory basement and realize how raw and dirty the basement is. Unfortunately, my partner suffers from autoimmune difficulties and afterwards was couch ridden for two days. I'm much more resilient, but also found I felt somewhat ill afterwards.

The spa has great staff and services. It's just unfortunate that the facilities seem to be suffering from age and a poor environment choice.

DO NOT GO HERE. 

Terrible customer service... The therapist was nice and ok but they shorted me 15 mins on my massage. I don't need to go into detail because i'd sound like a nut but suffice to say the customer service is terrible.

Waited in line for 20 minutes just to be told that they didn't have the item that was listed on the menu on the truck.  Asked why it was on the board still.  She said because we have the item.  Just not today.  And just sat there and stared at me.  OMG.  What kind of business is this?!? Get it together.

Waited in line for quite some time (expected). When I finally got to order they could not get my card to work, which can happen on mobile swiping devices, but I was never immediately informed of this or asked if I could pay another way, instead I was just pushed aside while other people ordered. Finally I was told that my card didn't work. I said I would've paid cash if you'd of told me that my card didn't work.  By that time 5 people had ordered in front of me so I walked away. Rude and unprofessional. Who knows if their dogs are any good. I won't be putting in the trouble again to find out.

I had the Southside Dawg and the Georgia Peach Dawg today!
Both good, but I enjoyed the Georgia Peach the most. Hotdogs are hot, the buns are super fresh, and their soda options are great!
But if we're being honest, I will go back to Bulldawgs simply for the customer service. The guys are super friendly and accommodating, they thanked me 3 different times for stopping by, and care about their business and its customers.
High quality beef dogs, chewy fresh bread, inventive toppings, and wonderful service!

Drove up to Pitt with a fellow chef from Phoenix, while he was in doing his tasting, I went to PPM to check it out! I ended up eating here and got the lunch special which filled me right up. I had the public market dog with the corn relish and it was beyond good! My only complaint is that I didn't have enough room in my stomach to try all the different dogs! I will definitely be stopping here next time I'm back in town!

I was excited to go here on the recommendation of a friend. Something quick when work gets really busy. 

Today, I stopped in on break for a meal replacement shake.
Damn. Watery as hell. It was the Nutty: peanut butter, banana...things that should theoretically make a smoothie nice and thick. Nope. 

I even talked to my friend afterwards, and she says she has recently been disappointed with this location. Apparently it was great last summer. I'd try this place again but I'm unconvinced it will be any better.

Another Failed Venture.

These folks packed up and abandoned their store in the middle of the night.

They are closed.  Building security has indicated the landlord is chasing them down.

Pretty ho-hum.  I wandered in here recently on a stop on my bike running some errands.  Thought I'd give it a try.

Well, it's pricey.  It's also kind of bland.  I think they use too much ice as filler in their shakes.  I mean, come on, if you're charging $7 for a smoothie, don't short me on the ingredients.  

Maybe they should try to make a profit on customer volume instead of margin.

Ich verbrachte neulich über eine Woche in diesem Hotel. Ich kann sagen, dass das Zimmer sehr gemütlich war - ein Muss, weil es während meines Aufenthalts in Stuttgart sehr warm und schwül war. Das Duschwasser war schön warm und der Wasserdruck war gut.


 Das ganze Personal spricht auch sehr gut Englisch. Es war freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Essen im Restaurant war gut und der Service schnell und effizient.


 Meine einzige Beschwerde war der Preis fürs Frühstück. Ich fand 17 Euro zu teuer, aber es ist in anderen Hotels in der Gegend vielleicht vielleicht genauso teuer.


 Neben dem Restaurant gibt es einen Sitzbereich, aber wir saßen abends gerne im Biergarten an der Rückseite des Hotels, um das schöne Wetter auszunutzen.


 Ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder in diesem Hotel übernachten, wenn ich wieder in die Gegend kommen sollte.
Sauberes City-Hotel, wenn man ein Zimmer für Ein- oder zwei Nächte braucht. Der Preis könnte auch niedriger sein.

I know many hotels in Europe are outdated and alot of them don't have a/c. I booked this hotel based on the reviews I read from tripadvisor, totally not what I expected. This hotel did have private parking lot, which was one of my requirements for a hotel since my husband and I were driving through Germany. The hotel was really small, the room was small. Bathroom smelled. The shower door doesn't shut properly so the water leaks onto the floor. That's why it smelled, every time someone showers, the floor ends up getting wet and the guests would use the towels to soak that up. Thus making the room smell like wet towel. No a/c but there was an old fan in case it gets hot in the summer. The beds are old and hard. In europe expect to find your queen bed to be made up with 2 twin beds put next to each other. I guess the hotels are so old with small doorways and hallways, they can't fit full/queen size beds in the room. Old and Small, look elsewhere if possible. Affordable hotel but definitely decrease in quality.

Edwin's selection of frames is well curated, unique brands, great designs, stuff you won't find anywhere else and the prices are reasonable.  Service is personable, no hard sell here.  Must visit if you are looking for new frames.

"Boom", that was easy! In just one visit I was able to get my eyes checked and pick out Götti frames I am ecstatic about. During my eye exam, Sivan (optometrist) was professional, thorough and answered all questions I had about my eyes/vision well. Ed (optician) is extremely knowledgeable, personable and helped me confidently decide on frames that suited my face. He's dedicated to quality and style. There is no shortage of collections to choose from. I am so pleased with Boom Optical's customer service and the comfort/quality of my glasses.

The service at this newly opened optical was amazing.  I loved that they carried Superdry accessories which I have not been able to find anywhere else.  I found their prices reasonable and the selection well curated with something for all budgets.  I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Great selection of stylish and functional glasses frames. Very informative and helpful in selecting the best glasses for me. Very good service. This is one happy customer.

Excellent service. I recommend Boom Optical to all of my friends and family.
Ed was very knowledgeable and did a great job suggesting frames that suited me.
Selection was great, and my prescription glasses were ready for pickup within days.
Bought my first pair of glasses in many years here, and the frames look so good I don't want to take them off.
A+

This mall has been reincarnated since the addition was added a few years ago. With new higher end stores and a new food court, and a seemingly constantly evolving family washroom. 
This mall was falling flat just a few years ago, but now has new life with the addition of such stores as Sephora and Apple. The forgotten corner were a former Zellers still has signage is the only dull part of this mall. I have heard this will soon become one of the new Target locations in the near future, hopefully it will brighten up that area. 
The mall has skylights throughout and very high ceilings on both levels giving you an airy, uncluttered feeling.
With all the regulars like Sears, The Bay and Old Navy along with destination stores like Apple and Victoria' Secret as well as a handful of smaller chain stores, it has a pretty decent selection and variety of stores.

I am lucky enough to have grown up with this as my local mall, but I discovered when I moved away that people from other places in the GTA travel from far and wide to come to Upper Canada. Indeed, now that I have visited many another mall, Upper Canada still stands out as a GREAT mall. The food court is huge, the ambience throughout the mall is inviting and it has pretty much any store you could want to shop at, including Apple Store and Coach in recent years.

My wife brought me here randomly and I'm happy she did. The mall has a good selection of stores, it's not too crowed other than the washrooms. The food court is decent for a mall. They have Kernels so I was happy. Not an amazing mall but it is a good one.
One of my favourite malls!  It has great stores and extremely family friendly.  Not as busy at other malls and it's against the traffic for us.

Definitely the best shopping option in the area. It has all the mainstream stores you would expect, plus they have a White House Black Market shop which you don't find everywhere. Mall is clean and parking is pretty good most of the time. They also have good variety in the food court. Will keep shopping here when in the Newmarket area.

I saw a few reviews on this place and decided to check it out. I had no idea it was so close to us and right next to the Von's I frequent. Not sure how I overlooked this place.

I'm originally from northern Illinois, about 90 miles outside of Chicago. My wife had never been to Illinois until a couple of years ago. While there we went to Taste of Chicago where she had her first Chicago dog and immediately fell in love.

We have been to Windy City twice in the past two weeks since discovering it. The second time we invited my parents who also were in search of a little taste of home.

The first time we went, my wife got the Chicago dogs and a Green River (limey ginger ale soda). I got the Italian sausage and a pizza puff. I'm not  a big fan of hot dogs, but my wife confirmed they were solid reproductions of authentic Chicago dogs. The Italian sausage was decent. I had never had a pizza puff before and am now a fan. My wife's meal came with fries which were really good, nice and thin and crispy. Just the way I like them.

The second time we went my wife again got a Chicago dog. I got an Italian beef sandwich. I don't think I'd ever had an Italian beef sandwich before. I got mine dipped with cheese, peppers, and giardinera. I liked mine a lot. I think I'll get that again. I might get it wet though, which ironically is drier than the dipped. The dipped was really good but the sogginess made it difficult to eat.

Overall a decent experience. Looks like the pricing is good too. I definitely want to come back and try the burger.  I had the #4 which is great because you get a Chicago dog and a small Italian beef.

Props to this little lunch joint. Any place that can deliver a fast and filling and good lunch for under $10 gets 5 stars in my book. Hits all the marks with the food but the clean and friendly service to boot. I will be back.

I had never heard of Chicago-style Italian beef until I moved into an apartment a couple of blocks away from Al's Beef. I looked up reviews on yelp and things didn't look promising, so I held off going. But one night I was watching one of Anthony Bourdain's shows and he went to Chicago and had an Italian Beef. It looked so good I had to have one. I drove to Al's and ordered a hot beef dipped. The place felt like a fast-food restaurant, but I really wanted this sandwich to be good enough. I got the sandwich home, unwrapped it and took a bite... 

Bland. 

How was the meat so dry? I just watched them pull it out of a vat of warm liquid. It felt like I was eating mushy sandpaper. 

So much disappointment. 

This set me on a quest for a good Italian Beef in Vegas, and luckily I found Windy City Beefs-n'Dogs. 

I walked in, and it's the total opposite of Al's. The people are friendly, and memorabilia lines the walls. You can feel that the people who run this place love it, and in a world of chains, it feels like a real family establishment. 

I ordered the #13 beef and sausage, and was surprised to find that the sausage was actually in the beef. I fished it out, put it to the side, and took a bite of the Italian beef. 

It was everything that Al's wasn't. Moist, fatty, and salty - the vinegar from the peppers cutting through it all combining to a delicious, perfectly balanced mess. The fries perfectly crisp. The meal is so large I can't finish it all at once, but I'm barely out the door before I start to crave it again. I've been there four times in the last two weeks. As an added bonus - the people here are unbelievably friendly. 

This is no high-end restaurant, and the food is by no means fancy. But the price is right, the food is delicious, the people are friendly, and it's just everything you could possibly want it to be.

Great place, Great Food, EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE!! We came in with 8 ppl they fixed us up a table and served us faster than Mc Donalds serves Fries! Great quality food... Everything is Great Great Great!!! If you haven't ate here its a MUST!!
It's a wonder I have not eaten here earlier. This place is the bomb. The dining area is a bit small, but there's outside when the weather permits. Will go again to try another off their menu.

Born & Raised In Chicago!! How Dare You Name Your Restaurant Windy City Beefs & Dogs!! I'm Sorry This Is The Worst Beef I've Ever Had Nothing Like Johnnies, Portillos, Jays, Gene & Judes That's Original Chicago Beefs This Isn't A Good Knock Off Beef Theirs No place Like Chicago Beefs When I'm Out Of Town I Eat Out At A lot Of Supposedly Chicago Restaurants And Nothing Is Authentic You Must Of Been From Suburbs Not Chicago Please People Don't Think That This Is How Our Food In Chicago Taste Because Its Not!!  Hey Owner CHANGE YOUR NAME!

First time here and I am amazed! We sat at the bar and it overlooks their kitchen so we watched how they made our orders. I swear, I was excited for my food! I ordered the #3 windy city's foot long Vienna chili cheese dog and fries! It exceeded my expectations! Definitely check this place out!

We Ordered:
#4 Best of Both Worlds Combo
#15 Davenco Gyro & Black Cherry Soda
2 - #10 Italian Beef Sandwich Combos

The food was great. It came out fast. The total was only $40 and all 4 of us left full.
I love that they have Black Cherry Soda !!!!!!!

May have found one of my new favorite lunch spots. I remember trying it a few years ago and wasn't all that impressed. Being from the Chicago area and trying to find some good food I decided to give it another try and found that I enjoyed it much better. Hot dogs and sausage sandwiches are very tasty especially for the price. Is it 100% authentic like being in Chicago? No but it's one of the closest I have found in this town

I had been wanting to stop in for some time. It was worth it! Delicious dog! Although I did request no onion (I know... bad), I got onions anyway. The kicker was that it was still great! I'll be back for sure to try other stuff.

The girl cashier was rude tonight and took another customer before us on purpose.  I've been here before, but I've never before had such poor customer service.  The hot dogs and fries are decent but really nothing to write home about.  It's possible to get these kind of dogs at fast food joints, and the buns are kinda on the mushy/soggy side.  Being from the Midwest, I like the Chicago decor, but friendliness is an attribute to that area of the country, and this place fell short of that tonight.   I agree with others that there are no alternatives for turkey, veggie or vegan dogs which is why I could never bring any of my veg friends there.  Who wants to eat just fries?  Not a problem anymore since I won't be back.

Great authentic Chicago dog place! 

Chicago dog is a must try here and get it the way it is, no alterations. Also, it's not a complete meal without an Italian beef sandwich. Go Cubs!

We kind of wound up here on a whim after coming to an impasse over where to eat. My buddy said his place was pretty good and he was driving, so tubular meat it was. The menu was rather impressive, boasting more than just hot dogs. They offer a variety of sandwiches and burgers, along with the dogs. I contemplated a burger, but opted for a Chicago Style Dog. The dog was pretty good, the french fries were average. The combo will run you about ten bucks. This is one of those places with limited space inside, so avoid the traditional noontime lunch, if you are able, or you will be cramped at a little table. They do have some outside seating, which is only a viable option if the outside temperature cooperates. The staff was friendly and attentive, but the cramped quarters were kind of a turn off.

We will drive out here, out of the way, to eat a hotdog here. We live in Summerlin and close to Buldogis, but sometimes you crave a real hotdog that will remind you of the real world out there. This place will do it. 

We love it for the size, flavor and of course the prices. Can't beat their price to proportion ratio. Generous. My husband is a big boy who loves to eat so normally when we eat hotdogs he has to order a minimum of two. He doesn't have to do that here but he still will of course. He does love this place more than I do, but that does't mean I don't get down. 

We always get their polish dog, Chicago dog and Chili dog. Oh the simplicity of hot dog love. They are all yummy. We get the fries too sometimes, and they're actually really good. Thus I was won over. Tasty fries on top of good dogs is a stackers heaven after all. 

So go to Windy City when you're craving a Chicago dog. I don't know many places that pay proper mind to the relish dog unless they're trying to be gourmet. Sorry Chicago. Sneaky little Vegas fusion eaters.

This place does it right. These guys are the real thing. Not posers, not corporate. Good reasonably priced dogs. Big, juicy, Corned Beef Ruben sandwiches, Gyro's, Polish dogs.  All good. The owners work in the restaurant and are very friendly. And once again, reasonably priced with good portions.

I've eaten at the other location in Henderson and really liked it. They also have good deep dish pizza at the other location however the the only pizza you will find at this one is a puff since the menu mostly consists of dogs, sausages, Italian beef and wings. I had a #12 which is a 2 grilled sausages with onions and peppers on bread. The onions and peppers were perfect but the sausage was too dry. Remember I had not just 1 but 2 of these dry sausage to work through. Even with adding mustard it just didn't help. Then my wife and I shared a basket of chili cheese fries however we didn't eat but a small dent in them. After tasting the chili I remembered that I didn't like it at the other location either. Honestly I don't care that it doesn't have beans but what I care more about is that it tastes like a stinky armpit smells. I love chili just not here. My wife ordered a pizza puff that I ended up eating a few bites of and it surprised me how much I liked it. I have had more authentic ones at other places and this one is more like a over-sized totinos pizza roll yet it was damn good. I can't say enough about how nice the staff was. They took the time to show us menus we could read at a table since the menu board here is curved and at a weird angle so you need a neck massage after looking at it too long. Staff checked on us a couple times to make sure we were good and to see if we needed anything so that was a plus. The inside is small with some tables and a bar with stools and they have a couple tables outside.

Fantastic place for anyone  from Chicago or anyone that wants authentic chicago style food. They were extremely friendly and the food was great! I will definitely be back! ps: if you want ketchup on your vienna beef hot dog..youll need to get that yourself from your table :p chicagoans dont put ketchup  on hit dogs
Great food and service!!!!!. I will be back. Burgers, Chicago  dog, and Italian beef were amazing. Fair prices

First time trying it out! It takes some time, so dont go here if you're in a hurry, fair warning. Had the Chicago dog combo, and it was very good. Dog was just a little snappy, sport peppers spiced it up perfectly, and the relish was that neon green stuff. French fries were more crunchy than I like personally, but delicious little shoestring fries. I really like the fact that nothing was TOO salty... I know what's important to many people. I will definitely go back and take the hubby and try out some of the other stuff!

I came here for lunch with my dad and was amazed at how well they do their dogs here. Perfectly cooked and seasoned, any of their options will cure your hunger and tickle your taste buds. I conquered the polish dog with peppers. I felt like I was transported to a baseball game by the flavor, only it was Wayyyyy better. There will be a line so be prepared to wait for an awesome taste of authentic Chicago dogs.

Yes another spot my love introduced me to, well he is a local and knows all the best places. We ate a huge Italian beef with giardiniera, and you have to get it with giardiniera! It was so delicious, we totally forgot to take a picture. We could not stop eating! The staff is really nice, and friendly. PS they have a board by the register and if your first name is one of the names they selected you get a free hot dog! SWEET!

Came here on a Monday afternoon for lunch with some friends. A little bit of a drive but one of my friends and I have been meaning to try this place out. You order your food at the cashier then find a table yourself. 

#4 Windy City's Best of Both Worlds - Vienna Hot Dog & Fries and a 3" Beef Sandwich - (Vienna Premium Beef Hot Dog served on a Steamed Vienna Poppy Seed Bun with all the fixings, Mustard, Onion, Green Relish, Pickle Spear, Tomatoes, Sport Peppers sprinkled with Celery Salt, a 3" Italian Beef Sandwich made with thin slices of Freshly Cooked Beef with our own Au jus served on a Gonnella Italian Style Roll, Served Dry, Wet, or Dipped. Served with Fries) - I got my sandwich wet with medium peppers (serrano/jalepeno level? apparently their hot was habenero level.... ouch)

The hot dog was pretty good. Soft bun with all the fixings. pickles and tomato gives it a nice crunch and bright flavor. Pretty good compared to the normal hot dog from like Sam's Club (big price difference but thats not the point here LOL) 

I was told about this place after trying Big Al's and their dipped sandwiches. I opted for wet vs dipped because i've read reviews (maybe not for this place specifically) but dipped may be too wet and hard to eat. To be honest, even wet was quite uhm wet. Flavors seemed pretty comparable to Big Al's. Maybe i'm not too experienced or knowledgable in this style of beef sandwiches so i cant say much. Still pretty good overall. 

The price of this combo is actually not bad. Got me quite full. Should opt out from getting a drink and ask for a water cup though. Adding a drink bumps price from $7.95 + tax to over $11 after tax. XD (im a cheapo shush).

I honestly can't believe I've never posted a review for Windy City.  This is the real deal place for a beef dip in Las Vegas. It's that good!

Bar and restaurant owners in the Las Vegas Valley throw their hands up in frustration and scream,  "Damn you Windy City" when their hotdog bun stuffed full of processed roast beef and a side of "Ahhh Joo" gets sent back to the kitchen, because the secret is out... Real beef dips taste great.

The staff is super friendly.

The food is delicious.

The restaurant is clean. 

I avoid Lake Mead and Buffalo, because I can't NOT,  double negative,  stop for a beef dip. Sue me!

I recommend to everyone.

My wife and I stopped by Windy City Beefs N Dogs on a Saturday afternoon outing based on our friend's recommendation. Not really knowing what to expect, we opened the door and were immediately greeted by the staff manning the grill. 

We walked deeper into the "joint" decorated with Chicago memorabilia (mostly sports) and immediately became overwhelmed with Chicago delicacies on the menu that we knew nothing about (since we are not Chicagoans). Playing it safe, we went with the tried and true Chicago dogs. We each ordered the two dog combo which comes with fries and a drink. After ordering, we got our drinks at the self service fountain, sat down at a table and waited for the food to be prepared. Everything is made to order, so if you are patient, you are in for some great tasting food. 

When our food was ready, they brought our wrapped dogs in a basket and piping hot fries in a little brown bag to our table. The dogs looked just like the picture and the flavors of the Chicago dog were amazing (Chicago pickle relish, sliced tomatoes, sporty peppers and celery salt - all of which are offered for sale at the counter). 

My wife and I ate, all the while being checked on to see if everything was okay by the employees. We were so amazed by the flavor of these new found favorite hot dogs. 

As we got up and headed for the exit, all the employees thanked us for coming in. 

We now make special trips to Windy City just for their Chicago dogs.

Dipped!  If you know beefs, you know what I mean......So do they!  Nuff said.
Authentic hot dogs and polish sausage.....Maxwell street style. Pizza puffs!

If you're new to this and have never tasted a TRUE Chicago hot dog, be sure to get it without all of the junk on it and just get it with ketchup.
Best French fries I've had in a long time - thin and crispy. Cheap, friendly, chili dog and Italian beef sandwich. Just wish they had brewed iced tea!
Very friendly staff and yummy food. Best Chicago dog I've had in Vegas for sure.

I really liked this place. We went in one night not knowing they closed in ten minutes. Sorry guys! They were so nice and didn't even mention the time to us. We did take everything to go although they offered us to sit inside. Kudos for the niceness.

I had an Italian beef sandwich with the dip on the side. Also got the foot long chili cheese dog.

The food was made fresh and hot.

I really enjoyed the chili cheese dog. It had onions which made the dog for me. It wasn't overly salty.

The Italian beef was a bit disappointing for me. Not that it was bad it just wasn't OMG I need to come back soon for this- good.

You know when you see things on tv and people make it look SOO good?! When you finally try it it is either wow this is so good! Or wow those people's tastes buds may not be as good as mine. Well I felt like I could live without Italian beef sandwiches. It was good but nothing I'd be recommending soon. I would recommend the chili cheese foot long though.

They had one with an Italian sausage I probably should have gotten. 

The prices were affordable, the food was fresh and good, and the place was clean. With the friendly staff I'd definitely say check it out.

I came to Windy City Beef-n-Dogs on a whim when several other attempts at deciding where to go for dinner failed. I am glad I ended up here.  When I first walked in I noticed not only the many other diners but also the Chicago sports memorabilia on the walls.   I spent several minutes looking at the menu of Chicago themed food choices. I settled on the Italian Beef sangwich dipped. That is to say beef on a roll dipped in sauce. Or "gravy" if you want to be correct. It was a huge sandwich and very tasty indeed.  To top off this Chicago outting in Vegas I ordered a Green River Soda. I'm not really sure what to think of Green River. It was almost soap like in taste. I don't think I would order it again. The sandwich I would for sure. Maybe even something different like a classic Chicago Dog. Oh, and the service was good too. A little slow and seemingly unorganized to a small extent. But it was friendly and professional.

Can't go wrong with this place.  I have been going to Windy City Beefs N Dogs for many years.  The service has always been friendly and the food always comes out right.  The beefs are, juicy, moist, and lots with flavor.  The prices are fair and I definitely recommend you check this place out.

I ordered the dipped Italian beef sando with mozarella and jardiniere (medium spicy).  When I looked at the menu, I wondered why this one didn't come with fries like many of the other items here.  That was until I saw it.  This thing is GIGANTIC!

It is dripping wet.  It is messy.  It is really tasty.  

I can only compare this to the one I tried at Al's Italian Beef when that was still open.  I think the jardiniere and seasoning were a little better at Al's, but this is still quite good.  You do have to pay extra for both cheese and jardiniere, but both are well worth it.  I'll try it with sweet peppers next time.  

Well worth a visit and the food coma that follows.
I took my Japanese (from Okinawa) co-worker here and she loooooooooved it and so did I! Don't worry guys, I'll definitely be returning!

Windy City Beefs-n-Dogs is so good. I love going here after I have my workout. Ha- I know that sounds CRAZY. I only do it once in a while. They have a few tables outside that are nice t sit t on a nice Vegas day and watch all the crazies walk by.

This place has true Chicago style dogs as well as man other things. We always order 2 Chicago Dogs with everything, 1 Gyro and a basket of chili cheese fries.

They also offer 2 names each day, and if it is your name, you can get a free dog! Never my name but I love to check.

Never had a bad meal here and everything is so fresh and delicious. The owners are always there and you can even bring your dog to sit outside with you. Sometimes they will bring your pup a hotdog and water on the house. So cute and much appreciated by the animals.

They also have done Groupons in the past which was how I found this place and it was a great deal. Hoping they do another one. They are usually voted "Best of Vegas". Try it out!!

Windy City has been my weekly go-to favorite for years. While their food is nothing original, it does mimic the real thing. What is most frightening about the place is their ownership. They pretend not to have an "interest" in the business. Thus, should something not be properly executed or they commit a serious faux-pas, the customer is faced with a screeching female and male bully of the largest sort. Since I noted the owner was handling money and preparing food baskets with the same hands, all of which resulted in a disastrous experience for us...I will never risk eating there again. Anyone can grill a dog, steam a tamale and cook a hunk of beef. Beware, this joint charges for everything and as long as one pays up and never questions a thing, it's decent. But, BULLIES belong where they came from. Not here!
Omg! Love this placccce!! I can't even begin to describe! The people there are nice, attentive and genuine. Kind of make you feel like family. It's decor is great and ALWAYS clean.
Great hot dog joint off the beaten path. Tried the polish dog and it reminded me of something right out of a stadium or a street cart.Going back ASAP

Las Vegas is a far cry from Chicago and if you ever been to Chicago you know that Vienna Beef Hot Dogs made the Chicago way or style are outstanding.  Windy City brings that bit of Chicago here to Las Vegas.  if you long for Chicago style Hot Dogs this has what you want.  The place is decorated with everything from Chi Town...the Cubbies, the White Sox and the Stanley Cup Champs The Black Hawks.....this place is a homer.

Our family has been here a few times and the service and food is always outstanding! The nice ladies (& gents) at the counter always greets us with genuine smiles and our little guy has never come out of there without them offering a little cup of sherbet (on the house!) Seriously warms my heart!

Everything we have ever ordered from Windy City has been delicious and freshly made! Hotdogs, yum. Wings, better than the other guys. French fries, yes please. Pizza Puff, mmmmm!

But NOTHING can compare or even stand a chance against their ITALIAN BEEF SANDWICH! (with everything; don't you dare take anything off of it.) (WET; they dip the entire sandwich in au jus and you can get it as wet as your heart desires.) You CANNOT order this sandwich without having them dip it into the au jus. I would think that would be somewhat illegal somewhere. There is some sort of 'relish' that they slap on there that has carrots, peppers, onions that will literally knock your socks off. That relish with the thinly sliced juicy roast beef, gooey cheese, and the savory wetness from the au jus will do a number on your tastebuds. Trust me. My mouth is literally salivating as I type this. If you've never tried it, I judge you. Hard. 

Go there. Order it. Then thank me later. Kbye.

Great quick service establishment the staff is friendly and knowlegable. 
I will order;
2 Chicago Dogs w/everything and a large chili add cheese. Chili is homemade and real flip'n good.
 Or... either.
Italian Beef Combo soaked w/sweet & hot.
Fries are skinny and crisp w/just the rite amount of salt powder. 
I chow here 4x's a month since the place open.
The joint is kept very clean.
Good job my fellow Chicagoan! 
 Oh yea... 1 do have one complaint, they never pick the name Joe to feature on the daily chalk board. lol...
Cmon it is yelp, ya gotta complain about something.
DA BEARS! GO HAWKS! GO SOXS! and _ da cubbies!

Service here is usually really great. Today the cashier who took my order was extremely rude and impatient. She definitely did not have mid western ways. Not sure if I will be traveling so far to order from them
Great people, great Food. I love the soft Poppy Seed buns and they made a great Chi dog.

Excellent Chicago dogs are served here. The dogs have a nice crispy snap when you bite into them. The rolls are nicely steamed and the fixings are all that you want in a Chicago dog. Plus, they served some really nice homemade fries and are definitely not the pre-made frozen kind. Service is quick and very friendly. Their prices are really reasonable too. In short, good food, service and price--everything you want in a great restaurant. Will definitely be returning whenever I am in the mood for a great Chicago dog.
What a joke not even close to Vienna style Chicago sorry but your flavors not there. Born raised Chicagoan
This place has got some awesome Chicago dogs and hot roast beef sandwich ROCKS!!!

I would recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic Chicago style dogs.  The food is fantastic and the staff is very friendly. I also love the environment. I travel to Vegas for work and always go out of my way to eat here.   Only complaint is they don't take American Express.

Got to eat here this past weekend. First time dining in as we only did to go once before. We had an appointment across the street and wanted to eat at someplace in the area. We were also hungry and wanted a quick bite to eat..
This is a great place to come if you're hungry and want food asap!  
We ordered two corn dogs, a #4- best of both worlds hot dog and 3in beef sandwich, #8 -chicken wings (mild with ranch) & their special for that day - a 16in sausage with fries and a drink. 
Everything was pretty good! The fries were not soggy, nor burnt. The chicken wings aren't smothered in sauce, which is appreciated. It gives you the chance to put as much or as little as you want. It's even enjoyed by the little ones because it's not spicy.  
We went around 3:30pm and dined in. There were only 2 other parties eating there. However, while we were there, 4 other people came in and did to go orders.

This place is the real deal! The place is always clean, the food is always fresh and hot, and the people are always friendly. We eat here at least once a week. All the food is the REAL DEAL Chicago dishes.

Sandwich was great and extremely satisfying. The service was great and these people look and act like they are from chicago (thats a good thing). I felt like I was being transported from vegas to chicago the moment i entered the shop.

We threw a party for 30 to celebrate Independence Day and ordered from Windy City's bulk menu to provide Italian beef for the hungry crowd. We picked up the fixings (beef, au jus, bread, peppers and giardinera) a few hours before the party and it was a breeze to prep and serve. It was a big hit. Many had never experience such a thing before, yet they loved it.

The MIL was hoping we'd pick some good old American fare so I found this place was close by their house and thought 4.5 star average can't be wrong. 

I got the #4 Hot dog & 3in beef sandwich w/ fries ($7.95).

 I love Chicago dogs and theirs is pretty legit, though not my favorite in town. I realized I prefer a snappy dog than a softer, boiled dog which I have the option elsewhere.  I dont like when boiled dogs wet the bread either. It's just a preference and is not a reflection that this place is bad. I think if you're feeling a Chi-dog, this should be on the short list as this is pretty close to what I've had in Chicago.   

The beef sandwich comes with different options: au jus- dipped, wet or side, cheese, giardiniera- hot or mild. I put my au jus on the side and good thing since the sandwich was already kind of wet and falling apart. I didn't feel the au jus added much and half the cup was oil. The giardiniera was pretty good and I got the hot kind and it was spicy! That was just okay and just a bit too soggy and greasy for my liking.  Just doesn't settle right with me- Windy City indeed! I blamed it on my MILs old dog though! The fries were thin cut, seasoned well and crispy- these are how I like my fries! My BF also got the same combo and the MIL and grandma split one and sandwich was the least favorite.

My MIL got the footlong chili and cheese dog w/ fries ($5.75) and I took a bite. I'm not a chili type person, but I try a bite whenever my BF or MIL order chili items and this was pretty good. The BF said he'd order it next time and she thought it was tasty.

The service was alright. There was a mistake on the order, but they were quick to correct it. The lady who brought us our order came back to check on us and was friendly. This really isn't a full service place though- the drinks, condiments, utensils, trash is DIY and you order at the counter. 

I can see why people like this place as it's comfort type foods. I can't really say my experience was 4 star worthy as there was aspects of the food I liked and then there are parts that fell short. I think we will return specially since the in laws enjoyed themselves. I would like to try their Polish sausage since it's grilled to get snappy next time.
Came here for dinner and ordered the beef and sausage dog, it was really good. We got hotdogs for the kids and they loved them as well. This will be my place for hotdogs in Vegas from now on.

Hidden inside a strip mall is a lil' hole in the wall restaurant that serves authentic chicago fare. Think open kitchen, bar stools and diner tables.

I always get their French Dip with Roast Beef.... it's amazingly good. If you like peppers, ask for them to add hot peppers to it. They make their own and I just can't get enough of it. My friends also swear by their burgers. Lots of people were getting the polish dog that day and it looks enormous (ha ha insert joke) and very delicious - going to get it next time!

The staff here is also super friendly and I believe it's a mom and pop shop, which makes me want to go back even more!
Best place to get a taste of home! Friendly staff and owners! We love to come here to eat. Recommend to anyone that wants to have a taste of Chicago food!!

We had been wanting to try this place since I had read reviews from Chicago natives that Windy City served authentic Chicago hot dogs & Italian beef sandwiches. We were not disappointed! I loved my first ever Chicago dog. I see what all the fuss is about. The snap when you bite is fantastic. All the toppings added to the taste. The beef sandwich was positively loaded with meat. We got ours dry with the au jus on the side, the better to dip the sandwich & fries in. Those fries! They were hot & crispy served in a brown paper bag. They are among the best fries I have encountered in Las Vegas since moving here. The employees were very helpful & friendly. Windy City gets my highest recommendation for both food & service.

This place is so awesome! The Italian beef was just as good as in Chicago! The portion was huge! Staff was very friendly. The restaurant is clean and in a good location (across the street from golds gym lol). Be sure to bring a heavy appetite when you come! I'll be sure to try the wings next time

I can't believe I have shopped at Von's dozens of times and never investigated Windy City.  I only found it by using Yelp's nearby function, but now that I have, I will be back.

I tried their Italian Beef sandwich, wet, with mozzarella and giardiniera.  The beef was super tender and they get a bonus point for having above-average fries!  The staff was friendly and the other food looked great.
Good food, even better customer service. They are dog friendly. My dog and I sar outside. They even gave her a hot dog!

Windy City Beef N Dogs. Best Hot Dog in Las Vegas. If you are from Chicago like me, think Superdawg or Byrons. Also excellent Italian Beef Sandwich. You can get it dry, dipped or wet. Think Al's in Chicago. Order at the counter and grab a table. Your order will be deliverd to the table by the friendly staff. Great service, indoor or outdoor seating. Worth a drive from anywhere.  For us they have replaced another place on Rancho that serves Chicago style Hot Dogs.

Having just moved here from Chicago, we were very anxious to try a restaurant that 
came highly recommended by another local eatery and had such good reviews on line .

We went there last night and were very disappointed. The "friendly service" was non existant. We sat down at the counter and when we tried to order we were told we needed to come over to the counter because " we can't hear you.". When we asked for a knife and fork we were told "I'll get them for you,but they are on the counter over there." This was from the OWNER!  So much for friendly service.

The hot dog hot I had was fair but small and soggy, my hot tamale came in the same wrapper it was sold in the supermarket, and the chicken fingers were obviously pre cooked.

If you are going to compare yourself to famous Chicago  hot dog stands like Byron,Al's, and Gene and Jude's you better be ready to stand up and be compared to those places by people who have grown up eating there

Maybe it was a bad night for the owner but when you charge $20.00 for one hotdog and fries and one order of chicken fingers and two drinks,you should at least try and put a smile on your face and ACT happy.

My husband and I usually get take-out on Friday nights and Windy City kept popping up on my Yelp app. We decided to give it a try and it's now in our permanent rotation! It's a cute little hole in the wall celebrating all things Chicago. The walls are covered in memorabilia and everyone behind the counter is dressed in Chicago garb. The first time I visited I came in and placed our order and sat at the counter and waited for the food. They were quick, efficient, and super friendly. They used my name and asked me how I was doing. Everything smelled fantastic and I couldn't wait to get home and dig in! 

My husband got the #4 - a Chicago style dog and a 3 inch Italian beef with fries. This is definitely a great deal, you get the best of both worlds. I settled on an Italian beef, dipped with mozzarella, and a side of fries. OMG! I fell in love with Italian beef sandwiches in Chicago and this one hit the spot for me. You definitely want it dipped with ooey gooey mozzarella. The sandwich is huge and delicious, I completed gorged myself, leaving only one bite. The fries are shoestring and completely satisfying. Great customer service and delicious food, we were immediately in love. The next time we ordered, we decided to try their chicken wings. My husband love wings and I can appreciate a good wing as well. These are the best! We now split an order (there are 13 in an order, plus fries) and are completely happy. The wings are crispy and huge. The sauce comes on the side, which isn't my favorite, but I don't mind too much because they have so much flavor anyway. Last time we ordered we also tried a pizza puff, basically a step above a hot pocket, but lots of flavor. 

No need to get on a place to satiate those Chicago craving, just hop in your car and give them a try!

I have only been to this place once, and I can assure you once is enough to get you hooked. I will be back many many times. I am from the Midwest (Wisconsin to be precise) and have visited Chicago a few times. I have had a few good Italian Beef sandwiches in my time and I'm impressed with this place. Not only are the prices reasonable, and the portion sizes are great. I got an Italian Beef sandwich with mozzarella for $8.oo and was completely NOT prepared for the amount of sandwich I was about to get. It gave me two meals. Two delicious meals. Their hot dogs are ACTUAL hot dogs, void of that crazy thing called ketchup.

The service is great and fast. I ordered and only had to wait for a minute or two before my food was served to me. The staff was also very friendly and knew what they were doing. The place also has some crazy specials that go on. Seemingly random things, like "If your name is Nancy, you get a free drink!" Which I mean, is awesome if your name is Nancy, lol. They keep calenders around to in case you want to pick up one. I have found an Italian beef place and look forward to going back. I highly suggest it if you want a lot of food for the money you spend. They also have a sister store down in Henderson called Windy City Beefs-N-Pizzas, which I'm going to check out soon. :)

On my last visit I experimented a little and tried a Hamburger ordered medium rare.  Although the burger came out medium, with fresh lettuce, tomato, onions, and an exceptionally tasting dressing, it was still very good enhanced with Tomato Ketchup and Mild Yellow Mustard on a soft Sesame Seed Bun.  Spicy Mustard is also available.  

Fries were greasy but hot and tasty.  And, even though it was lunchtime, of course I would not leave without first ordering and then downing an entire Italian Beef Sandwich, as well.  This time the impressive sammie was 7-1/2-inches of greatness, featuring beautifully seasoned dipped beef and oodles of zesty Sweet Green Peppers.  Tables were regularly cleaned as soon as diners left.  And, service was as friendly as before.

Another 5-star lunch!

Being from Chicago, this place is just the comfort food I'm looking for when I'm homesick. Beef is actually really good. The only thing they REALLY need is liquid cheese for cheese fries. If they had Merkts cheddar I would give it 5 stars.

As an old Chicagoan, this place was perfect.  Great service, perfectly cooked hotdogs with Chicago imported  condiments.  Greeted by the owner the way a Chicago native would (he grew up within a mile of me on the west side).  Fun combination specials and all sorts of promos (free chips if your address has a "3").  Perfectly cooked fries in a greasy bag... all the smells and tastes of the old neighborhood.

So I've been trying to be more spontaneous and try new things randomly, which led me to this hidden gem. This place is in the vine parking lot on lake mead and buffalo next to the subway. I honestly wish they had a bigger sign so they could attract more attention. 

Anyway, I ordered the Vienna corned beef Reuben sandwich with fries, and it's by far my favorite Reuben I've had in Vegas. I totally suggest people giving this place a try, and I can't wait to try new things. Oh I almost forgot, they also have cheesecake on a stick dipped in chocolate! Whoa!!!

Everything was perfect for this hole in the wall. Food was amaze and just as Amazing was the customer service I'll be back sit at the counter and shoot it with everyone there. The food is absolutely perfect for a dipped sandwich I will be back and order the whole menu. The fries were cooked to perfection. My cheat days will now belong to this perfect place to eat.

So far Windy City Beef-n-Dogs is the best Chicago style fast food I've found in Vegas. Too bad it's on the opposite side of town from where I live or I'd go there more often.

They have all the real stuff- Vienna Beef dogs, poppy seed buns, Italian beef, sausage, Maxwell St. Polish, even pizza puffs and tamales. I think they even have Old Style beer on tap!

You can't beat the 2 dog special with fries for $6 when other places in town are charging $6 + for a single dog!

Their beef/sausage combo is as good as any I've had in Chicago. I hadn't had one in almost 2 years and it was really good stuff although a bit expensive.

I think they just recently added gyros sandwiches to their menu and I had one the other night. As with their other stuff the portion was ample and it was made with care. My only gripe is they are using pre sliced gyros and don't have the whole spit - rotisserie setup. I would encourage them to get the whole setup. I know it must be an expensive outlay originally, but having a good gyros in the lineup completes the Chicago menu nicely.

The restaurant looks like it's a family run place. All the people behind the counter are real Chicagoans who put the necessary care into the food and they really respect the tradition. It shows in the quality and taste.

If you want to have your own Chicago cook out, they even sell all the dogs, beef, sausages, buns and fixings by the pound to take home.

I'll continue to go back when I can. How about opening a Henderson location? :-)
Italian beef is a must ! Get it dipped with peppers and cheese ! This place is decked out in all Chicago pictures , sports items

A hard swallow o_O

Hot can't even begin to describe the spicy mustard coated maxwell street style polish. Verbose enough? As of late I've been divulging into spicy meals where ever & whenever feasible & its been rather flat out, well that's just about it, flat (or maybe I haven't been going to the right places)

As I chatted away with the friendly lady over the counter about all things chi (yes I'm from chicago) the busy bodies of the place were preparing what would be, my last spicy treat for...oh let's say the next decade.

After a short wait, my meal slid in, coated with sport peppers, spicy mustard & everything else in the kitchen sink! Slid the peppers out of the way & worked my way into the meal. 

A quarter of the way through the heat had started building up, near half point it felt like an atomic orgasm had just erupted in my mouth! My palate was having a seizure, sweat gushed out of their glands & the tears could no longer be held back! It was scorching hot! To the point where my tongue started rejecting the food the moment it made contact! I gazed at the lady as she remarks "you wanted it spicy" & I return the gesture with the look of defeat. As I take a long pause from the meal to let the heat wear out.

All in all I shall return! For more of the pleasurable punishment! Friendly chi-town staff, neighborly & real. Sorry I couldn't say a proper g-bye, I was sucking up the blood o.O (i kid)

When I want a Chicago dog this is place. I have tried in other place and they not as good as this place. The workers are supper friendly. And other stuff on menu are very good also. This place is worth a try

My husband and I came in to try out this place as we have seen it when we drive by. I ordered the hotdog combo and my husband ordered the italian beef half sandwich with a hotdog combo. I must say that the hotdog was good but definately nothing to rave about. What was worse was my husbands italian sandwich which was dried out and the cheese on top wasn't even melted. My husband told the lady at the front and she didn't seem to care instead she made sure to take it away so no one else would see it. I feel she should have offered something else instead but she opted to lose business as we would have come back for the hotdog which wasn't terrible.

If you want a great Chicago Hot Dog, you'll just have to go to Chicago.

That pretty much sums it up. When in Chicago I make a pilgrimage to Super Dog and Hot Doug's. These two places were rated 3 and 1, respectively in the US.

I had high hopes of finding something, close, not expecting perfection. 

At the suggestion of the order person, I ordered the House Special, a hot dog accompanied by a beef dip sandwich.  It was served with  french fries.

Though they did prepare the hot dog with Chicago like fixings, it was nowhere in a class with Super Dog. Neither were the fries, just  on par with Mc Donald's.

I can't say anything nice about the beef dip, so I won't say anything. 

I went with Brian, my house painter, who is an exact look a like, for the Zig Zag Man.

He never had a genuine Chicago Hot Dog, but he said he'd had better, too.

Service was friendly, and for Las Vegas, this is better than Pink's, and it's probably as good for a hot dog, that you will find in this wasteland of eateries. 

Two Stars means "I've experienced better", and these folks are not in a class with hot dogs from Chicago.
I have never had a bad anything here and I have been coming here for years! The food is hot and at a good price, Chicago dog with chili cheese fries all the way.

Nice little place with really tasty hot dogs! The food was very good, I enjoyed their Chicago style dogs but they also have sandwiches and chicken fingers, among other things. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Really relaxed atmosphere with Chicago sports memorabilia for decor. Great place for lunch or a quick laid back dinner.
I've had the tamales with chili and they are awesome my favorite dish hands down. Theres always a line so it's gotta be good

Ho hum
The food is ok, the only thing that I was disappointed with was the Italian beef sandwich, ordered it dry and it was fairly tasteless.  the service was bellow par, some sour faced lady took my order.
 But over $10 a head for 2 hot dogs, greasy fries and a drink?
I can think of many establishments I can spend $10 on lunch....this one is not on my list.

Came here for a quick bite to eat. Got the  Chicago style dog (without relish of course!) I've always been afraid of poppy seed buns but it didn't matter, it was delicious! The fries were smacking!! Also try the pizza puff, it's amazing! Reminds me of the pizza pockets from elementary school. My gf was upset there was no desert offered lol, but I'm okay with that. Ill definitely be back for sure

Yes!! What a find on my way back from a 5+ hour hike at Red Rocks.  A quick Yelp search for lunch spots brought me here and since I had such good luck in the area for breakfast I figured I would roll the dice on getting a real Chicago dog just a few miles outside the strip.

Tucked in a strip mall I knew this place was the real deal when I walked in.  If someone blindfolded you and dropped you inside you would swear you were on South Wacker and not in the middle of the desert.   

Got the Chicago Dog (of course) and chili cheese fries since I had some calories to replenish.  The dog was awesome, the real deal - onions, relish, peppers, pickle, tomato, celery salt and the signature poppy seed bun.   Cooked perfectly - great snap and all the toppings were fresh and delicious.  Same deal on the fries - thin and perfectly crisp with a great later of chili and cheese on top.  Not sure if it's intended to be a single serving but it was for me!

Believe the reviews - this place nails it!!

Born and raised in Chicago this place is amazing for all your Chicago eats. The best Chicago hotdogs in town. Friendly staff, even the customers are friendly and talk to you. A must!!! I've already tried half of the menu, and nothing has disappointed yet.

Oh, so that's a Chicago Style dog?  This was my first time trying one.

I must have eaten it wrong, because I was not impressed.  

All the parts of the dog were good, but they didn't add up to much.  The dogs are high quality Vienna Beef, and have a great snap.  The only other ingredient that made the dog distinctive were the tomatoes.  I expected the bright green pickle relish to contribute something significant to the flavor profile, but it really didn't.  The poppy seed bun was unremarkable.

I ordered a combo that came with a bag of french fries.  The french fries photographed well (LOL), but they were totally limp.  Nobody like limp fries.  Clearly I should've went for a bag of Jay's chips.

Now, I realize all this just doesn't add up.  It must be my fault.  Clearly, I must have eaten it wrong.   

I failed on my first try, but I'm not giving up.  I'm definitely going back to Windy City next time I'm in town. I'm gonna have a Chicago Dog and I'm gonna like it.  

Mikey C says:
           So your brother's bound and gagged
           And they've chained him to a chair
           Won't you please come to Chicago just to sing?

Where where where to start with this place.

Ill start with walking in, to a small over crowded restaurant with menu that hangs loomingly over your head making you crink your neck back trying to see the few small options. If someone had been siting at the table near the register we wouldnt have been able to see the menu.

Then upon review of the menu at the "Authentic chicago hot dog place in vegas" discvered THEY DONT EVEN HAVE A CHEESE DOG!!!

Once we ordered and paid for over incredibly over priced food. 8.75 for a bun with a scorched hot dog(what my girlfriend got instead of a cheese dog), a small drink and what any restaurant would consider to be smaller than a small amount of unseasoned reheated and mushy french fries served to us in a paper bag like I was in kindergarten going to school with a sack lunch.

I ordered a Italian beef sandwich dry with au jus. When I unwrap this the bun is so damp and wet that it was stuck to the paper monstrosity they wrapped it in. I ended up tearing 1/4 of the bun off as to not eat paper. I take my first bite only to discover more atrocities lie in wait. The "Italian beef" is more like dehydrated beef so dry that when I took a piece I couldnt even fold a 1 inch piece without it crumbling apart. the au jus they gave me might as well of been water with some brown food dye in it to make it appear to be au jus.

All in all a pathetic excuse of a restaurant. A news article on the wall from when it opened says that the owners number 1 rule is to not call peoples order out by order number and get to know every customers name. Well they certainly didnt call my order number out but they didn't fulfill the other half either and ask my name instead the eye lid seizuring waitress yelled at me while I was reading with my order.

This is one place I will definitely never recommend as my girlfriend (who is from chicago put it) the only thing on the menu chicago was the all beef hot dogs which were not cooked chicago style but were instead charred on a grill until black and crispy.

If there were a no star rating thats what I would give.

Secondly this is not my first time visiting a yelp restaurant but I was so disappointed in this entire experience I felt compelled to share for the first time on yelp. Dodge this place at all costs.

I love OG Italian beefs. Grew up on them. My beef was seasoned well and the hot giardenara was excellent.  The one thing I did not like was on top my sandwich was really salty. I'm not sure at what point they added the salt but it was way too much. That's why the 3 stars. Other than that this real deal chi town beef spot would have been better. They have Vienna dogs with the works and also sausages both polish and Italian style. For me the salt killed it. 

I will be back but next time I will try their daily specials. Much better value served with fries and drink for under $10.

Tried this place today for lunch. I got the 
 #5 Windy City's Maxwell Street Polish & Fries 
A Vienna Polish Sausage, Plain or Spicy, Steamed then grilled to perfection, served on a Steamed Vienna Poppy Seed Bun served with Mustard, Grilled Onions & Sport Peppers. Served with Fries. All this yummy goodness for 6 bucks. Can't beat that.
Service is fast and friendly. I will be back to try something different!
On a whim, I stopped in and was treated to a fantastic dog and friendly service. I greedily eyed the beef sandwiches while I ate, so I'll definitely have to come back for one of those.
Out standing great Chi hot dog fast service my order was ready before I could find a table
Always a pleasure going here. People are super friendly and food is good. Definitely a fun place to go on game day.

This place gets a solid 4 stars for many reasons.  One being the closest to a real Chicago dog from real Chicago peeps I have had outside of Chicago.  

The firm but soft bun, the snap of a great dog (however I did not get the vienna dog I hear those are better) the mustard on the dog, the oh so sweet relish that for some reason you cannot find but online, the oh so snappy pickle, the crisp firm onions and the firm pickled spicy sport peppers, oh and don't forget the special salt.  An all and all great Chicago dog!  Oh and a Bag of fries, gotta like that one ;)  However I almost got slightly distracted from my goal and got the Ruben a favorite of mine that I rarely order.  Ok next time...

So the solid 4 stars come from the owners working behind the cook bar, and the fact that they came by twice not just for me but others as well to see how the food was.  The wife-owner also came by to take baskets away (take baskets away at a fast food spot?! AWESOME!)  and make sure you were full.  While we were there a steady stream of people came and went.  I found out they used to have a spot downtown that was recently closed down due to downtown building improvements.  

I don't remember people being this friendly in Chicago but I do remember a time when people were this friendly in general.  It was an awesome change as far as treatment goes and I love a small business run how it should be run by people who care.

Da dawgs!

If you live in Vegas, you already know you can visit Paris, the Big Apple or Italy with just a short drive to the Strip.
So often, however, these Vegas versions leave much to be desired. Our Paris is packed with slot machines and plastic Eiffel Towers full of daiquiris; New York- New York is a watered down, corporate version of the real thing and apart from the gondolas, visiting the Venetian is about as exciting as a trip to Epcot Center, complete with bewildered herds of tourists.
But step inside Windy City and bam! There you are in a downtown Chicago hot dog joint, complete with mouth-watering smells, packed with photos from Wrigley and Soldier Fields and staffed by the kind of smiling, friendly Midwestern folk who've made hundreds  of hot dog spots in the real windy city longtime tourist favorites.
Like about 80 percent of Chicago vendors, Windy City sells Vienna Beef hot dogs, and the cooks here build 'em any way you want. I recommend you order yours Chicago style: in a warm, soft bun and piled high with tomato, onion, green relish, pickle, sport peppers, mustard and celery salt. (Also, it should be a crime NOT to try the chili-cheese fries.) Grab your dog and head back to any number of the tiny tables lining this narrow, in-love-with-Chicago hot dog heaven. Check out the wall photos of Walter Payton or the Chicago skyline. Lose yourself for a moment in a haze of beef, bun and that warm, world-famous Chicago family feeling.
Unlike other themed hot dog spots in the valley, Windy City offers a superior product at a reasonable price, is meticulously clean and actually feels and sounds (thanks to its funny, outgoing staff) like its namesake. 
Las Vegas and Chicago: two cities joined at the hot dog (to paraphrase a favorite writer of mine).

The Chicago style dog was good.  I got it with everything.  But the Italian beef sandwich was to die for.  I got it wet with hot giardiniera and it was so, so good.  I will be back., probably sooner than I should be.
This is the best hole in the wall, mom and pop restaurant! I highly recommend making this a Vegas must visit place.
I ordered the other night.Great customer service.Good hot dogs.

Service and ambiance was good.  Food was pretty bad.  Fries and wings were both clearly cheap frozen mass produced products and not restaurant quality then refried poorly in oil.  I could walked over to Vons next door and baked my own fries for way better.  Prices are pretty cheap but food was just terrible.  When I go to a restaurant I expect restaurant quality food and this place did not deliver.
Omg...so good. Third time here. Today I got a gyro. Yesterday I got wings and loved them!!! My coworker got them today. On top of fabulous food, the nicest people! Like Cheers but food.

Decent food at good prices!  I probably would have hit it with a 3.5 in my book, but it's more of a 4 star spot than a 3 so I will round up.

Ordered the #1, Windy City's Chicago Style Hot Dog & Fries.  Portion was a little small, but I guess that is why they have a #2, which is the same thing but with two dogs lol.  I really liked the pepper and the toppings on the hotdog, but I would be lying if it was my favorite dog in town.  Since I have never had a real Chicago dog, I don't care if it is authentic or not....but the dogs were somewhat small, and not very snappy to me.  But still a solid hotdog!

Also did the #10, Windy City's Chicago Style Italian Beef Sandwich.  We ordered it wet, and it was definitely good, just wished there was something more in there besides meat and bread.  Needs some sort of pepper or veggie for consistency and taste IMO.  My friend ordered the sausage and peppers, and it looked a lot better tasting to me.

I think my tab was around $12, so it is decently priced, and if I ordered the right stuff, it is good bang for your buck.

Give it a try!

My mother and brother were born and raised in Chicago, and I love Chicago-style food.  Until now, I'd not found a good place in Vegas to get an Italian beef sandwich or a real Chicago dog.  I have now.  They even have all the fixin's for sale, including the Vienna Beef hot dogs, sport peppers, and giardinare.  Forget about Al's, come here.  They also have another location where they serve Chicago pizza, but I've not tried them (yet).  But I promise I will.

I haven't had a hot dog in years and it was worth the wait. Friendly staff. The dog was perfect. It was hot, juicy and dripping with flavor. The only thing missing was a ball game, a movie, or a family reunion.

I really can't tell you how well the chicago dog was compared to others; it's the first I've ever had. But I thought it was pretty good, even though the dog itself seemed kind of small. I guess that's just how they come. The toppings were plenty however, and the seasoned fries were delicious.
My favorite thing here has to be the italian beef sandwich, which comes mild or hot. Be careful, when they say hot, they mean hot, not that pussified wannabe spicy crap you get at most places. So, so good!

I had been wanting to give this place a try for sometime now. The location on Eastern is 5 star all the way, but the same vibe isn't felt at this location for me. The menu board above the register is painful to look at because it's awkwardly hanging. The employees were very friendly and helpful with going over the menu and checking on us while eating. I ordered a "Pizza Puff" combo priced at $4.50 plus 50 cents each for the addition of chili and cheese to the fries, onions were free. The pizza puff had cheese, sausage and sauce inside. It did taste ok. It reminded me of something you got for school lunch when you were younger, but in a very slightly better way. The basket of chili cheese fries is over $4 alone, so upgrading your combo with the addition of chili and cheese for just a buck makes it cheaper for the same size. The fries were good and the onions very fresh. The chili was not god though. I have had canned chili that tasted better. The basket of fries was a huge amount, but I really didn't eat but a few bites and then just couldn't eat anymore so a lot was wasted.
