She is so genuine and listens to what you want and gives her professional advice. I came in with pretty solid blonde highlights, we added dimension - lowlights and highlights with a base break (don't know all the lingo) but it turned out AMAZING. Got a million compliments! You will not be disappointed!

Whitney has been my go-to stylist for over four years.  I have very fine hair that can be challenging to cut and style. With Whitney, I know that I'll leave the salon with a flawless haircut that is easy to maintain.  I have tried other stylists and always end up coming back to her for a cut and color correction.  I highly recommend "H is for Hair" to anyone of any age that wants to look their best.

Most amazing place to get married! We went to Container Park. Definitely recommend this location as it has restaurants, bars and a beautiful backdrop. It was beautiful wedding. Everyone on staff was so nice and helpful. They had answers to all my questions and made sure to set up my first reveal in my dress how I wanted. 

The pastor was well spoken and had heart felt words

The photographer was WONDERFUL. We had our own mini photo shoot and was attentive to my concerns. I am very tall so I wanted to make sure photos were not taken looking up at me that would give me a double chin. The photos came out amazing and it's even better they give them to you right there on the spot. 

Couldn't have chosen a better place to elope. I am over the moon. If you're eloping in Vegas this is the place.

UPDATE: 

I am very happy that they reached out to me, and they spoke with me regarding my issues. Very professional, i think it was all a miss understanding, and they are resolving my issue. I do recommend this place, Like i said photos, venue and Minister were awesome. 



I got married here in Mid September. The chapel, the environment, and customer service was perfect. The photos came out perfect. The cermonoy and venue is nice as well.

PRICING was a big deal for me here. I got the 150$ package, which comes with 15 photos. So the photographer takes 100 plus photos and they only let you choose 15, if you want you can buy all the photos for 150$ on top of what you paid already, that's ridiculous. For you to have guests take pictures its an additional 50$! So why didn't I get credited for my 15 photos that I paid for in the package of 150$? I had to pay another 150$ if i wanted al my photos. I also got charged for my guests to take pictures, which i was not aware of. Until i called and asked why it was so much. They had no clue what I was saying.

I did not want to spend much so I was googling different places and I found this place! Staff was very friendly and informative. The chapel for the ceremony was gorgeous. The minister did an awesome job as well as the photographer. My husband and I are very happy and glad that this place made our wedding day memorable and fun! :)

What a pleasant surprise this chapel is! My husband and I renewed our vows and took advantage of their FREE grand opening special. The staff was super and very helpful. The chapel itself is really pretty - Neutral colors so it worked with my colors. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone wanting a Vegas wedding experience!

Did some research before deciding for this chapel. Called to make an appointment spoke to Rossane to reserve a time and date.

Chose the cheapest package because we wanted something simple. Rossane asked me if I wanted flowers. That she will do something amazing and pretty and such such. I took her offer and said yes to this additional add on. It was a mistake! 

The day of, we got up early to go get our marriage license. The bureau was just around the corner, which was very convenient. My appointment with Lucky Little Chapel was at 10:30 am, but I called them right when they open to see if they can take us since we got our license early and didn't want to leave downtown and come back. Luckily, there were cool about it. 

We arrived and once we go into the location, there was this guy that popped out from the inside like running towards us and said with a tone "where are you guys going" we said "we have an appointment with Lucky Little Chapel" then he said "ohh, because many bum come in, so I thought you guys were one" OKAY?? our faces were "WTF" seriously. I just let it go... He then show me the office. (BTW, it seems that they only have 1 chapel set up, that is what I saw)

I was welcome by this lady (forgot her name) I gave her all documents she needed. Then ask me to pay the remaining balance which includes my so call "bouquet." I wanted to say something but didn't want to make a scene. I just remember when Rossane said to me that she will make a beautiful bouquet, bla bla bla. I swear, I could have bring one from LA and it still looks much better than the one I got at Lucky Little Chapel. The bouquet was very disappointed to me, the 2 roses did not look fresh!! I was not happy at the moment. It look like rushed work when preparing my bouquet, TIP: DON'T GET THEIR BOUQUET. NOT WORTH IT!!!

Despite that tiny situation, we enjoyed the ceremony, (about 30 mins) Our pastor was amazing and the pictures came out great too. (the one we picked! of course) because all the other the photographer took, was not in a very nice angle. 

I would recommend this place, just don't get their flowers, unless you don't mind not so fresh flowers.

This is a cute little chapel in Downtown Las Vegas.  My god-brother reserved the chapel during the week and they married that Saturday.  They have a really cute setup and a nice little bridge where you can take pictures.  The staff was very welcoming and friendly.  They had fresh flowers, pictures and a video included in their packages (I'm sure there are different size packages).  There was not that much foot traffic (because I don't think many people know about this place), but if I had to do a nice inexpensive wedding ceremony, I would give this place my business.  The taxi driver said its convenient and right by the courthouse (where you get your marriage license).

When I got married in Vegas back in 1998 (needless to say that didn't work out) we went to another chapel, but Lucky Little Chapel is by far better.

In Vegas, ready to get married! But most chapels looked old fashioned and didn't appeal. We found some pics of Lucky Little Chapel online, called them and found a good package for our wedding. The packages were good value and less complicated than other chapels. For instance: you own the photos immediately. Photo quality was great and the photographer professional. We opted for live streaming, good quality using ustream.tv. Friends and family on 3 continents were able to watch. Added a video as well and received it immediately on a USB drive. Everybody we talked to was professional and friendly, from our first phone call to our minister and the owners. We definitely recommend Lucky Little Chapel!

Thank you to the Lucky Little Chapel for making our day so special!  My fiance and I wanted something intimate for just the two of us.  From the time we booked online to our wedding day everyone at the Lucky Little Chapel did a great job.  Henry, our minister, made our ceremony personal and memorable.  This day was a long time coming and we couldn't have picked a better place.  The only thing we were not too impressed by was our photographer.  While the posed photos were good, the photographer seemed to have difficulties capturing the candid photos during the ceremony.

Overall, a wonderful place to have your wedding.  You won't be disappointed!

I can't say enough great things about this Chapel, everyone was just so AMAZING. My special day was so perfect thanks to everyone here for going Above & Beyond for me. Special thanks to Esmeralda for everything she did & making sure everything was PERFECT. Christian the photographer was so sweet, out pictures came out lovely, I was so nervous at one point and then she started talking to me and helped calm my nerves. Minister Belinda also was wonderful, such touching words, ceremony was beautiful. I can go on & on but you get the point, so happy with everyone who made this day for me so perfect. Thank you ALL so so much!

Friendly, thoughtful, accommodating staff. Clean, well lit, tasteful, modern space. 
Can't wait to see our pics. Great props and poses. 
Transparent pricing with no hidden fees.
Convenient parking right next door. 
Very happy with the experience.

Ok, in full disclosure, I have not read any of the reviews for this chapel or any other chapel in Vegas.  I'm sharing a participating dude perspective and I was not responsible for booking our Vegas wedding, she was.  (I was busy booking last minute airfare, hotel, buying a ring, etc).  

However, listen up guys if you want your gal to be blown away impressed and happy as hell. 

TIP:  I'll start with a pointer on getting your marriage license to save you circling stress!  You need to be on the SW corner of Clark and 3rd street, that's where the entrance is for license place. There is parking on 3rd (pay parking at a machine and takes cc's) between Clark and Lewis along with a parking garage. Fill out your ppw ahead of time. We went on a Sat around 1:15 and were out in 30 mins. 

Next, this chapel is around the corner from marriage license bureau so leave a bread crumb trail back to your hotel, or get the limo package and make it easy.  Next order her a bouquet from their florist, they did an amazing job and she was blown away.  To me it looked like flowers but hey, it's really her day right?  I get it, most people who elope and or get married in Vegas have a budget, but throw down a couple of bucks and get her flowers she can take with her. The compliments we received heading to dinner and in hotel made her feel extra special - which guys in turn leads to you being handled extra special right guys?

Everyone there was friendly, helpful, and absolutely down right awesome. The minister and even the photography crew rock. I know she also used their recommended stylist and she did an amazing job making her look great on the day (don't tell the Mrs this, but it's the best I've seen her look in eons!). I'll have to find out her name because she worth it for hair and makeup. 

From what I did inquire about the event and booking, they run you thru all the options, you pick, and they set it all up.  Boom, easy peasy and takes the stress out of a stressful moment.  It was so seamless and went off without a hitch. The photographer Bryne (Brian as its pronounced) rocked. Cool guy, took some amazing shots and I can tell you I got a face for radio, not TV!  Cameras and I dont get along and he did an amazing job. We over bought on the photo package but couldn't help it, he actually made this ugly mug look good.  

Net, net, I'm sure there are plenty of places who can get you two hitched, but if you're reading this then you are like me (us now).  You want to hear from someone else who used them and how it went. You want that recommendation and endorsement that something went perfectly and I must say, this was the highlight of my trip too.  Use em guys, make your life easier and happier!  Good luck on your future weddings all!

* Disclosure - I had originally booked this chapel for my wedding but had to cancel due to the size of my guest list growing beyond what their space could handle.  However, I did visit the chapel in person and interacted with the staff.  This review is based on my interactions and visit.  I am a little sad we couldn't stay with this venue.  Size was the ONLY issue.

What a wonderful small chapel with a warm staff, great photography, and fantastic specials.  I originally booked the $77.00 Happy Hour Special.  A fantastic deal (minister and photographer tip separate).  This chapel also offers live internet feed of your ceremony; they provide you a link a week prior to the ceremony, which is password protected.   It is a small space.  We originally had 15-20 guest on our list, but it grew much larger.  Space could easily handle our original guest number.  The guest seating is in chairs, which is much more comfortable than tiny pews.

The space is small (most all of the wedding chapels in LV are very small) but elegant, with a very clean and modern design.  The lighting is phenomenal.  Easily one of the cleanest chapels I've visited.  Air conditioning worked great as well.  Believe it or not, this is an issue with other places.

Very conveniently located near the marriage license office at the courthouse in an unassuming office building.   If I had any issue, it would have been the parking.   Street parking and parking garage parking with fee for both only, which would have been a major issue for my guests.  

Pros: 
Clean 
Fantastic pricing
Very caring pro-customer service staff
Timely and friendly communication
Great lighting and photography
Convenient location to courthouse and downtown activities
Modern and clean design inside
Chair seating 

Cons:
Parking could be an issue if you have more than a few guests

Highly recommend for smaller weddings.  I wish this chapel and staff continued success and would definitely use them for a smaller wedding or vow renewal.

My husband and I just renewed our vows at Lucky Little Chapel Container Park. We didn't really know how to plan or even what we needed to do. The people working there went above and beyond. Helping us choose the right package. Making it truly a memorable experience!!!! Our photos are amazing!!! So happy we chose Lucky Little Chapel!

This place was seriously absolutely perfect for what my new wife and I had in mind for our Vegas wedding. It was not tacky like so many of the other chapels, the photographer which my wife was extremely cautious about, he did a wonderful job, the staff was very courteous and Ivan, our wedding officiator was very pleasant! Couldn't have been happier!

Attended a wedding here a couple of weeks ago at the Container Park location. The couple purchased the $149 package, which included a bouquet, boutonnière, and 15 professional photos. The bouquet/boutonnière were fresh, lovely roses and tastefully done! Pastor Sneed, who officiated the ceremony, was sincere and gave heartfelt advice to the newlywed couple. The actual ceremony space was clean, smelled pleasant, and designed really well and modern! The entire ceremony took approximately 10 minutes and as a courtesy, allowed the couple to choose their own wedding music to play in the background.

The photographer, Christine, was very professional; the photos turned out great! Be sure to tip the Pastor and the photographer...for the price, you cannot go wrong!

My now husband and I decided to elope a year early (May 13, 2016) before our planned wedding since we wanted something just for ourselves. Both originally from Vegas, we knew of where some chapels were but we took to yelp for reviews. We found Lucky Little Chapel on Yelp,went to  the website, booked our date and time online (Which was so easy!) There are add ons if you need to rent a dress or tux, civil or religious ceremonies and a section if you wanted to add something of your own. (We did our own vows; so we wrote that in). We did the Happy Hour Special, which was 77$ with 7 Photos. Great deal compared to other locations on the strip. We then got a phone call and text confirmation about it being reserved  and what we needed before the ceremony which I thought was nice. We were so scared of the location because we just booked online and was hoping the photos we saw from other reviewers did enough justice for us. The outside location wasn't that pleasant, but it was being shared with other business'...When we went there was a sewer smell which made me so nervous because I get sick quickly off smells...but inside the "chapel/rental" part they had fragrance to hide the odor. (it did a very good job of hiding it.)  They had Amazing Staff, Minister and Photographer. Everyone was so cordial and pleasant. It went by very quick, but it was worth it. Our minister was fully engaged with us and made us feel warm with the  words he said. Our Photographer put up with our silly poses and took great photos. We also received the photos that evening by email. Another photographer even helped my husband tie his tie. (THANK YOU) The Chapel was small but ohhh so cute. The wood floors were beautiful and the back wall was pretty. All in all minus the smell, I would recommend Lucky Little Chapel if you want a small, quiet, vegas wedding.

The chapel is beautiful and the staff was totally accommodating and did everything to make the ceremony special.  We didn't have family or friends with us and our grown kids secretly emailed pictures to them to place on the chairs as a surprise to us to show they were there in thought.  We were so surprised when we saw all their faces on the chairs after we walked down the aisle! Everyone there was great to work with and they have my complete recommendation.

Don't be off-put by the office building exterior or the bail bonds office next door....it just adds to the Vegas wedding story....the lovely chapel, touching ceremony and excellent customer service is what will make it special.

Wow. Just wow. This business is customer-oriented, efficient, responsive, and devoted to giving the happy couple the exact experience they want. I couldn't say enough great things. Candace was my coordinator and got me everything I wanted. She communicated with me throughout the entire process, since I live in Texas and was planning from afar. I have never gone through this process before and she was a rockstar. She literally let me know everything to expect, and talked me off a ledge when I lost all of my post-wedding paperwork. The owner called me herself when rain threatened to ruin my outdoor wedding and discussed alternative options and even offered to let me do my photos the next day when the weather would be better. Of course it poured down rain and the entire container park lost power right before my ceremony, but the indoor chapel was beautifully decorated and lit with candles and the lights came back on as soon as I started walking down the aisle. Henry was our officiant and was so well-spoken and smooth, never sounding as though he were reading off some speech he'd given a million times. Jed was the photographer and gave me tons of beautiful, quality photos right on the spot. Y'all made me and my husband's day so incredible and we couldn't thank you enough! Highly recommend!!

Initially, I was supposed to be married at the courthouse bc the husband and I wanted an easy and quick ceremony. Being married under that fake flower arch with that calendar in the background kept bothering me so I kept searching for other options. 

While searching online for other options, I ran across an article about being married at the Downtown Container Park and I was immediately drawn in. We drove down to the location and found their chapel on the third floor and booked our ceremony on the spot.

The ceremony itself was beautiful. Being married outside in the slides was fun, easy, and memorable. Our photographer Michael did an amazing job and we received our pics pretty quickly and were so impressed with them so we ordered 30 more. Our pastor did an amazing job marrying us and made everything perfect. 

This was truly the best day of my life and I have the Little Lucky Chapel to thank. You guys did an amazing job!!!!

Great experience from the first call to reserve the date to the limo ride back to the hotel 
Belinda the minister said heartfelt words 
The photos were great and the video is a fun keepsake to show family back home.
So glad we purchased the lucky in love package,it's a good package for the price 
Thank you all for making my ceremony lovely

On 7/11/2015 we got married here and it was an amazing wedding! The staff were courteous and friendly. The ceremony was preformed by Ivan Rubio and he was great! His words were different and so meaningful. Our photos were taken by a young man named Noah and they were beautiful! I can't say enough good things about this place. I searched for months when my sister came across this chapel and it fit our needs perfectly! Thank you so much for a day we will all cherish and remember!

After much research I found this gem. My husband and I did not want a tacky Las Vegas wedding. We wanted pictures from a classy looking ceremony and along the strip, because it is vegas after all. What we got was much more than I could have hoped for. The place is beautiful, but very small. It consist of a wall made of some sort of rock and they have beautiful chairs (not the flimsy folding ones you often see nor the uncomfortable pews some places have). They also have an array of props for pictures. Our driver was prompt, professional and friendly and even went out of his way to return my cellphone  after i left it in his car .  I can not say enough good things about Mike our photographer. He was fun, professional, and easy to work with. I picked this place due largly to the beautiful photos i seen online. Mike did not dissapoint. Truly amazing photos. We got married on a Tuesday our license was ready to pick up on Thursday and we had our wedding photos all 100+ by Friday! In comparision to a lot of other chapels in vegas this is by far the best deal. Similar package at one of their competitors would have cost me nearly double what Luckily Little Chapel did. The only thing that was not above expectation was the officiant. Perhaps she was having a bad day, but she was not warm or friendly like the others working there. She did speak beautiful words at our ceremony. Which is the most important thing, but it would have been nice to have someone a bit more pleasant and i wish i tipped her at the end so i could have tipped accordingly. 
Words escape me for describing how truly greatful I am to have found the Lucky Little Chapel.

I surprised my husband with a renewal  ceremony on his birthday of March 13, 2016.  I set the appointment online.  Everything  was taken care of in advance.  The Chapel was beautiful, the officiant made us feel at ease and the photographer was great.  All the staff are professional, friendly and went out of their way to make this day special.  No hidden fees, very easy to find, and great parking.

Exactly as i hoped getting married in vegas would turn out, from beginning to end. When i called to book a time and date, i knew what i wanted to that was quick call. When we got to the chapel 15 min prior to our booked time. We checked in and were asked i wanted flowers. I chose to not buy them as i thought they were a little expensive. We then waited for the minister to come talk to us about last minute details. Ivan our minister was very friendly and explained everything to us so we were all on the same page. 

Our turn came to go into the chapel and get married. Minister Ivan was great, the whole ceremony was quick and simple yet memorable.

 The chapel was beautiful, which is why i chose Lucky Little Chapel vs other chapels on the Strip. If you want a stress free, easy quick wedding with great photography, then this is the only place to go.

What can I say, this chapel is well worth it, I was running late, went to the wrong chapel and held them up. They were so nice and patient with us. The staff are great to deal with, and the minister performed the ceremony beautifully.the photographer takes great pictures, which we loved.  Thanks to all the staff, you made my vowel renewal of 20 years just as memorable as my wedding day.

We have to send a HUGE Thank You to Lucky Little Chapel. This place is AMAZING!!!! We called one week prior and had absolutely no clue what needed to get done, as everything was so last minute. The staff was very informative. We were told we had to go down the block to obtain our marriage license prior to the ceremony. When we got to the chapel I was impressed with the setup. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. We had over 40 people and they were able to get them all seated. 

I have attended many wedding, however I have to say the minister was great!! We did not have wedding vows prepared but that was ok because her words were so unique and memorable. The photographer was accommodating and did a fabulous job as well. We were able to obtain pictures that included everyone in my party. 

As we all know, Vegas is highly unique and has so many options in regards to wedding chapels. All we have to say is if you are shopping around for something affordable, reliable, professional, clean and simply AMAZING, this is your place. 

Thank you so much Lucky Chapel Staff for making our day a memorable one!!!!

Regards,

Iker and Nova Rementeria

We were absolutely satisfied with the services. Everyone at the chapel was easy to talk to. We had the happy hour wedding and it was incredible. Simple and solemn ceremony. The whole vibe didn't  feel tacky at all!

I just went to a wedding for my cousin this last week. This last minute elopement made me assume that this chapel would be old and run down.  Over all the customer service here was great. The space was very clean, and the ceremony was made special an intimate because of the clergy marrying them.  I think that was the most important element of their wedding and what makes this place a good chapel in vegas. It's rare to find someone who doesn't treat the bride and groom like its a factory and they are reading from a script. This man was heart felt and warm. This location is quick and easy in proximity to where you purchase your marriage license as well.  Though the space is in an office building complex they're particular space is nice and light, and they are efficient and thorough in making sure you have everything you need.

While looking for places to get married, i was looking for a place that was fun and stumbled upon the Container Park location. Saw the pictures that people had done inside the container and was sold. 

I made our reservations a month in advance for 11:30 am on a Monday and selected the custom bouquet and boutonnière. I was in contact a couple times with various people (Rachel, Christian and Noah). Originally spoke with Rachel about the time and location and she was great! She was enthusiastic and super helpful in answering my questions. I spoke to Christian a couple weeks later about my bouquet, she seemed very unsure of what she was doing and not very happy. A couple days before we left for Vegas, I called about my bouquet because I wanted to make sure they were able to get all the flowers, that's when I spoke with Noah. He confirmed flower type and colors with me, he called the florist, and gave me a call back. He said they were able to get all of them, and I was excited.  

The day came and the only thing that was on time or correct was the limo driver. We got to Container Park about 10 minutes prior to the 11:30am time we chose. Noah welcomed us then sent our driver to go pick up our flowers from the downtown location. He returned after 11:30, and I was very surprised and shocked at my bouquet because it wasn't what I had asked for. The flowers seemed fresh and they were completely wet, but the colors weren't as they were supposed to be. When I spoke to Christian originally, I gave them another color combination incase they couldn't get all of them for the original picture I sent. 

Our officiant didn't show up until around 11:50 am, asked us a couple questions and that was it. She could have asked for the donation then because we were still waiting for the photographer to show up, instead she awkwardly gave it to us inform of our family at the end of the ceremony. The photographer finally showed up sometime after 12pm. 

The whole time we were waiting, our family was getting antsy, and Noah was sitting there aloof not really making small talk or checking on why everything was running late. I had asked Noah about taking pictures in the Container and he said of course they could do it. When I asked the photographer at the end, he said "well with your mini package we stay in the chapel but I guess, yeah.' 

In the end, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Maybe everyone celebrated a little too much the previous Sunday (June 4), but they are in the business of helping people in their special day and I feel like they did not accomplish that at all.

great people! thank you Mr. Jeffery Barton for personalizing little details in the service (you got to know some important info about us ... like that we had been together 7 years) from a few smart questions before we started. the photographer had great photo ideas ready to try. before the wedding, they respond promptly to emails and they had everything setup (like our special song)... I didn't have to worry about anything. all fees were upfront (nothing hidden) and were very reasonable. the little chapel was the perfect size and oh sooo pretty (and a very cool location).

We were on vacation in Vegas and decided last minute to get married so we found this chapel online.  Since It was a last minute thing so we didn't really have a lot of time to prepare and kind of rushed it. Its a beautiful little room that you get married in.  We were very surprised at how classy and elegant it was.  We got married on a Tuesday so we received the Happy Hour Special of $77 plus the  minster fee of $50. The minister we used was very pleasant and took time to talk to us before the ceremony to make sure he knew what we wanted.  The photographer looked like he was 15 years old but once it became time to take the pics we were all impressed by his professionalism and how he carried himself and the pictures we received were fantastic!  Its a beautiful place with friendly employees and great customer service!

We initially chose the location near the courthouse.  However, after we took a look at the Container Park location, we immediately decided that was a better option. 

When we entered the Office at the Container Park, the staff member took care of everything necessary to transfer our ceremony.  She took the time to explain everything to us. 

When we arrived for the wedding, our photographer, Christian, was there to greet us.  She also walked us through the ceremony.  We took a couple of snap shots out front before the pastor arrived.   

Our pastor was fantastic.  What I thought was to be a quick, "Do you?  Do you?" ceremony turned out to be a very heartfelt ceremony.  Within moments, it felt like we had known him for years.  His tone and his demeanor were absolutely perfect for us.  

Afterwards, we took a few more photos around the Container Park.  Christian did a great job capturing our personalities.   

Our package included 15 photos.  We were asked to select the ones we liked best.  Because we selected more than 15, there was an increase in price.  But still less than we would have paid for a traditional wedding photographer.  

We are very happy with our ceremony.  We highly recommend the Lucky Little Chapel in Container Park.

I've been to a number of weddings in Las Vegas, but I've got to say that this chapel has a vibe that makes you feel like it will last a lifetime! Wonderful staff, rates, and most positive feng shui! I'd recommend this chapel to anyone ready to get hitched.
We had an amazing experience!!! Roseanne was the best!!! We got married on our 3 yr anniversary and they made sure it was perfect with everything we wanted!

There were soooo many chapels to chose from especially in Vegas and thank goodness we went with Lucky Little Chapel in Container Park!! I booked online without ever viewing the property but we went about 2 weeks before the weding to check it out and it was all so pretty and especially what we were looking for. The staff was all sooo helpful and didnt make me feel like i was a bother for some of my requests that i thought i just needed to have. The minister was so AWESOME she knew exactly what to tell me to help calm my nerves right before i walked down the isle. I would like to also say that all i told them about my bouquet was what colors i wanted and it was stunning!! And our photographer Noah was OUTSTANDING!! My day was perfect and it wouldnt have been without this amazing staff!!

Less than a week ago my husband and I got married here and we had a great experience. It's a very clean, bright and cute place and and great staff!
Here are some details, that might be helpful:
My husband and I were quite unorganized and thought that we can do the paperwork in a few days after the ceremony- we were wrong. You have to get a marriage license before the ceremony, otherwise you won't be able to get married. So we got there at 9.45pm on July 4th, and found out that we have to go to the court house to get the license in the license bureau, that's two blocks away from the chapel and open till late! To get the license you need a valid ID and SSN. Then we got back and the pastor asked us some questions about the type of ceremony we want, music and other stuff that I can't remember already.
Everybody was super nice and helpful, nobody rushed us and staff stayed a half an hour pass their closing time - love, love, love this place!

This was our first visit to Las Vegas, so I can't speak to the other chapels' quality, but we had just the wedding we wanted at the Lucky Little Chapel.  We visited the day before our wedding right after we got our marriage license, and the staff was very nice about showing us where our wedding would be beforehand.  Reverend Belinda gave us a short and sweet - but meaningful - ceremony just like we asked for.  The chapel itself is beautiful, and while not suited for a large number of guests, was perfect for our needs as we only had  four guests.  We got the $77 special that came with a rose and 7 pictures, and our guests took plenty of pics of their own.  I would absolutely recommend this chapel for any small wedding or vow renewal.  Would go back here to renew our vows in a heartbeat, and we just might one day.  Efficient, reasonably priced and excellent service!

My mom and dad wanted to renew their wedding vows for their 50th anniversary while we were in Vegas.  We decided on this lovely place at Container Park!  They did a great job. There was a little glitch with the bouquet, my mom didnt notice, but we did and they couldnt have been nicer about it, and apologized and made it right.
The staff was absolutely wonderful.  I think the photographer had a lot of fun taking the pictures, which by the way were really good.   Thank you thank you thank you!  - Sorry it took so long to post this review.

We wanted to renew our vows while visiting Las Vegas. We had no reservation for any chapel, we wanted to have a nice and warm (and affordable prices) ceremony. 

We found a flyer about Lucky Little Chapel with a promotion of a wedding cervice for $77. IT included the ceremony in the chapel, a rose, wedding music and 7 photos of us. We decided to try our luck and went to the chapel without reservation. We were immediately served by a super nice minister and we did the renewal right away. The service was very nice and the minister's speech was beautiful. 

After vow renewal we were photographed. We'll get the photos in 48 hours. 

Definitely worth $77!! We also tipped the minister for $50 ($40-$100 recommended) and gave a few dollars to the photographer.

My fiance and I got legally married here tonight, after having a ceremony in Mexico last week. We bought the $77 special, and everything was perfect. The venue was easy to find and  condensing located. It was clean and cute. The staff was nice, and the photographer was amazing. We had a link for our photos before we even finished driving home! We brought our dog, and they were very welcoming and got great pictures of him. I regretfully didn't get the minister's name, but she was very good and did a beautiful, short ceremony that she let us customize since we'd already had a full ceremony. We didn't rent or buy any clothes, flowers, accessories, etc. but it looked like they had a great selection. I'd recommend this place to anyone. We were blown away by how efficient they were and how nice it was.

I got married here on October 15, 2016. All I can say is excellent customer service. I got the highest package they offered. They treated me like a princess. When I  went to get fitted for my dress, which I was very nervous about, Roseanne put me at ease when she helped me pick out the perfect dress for me!! After my fitting I had to go to the container park location where I was having my wedding. They provided me with transportation there, I initially planned to ride the bus, and waited for me to finish my business and gave me a ride back to my hotel on the strip. My wedding was absolutely gorgeous. They accommodated  me in everyway. They added extra decorations to their already beautiful chapel to help match my color scheme. The pastor they provided was very personable and did a great job. The photographer took lots of pictures and we were able to keep all the pictures that were taken. Overall I had an awesome experience and the staff there helped make my day extra special. I would definitely recommend this chapel to anyone looking to get married in Vegas.

It's almost five months since we married at the Lucky Little Chapel and we're still talking about the great service and all around good time we had! Rosanne was so helpful and patient. We got lost and she was lovely reminding me we were all good and not to worry. I feel so good about the decision we made to get married here. My parents were so happy with the service by the officiant. The photographer even held our iPad as we skyped my husband's daughter and son-in-law! Love the photos and more than that the great memories we have to share! Thank you Lucky Little Chapel for setting us off on our marriage adventure! Alice T.

FINAL UPDATE**
After meeting with the owners I am feeling very satisfied with the outcome of our experience, there pleasant demeanor and understanding of my issue made and impact, they took out a large chunk of their time to make my family feel important,  which I feel in a business as this, is incredible, people in general aren't always as kind and I would definitely recommend them to another couple in a heat beat. Let me also reiterate that the experience at this chapel was never disastrous or unpleasant simply one important aspect went astray , they worked with us on this issue and we are more than happy. Thank you so much Luck Little Chapel, we will see you for our vow renewal in 10 years 





UPDATE

I was pleasantly surprised today when I received a telephone call from the owner asking for more in depth details of my experience. He listened and did not argue or attempt to prove wrong my issue. In most cases when you've had a bad experience at a business, you usually tend to accept a loss and have no other choice but to move on. Let's make clear that I was not looking for any refunds or hand outs or anything of the sort, however after we spoke he offered an additional service to my family and I that, although does not turn back time and restore that day, is still generous and beneficial to us as a unit. A responsible and warm hearted owner he seemed to be, which makes me feel that much better about our experience. I'm very confident that my next update will be a positive one. 


**Original**
So yesterday we were married at this chapel and I wasn't at all disappointed with the minister or the coordinator... however, our pics came out terribly, I paid an extra $125 to receive extra photographs and the video and they were so bad, however if I didn't purchase the extra I wouldn't have gotten photos of all my guests and etc.  This really breaks my heart because I cannot replay this moment and retake those photos of my wedding day. The photographer shot from terrible angles, and most of our photographs were ruined by sun glare and she did not at all get any good photos of my father and I walking down the aisle or any good breakdowns... she was so timid with my large group and gave no kind of direction. Easily she could've said "father and mother of the bride" , "father and mother of the groom" and so and so forth, that did not happen, this is something I asked for before hand. And then there's the video.... much like the photographs they were shot from underneath our heads facing upward so all you can see is my double chin and parts of the end of the backdrop, let's keep in mind I am pregnant so there isn't much running away from that, but the angles could've and should've been much more flattering. I am so incredibly disappointed... this is time and money that cannot be replaced, an extremely special moment for us and I cannot believe it turned out the way it did. The photographer was honestly polite, it's not as though she changed our experience through attitude it was simply her work that was terrible. The coordinator was very nice and the minister did her job as well.

I love this wedding venue!! The Lucky Little Chapel is a super beautiful wedding chapel right near the courthouse in Las Vegas. The staff was so friendly--they seemed really into giving their clients a beautiful wedding experience!! I live in Las Vegas and like to stay on top of good places to refer to frequent guests. I am recommending the Lucky Little Chapel to all my friends who want a Las Vegas destination wedding or vow renewal that is romantic, beautiful and reasonably priced.

My husband and I got married at The Container Park on Fremont street. I was planning a destination wedding and the Lucky Little Chapel employees were very helpful and professional. Honestly, the chapel was modern and really nice! I think this is one of the best chapels in Vegas. 


    The ceremony was short and sweet ($99); and I loved my wedding bouquet which I custom ordered from them ($85 extra). Our photographer was great! She took lots of awesome and funny pictures, making it hard for us to choose just a few (8 included but we chose 17 more than that ($85 extra). We had the chance to pick the photos right after the ceremony but we hired our own photographer for pics on the strip and had to go. We returned the next day and picked out the pics (sent via Dropbox link) The minister was excellent and had some great words of advice. He was friendly and kind and asked us if we wanted religious words or not. 

    Highly recommend this chapel compared to old and dated chapels all over the city.

I am highly impressed with this beautiful and modern chapel that oozes elegance. You can feel the warmth and charm as soon as you walk in. The staff is friendly and the minister gave a heartfelt ceremony. The value is well worth the affordable wedding packages. Definitely the best deal in town if you are looking for a great Vegas wedding experience.

My wife and I just got married here on Friday, 3/17. The entire experience, from booking to planning, to the day of the ceremony, was simply fantastic. Every person we spoke to was cordial, and extremely helpful. The florist did a special request bouquet of sunflowers and roses that was beyond beautiful. The container park location is stunning and extremely unique. Our photographer did an amazing job of capturing our memories. Pastor Henry's ceremony spoke to us and left us with a memorable experience. We highly recommend this location if planning a Vegas wedding.

I was nervous about getting married in Las Vegas but I'm glad we did. We both loved the chapel and the service. Everyone was so sweet and the ceremony itself was wonderful. We will be back in some years to renew our vows.

Thank you Lucky Little Chapel for creating such a beautiful memory for us! 
The staff was so helpful and professional, answering all the questions I had. Monday afternoon I called this chapel to get information regarding their packages & less then 12 hours later my husband and I were there! 
We came in to renew our wedding vows and as soon as we walked in we were so impressed. Originally, the thought of coming into Vegas to renew our vows seemed a little silly, but the genuine spirit of everyone here and the unique-beauty hidden in this cute little chapel was so sincere and sweet that I would definitely recommend this chapel to everyone and anyone looking for a Vegas chapel. 
The minister was great! He took time before our ceremony to get to know us, asked us questions about our background and what ceremony type we'd like. He did such a good job making it personalized for us, even included our children's names in his prayer. (Completely worth MORE then the minimum $50 donation) 
We weren't rushed either. After the ceremony the photographer came in and took great photos, she had lots of cute props to make the experience fun and posed us in a bunch of different ways. (Don't forget to tip your photographer too!!!!) 
Overall- The whole experience was so impressive and surpassed our expectations! If you're reading this review in search for a chapel - don't keep looking, just give them a call!

The people who run this chapel are amazing! I got married here a few hours ago. I am very pleased on how everything turned out. I found this wonderful place via Yelp. So since it has great reviews, we figured it would be a good idea to stop by (btw, this place is around the corner from the marriage licence bureau. Not a bad walk ). The staff is very knowledgeable and kind. Pastor Ivan Rubio did a wonderful job with officiating our wedding. Overall, I'm pleased and recommend this chapel.

We were just married here (at the Casino Center location) on 5/14/17. The staff was great and took care of everything. Our minister, Rene, was wonderful and we had the best Elvis around! Our wedding was a total blast-just what we wanted-all without the stress of having to plan a big shindig. Our pictures turned out beautifully and we couldn't be happier with our experience. This is a great place to get married!

My now husband and I had a wedding planned for another date and location in Southern California, but we decided to elope on a Thursday and I went into panic mode. I found an ad for Lucky Little Chapel online offering a "free wedding", I called and left a message, within about a half an hour Rachel called me back and eased my hesitation about the advertised promotion, she told me they had just opened and were offering to marry couples for "free" to work out the kinks, all we need to do was make a donation to the minister. After talking it over with my then fiance, we made an appointment for Sunday at 1pm, we had three days to make this happen.  I had several phone calls with Rachel and every time she was awesome, she accommodated us in every way possible. 

We were married that  Sunday in the most intimate ceremony between just the two of us, our ceremony was above and beyond our expectations. We are over the moon with the service we received and the memories will last a lifetime. Rachel was not only the witness, but the photographer and provided us with high quality pictures that we shared with our family and friends. The minister was very accommodating with our requests for the ceremony and he personalized it as well. 

If you are looking into getting married in Las Vegas, we recommend Lucky Little Chapel!! You will have the best service and feel like royalty from the minute you walk in until you leave married, I promise you!! 

Thank you Rachel and Henry for your attention to detail and your genuine service. 

Kevin and Kalar

It is as advertised!  No frills, beautiful little chapel room set in a little strip of stores, next to a bail bonds place.  It was amazing how Pastor Belinda conducted the ceremony and her words were incredibly heartfelt and sincere.  Looking back, I may should have bought the DVD of the ceremony...The photographer was very good and we were very happy with the pictures that were taken.  My bride and I were happy that we didn't just do the Justice of the Peace in Colorado and opted for this Vegas adventure.
They cater to everything you need- and they are so nice! The pictures came out beautiful and I couldn't have asked for a more beautiful wedding.

Please read the pros and cons while making your decision. Let's start on some positive notes!

I went to their Container Park location. A year ago (well before I popped the question) my mother and I stumbled across this wedding chapel tucked away in Container Park off of Freemont Street and I absolutely fell in love with it!!! It's small, but beautiful. The office & chapel are housed in shipping containers which is something you have to see to believe! When I saw this chapel I turned to my mother and exclaimed this is the place I've always dreamed of! My mother coaxed me into checking prices and asking further into it, because I knew it would probably be out of my budget when the time was right, but it wasn't!!!!

They have packages for all types of budgets starting at $99. The place isn't over the top like you might expect for Vegas, it's very well put together.

When visiting in person and speaking with them they were very nice and LGBT friendly. I never felt any type of judgement or hesitation. We even were running late because of the public transportation they were still nice and understanding!

They have a "happy hour" rate that is advertised, but it's not for this location. I paid the extra because I thought this location was worth it.

I forget the officiant's name, but he was amazing. Asked us a couple of questions before hand so he could make sure it was how we wanted and guided us on what to expect. I would give him 5 stars if I could!!! Even though we were complete strangers he made me feel like he truly cared about me and that he was about to be part of a huge life altering event for me! (the tip for the officiant isn't included so please make sure to have cash for a tip. They told us $50 when we called before we got there was the suggested tip, he provided us an envelope that read $50-$100 was suggested. Please make sure you tip this is standard practice in any state and any chapel).

Now... my cons!

We didn't plan on getting married until this upcoming fall, but life happens and plans change. Due to this you can probably imagine we were on a budget for our wedding/honeymoon  and had to make lots of compromises. Part of those compromises is that not all of our loved ones could come. We only got to have my mother and her best friend (plus his family of 3) there with us.  This means wedding photos were highly important to us.

I asked both in person and while booking if we could take photos there. The answer was yes, but not during the actual ceremony unless I purchased a media package (which I couldn't afford and thought I wouldn't need since they had a photographer on staff). My guests were told that they couldn't take pictures at all, even after the ceremony. When I found out I questioned this and was told yes, we could take some photos while the photographer stepped out if we hurried. This seems like misleading information to get me to their chapel so I wasn't too happy with the conflicting policies that were relayed to my guests and I.

I would have still given this chapel 5 stars if it wasn't for the photographer. The photographer was absolutely HORRIBLE!!! My package came with 7 photos and I had to go through the entire list of pictures twice to even get 7 that I half way liked. Most were blurry, out of focus, bad angles, or very unflattering. The room was setup to hold 20-25ish guests and we only had 5 in attendance. He could have moved anywhere in the room to get a good angle, looked through the lense before we started to tell my fiancé that her hair would be over her face and suggested we switch places, or posed us after like we were standing up there in the ceremony, but at a better angle, but didn't. 

As a child of a photographer I know,  if you take photos in a wedding chapel for a living you should know what settings to use with the lighting to be able to get all three parties in focus during the ceremony. You should take multiple photos of the same pose incase people blink or you are out of focus, most of our facial expressions were off. Basically... I hope you're not counting on taking them home to your mother-in-law because she will be highly disappointed like mine is. I feel like my loved ones missed seeing my wedding because of this. It was a beautiful wedding and I don't regret my choice because I'll cherish the memory always, but I won't have amazing photos to show for it.

They did offer to rectify the situation AFTER I expressed my disappointment, which shows me he normally provides the same quality of work to everyone. We didn't have time to take them up on their offer and at this point I was upset and wouldn't have been able to fake smile my way through more photos with him.

On 7/27/2015 my sister and her fiancé got married at this beautiful chapel and me and my husband were witnesses. This place is very clean, bright and welcoming. Great experience, very professional and nice staff and really affordable packages. $77 package included the ceremony, a rose and 7 pictures that they email you later. They came out great. Really wonderful experience. In one word "AMAZING " 
Thank you LUCKY LITTLE CHAPEL !!!

Been a fan for a long time but never been spoken to so rudely like I was tonight by the receptionist. The other reviewers were not exaggerating. Couldn't even finish my order. I doubt I'll be back after this.

The food was good here. Hot and fresh. Prices were good too. That being said the crab ragoons were empty. The place is clean also. The staff as with most little Chinese places is not the friendliest people. But I would defiantly recommend this place.

Clean - it was clean (smelled like cleaning products) got bourbon chicken and fried rice - chicken was not bourbon chicken and the fried rice had no egg or anything else in it and was hard.  Cheap and clean is all I can say...
Very good Chinese and fast! Tastes fresh and not like mall Chinese food. Lunch specials with tea for around $5.

I've loved the food from here for years but the staff is horrible and now the food quality has started to decline. The lady who is always working at the front is extremely rude and unprofessional, she will cop an attitude over everything. She named it off and it was wrong, so I said "oh no that's not what I ordered" she then ARGUED with me about it, and got mad at ME because SHE messed up my order. I told her not to worry about it and paid anyway but I will not be going back. Her personality explains why there is no one ever there, I don't know how they stay in business.

Mediocre Chinese. 

But it's cheap, quick and right by my house. Plus, they stay open late. 

House special lo mien isn't bad. Neither is the General Tsao chicken.

I've been wanting shutters for a very long time so when it was time to take the plunge, I knew the exact company I wanted to go with.  Everything couldn't have gone any smoother. Overall a well deserved five star rating!
I bought our shutters 18 yrs ago and they look as great as the day I bought them. I just sold that house and I can't wait to get them in my new home in St George , Utah !!

We'd like to thank Eric Acridge of Sunburst Shutters for his outstanding performance of installing our shutters today.  We are beyond pleased with the product and with his work. When our house was built eight years ago, the owners had Sunburst install the shutters. We bought the house six years ago and the shutters have worked beautifully until one pulled apart. If I ever need any new shutters or service, I will go to Sunburst.
Great Company! Professional and installed the shutters in a timely matter. Pricier than other places but worth it. I went based on yelp reviews and they did not let me down. I recommend them !!

We've always bought our shutters from Sunburst and they are a great company to work with. We paid $6,000 for our entire house of shutters and it was worth it.

I dealt with Paul for my consultation and ordering. He's great. I've known for a while that if I needed shutters, that I would go with Sunburst. I just needed to find a house to buy first. 

We visited the showroom, and one of the girls explained all of our options so that we knew exactly what we were going to want. She explained frames, louvers, textures, opening styles, and wrote all of our choices down so we could present them to our sales person when we did finally buy a house. 

When we knew the exact day we would get our keys, I scheduled Paul to come out the day after. We were probably his easiest sale ever. We handed him the specs we wanted, and pointed out which windows we wanted measured. He never even had to pull out a sample. He was quick with his measurements, and told us about what swings would look best for each window. 

Later that afternoon, as I was telling my wife which windows I ordered, the afternoon sun hit our eyes from a window that we didn't order. I called Paul and he set another time to measure that window, but promised that the others would be in production. 

The installers were great. Very minimal dust and trash left behind. There was a problem with two windows "creeping" closed when you open them. It was an issue with being out of plumb. Also, one sunburst (half round), was the wrong size. There was an existing sunburst that we didn't remove, and the other company measured differently than sunburst did. Not a big problem, and Sunburst reordered it. When they came to install the replacement sunburst, the installer corrected the "ghost shutters" that were moving on their own too. 

All in all, a great product and customer service. Angela, the scheduler was awesome as well. I probably talked with her the most, as I had to reschedule a couple of times, and she did so much to accommodate our schedule.

These shutters have totally transformed the look of my home.  Installers were fast and professional. Salesman and staff fair and easy to deal with. I cant recommend these enough. I went with the polywood product and they are everything I hoped for an more. Highly recommend.

Can't say enough good things about Sunburst.  Chris did a great job informing us of the price points and styles available for both shutters and blinds, which led us to choose shutters. The installers were fantastic, absolutely no problems with installation, and cleanup was impressive.  We did seven windows downstairs, plus arches over our two largest living room windows, and plan to do the rest of our upstairs windows later this year with Sunburst, of course.  They are the best!

Sunburst was an absolute delight to work with from my first call to request a quote all the way to installation. Chris came out to provide us with a quote. From my first phone call, visit to showroom, salesman Chris measuring to install, this was a great experience! I have used Sunburst for two of my homes and my sister used them as well. Perfect job everytime!  Bit expensive but you get what you pay for and they last forever.   Will use them again if I buy another home.  Never had a problem.  Love my shutters!!!!

It has been about 1 year since we have had our Sunburst Shutters through our entire home and it is one of the best purchases I have ever made! GREAT EXPERIENCE!  We LOVE our shutters.  We have remodeled our home and our Sunburst shutters were the final finishing touch that totally completed the look we desired.  Sunburst has a friendly staff that answered all of my questions when I visited their design center.  Our sales person and the installers were very respectful and not pushy at all. This is an updated review. My first experience with sunburst was less than I expected as far as customer service for scheduling went. Salesman was awesome (Chris). Dan (manager) took the time to address my concerns the first time around. Thanks Dan:)

Our shutters were installed last week and we couldn't be more pleased. We are very impressed with the professionalism and quality delivered by Sunburst Shutters. Paul was a pleasure to deal with. We feel good about our decision. Our polywood shutters look fantastic!
Great job Sunburst shutters! Wished I would of had them installed years ago. My advice, dont wait!

I wanted an alternative to blinds and decided to use Sunburst Shutters after seeing their advertisement in a mailer: and I'm so glad I did. Very happy we went with sunburst. Shutters look awesome! Highly recommend this company.

After my husband and I purchased a home, we decided to replace our vinyl blinds to wood shutter blinds. Sunburst shutter are a great team of professionals. After moving to Las Vegas, I discovered the summer sun can play havoc on furnishings while adding heat. Pretty much a flawless experience with Sunburst.  Everyone we dealt with was courteous and professional and did what they said they would do.  The fit and finish of the shutters is amazing.  We highly recommend them.

Sunburst Shutters & Window Fashions Company is simply the best in LV town for your window coverings! Hands down! From Kim to Chris 5 Stars with exemplary service. To the installment team Erik & Oliver Thank You for the pristine superior job you have done 5 Stars!!!

 From the initial estimate to the final nail, this company has been professional,  ahead of schedule, and delivered an excellent product.

I am 100% satisfied and highly recommend this product.

Get ready for the compliments. Everyone who visits can't get over how much more beautiful everything is. Friends from CA came for a visit and they decided to contact Sunburst Shutters in Los Angeles. Deal directly with Sunburst Shutters. They are the best.  And, the biggest surprise was the price. I was able to have all the 21 windows done. We are extremely pleased with our investment.

Just own it, apologize for it, make it right and do something for them for the hassle. None of which has happened with this company. I've had to call over n over and speak with everyone n get harassed and blamed for simply wanting the right product I ordered in the first place?!? Months later not done. Doing the right thing is apparently hard for some. Steer clear, buyer beware. Third and last house they'll decorate. If you must deal with anyone, try and deal with Derek directly.

Sunburst shutters are fantastic.  We had estimates from two other companies and there was no comparison to quality of sunburst and you even qualify for energy rebate.  What a difference they make not only in the appearance of our home but also in the ability to keep heat in on cold days and sun out on the recent hot weather we have been experiencing in Las Vegas.  Sunburst was not the cheapest but the quality you are receiving makes up for a few more dollars you must spend. From sales to installation we experienced absolutely no problems.  You want the best get sunburst.

We bought Hunter Douglas Architella honeycomb shades through Sunburst Shutters six years ago. Sunburst shutters gave us great service and a very good price when we made the initial purchase. What's been telling in the intervening years, however, has been Sunburst Shutters' responsiveness when we've needed work done that's covered under Hunter Douglas's warranty. Sunburst Shutters has been equally professional--quick to respond and good with the follow up--responding to problems years later (we've needed repairs on the lift mechanism on two of the nine shades). It's that kind of consistently high quality service (thank you, Darik!) that engenders customer loyalty. I highly recommend Sunburst Shutters.

Consultation service with Paul was excellent a few years back.

Installation service was OKAY - its installers did not do a thorough job in cleaning up their mess.

WARRANTY SERVICE NOW IS TERRIBLE AFTER A FEW YEARS:

05/04/2017 - The supervisor Shawn came and saw quite a few louvers of one of the shutters warped & offered to order new replacement.

06/22/2017 - Appointment was set at 8:30AM.  Technician did not arrive until 9:15AM; and he only brought 2 and a half pieces of louvers when there are a minimum of 5 louvers needed to be replaced.  The technician was told by Angie to take pictures of my warped shutters.

07/10/2017 - Received phone call from Angie of Sunburst Shutters requesting that the supervisor need to come to inspect my warped shutters & to take pictures again.  Appointment has not been set at all.  So who knows what is going to happen!!!!!!!!!

07/11/2017 - Received phone call from Darik, the General Manager, to inquire about the problem after I posted the above review with 1 star on 07/10/2017.  He offered expedited rectification and apology.

07/14/2017 - Received phone call again from Darik informing me that Sunburst would send its technician out with plenty of louvers to replace the warped ones; and no further pictures are required.  Appointment was set on 07/18/2017 between 11AM to 12 Noon.

07/18/2017 - Supervisor Shawn & Mr. Darik Nielson, the General Manager, arrived shortly after 10AM.  Replaced the warped louvers & Mr. Nielson apologized again.

I had Sunburst Shutters did all my shutters in my previous house and this second house in the Vegas valley due to its superior quality compared to other companies.

I am glad that Sunburst stands behind its product, takes care its customers and offers expedited rectification.

I absolutely love my shutters. They look beautiful and got a great price. Got the polywood. Worth the upgrade but even the regular ones look great too. Only gave 4 because the customer service was lacking during installation and not super friendly.

This updated review is long overdue. After my previous review, the management did some investigating found out it was me that left them a bad review. He called me and apologized for the experience I had and wanted to fix my problem as soon as he could.

He explained that the original guy that was suppose to come out wasn't available and it was their mistake for that. They sent Eric who was wonderful and took care of the roller situation. They even gave me some money back for the inconvenience.

Eric actually found a defect with one of the rollers and would have it replaced as soon as possible which they did.

I'm very glad Sunburst was very proactive and customer friendly driven. I thought it was fair and I hope to do some more business with them in the future.

I am completely satisfied with my shutters from Sunburst Shutters. At first I only ordered a set for my master bedroom. After they were installed, I became so impressed that I am considering having a set installed in my living room. The only downfall about their product is the steep price for window treatments, that's why I will only be doing one room at a time, other than that it's a 5 star product.

These guys are brilliant, always, and I have recommended them to others. I have been coming here for 4 or 5 years with our Toshiba laptops...an impossible virus, a system crash, and when laptops keep overheating. All fixed perfectly, and no files lost, plus, as a side benefit, these guys always improve the performance. Also, I once had a corrupted doc that the current I.T. staff at my job couldn't recover. So I went to them for this file again, they recovered it!! They are the best!

Our company had 3 laptops that would not get to the desktop screen. This company offered free diagnostics for them to come to our location which I thought it was super convenient, I had called 2 other places and they wanted at least  100 to come out for a diagnosis, we didn't really want to let the laptops leave our facility due to network security issues. Vellve Systems came out and performed a brief diagnosis, they offered to take the laptops back to their shop but like I said , we couldn't do that for security reasons . The next day they came back with all parts needed and fixed them on the spot, they hooked them all up to these network again. Jim was very professional and knowledgeable,  we will use them from now and on . I'm still surprised they didn't charge anything to come out.

I was on a trip and dropped my HP laptop by accident.  The laptop didn't open or close completely.  I couldn't even get the computer to the long in screen.  I was afraid I was going to lose all my family photos and a lot of work stuff.  I took it to this computer shop and Daniel checked the hard drive to make sure it was safe.  He said it wasn't reading but that didn't really mean anything since they can work around it sometimes.  I left my laptop with them.  Daniel called me back the next day letting me know they could fix the hard drive and also repair the screen, since it broke.  He asked me to share screens from my computer at my house and his computer at his shop so I could make sure all the pictures I need were there.  I checked them all and I was really happy he recovered them all.  I was on the phone with him for a while and I really appreciated his patience.  When I picked up my computer, it looked like new with all my stuff recovered.
This computer shop knows what they're doing and I HIGHLY recommend them!  Yaaay!!

I was in town to see my family and I spilled water on my macbook pro, I needed a fast service, I found this repair shop. My laptop was fixed in 2 days and price was reasonable. I know where to send my family or my friends in Charlotte from now and on

We have been very happy with Vellve Systems as our I.T. department. They have managed our servers, emails and all of our computers at our Charlotte and Chicago office. It is extremely important to stay up with technology and be protected from vulnerable attacks on the Internet , you will be extremely satisfied with Vellve Systems.

Vellve was good in summer 2010. Repaired my desktop by updating my BIOS and reinstalling Windows. Price was fair. In summer of 2011 I'm not as impressed. Gave me an obvious runaround as to what was wrong. They fixed it but took a long time and upped the price substantially from the original estimate.

I called around few places and this company was the only one with free estimates.  I took my iMac for repair since it didn't turn on after the storm we had 2 days ago, and they told me they'd call me as soon as they could figure out what the issue was. Later in the evening one of the techs called me, telling me a part had been blown and the part was in stock. They fixed it right away and gave me 1 year warranty. They didn't try to up sell me anything and I was very happy with the service. 

Excellent computer repair service . 

Thank you very much and I will make sure my friends get to know about your company.

Alex was great! Came out to our house, took a look at our setup and made recommendations to install a new wifi network. I can figure most things out with time, but we have an old house with plaster walls and a new part with steel beams and no matter what I tried, I could not get a good signal all over. Alex suggested two new routers, had his install guy check the wiring (had a bad jack) and now it works beautifully. Money well spent and zero aggravation for me!  

Alex also reinstalled my windows 7 software  on a desktop after the forced windows 10 upgrade crashed my computer.  Another computer repair company put some bootleg copy on my PC about a year ago when they fixed the crashed drive. I kept getting "your copy of windows is not genuine" - super aggravating after paying $250 to have it fixed. Now it works like it's supposed to!!

Vellve will be our new outsource IT guys from now on.

Will not use them again. Took computer for simple power jack replacement and turned into whole fiasco of getting the part shipped, which he said he had in stock before leaving the computer with him, then a problem with overheating, then a problem with the power adapter. What was supposed to be a simple 1-2 business day repair turned into 10 day complicated headache.

Being without your work laptop nowadays is big nightmare . I was looking for a fast-service repair shop , I called several other places and non of them seemed to know what I was talking about or knew how to solve the problem. I called Vellve Systems and they transferred me to their network administrator Jim, the moment I started explaining my situation , he knew exactly what I was talking about . He suggested he could log in to my network using my laptop remotely instead wasting and waiting for someone to come to my home-office , Jim logged on, looked up the issue around my network settings for my modem and router, got me up and running again without all the headaches (connectivity issues ) I was having. This company is now on my top 5 in general in the Charlotte community . It seems the bigger the companies are , the less knowledgeable and the less they care about their customers ! Not these guys.. I highly support locally owned businesses such as this

I have an old laptop that I wanted to bring back alive so I could use my old software for music. They diagnosed the issue to be a hard drive failure , they were right because now I have new hard drive and its working perfectly fine ..time to start my music classes!! They were on point . Will come back.

I have been doing business with Alex for well over 5 years. I have always known his pricing to be fair (one reason which led me to him) and his service to be fast (the second reason!) I came from a large corporate environment world and now that I'm on my own, I'm prone to Viruses-but he keeps me up to date and protected. No matter when I call, no matter what the issue is, he hangs in there until it is resolved. Most recently, I had an extremely difficult troubleshooting issue which he finally narrowed down to the service provider settings. It's almost like he thrives on a challenge and won't give up until it's resolved. I love this guy's work! Fair, honest, and delivers a good product. You can trust him!

I was visiting some relatives and stopped by to drop off a laptop that crashed holding my aunt's customer database files. The tech there was so friendly, letting me know he could take a look at it within the hour and would call with a status update.  They called as promised and explained the issues. Luckily all files were recovered, but it would take a little more time to repair and try to get it up and running. I had to return home to FL the next day, but they collected my aunt's info and contacted her the following day. Her laptop was salvageable, and they were even able to walk her through some computer basics and learn how to back up her files! Great customer service.

Alex made a visit to my house to determine why I was not getting a good Wi-Fi signal in part of my house, and he was able to quickly assess the problem and addressed it immediately.  Even before we had a contract he helped me navigate Time Warner Cable and provide immediate help.  

He and his technician were back within a few days to help me install a secondary router, while maintaining my existing home office set up. Also, right after the technician left, I experienced a minor problem, called Alex for assistance and he sent his tech right around to come straight back to my house.  Poor guy - I think he might have been late for dinner that night!

Very happy with Alex, his recommendations and the service at Vellve Systems.  Our Wi-Fi works so fast now - happy household.

This company gets 5 stars from me.  I have had a home business for over 20 years and have dealt with a multitude of different computer installation and repair companies.  Vellve Systems is far superior to any of these companies I have dealt with in the past.  I had a major issue on a Sunday, and they responded within an hour.  I was up and running again in no time.  I was shocked at the level of skill and responsiveness.   Because of their excellent level of service I purchased additional equipment at excellent prices.  This was also all on-site service.  They go above and beyond for their customers, which is something that is rare these days.  Needless to say, I give them the highest recommendation possible.

This is the 2nd time I contacted Vellve systems for help & can't be more happier with results AGAIN!!!! 

1st time I just needed to wipe off my old lap top that wasn't being used for years and just needed to bring it back to its workable condition - which was done in a time promised by Alex with very reasonable price. 

2nd time, for some odd reason my lap top stopped working(bios & it wouldn't respond to ANYTHING), after diagnostic at Vellve's I was told HD is fried and all my data is lost. All the documents/invoices/bank statements & way more for both of my biz are gone along with my precious 2 year old daughters pictures and videos of her first 2 years of life( I had some of them stored in my other devices but not all of them). Alex fixed my lap top by replacing it's hard drive to a new one, which I picked up at the time when it was promised to me, but I was out of all my very important data, after going back and forth of different options I agreed for Alex to recover my data. He advised he had to order specific parts and it will take about 2 weeks, 

I just picked up my a hard drive from his shop today with all my data and most importantly with all of my daughters pics and videos & I can't be happier to have my life back & most importantly my daughters memories. Very well knowledgeable individual, he and his office staff are very friendly and helpful, have great communications & always gets the job done by the time promised.

Hi, we brought in a company laptop infected by a virus.  It was bad!  We couldn't open up any files. 

They diagnosed our machine for free. We declined the service, at the moment, because our manager was not there to authorize the repair.  Like I said, we paid ZERO for them to look at it. The next week, when our manager was in, we took it back for the repair. The laptop is now working and all of our files are there without any issues . Great customer service and prices!

Alex and his team are my go to IT experts. They keep our systems up and running and are very responsive to our needs.  Recently, Alex enabled my iPad to replace my laptop and access our server remotely. I highly recommend them.

Very satisfied with the service . Location is very convenient for me. Price was very fair in my opinion, especially with the kind of service I received and turn around time. My laptop was returned to me exactly the same way I dropped it off, no scratches or damages. I am a very picky person with my electronics so I pay close attention to these things. I will be a repeated customer.

My Dell laptop completely died on me with all of my important documents and years of saved pictures inside. I was recommended to this business to repair my laptop, they repaired my laptop in a timely manner with all my stuff still intact. My laptop is not only fixed , it's working faster than ever!

Initially, my company, American Granite used Vellve Systems for just few small computer and internet upgrades and ended up hiring them as our IT support company. And let me tell you! That was the best decision we could have made! They are super professional, reliable, detail oriented, extremely knowledgeable, prompt to respond to all your questions, and fix all your computer and network issues in a timely manner. They will also give you a free first time consultation!

This place gets my second 1-star review ever. And the only other one was a place that gave me food poisoning and nearly sent me to the ER.

I gave them my hard drive because it was having problems and they were offering a free diagnostic. I was told to leave my cables with them and they would call me within 24 hours with a quote. After waiting 48 hours, I called them and left a message.
