Thanks for existing, Rush. Glad to have a place like this in our neck of the woods.
Had an awesome first experience. She was nice, gentle and kept up a little chit chat with me to fill in the awkward silence haha. Cheap too! For 20 I got my eyesbrows and lip done. :)

I have been going to Anita for about a year now to get my eyebrows threaded. I have sensitive skin that breaks out easily so I can't get my eyebrows waxed. If you have never had your eyebrows threaded before, I must inform you, it still hurts! It is pretty quick though and no chemicals are used on your skin. It is very hard to find people who do threading (unless you want to get it done in the middle of the mall with everyone walking by) but Anita is great. Make sure you give yourself atleast a week to get an appointment as she books up pretty fast. I don't know what she charges for other services but I pay $12 for my eyebrows to be threaded and it lasts about 3 weeks.

Great New Look for $12! I went in for eyebrow threading since I can't wax due to having senstive skin. First time hurt some but the results are worth it! Anita knows how to shape your brows to make you look great. I'll be back in 4 weeks!

I have visted Anita for a few years now to get my eyebrows threaded. 
Before I saw her, I used to get them waxed, which ended up pulling on my skin and now at 40, I have some loose skin under my brows.
Thanks to Anita, I no longer have to worry about waxing. Her threading technique has shaped my unruly brows better than wax or tweezers. She gave me the brows I always wanted. Her prices are very reasonable.  And she is always so polite and a joy. I also took my teenage daughter to see her. She was using accutane, and the natural thread would not irritate her skin like waxing.
After my session, she uses natural rose water on the area that was threaded. This gives me no irritation.
I highly reccommend Anita, she is very expierenced, reasonable and FABULOUS.

Allgemein
Anlässlich des Geburtstages meiner Frau besuchten wir am Wochenende das schöne Ludwigsburg. Da dies unser erster Aufenthalt in der Stadt war, verlie§ ich mich bei der Auswahl eines geeigneten Restaurants auf das Internet. Hier stieß ich auf das "Elefanten"... und was soll ich sagen? Reserviert, eingekehrt, bombastisch gegessen! Freundlichkeit, Herzlichkeit, sensationelle Speisen, Riesenportionen mit hoher Warenqualität zu fairen Preisen! Sollte es uns wieder einmal ins "Ländle" verschlagen, ist das "Elefanten" das Speiselokal unserer Wahl! 
Das Essen
Oktopus vom Grill, warmer Vorspeisenteller, Lammhaxe mit Auberginen und Tomatenreis, Elefantenplatte, Griechischer Joghurt mit Honig und Walnuss, Eisbecher

Leckerer Griche! 

Das Essen hier ist ein Hochgenuss.
Der Service schnell, freundlich und immer für die Gäste ansprechbar.

Wer also einen guten"Stammgrichen" sucht ist hier super aufgehoben.
Die Karte ist umfangreich, die Auswahl der Getränke ebenso. 

Die Preise angenehm günstig, die Portionen üppig und wirklich sehr schmackhaft.
Nur die Toiletten halten diesem Standart nicht stand: alt, eng, Fliesen aus den 60ern, allerdings sauber.
Die Terasse vor dem Eingang direkt an der Strasse läd denn auch nicht wirklich zum verweilen ein, drinnen ist man dann schon deutlich besser aufgehoben.
Der Elefanten ist immer gut besucht und so empfiehlt bei Gruppenbesuch durchaus eine Reservierung, wie in der Hauptessenszeit auch.
Äußerst freundliche Bedienung, sehr gutes Essen - was will man mehr?

Unser Lieblingsgrieche!! Wir kommen immer wieder ! Alles frisch und in großen Portionen angerichtet, sehr sehr lecker und super Preis für diese Portionen!! Der Service ist auch klasse, so freundlich, zuvorkommend und herzlich !!

Es wird endlich an der Zeit, dass dieses Restaurant von mir bewertet wird da ich schon mehrmals dort war.
 
Über Jahre hinweg habe ich mich dem griechischen Essen verweigert da es immer nur Suvlaki, Gyros, Athen-Teller usw. gibt. Und dann ist zu allem Überfluss das Fleisch tot gebraten und total trocken.
Am "Elefanten"  komme ich regelmässig vorbei und habe auch die Speisenkarte gelesen. Wie immer halt.....Gyros, Suvlaki, Athen-Teller ect.
Meine Frau mag aber Griechisch.
Okay wir sind rein und waren über das Ambiente überrascht. Kein Akropolis-Stuck an Decken oder Wände sondern ganz dezent griechisch eingerichtet.
Saubere Tischdecke und Blümchen auf dem Tisch.
Sehr gut besucht obwohl es Dienstagabend ist.
Der Service ist an Freundlichkeit nicht zu übertreffen. Vor allem der Chef selbst ist die Herzlichkeit in Person.
Die Karte bietet eine schöne Auswahl an Vorspeisen und Hauptgerichte an.
Natürlich sind die "Athenteller" genauso vorhanden wie auch einige Schmorgerichte wie Lammhaxe oder Stifado.
Die Getränkekarte ist "normal" mit griechischen und württembergischen Weine.
 
Ich habe mir den Elefantenteller gewählt der aus folgenden Komponenten besteht: Lammfilet, Schweinefilet, Gyros, Pommes, Reis und Salat. (Der Salat kommt vorneweg.)
Der Teller kommt und.......???
Lammfilet ist rosa(!!) gebraten, das Schweinefilet ebenso und das Gyros ist saftig.
Das Essen ist sehr gut gewürzt und die Portion mehr als ausreichend.
Die Anrichteweise der Speisen ist nicht unbedingt kreativ aber ich sitze hier ja nicht im Sternelokal sondern in einem gut bürgerlich-griechischem Lokal
Zum Digestif gibts einen Ouzzo aufs Haus (vielen Dank!), für die Kinder einen Lutscher und der Chef verabschiedet sich per Handschlag von seinen Gästen.
Da ich nun schon mehrmals dort war kann ich die Kontinuität der Küche bestätigen.
Reservierung wäre nicht schlecht. Vor allem am Wochenende
Probiert´s aus und gebt mal Feedback!

Als vorab Info, habe ich den Tip mit dem Elefanten von unserem Nachbarn erhalten. Da ich wirklich fast jeden Griechen im Kreis Ludwigsburg kenne, dachte ich mir
so viel anders kann es dort auch nicht sein.
Aber was soll es einen Versuch ist es wert. Seit dem sind 3 Monate vergangen und ich gehe fast jede Woche hin. Super freundlich, dezent eingrichtet nicht dieser griechische Schnick-Schnack. Das beste an allem ist auch das wichtigste, das Essen, es schmeckt einfach hervorragend.
Es gibt keinen besseren im Kreis Ludwigsburg. Egal ob Fleisch o. Fisch, auch der Gemüseteller 
ein Genuss auf den man immer wieder Lust hast. Abgesehen davon kommt das Essen (obwohl es ob Mittags o. Abends, einfach immer fast restvoll besetzt ist) unfassbar schnell. Deshalb gibt es hier die volle Punktzahl, für dieses Lokal würde ich noch einen Extra-Stern vegeben wenn ich noch einen hätte.

Ich mache es  ganz kurz.
Es ist eines der besten griechischen Restaurants die ich kenne weil das griechische Essen dort so schmeckt wie bei Janis am Strand in Griechenland.
Wir mussten lange suchen aber wir wurden gottseidank fündig.
Einen Kritikpunkt haben wir und vielleicht ist der hilfreich für die Betreiber.
Wenn man im hinteren Bereich des Lokals sitzt stört es doch sehr, dass man immer den Blick auf die Toiletten hat...die Türen gehen auf und zu und man schaut  direkt auf die WC Schüsseln und das muss ich gestehen verdirbt einem den einen oder anderen Biss.
Vielleicht kann man das irgendwann einmal ändern wäre echt toll.
Ansonsten weiter so.

Allgemein
Eins meiner Lieblingsrestaurants in Ludwigsburg!
Klassische Griechische Gerichte die mit viel Liebe und Leidenschaft zubereitet werden!
Die Wirte sind einfach immer freundlich, es gibt nach dem Essen Ouzo oder Espresso aufs Haus! Trotz vollem Lokal mussten wir nie lange auf Getränke oder Essen warten! Qualität ist immer top!
Sehr nett um in der Mittagspause oder nach Feierabend einen Kurztripp nach Griechenland zu machen ;)
Bedienung
super freundlich! Auf die Empfehlungen kann man sich immer verlassen, sehr freundliches zuvorkommendes Personal
Das Essen
Zum Mittagstisch gibt es immer einen kleinen Salat vorab, das Joghurtdressing schmeckt ausgezeichnet! Fleisch ist immer frisch, die Calamari ein Genuss!
Das Ambiente
Auf der Theke stehen lauter Elefanten herum, passt zum Namen :) sonst sehr neutral und modern eingerichtet
Sauberkeit
Der Tisch wird immer gründlich sauber gemacht! Allgemeine Sauberkeit herrscht dort

Hallo zusammen, 
auch das ist zu empfehlen, jederzeit immer wieder :-)


 Gruß Steph Schmidt 
Oberstenfeld

Kann ich ebenfalls empfehlen wenn man die Küche mag mit Knoblauch, es könnte ein wenig kreativer sein und mehr Abwechslung. Feste bleibende Speisekarte aber immer alles echt frisch. Ich vermisse ein wenig neue Aktions Speisen die es der Saison entsprechend gibt.....
Aber ein netter Ort Freundlichkeit ist hier stverständlich und absolut immer vorhanden.
Wir gehen schon seit der Eröffnung hin. Habe viele Freunde und teile der Familie dorthin mitgenommen, und alle sind nun auch soetwas wie Stammgäste! Absolute Empfehlung!
Einfach Super lecker! Mehr brauche ich nicht sagen.:-)

Warum sollte man nach 5 sehr guten Kritiken zum "Elefanten" noch eine weitere schreiben? Muß man in ein an allen Öffnungstagen vollbesetztes Restaurant noch weitere Gäste locken? Kann man einen der motiviertesten  Gastronomen zu mehr Freundlichkeit bringen, als überhaupt möglich ist?
Nein! (Hier müßte die Kritik enden. - Aber trotzdem:)
Im Januar 2009 wollte ich nach langer Zeit mal wieder griechisch essen und ging, wegen Krankheit meiner Parnerin, allein zum Elefanten. Es gab dieses Restaurant als "Grieche" noch nicht so lange. Das Ambiente war eher schlicht, es "dudelte" keine Folkloremusik und es war nur ein weiterer Tisch besetzt. (Heute unvorstellbar!)
Dann bestellte ich einen Uzo (nicht "auf Haus", sondern vor dem Essen), einen Schafskäse und den Elefantenteller, dazu einen Retsina (ja, einige mögen ihn nicht).
Was dann kam, war eine Reise in die Vergangenheit, die kein Auge trocken lies! Ich erinnerte mich an die mittleren 70er-Jahre. Alles war wie früher. Die geschmacklichen Erinnerungen überschlugen sich. Es wurde, wenn auch alleine, einer der schönsten Abende. 
Seit diesem Tag sind wir, natürlich zu zweit, regelmäßig dort. Sehr schnell gab es ohne Reservierung keine freien Tische mehr. Heute ist das an allen Wochentagen so.
Heute beginnen wir immer mit dem (Aperitiv-) Uzo und gehen dann über die gegrillten Peperoni mit viel Knoblauch für den einen zur vegetarischen Gemüseplatte und für den anderen zur Fischplatte. Ein Dessert konnten wir nie ausprobieren, weil trotz "Vorfasten" spätestens danach, nichts mehr ging.
Die verschiedenen Speisen sind in den vergangenen Kritiken ausreichend und treffend beschrieben worden. Es ist eine ehrliche, sehr gute griechische Küche (so, wie man sie sich in Deutschland vorstellt), in einer Frische, die alleine schon im hohen Durchsatz durch die vielen Gäste begründet liegt.
 Was mich besonders rührt: Hier wird eine gastronomische Erfolgsstory gelebt. Freundlichkeit, Fleiß und Qualitätsbewußtsein führen zum mehr als verdienten Erfolg!
Der Inhaber verkörpert tatsächlich "die Freundlichkeit in Person". Er lebt sie. Wir haben ihn niemals, bei allen unseren Besuchen, anders erlebt.
"Jamas" und "efkaristo" (gesprochen) an Ihn und sein Team!

Did takeout for gyros and chicken.  The food was a bit dry, and not very tasty.  The portions were good.  The restaurant decorations and atmosphere looked very nice, but the food would prevent me from returning here.

Wir sind mit 8 Mann eingefallen und wurden absolut nicht enttäuscht. Das Essen war frisch und lecker zubereitet und es wurde gleichzeitig serviert. Da kann man nicht meckern,
Der obligatorische Ouzo rundete das Essen ab ;)
Das Personal war sehr freundlich und aufmerksam, ein gelungener Abend.

Hier haben wir während unseres kurzen Aufenthaltes einmal zu Abend gegessen. Das Essen war super lecker und eigentlich recht günstig im Preis! Das Personal war super nett und wir haben uns wirklich gut aufgehoben gefühlt. Hier sind 5 Sterne mehr als verdient!!!

Einfach nur jammmiii. War selbst schon einige Male nun dort und kann nur von positiven Erfahrungen sprechen. Das Essen ist wirklich sehr lecker und das Personal super freundlich. Allerdings würde ich gerade am Wochenende eine Reservierung empfehlen, da es nicht arg groß ist und wirklich gut besucht. Habe es schon etlichen Bekannten weiterempfohlen und auch diese sind wirklich begeistert.
Da ich sehr oft in Griechenland Urlaub mache erlaube ich mir urteilen zu können wie griechisches Essen schmecken soll und was ich sagen kann: Das Elefanten ist wirklich ein Grieche. Nett ist auch der kleine Ouzo den man am Ende vom Wirt bekommt  solche Kleinigkeiten machen ein gewissen Charme einfach aus und macht auch die etwas (aber wirklich nur etwas) erhöhten Preise wieder gut.

Allgemein
Die Reservierung erfolgte telefonisch. Das Personal war informiert und wir bekammen unseren Tisch zugewiesen. Alles war vorbereitet und nach etwa 5 Minuten wurde die Bestellung aufgenommen.
Bedienung
Das Personal ist sehr freundlich und aufmerksam gibt sich Mühe für die Gäste ohne aufdringlich zu sein.
Das Essen
Verschieden Platten wurden bestellt. Das Essen war sehr gut und die Portionen ausreichend.
Das Ambiente
Das Lokal ist gemütlich und übersichtlich. Die Einrichtung ist einfach und bequem. Es gibt keine Tischdecken aber ist nicht störend. Der Lärmpegel ist erträglich.
Sauberkeit
Es war sauber und aufgeräumt.

Bestes Griechisches Restaurant in Ludwigsburg! Super nette Besitzer, üppige Portionen, extra-wünsche sind hier kein problem!
Nettes modernes Ambiente!
Service immer sehr zuvorkommend!
Immer Saubere Tische!
Und am Ende gibts einen Ouzo aufs Haus! Toll!!!

Ich bin regelmäßiger Gast in diesem Restaurant.
War schon oft mittags und manchmal abends da und es ist zuverlässig auf seinem Niveau, nett im Service und das Ambiente ist in Ordnung.
 
Die Speisen von der Mittagskarte sind etwas kleiner als abends, aber lecker sind sie so oder so. Mittags esse ich oft und gerne den "Kreta-Teller" - gyros und junge rinderleber. Die Leber ist wirklich sehr lecker. Auch empfehlen kann ich die Calamari... besser geht kaum, finde ich!
Es gibt immer einen Salat zu jedem Essen und der Ouzo aufs Haus ist nahezu obligatorisch.
Es ist klassische griechische Küche, aber gut zubereitet und genau das erwarte ich von einem Griechen. Sehr empfehlenswert und man wird immer freundlich und zuvorkommend bedient.

auch wenns schon so viele kritiken zu diesem lokal gibt, geb ich noch meinen senf dazu: sehr aufmerksamer service! wir konnten den beilagensalat einfach in einen bauernsalat wandeln und am schluss gabs die wahl zwischen ouzo oder espresso aufs haus! das hatte ich auch noch nie! top! 
schade dass bei der fischplatte fast alles frittiert war und dass mein bifteki innen noch ein hauch zu wenig durch war. aber sonst wars super!
Sehr leckeres essen gute Portion sehr netter Service hab mich rundum wohl gefühlt immer wieder gerne.

Ein Geheimtipp unter den griechischen Restaurants. Zwar sieht die Speisekarte genau so aus, wie bei anderen.Aber der Service ist wirklich aufmerksam, flink, sehr freundlich. Das Essen wird sehr liebevoll angerichtet.Die Fischplatte, die ich gegessen hatte, war hervorragend. Die Tintenfische butterweich, nicht wie sonst gummiartig.Das Seezungenfilet war wahrscheinlich tiefgefroren, aber es störte nicht.Die Zitronenkartoffeln, die als Beilage dabei waren, hatte ich so noch nicht gegessen. Sie paßten wunderbar zu diesem Gericht.
Der einzige Nachteil war, da das Restaurant bis auf den letzten Platz besetzt war, war die Lautstärke auch dementsprechend, so daß man sich beim Unterhalten mit lauter Stimme sprechen mußte.
Aber alles in allem, ich werde mit Sicherheit dort wieder essen gehen.

Nach dem Besuch des Ludwigsburger Weihnachtsmarktes machten wir mal wieder einen Abstecher zum "Elefanten". Glücklicherweise hatte wir eine Tisch reserviert, wie immer war das Lokal sehr gut besucht.
Zeitgleich mit uns traf eine größere Gruppe ein, wir erhielten jedoch Getränke und Speisen zuerst. Der Octopus vom Grill aus der Vorspeisenkarte war ein Gedicht, meine Begleiterinnen liebten das Pitta-Brot. Zu jedem Gericht gehörte ein kleiner Salatteller, dieser wurde vor der Hauptspeise serviert. Die Rinderleber meiner Frau war ein Highlight, zart und nicht trocken. Der Hermesteller und das Gyros waren so gut wie wir es aus der Vergangenheit kannten.
Durch den starken Besuch war die Geräuschkulisse sehr hoch, das war aber das einzig Störende an diesem Abend. Die freundliche Begrüßung und der souverände Service machen einfach gute Laune.
Das Essen hier ist sehr gut, die Portionen recht üppig und das Personal sehr freundlich.

Hier ist der Kunde noch König!
Ein wirklich ausgesprochen zuvorkommender und netter Service ohne aufdringlich zu wirken.
Das Essen ist sehr gut, der Chef gesellt sich teilweise sogar selbst an den Tisch zu einem kleinen Schwätzchen.
Einem wird generell die Türe aufgehalten beim Gehen.
Nur zu empfehlen!

Vous croyez que les traditions culinaires acéricoles du Québec se perdent dans un océan d'établissements commerciaux couteux et décevants ? Si oui, une visite à la Cabane à sucre Handfield s'impose. Située à St-Marc-sur-Richelieu au cœur d'une érablière bicentenaire, dit-on, cet établissement de qualité, construit en 1971, vous offre un véritable retour à la tradition. 

La nourriture ici est authentique, copieuse et délicieuse. Au menu, le restaurateur vous propose les grands classiques des cabanes à sucre, à commencer par une excellente soupe aux poids mijotée avec un fond de lard fumé. Après cette entrée, vont suivre le ragout de pattes de cochon et la tourtière. On trouve aussi du porc si tendre qu'il s'effiloche sous la fourchette. Des oreilles de christ croustillantes et salées juste à point. Le chef vous sert aussi d'excellentes saucisses artisanales (oubliez les misérables saucisses Hygrade dans le sirop, ce n'est pas le genre de l'endroit). En accompagnement : du pain frais, des patates bouillies, des betteraves et des cornichons marinés ainsi que du ketchup maison aux fruits sont à votre disposition. Le tout, est offert dans un menu à volonté. Si vous avez encore faim après tout ça, le pouding du bucheron, les crêpes et la tarte au sirop d'érable viendront sûrement combler le dernier espace disponible dans votre estomac. En passant, le pouding était si bon que j'en ai commandé un pour apporter. Oui, on peut faire ça, il suffit de le demander. 

Le soir, des violonistes accompagnent votre repas d'une musique folklorique. J'accorde une note particulière à l'attention portée au décor qui est composé d'antiquités. C'est un peu kitch, mais charmant et ça vous plonge dans l'ambiance d'antan. À noter aussi que l'établissement offre une bière artisanale en fût qu'on ne sert qu'ici. 

Il reste donc de ces cabanes à sucre authentiques où l'on vous servira une cuisine de qualité. La Cabane de l'auberge Handfield est l'une de celle-là. Ouvert du 1 mars à la fin avril. Pour les groupes, mieux vaut réserver à l'avance. Je vous la recommande.

Avec la présence d'un menu alternatif destiné à plaire au plus grand nombre (végétariens, végétaliens, sans gluten), la Cabane à sucre Handfield a de grandes ambitions. Malheureusement et malgré d'aussi bonnes intentions, j'ai été assez déçu de ma visite à la Cabane.
Alors qu'il est au même prix que le menu traditionnel, les plats du menu végétalien sont loin d'être aussi variés: outre le pain (sans produit d'origine animale depuis peu!), la soupe aux pois et le creton aux lentilles offerts en entrée, le cœur du repas est seulement composé de tofu mariné dans du sirop d'érable, d'une polenta, de fèves et d'une pomme de terre cuite à la vapeur. Les quantités servies étaient correctes: comme c'est une cabane à sucre, on peut en commander autant qu'on veut, mais je n'en avais pas très envie. On en a fait le tour avec une seule assiette! Je me disais que, au moins, je gardais de la place pour les desserts. Je suis tombé des nues lorsqu'ils sont arrivés sur la table: la seule option végane (notez l'utilisation du singulier) était une pomme cuite et enrobée de caramel. À l'inverse, le menu traditionnel inclut tartes au sucre, pudding et autres pancakes. C'est d'autant plus dommage sachant que toutes ces préparations sont facilement "véganisables". Le menu alternatif est un pas dans la bonne direction (que j'encourage!) mais il n'est ni original, ni complet. Au moins, la tire était délicieuse!
Je tiens toutefois à saluer l'organisation et l'attention du personnel. Si vous choisissez le menu végétalien, on vous remet au début du repas une carte à laisser sur la table pour faciliter le service (attention, toutefois: la carte mentionne un gâteau à la semoule et au caramel mais, faute de popularité, il a été remplacé par la pomme au caramel). Lorsque les plats arrivent, les serveuses et serveurs indiquent alors clairement lesquels sont adaptés à votre régime alimentaire. Il n'y avait qu'un seul serveur qui ne semblait pas s'en soucier (et ramassais les plats sans demander si on avait terminé).
Bref, si vous êtes végane, vous vivrez probablement une meilleure expérience dans une cabane à sucre végétarienne (comme La Cabane à Tuque). La Cabane à sucre Handfield "accommode" mais ne parvient pas à offrir une expérience végétalienne mémorable. La présence de calèches avec des chevaux risque aussi de vous déranger. Si vous désirez quand même y aller, assurez-vous de bien préciser le menu désiré lors de la réservation.

Une cabane à sucre chaleureuse et invitante.  Le personnel était attentif et sans exception, toujours souriant.  J'ai trouvé la nourriture bonne et les oreilles pas aussi grasse ou sèche qu'à l'habitude.  Il y a toujours un peu d'oreilles pas loin à cette cabane.  Je trouve que le prix d'entrée est trop cher. Je ne pense pas que le prix de 27,50$ par personne, hors taxes et excluant les pourboires est raisonnable.  Pour 2 personne on s'est tire avec une facture de: 67$.  C'est un peu cher pour des omelettes et de la saucisse non?

La cabane à sucre, une activité incontournable au Canada ! J'ai testé celle ci mi-avril et c'était super ! 
Le cadre est très beau (en plus il y avait grand soleil), et il y avait un vrai menu vegan donc c'était parfait  Evidemment, on ressort de la, en se promettant qu'on ne mangera plus pendant trois jours tellement c'est copieux et bon. 
Le personnel est aussi très agréable et souriant.

Overall a decent cabane a sucre with charming ambiance and excellent service. Set your GPS to the address listed on Yelp as google maps will bring you to a B&B. Once you park, there is a 10 min walk to the entrance, or you can take a shuttle. We took the shuttle ride back and it was on a tractor, really fun to ride on and the wait wasn't long at all.

Gluten free or vegan friends please note that this is the exact opposite of a health food spot. I am gluten free and the food was typical "cabane a sucre" stuff which I just don't eat. I don't eat gluten, beans, lentils, eggs, pork, rinds, OR sugar! I can't give them a poor review for my silly food preferences though LOL.  Luckily I had a large healthy breakfast beforehand. For a $30 cabane a sucre experience, I've gotta say, they did an excellent job. The service was really fast and friendly too. I loved the fireplace and live accordion music.

I decided to come here for the ambiance and to be with my family. If you are the type (I'm jealous by the way) who can eat whatever they want and not have any reaction then this is the place for you! Everyone who ate the smoked ham LOVED it! The sausages looked a little oily though. 

I have to end my review on a sad note.. the horses that were used to carry dozens of people over and over around the path looked so depressed. They were well groomed and beautiful horses but they were in pain and definitely mistreated by the owners as they kept on whipping them to behave (I know that's customary but it hurt to watch).  My mom even commented that one of them seemed to be limping as he couldn't keep one of his hooves down (it seemed like he was injured). Why can't they use another tractor to ride dozens of people around and ditch the horses or have them for only private use (pay for a round with only 2 people to cover the medical costs for the horse). Read the hidden review of Barbara C (you have to select "show not recommended reviews" then copy past it into google translate). This is a snippet of what she wrote (translated) 

"our exit was totally spoiled by the sight of the two horses pulling a cart out. One of the two horses was particularly bad; He ran diagonally and his hind legs bent constantly under the effort he was making to move forward. In the turns, he almost fell on the other horse beside him, his legs slipping through the mud. It hurt to see him coming and going, over and over again, obviously suffering, shaking his head to the left and right, with foam on his lips and his tongue on the side of his mouth"

Due to the horses I deducted 1 star. I can't stop thinking about them. Please boycott the horse ride and comment on their condition to the owners guys. I wish they would just keep them in a stable outside :(

I had the vegan meal which was absolutely delicious! Marinated tofu, beans, lentil pate, steamed potato, perfectly done polenta. Their beets were scrumptious. I didn't try the pickles or the homemade ketchup, but my husband did and he really enjoyed them.

The young lady serving us was very attentive and took note of who had a vegan, non-pork, or gluten-free menu. The only reason I am giving the rating a 4 star is because as soon as the older lady started clearing the table, nobody could have seconds or finish the rest of their plate. My husband and our friend was looking after their children for just a moment and whoosh! Plate was gone! Even if there was some food left.

Came for the first time on a Sunday for pretty much full body wax, which I specified over the phone two weeks prior. The woman who did my wax was the same one that spoke to me on the phone. She agreed to a certain price for all the services I asked for and then when I was there and she was waxing she said I didn't ask for this and that and that each is extra.

As if that's not enough she let the other girl who only knows nails help her wax. The girl didn't even know to apply the wax in the same direction as hair growth. I told her I don't want the other girl waxing if she hasn't gone to school for it and they never listened. At this point I didn't argue too much because I didn't want them to mess me up more than they already had. I never let them get near me for Brazilian and arms which were still left to do because they were just raising the price and they'd left numerous hairs on my legs.

Please save yourself the disappointment and just go to Petals which is my regular place but was strapped for time and they're a bit out of the way at Yonge and Bloor

Yes,  I appreciate the cleanliness and courtesy.  I also like that no one asked a million questions about my personal life and yes everyone spoke English.  They really took their time (way more than it normally takes). They took me in at the last minute on a Saturday and it was a good price.  I just wish they did a better finish.  It doesn't seem like they have the experience/expertise I am use to.  The girl, and I mean girl (looked 14 but said she was 17) tried worked hard/carefully on the cuticle work and massage but it was the other Ladies who did they painting that rushed and didn't clean up the mistakes. I might go back for the mani pedi but definitely will not do French again. Although I must admit it's one of the cleanest French lines I have had that were done manually. I just wasn't pleased that they didn't clean up the nail Polish around the finger and took sooooo long. Also did my feet and hand sequentially rather than simultaneously. They were NOT busy.
Amazing service. Ahhh hot stone foot massage is my favorite! I always go there with my coworker to relax. They are very clean and professional

Deceiving experience. Inexperienced nail customers beware 

I barely ever get my nails done and wanted to try something new spontaneously
Asked for uv gel nails, discussed what I wanted and shape also. Later discover the women did acrylic on my nails from watching videos on both methods when I got home. The woman used a wet brush dipped in powder and laid that on my nails instead of a gel type product 
Paid for uv gel ($35) when acrylic is $25
Did not get what I asked for and on top of that I was charged for something different. 

This deception is unfortunate. Next time I'll do research on types of nail service methods. Very disappointed in my experience ...

Have been searching without success for a new nail salon since my regular place for 2+ years (Michelle Le) went downhill... like bloody cuticles downhill... (!)

My search went on for more than six months without any success at all.

I found a great place downtown (http://www.yelp.co.uk/biz/nails-attraction-toronto), but I need somewhere close to my home/office that's more convenient. So I started popping into area salons. I tried:
1. Top Queen Nails (http://www.yelp.co.uk/biz/top-queen-nails-north-york)
2. Aphrodite Spa & Nails (http://www.yelp.co.uk/biz/aphrodite-spa-and-nails-north-york)
3. http://www.yelp.co.uk/biz/sunshine-spa-and-nails-toronto

And wasn't satisfied at any of them. I want to feel comfortable and taken care of when I'm getting a mani or pedi - is that too much to ask?? It's supposed to be a SPA service!

Then I noticed a sign on my way home from work that I hadn't seen before - Lotus Nails is tucked away at the side of a strip mall on Don Mills Road - if you don't know where it is, you''re not likely to stumble upon it - I just happened to be taking a weird route home - YAY! 

So I met Amy and Jenny - who are both fantastic! They opened about six months ago (Summer 2012) and seem to be in a great rhythm already.

Lotus is friendly, very clean and tastefully decorated, brilliantly cozy and comfortable.

I got UV gel nails (French) - they lasted for almost a MONTH looking great!!! I have never experienced such a long-lasting manicure. JOY!! Finally!

It was worth the wait to find this place.

There is lots of free parking on-site, and it's close to many major arteries I use all the time! I will be back!!!

Other notes: The business card I took to remind me to write this review says they also do waxing & facials, threading & tinting (besides all regular nail services).

Wow. Went there to get acrylic nails and I wanted to get coffin shape and she told me I need to pay $5 more for that. I said fine. Then as she proceeded she just scraped the top layer of my natural nail and didn't even trim my nails and they are all uneven lengths.... To long to just go ahead and start putting tips on that's for sure. So If she couldn't even cut my nails or anything I don't know what I would have been in for. I just left and went to another place to do them and they trimmed my nails and were not Impressed with the way that person had scraped the top layer of my nails. What an absolute waste of time. I am so pleased that I left.
The place was clean and pleasant and the ladies who did my nails mani and pedi did an excellent job for the price I paid. I would go back if I lived in the area.
this is a horrible place; had a crown done, was charged $1000 for it.  It cracked within three months, and they wanted to charge me full replacement charges

I woke up one Saturday morning with some severe mouth problems... I had an awful canker sore, my wisdom teeth were hurting, and my gums were in severe pain and looked like they were beginning to decompose. Seriously: there were some green spots on there that did NOT look quite right. For a second one could have thought I had meth mouth (I'll get back to that in just bit).

Now here's the thing about living in a small town: good luck finding a dentist that's open on a weekend. So for the next 48 hours I proceeded to rinse my mouth hourly, brush my teeth every few hours and go on an overdose of painkillers, to no avail: by the end of the weekend, my mouth looked just as bad, and I was still in severe pain, ready to start pulling my teeth out with pliers, then drive to the nearest Walmart (there's three of them in town!... but that's another story) and go on a shooting rampage. My boyfriend was supposed to visit in a few days, and we had some serious making out on the agenda, which would not happen in these conditions (did I mention the serious halitosis?): I had to take action.

Monday morning, first thing right out bed, I go online and find the first dentist that will take my insurance: Baytowne Dental Center. Amazingly enough, they ask me to come in the next twenty minutes. Forget about taking a shower: I brush my teeth, jump into my car and I'm on my way.

My first experience there was quite positive, if a bit traumatizing: the dentist, Dr. Hick, looked at my mouth for just a few seconds and knew what it was. ANUG. You know it's semi serious when your dentist starts taking digital photos of your mouth...  I'll let you look it up, but beware of the photos you might come across as you google it (stay away from Google images!!). Some rare form of gingivitis that's the most common symptom of meth mouth (here we go!... seriously, I swear, I never did meth, never will, and just in case I needed another reason not to try it, this should do it), and that used to be common among the soldiers in the trenches during World War I. Now how on earth did I catch that sh*t, I wish I knew. 

Twenty minutes later, I leave the office with a prescription for antibiotics and some weird mouth rinse which is supposed to make my tongue black (awesome... but who cares, I'd have done anything at that point).

Now thank Jesus for antibiotics. A few days and still quite a bit of pain later, my mouth finally starts feeling and looking normal again. I go back to see Dr. Hick, she gives my teeth a good cleaning, and everything is in order. Phew... I wouldn't miss on any making out.

Since then, I've decided to take better care of my teeth. I've gone back once, and Dr. Hick designed this ridiculous treatment plan which starts with pulling my wisdom teeth out (... not looking forward to this one...), root planing, cancer screening, and an obscene number of crowns which I won't divulge here... for the very affordable amount of 10 thousand dollars. What?! Yes, 10 thousand dollars. I wish that were a joke. There goes my down-payment for my dream vacation house in Puerto Rico. Oh well.

I'm not sure why this place has such bad reviews. I went in for a simple cleaning and everything was fine. I wasn't blown away, but I mean it's the dentist... Who likes the dentist? The hygienist started with X-rays and immediately showed me the problem spots. Dr. Hicks came in for about five minutes, identified some issues with fillings and cavities and was quite friendly. The hygienist explained all the jargon the dentist rattled off and then proceeded with the cleaning. She used a waterpik which meant no terrifying scraping sounds as she removed the plaque and then polished me up, took a few pictures and sent me on my way. 
  Basically going to the dentist is like going to the mechanic. You come in for routine stuff and they suggest a bunch of expensive extras. Even though they did this, I didn't feel any pressure to take them or even make a follow up appointment. 
   The only thing that creeped me out a little bit was how she took pictures of my teeth. She unwrapped a mirror from some paper towels, rinsed it in the sink, and then out the whole thing in my mouth to take pics with a digital camera. That didn't seem terribly sanitary, so if you're a germophobe I wouldn't recommend this place.

Baytowne is all about the revenue, but you do get a lot of bang for the buck. They do try to upsell you on services here, and their prices seem high to me. Make sure they tell you at the desk before you go back how much you are going to pay yourself and how much your insurance will pick up. This is NOT the place to go if you do not have insurance. 

The dental experience at Baytowne is a good one. The hygienists I've met are all very friendly and good at their job. Dr. Hick is also very friendly  as well. She has small hands, which is a big improvement over the former linebacker that used to work on my teeth. The best thing in my book, however, is that they have LCD TV's in the rooms that they position on a swivel arm right in front of your face so you can watch whatever channel of Comcast Cable while they are working on you. This is much better than what I was used to, which was a clock radio in the corner, tuned to the reactionary pundits of hate radio that you could not even hear when the drill went on.

Baby, don't do it. Dr. Hicks is not my pick! I went to this office and had my teeth cleaned and thought they had on gloves laced with led and using drywall tools on my gums.

I wanted a simple cleaning and was told I needed to have extensive work, not true my gums are fine and only went to slick Hick because a friend recommended her. Now that friend has been dealt with, I had to send her a slap-a-gram and a b*tch are you crazy email. I digress! 

Avoid these masked robbers, I mean dental professionals. The doctor told me I needed a root canal and wanted to put a temporary silver cap over my tooth until the super expensive porcelain arrived. Excuse, me? Did you just say SILVER? Who do I look like, Flavor Flav or Little Wheezy's play cousin?!? I told her to take her antiquated practice back to the dark ages and get me the heeeeell out of there. I grabbed my things, bolted for the door, and my tires screeched out of the parking lot like she was the poltergeist! Run Carol Ann, run toward the light, Carol Ann!!

Run! Don't even think about going here for dental work.  This is an unethical dental business preying upon the assigned ppo list to hijack their patients.  My mother just went to this Dr Hicks and got snowballed into a $479 dental cleaning.  That's about $226 above the average cost.  She also was told that each fee is based upon who you have for dental insurance.  They do not have set fees. She left that office with an estimated future bill of $5000 for so called work that needed to be done.   Note BUYER BEWARE!  Tomorrow I will call the better business bureau for the other suspicious work she had done in addition to the cleaning on my elderly mother.

Total change in management and selections!  New and gently used furniture for every taste and budget. Everything from small affordable dinette sets to luxury one of a kind finds. Scottsdale style with a Mesa price. Hurry! Inventory changes daily!!!

I don't think this business even deserves one star... I realize they are there to make money but I feel really taken advantage of..... I don't think they even gave me half what they sold my furniture for

Nice to see that things are getting back to normal!! Place is looking good. I use to shop here years ago. Things happen , closed down. Love it is doing so well again. You will see me again!! Keep getting OLD GOODIES!!!!! What happen to your little junk room?????

I found Terri's on the web this morning and called the phone number for this Mesa location to check to see what the hours of operation are. The recording stated that they opened at 9am. I drove the 10 miles from my home in Tempe out to Greenfield Rd in Mesa and arrived at 9:10am to find out they don't actually open until 10am. Soooo, I had to drive the 10 miles back home. I had planned to buy a couple of end tables and see about consigning 2 leather chairs and ottomans.  
So, my new plan is try the new Andrews Furniture New and Consignment store in Tempe at Southern and McClintock.

I cannot express my disappointment and distaste for this company more. We gave them thousands upon thousands of dollars of our furniture - nice designer things such as Robb and Stucky, Z Gallerie, Custom items, etc. (I am a designer).

My understanding of their 'contracted terms' was not explained to me because they slip it in by sending a third party delivery driver to come pick up your furniture. They say it is an independent company. However, they are the ones that make you sign the contract and you have to pay them for pick up (interesting). 

They took our furniture, asked us to declare value (which they NEVER) used and simply take lesser amounts for, and never explain to you their policies (which in my opinion should be illegal). The policy, or so they say after the fact, (my husband went down to the another store to inquire), is that you MUST pick up your furniture within 7 days of the contract expiring or THEY KEEP IT. You heard me. It's theirs. They don't call you, they don't let you know your contract is expiring. They simply keep it. 

So...if I understand this correctly, I need to set my alarm for this date and call a moving company to schedule a pick up within days without contacting us? And, that NO one from your company lets me know even a week out that the contract is closing? Boy, that certainly is convenient for them.

It's also interesting that all the small items sold and none of the larger pieces. I have to wonder if they were stuck in the back during the contract so that they could make more money later. Anyway, out of thousands of dollars of furniture, we maybe made $150.00 or so. 

And guess what? They own all of our fine furniture now to sell at full price. What a creative business strategy!

Oh, and here is the kicker. When we went down to find out about where our furniture was... The computer records indicated that they lost one of our Custom Robb and Stucky chairs. He said the records indicate it as lost, but since the contract was over they couldn't do anything about it. 

Hmmm....maybe someone just took it home. Once again, interesting business model.

If you are selling your furniture, my advice to you is...do NOT go here. 

What a disgusting way to do business.

Good luck, anyone else have this issue? The sales person filled us in with all of the complaints...so I know this is not uncommon.

If I could take away that star I would, we consigned many pieces of furniture and lamps before our move last year, they sold fast, but the store kept giving us the runaround about our money, then they went bankrupt and we never were paid, this was a very horrible experience and knowingly deceived us, I would highly recommend that no one deals with this business, they still owe us 750.00 dollars!!!!

We stopped in on the hunt for a new recliner for my dad.  We didn't head out looking for a used chair but in a whim we gave Teri's a shot and we were happy we did.  We were looking for a smaller recliner which apparently are tough to find but we were lucky enough to find a lightly worn one that fit the bill.  We paid $142 (after being twice marked down) where it would have easily been $500 new. They don't get 5 stars because they had the chair we wanted however that does help. The experience and service were top notch.  The nice gentleman working on the floor who wasn't pushy in any way (major points for that), suggested I ask the woman at the front desk if she could provide a deeper discount.  Apparently if the furniture is on the floor beyond a number of days they will cut the price even more, and that's what she did.  No cheesy gimmicks, just straight forward and real.  She was friendly and a pleasure to speak with.  The gentleman who helped us on the floor had the recliner ready to be loaded in my SUV before I was even able to pull my car around the back.  He helped my dad lift the chair, explained how to reassemble it and wished us a good day.  Easy, helpful, and an all round positive experience.  What a pleasant surprise!
They sold very few of the pieces we brought in.  They also broke one of the pieces (it could not be repaired) and won't take any responsibility.  You'd be better off with a garage sale.

meh did not care for this place at all. this place smelled like a musty old persons home; like your great grandmas or something . a definite turn off understood by the old, musty furniture in there. most the stuff was very old looking and far outdated junk...think duck wall paper era.  most things were overpriced, as well; especially considering what they are selling. its not a matter of taste per se, so much as a need to update product they buy to modern items and maybe vacuum the place/items every now n then. then maybe it will be more enticing. only plus i could see was they didn't hound me while i looked (didn't acknowledge us) and the place was spacious, so you could actually look easier.

I have used this location before and pick up a few good pieces. I recommended this Terri's to one of my older customers and she was basically robbed. They took her stuff in and when it was time to pick up the items that hadn't sold she was told they couldn't find the items. Really?! How do you lose someone's stuff. There were a lot of items. They would only give her a donation slip for a meager amount. Ridiculous. Stay away from this location. 

Go to the Terri's in Chandler. They are phenomenal!!

My husband and I literally furnished our entire apartment in one day thanks to Angie. She gave us amazing deals and didn't pressure us at all. She made the experience such a delight. And the furniture we bought was in wonderful condition!

Limited selection with average prices. Came in bc if you search for a shop in Phoenix this comes up first. It would be a shame if someone drove across town to this place thinking it was the best in the area.. I walked in and instantly was disappointed by the lack of inventory... I don't know who would give this place 5 stars?!?... probably friends of the biz owner.. Some of the reviews sounds like commercials.. Worth checking out if 5 mins away but don't make this a destination
Clean, well organized smoke shop with a great selection and very friendly staff. Couldn't ask for anything more. Highly recommend making this place your home smoke shop.

Love love love this place! I wish it was closer to me I'd be in every week. Joe is very friendly and knowledgeable, great selection and if they don't have what you are looking for they can and will get it for you. 
Can't wait to be back in the area to stop back in!
The store owner is super nice and they have really great prices. Clean, well organized store. Will definitely be back, great selection!

This is THE place to stop for all your smoking needs or even a refreshing drink. The owner is extremely nice and his nephew who works here is equally as nice. 

Their prices are great. Avoid going to High Maintenance down the street unless you want to pay double the price. Also the owner of the place is an asshole. 

They are also loaded up with wraps, cigars and all your smoking needs such as cigarettes.

Have you been dunkin lately? If not make sure to check this one out.  Prices are cheaper then Starbucks and coffee tastes better. What's not to like about that? 
There is a set of standards to be expected these days when it comes to coffee. What about service? At this DD the service is fast. From drive tru window to walking in, your coffee will be ready in 1 minute or less. It's a rather simple relationship between any customer and any retailer. You provide the coin, they provide the service. And this DD work very good from that perspective.

I do love Dunkin Donuts..... specifically the Toasted Coconut and Chocolate Frosted cake. :)

Pretty much 99% of the time I get the Coffee & 2 donuts combo (of course the Toasted Coconut & Chocolate Frosted cake). 

I used to go here WAY too often -- so often, that they know it's me when I order at the drive-thru. Cause I get the "Toasted Coconut & Chocolate Frosted cake"..... 

And seriously, I have to say that everytime -- cause for a long time they would mess up and give me a chocolate glazed donut or chocolate frosted glazed donut - - def not the same. 

Friendly staff. Make sure you get the coffee punch card if you order alot of Medium-sized coffees here...

After hearing all the hype, the commercials on tv, etc.... I finally got to experience Dunkin Donuts first hand.  I tried their donuts, coffee and breakfast sandwich. HMMM... Let's just say, I am not too disappointed that i don't have access to one locally. Their donuts were dry, my local donuts shop have way better donuts.

First of all, I am BEYOND sad that I do not live minutes from this DD anymore.  I first started drinkin DD when I lived in Boston and cannot get enough!  It's like liquid crack!

This location is so unique and reminds me of the staff I would meet at Boston locations--remembering your order, saying hi, asking how work was, etc.  They treat you like a friend!  

The iced coconut coffee is my fav and they ran out a few days in a row once.  The staff was really patient with me while I figured out my alternative and they even suggested a couple new flavors that I tried that were pretty good!

Overall, this is my favorite AZ DD location!

My order is always the same - A large iced black coffee. The never fail of course and the staff is very friendly. I make it a point to smile at my servers every time I'm in. They look like they are working very hard. I hope they are paid equal to their service.

Was happy to have this new Dunkin' Donuts arrive in my neighborhood. If I use my AARP card I receive a free doughnut with a medium or large purchase of a drink. The employees are very friendly I've gotten to know them pretty well :-) and if they're out of a donut that you prefer sometimes they can make it on the spot for you you just have to wait a few minutes :-)

Not the Dunkin Donuts that everyone remembers.

Two tiny shelves of stale donuts...I guess when the grocer is selling your way overpriced coffee like gangbusters, you can forget what got you there in the first place.
Quick service, but the selection of donuts is lacking at 7:30am. You'd think they would be fully stocked and ready to go.

So I went to this place a few times.  

The donuts are Ok, they are donuts nothing special.  
In reality I would rather go pick up donuts from QT gas station (with coffee, read below).  

Another thing that killed this place for me, is they don't know how to make ICED COFFEE.  I prefer iced coffee when the weather is hot/warm which in Arizona is frequent.  So I will order ice coffee with cream and sugar.  Ok anyone who likes iced coffee know if you use a granulated sugar product you add that into HOT coffee. 
Apparently the people who made my iced coffee drinks didn't know that.  I got iced coffee with a thick layer of sugar at the bottom of my cup.    

Not just once, or twice, but THREE TIMES.
The first time I said ok just a mistake, give a try one more time.  Second time I figured they didn't know how to make iced coffee so I was done.     

I got a coupon for a free coffee, so I used it got an iced coffee (the free made me forget that it's horrible even when free).  Took one sip and ended up throwing it away in the trash can right outside the door.

McDonalds has better coffee.
QT gas stations have better coffee.

Also selection on both donuts and bagels are very limited no matter what time you go in.  

People are nice, but their iced coffee making skills are horrible.  

Drive a few more blocks and go to Bosa Donuts on Indian School around 36th Street.
Better products, and it does not take for ever to turn out of the parking lot.
The food and price was exceptionally good, I was excited due to my hometown not having more than one dunkin donuts within 20miles from my house but the service could have been friendlier.

at this Dunkin Donuts they definitely take care of the drive thru before the walk ups. Everytime I come in here there are at least 3 or 4 cars that were in the drive thru as I walk in that are driving out f the drive thru before I even get served. I'm a honestly never come back to this location. It happens every single time I come here and it just happened again today right now. It's really aggravating when you have two clerks who are working their asses off to get the drive thru taken care of While totally blowing off the walk up people.
Best Coffee and Donuts.  It's Dunkin' not much else to say.

We have been there a few times for coffee. The coffee is very good. The customer service is good. The price is great compared to Starbuck's and the drive through is quick and easy. One night we stopped by for decaf. After staying awake until 2 am, I realized that the coffee was caffeinated. That was not so good. 

The donuts are terrible. They don't taste like what I remember as a kid. There was no depth to the cake donut and it was super light and spongy. Not what I think of when it comes to a cake donut. On top of it, the donut tasted like chemicals. I'm not sure if it was the frosting. It certainly did not have that homemade taste. Wishell's on McDowell is much better.
The drive-thru open until 9pm, but the in-store service closed at 8pm.  Haven't had a chance of trying it out, will do it hopefully soon.

My coworker and I have had to come here the past few days because our local Starbucks is under construction and has been quite undependable! We are more than satisfied with the available food and coffee choices. I also like that there is no line and both times, the employees have been very courteous- especially for 4:30 am! Thanks for coming through for us by helpin us with our caffeine and early morn food fix! WE APPRECIATE YOU, DD!
Thanks for the big ball of raw dough bagel this morning :( wish I noticed that before I got to work for my 10hr day.

Sadly, and sadly because I try not to eat out, this is on my way to work :P

They always get my order right and there is rarely ever a line if you get there before the 8 oclock rush. 

I'm from Chicago and we're Dunkin Donuts originals, all old, all dinky but good donuts. This location is really quite nice and modern! 

Go team! haha

I like dunkin'  but the service sucks ..  The cashier was rude but I would be too if I had that job. 




She messed up on our order didn't go back to change it because it would've been a waste of time she probably would've messed up on that as well. 

Just left dunkin' 20min ago!

I'm actually tempted to give this Dunkin' Donuts 4 stars for the drive thru alone... but it is a chain and aside from the drive thru, there isn't anything that special or unique about it.  So, three stars it is.

I've actually never been inside this location.  I've driven thru a handful of times for coffee and/or munchkins and I've always been pleased with the consistency of the product and ease / speed of pulling up to the window and placing my order to getting that first sip / bite!

Last visit I had my dog with me and the girl working gave me an extra munchkin as a treat... so sweet!
I wake up with a smile knowing I'll soon have a cup of their delicious coffee.

This is the best one in the area. Iced coffee is OVERLOADED with ice, but coffee is always on point and the service is good. I'm from the East and the consistency leaves something to be desired out here because I imagine they don't get the same amount of customers. Decaf coffee is almost ALWAYS cold at every DD I've been to. Ok, so make a new pot, don't steam old coffee, right? Nope, I get old steamed coffee so they can save time/money. This location will usually make a new pot without me requesting it and I appreciate that.

Before moving to university, this book shop pretty much defined what I thought student life would be like. Let me describe it to you.

Slightly archaic, dark and musty but in a good way, full of old books on subjects long forgotten and academic types leafing through thier dog- eared pages. 

Yup, I now realise that university studies are conducted with powerpoint slides and computers, but that is pretty much exactly what Tills Bookstore is like. And it really isnt as great as I might have hoped.

The atmosphere is of false intellegence, like the people who frequent it use the idea of looking smart in a second hand book store to feel smart. They really arent, especially when you see what Tills has or hasnt got to offer - a very poor range of books and those that you do want to buy are often in poor condition and bloody expensive.

I am massivly dissapointed with Tills, especially when it really is what I had expected and yet so much worse. There are plenty more and better academic second hand bookshops in Edinburgh, but not quite as tantalisingly whimsicle.

Tired of going to the same old Waterstones? Tired of paying a fortune for books in Blackwells? Then Till's Bookshop, an independent second hand book shop is the place for you! As someone who loves to read, and always is in the habit of looking in at independent book shops and then ending up buying books upon books I can certainly say that Till's is one of the best book shops I have been in. 

Just at the edge of the Meadows, Till's stores a range second hand books (ideal for students), but also stores signed books, and most recently, film posters. I have picked up a quite a few second hand books in politics for some additionally reading for my course and were very reasonable. 

If you want to get lost in a world of second hand books then this is the book shop to do it in, furthermore it is a shop which has been visited by some of Edinburgh's best writers including Ian Rankin!

I discovered this little bookshop while taking a bus ride up to my campus at Marchmont. I made it a priority to go and visit this little bookshop and was not disappointed. There are so many different types of books on anything you can imagine, Fantasy, History, Self Help, Poetry, Supernatural, Biography, Gardening, Languages, etc. I managed to lose myself in the bookshop for a good 2 hours just wandering around and it isn't even that big. There is also a lovely coal burning fire in the back room, which is lovely on a cold winters day! It is ery reasonably priced and has an absolutely fantastic collection of Fantasy Fiction books. Definitely a must see.
It is a Starbucks. Enough said! ... well, kind of  - this is a super high volume - 24 hour - non-stop machine!   Good service, good employees, but still Starbucks.

Very disappointing. A friend went on the drive-thru to get drinks. When she got here & I tasted it, it was TERRIBLE. We immediately called & was told there was nothing they could do. I tried a new drink & the venti size was over $7. What happened to "they'll remake it"?

Here's the thing: I love Starbucks. I get at least 3 lattes everyday and use the Internet access. At this Starbucks the Internet wasn't working, the electrical outlets didn't work, and it was so dirty I didn't wanna sit down. I went to the starbucks down the street and was much happier.

Unorganized. Nobody is making coffee constantly. Just busy to taking order. It takes forever to get a coffe. Employee spilled coffee on my clothes she said sorry(didn't even look at me) and just disappeared. Really? Worst service ever!!!

SO SLOW! I'm stuck in drive thuru line for 20mins now. Order taking girl doesn't even know what she's saying and takes forever to complete orders. It happens ALL THE TIME at this location.. Why? I saw 7 people working on the same shift... Not many customers... But WHY?? Are they all idiots???

Ill give them four stars because I like this location. Been coming here for years. Since 2010. and its always good. 
  except lately its been a lil slower than usual in front counter. Drive thru is always fast. But today i asked for an iced coffee with cream and sweetner. I recieve it but with no sweetner. :/ customer service was friendly

Coffee...... What can I say? They are great at their jobs and at 2AM  I NEED COFFEE.. I am spoiled and cant drink the Circle K Crap, so a 24 hour Starbucks is what I need.  I have been going here for over 7 years. I have seen staff change, managers change, but they always make my drink right and are pleasant to see when I go into the store.
There is a lot of Asian over here ;) always a lot of plp overs here 24/7 ;) love it anyway service are good plp r nice, great store

This is a funky Starbucks, but the closest to my work. 
Not my favorite one, I have to admit.
The crew is always smiling and pleasant enough. 
But they do seem to be training people a lot. Maybe high turnover?

Some people go to coffee shops to study, work, socialize, whatever...  I go to them get some caffeine, and it is usually when I am headed to work. So for me, the faster I can get in and out, the better... 

This is why a Starbucks with a drive-thru will almost always get more stars from me then ones without. And this location has a drive-thru. This location also has cheerful employees. 

If you do want to go inside, as other reviewers mentioned parking can be rough if you try to park up front... There is ample parking in back though.

I LOVE that this Starbucks is open 24 hours AND it has a drive thru.  Definitely needed in Vegas.  The staff was friendly, efficient, and timely and that was at 11pm.  It was refreshing to see such hardworkers that enjoy their jobs.  Nothing is wrong with having fun as long as you're working at the same time.
20 minutes wait ......... Waiting waiting ..... 1 person at the cashier, 1 for drive thru and 1 making drinks. Smh!!! Avoid this place if you don't feel waiting 20-30 minutes waiting

I just went to starbucks drive thru (Feb.9.2015 Tuesday 9pm) service was sucks
I ordered 2 coffees.
I waited in drive thru lane about 20mins. There was only 2cars front of me. When it my turns, she handed to me one coffee and my coffee was leaking. so she superimposed another plastic cup. My grande cup was sticky all over. Alright. That's fine I have napkins in my car. so it's ok. This could be happen. However, I was expecting she hand to me my second coffee. But she look at me head to toe as forbiddingly. She looked at me like I'm from another planet. So I asked her where's my second coffee? And she says There's no second coffee for you. wth? I ordered by phone and paid already. I showed her receipt whichs I already paid. After that,she don't apologize or says something and just handed to me second coffee with very ugly mad face. Well,bad experience with starbucks. I don't care it was her training,or she was mad at something. Im mad Why she ruin my feelings. And my coffee is still leaking
Every single time I go to this location on the way to work, the line for the drive thru is insanely long and slow paced! They need to step up their game big time!

This coffee shop isn't much different than the other Starbucks locations I've been to. I only went in twice- Friday night I stopped by to get an Iced White Mocha just to quench my thirst before getting on the bus. I've noticed a few customers inside. 

Blame the scorching 105 degree heat! At least it's peaceful inside. Anyway, thank God for Starbucks at the Boulder Crossing!

Probably the worst service I have ever had from a Starbucks.

I ordered  a VENTI Sparkling Berry Sangria with Herbal Tea.

It took them about 7 minutes to make it. And when they gave it to me, it was half full with the drink and the other half was with foam.

They said "that's how it is!"

They refilled it after I complained but then gave it back to me without any ice. 

Horrible experience!!!
Does it really take 10 mins for a Frappuccino to wait in the drive thru line. Bad just bad
This Starbucks has the slowest staff running their drive thru..I've been in line for 20 minutes waiting, hire more people!!!!

Busy, busy, busy and the staff was doing their best, however, I don't believe I have ever been to a Starbucks as unclean as this.  Tables dirty, counter sticky and in general a mess.  You need to get a code to get in the bathroom, so I was expecting it to be clean, wow, the restroom made a truck stop look clean, trash all over the floor, no toilet paper, floor dirty.  What ever you do don't look behind the counter.  On a positive coffee was hot and despite the crowd it didn't take as look as I expected.

I love me some Starbucks but this location is such a hassle.

This is the closest Starbucks to my office so I don't have a choice but whoever decided on this location really didn't think of the customers. The drive-thru is tiny & fits about 5 cars and anything after that is blocking other parked vehicles so that itself is annoying. It's located in a very large shopping plaza but the plaza is overcrowded with other businesses and every corner is tight.

Waiting at the drive-thru has taken me as long as nearly half an hour for some coffee with only 5-6 cars waiting which makes no sense at all. Since bringing on more food items the coffee seems to be an afterthought which is crazy to me. Coffee should come first & get rid of all the overpriced food. (I will admit that the chocolate croissant is pretty damn amazing - served warm) but it should still be about the coffee. 

I love the green tea frap when it's hot or the white mocha when it's chilly. 

Customer service here has always been great but the location is really bad. If you're not crunched for time go to a different location.

I had just arrived to Vegas when I got to this Starbucks. I needed to get online and do some stuff before hitting the town. Much to my dismay, this place was really busy and packed! I couldn't believe how crazy it was in there. I didn't have a choice though, I had to wait it out until someone got up from their seat. There's a good amount of room to sit...if you can find a seat! So if you're looking for somewhere to go and get some work done, find a different Starbucks. I went here on two different occasions and it was the same both times. 

That said, the guy who took my order was cool, but the baristas looked like they wanted to shoot themselves. No personality, no interaction. I don't know if I blame them though because they must be going non-stop in that place. The guy dropped my panini on the floor, but he got me a new one no problem. Just the icing on the cake for this experience.

24 HOUR STARBUCKS! Not too far from the Vegas strip. Plenty of seating, plenty of plugs for laptops, etc. They even have plugs under the long couch/bench thing. This place is busy all night, which is probably the reason why its not the cleanest of Starbucks. Easy fix, hire more barista's, or ones that do not think they are too good to come out behind the counter and wipe down a table or two. In their defense, I could not see how the 3 working could find time to clean or stock the display case. Needs at least 4 people on staff at all times. Upper management needs to pay more attention to this location. Right now @ 12:30am, the line is 10 deep. Who knows how many in the drive through.

Nice mix of characters walking through. If your looking for an asian girlfriend or boyfriend, this is the place to be.  Kris Kristofferson walked in while I was there. If it was not him, he has a twin. 

Chris D. - 70 year olds on laptops talking about breast implants is WHY I WANT TO BE HERE. I love quirky, different people.
This location has mastered the art of no customer service.  The employees must be trained not to smile and avoid all eye contact. The wait for coffee here is loong.....

Super slow service. Don't come here. They had five people working on a Sunday morning. Zero people in the drive thru. Only one person was working the dine-in customers with 8 people in line. Three workers were waiting for the drive thru line just talking and doing nothing. The exact same thing happened on Saturday as well.

This is the closest starbucks to my work,  so its where i head for my last minute hot chocolate in the morning or if my boss wants one.  This location is great if your on the go because of he drive-thru featured at this location. 

Because it is on Tropicana, you are gonna have a small wait in a cramped location. The staff is super knowledgeable and pretty quick, but since it's on a main drag, visible from Tropicana, next to about 10 store's and the gym, and across the street from the park..it is constantly backed up. Because of the small layout and limited seating, this is not the ideal location to sit and just enjoy yourself with your friends-if you would like that type of scenario you should probably get your coffee to go. 

The staff makes good small talk if there not too busy, but it seems like the staff is always changing. They always make my order correctly, but I don't have a very challenging order - Hot Chocolate most of the time. 

Sometimes pan-handlers can take away from the experience, but eh whatcha gonna do?

Cheers!

~MikeB

I love this Starbucks and all the hard working staff, but today I ordered a light Chai tea latte, and it tasted and smelled sour. She remade it, they were packed, and it still smelled and tasted bad. This is not the first time I've received an expired product, but before it was a food item. I brought it to work, thinking I'm crazy and every one who smelled and tasted it thought the same. :(
I always have looked forward to my Friday Starbucks, but I think I will be going somewhere else.

Just waited 18 minutes for coffee , in the drive thru . 
Drive thru shouldn't be more than 5 minutes .. 
 I used to work at one . 
 If I wanted to sit around and wait I would of gone inside . 
 And no I will be late to work .. 
 Thanks Starbucks ..

*Always* super slow. No joke. Even when there may seem to be little to no other customers there, they are always insanely slow. I would go there before work in the morning and leave myself plenty of time to get coffee and make it to work, and I was still late to work a few times because I had to wait 20 or more minutes. They almost always screw up your order as well.
They have given me my stuff for free, multiple times, without me even asking, because either the wait was so long or they screwed up my order.
The *ONLY* reason to come to this location is because they have a drive thru and are open 24/7.
Usually less busy at 8am than the other Starbucks locations in Spring Valley and the drive thru is open again! Free wifi as usual and lots of place to sit.
Ordered three drinks and none were ready in order, several drinks for others in between. The inside was very humid. Everything tastes great.

TLDR: renovated facility; 24 hours (except 2a-4a) excluding drive thru sometimes), always busy, iffy customer service

Starbucks is attempting to go above and beyond the norm by upgrading its facilities and food options. With the new decor, added seating, and new grab and go island, this location is meeting the new norm with its chains. 

I love how this facility is 24 hours for my late night coffee fix or study space. Sometimes they close the interior from 2a-4a for cleaning, which is smart for any business, but they keep the drive-thru open. Because of their operating hours, I'm able to maximize my benefits for my gold card by getting copious amounts of coffees and teas with my free refills. 

The service is par and I get mixed reviews, but I mostly get great service. I always approach with a smile and I'm often reciprocated. The restrooms do need attention, but I guess it's just so busy in the drive thru that it's neglected. Maybe it's fixed around that 2am cleaning time. 

One thing I enjoy about Las Vegas is it's diversity and I definitely see the melting pot here. With its location close to the Strip, I always see a group of Ethiopians ritualistically drinking their coffee, the group of Koreans meeting up, and those group of flight attendants and taxi drivers. There are people from all walks of life enjoying a shared space. It makes me appreciate how far we have come as a society and what privilege we are allowed to enjoy.

Decided to give this place another chance. Ordered 3 fraps at the drive thru, got home and two of the tree tasted like they forgot to add the syrup. Tasted like bitter crap. This place seriously needs to reevaluate management and employees the fact that this place is branded with the Starbucks name is bad. After this visit we will never return to this location. I'll drive up to rainbow which is further but provides way better service.

This is 1 of 2 24 hour locations (not in a casino). The other is on Eastern. I love going here on my way to the strip. This is a very busy, but very efficient location. Great friendly service and my favorite drinks all night long. Free wifi too!

This Starbucks gets my order wrong at least 1 of 4 times. This is the closest one to my office so I go here often. My biggest gripe is that I don't want to have to check everything I got before I leave the store, if I get stuff for co-workers I am sure they don't want my gems in their drink.

This is a busy, well stocked, plenty of in/outdoor seating, friendly service place. Love coming here while my wife gets her hair done, and great place to settle with kidos. Thanks for the great service, and I will keep coming back when in the area.
I like this place because there are lots of people here. The internet connection is pretty good. I like to come here and work on my business. Thank you starbuck
Worker tells me there's a line of drinks ahead of me but yet he's wasting time chit chatting with a regular customer instead of making our drinks.
Worst service ever. So slow. Don't come here unless your ready to wait 30 min for an iced americano

Worst. Starbucks. Ever.  I've traveled extensively and been to my share of locations both home and abroad.  This location is easily the worst I've seen and experienced. 

The primary strike against this spot for me was the attitude I was given by the staff.  Perhaps a bit of customer service training might fix things?  

The drink I ordered was made incorrectly twice and took longer than it should have (both times).  Restroom was filthy and the clientele seem to be louder / more obnoxious than normal.

It's around the corner from my new apartment but I won't go back.  

Good luck to any who venture out there.

I happen to be a gold card member which means I go to Starbucks all the time. And usually to this Starbucks. I went in this morning and got an iced coffee. Stepped out to go to the Home Depot, which is across the street, to buy something really quick and came back to sit down and finish my coffee. Finished it and went back inside to get a refill. As a gold member you get free refills. Now I understand if couldn't get one because I left, for about 5 to 10 mins. But I was told that I have to stay inside the store in order to get a free refill. Now personally I think that's bs. What if I wanna sit outside??? Which I have done before! I have sat outside talking to my wife, gone back inside and gotten free refills. No where in the benefits does it say you have to stay inside the store to get a refill. Anyways, I just think that's pretty stupid. I should be able to step outside and enjoy my coffee and get a refill if I want to, there's a reason why they have tables outside. Just saying!!!

Came in on a busy Sunday night at 6pm and ordered a sandwich and tea. The tea came right away but the sandwich took a moment. So I asked and the woman behind the counter was great. She apologized and made it. Then I looked at it and, I ordered the bacon, egg and gooda ( yes I misspelled lol) sandwich but it was egg white and Turkey bacon. I stated and the girl was on point. She apologized and said I'm so sorry I heard wrong, were out of that. But take this one and I'll bring a similar one to you on the house. 

Why a 5 star review. Mistakes happen, were Human. Great service and customer skills is something different entirely. Rectifying a situation like this to me speaks volumes. 

Plus. I loved both sandwiches. Add ons for next visit lol

I visited on Sunday morning.  The drive thru was busy, so I went inside the store.  Not busy there, but still waited a very long time to get my coffee.  It tasted horrible, so I waited again to return it.  The staffing looked sufficient, they just didn't know what they were doing & didn't care.  Poor customer service, depressing vibe, just not worth it.  I will not return to this store & am trying to break my Starbucks habit in general.

Dude. What's up everytime drive thru?? It's like get an order and put the order through. Multi million dollar biz with automated operations just follow it. Let's get going and speed it up fellow coffee survivors.

Hey, it's Starbucks. The herpes sore is sure to pop up on every street corner of every city in every zip code of North America, right? This location is great because they're open 24 hours a day most days of the week....I think monday and...wednesday they close at 1 for some reason? Do call to confirm. The Wireless Internet is free for 2 hours daily with your Starbucks rewards card, though be mindful not to conduct sensitive business such as banking and whatnot as it is, after all, a public hotspot. I have fond memories of this place because of A) its proximity to the 24-Hr Fitness I used to frequent, perfect for a quick chai hit after a workout and B) it's a convenient after-hours spot, where I can do a bit of extra work on the laptop or read a book while zoning out to tunes before heading home. 

The thing is, I don't usually go here for coffee...it's all about ordering a lite chiffon, getting a vitamin water, bringing an overpriced Dave Matthews CD to the counter....and producing a couple Java Monster Irish green cans and staying for 6 hours. Weird looks from the staff, but hey, I'm a paying customer. 

Speaking of staff....I had some friends visiting from Portland and a shift manager at the time (wearing thick black horn-rimmed glasses, naturally -- the stripper heels of the barista industry) first mispronounced my friend's name and then started to phonetically make fun of her name, to much giggling from the girls at the counter, as he was calling out our order. I stepped up and called him on it in front of the packed house. He quickly apologized and said he didn't mean anything by it. 2 things in this life you don't EVER fuck with: 1) My friends and family 2) the latency of my broadband internet connection.  

Other than that, no big whoop really. Getting worked up over a Starbucks is dangerous, like thinking that she's gonna marry you after the first Reverse Cowgirl. Get over it and move on with life.

Mobile order was perfect.  Then when we got here we added a tall drip of the dark roast and they filled the cup to the rim. Yea!  Many places don't ask and then leave the cup 1/2 empty.  This is a small Starbucks.  Just wish they had some outdoor seating.

This location is convenient and has a good amount of indoor and outdoor seating. I came on a Sunday afternoon for a few hours to work on my laptop. A mistake was made on my drink (but for the record, they probably would have remade it if I asked them to).

My bigger concern was that while sitting there, I oversaw at least 3 guests screaming at the counter for various issues. The employees didn't empathize or apologize, they actually seemed to be completely disinterested. One employee was even laughing in the face of an upset guest (wrong).

I didn't have any big problems here and I hope I never do because, as I have witnessed, there is a big chance the employees wouldn't give a damn.

There arent many 24hrs Starbucks  so I decided to visit  the store around 11:30pm and I couldnt belieave only two very nice girls were running the whole place which both inside store and drive tru were packed with a big nice smile, helping and workimg as fast as possible. Great hard hob from bouth Miss Lisa and Amanda

I really don't like leaving bad reviews but this place has horrible service, dirty bathrooms, always out of paper towels and the heavier set lady who's name i forgot is always in a bad mood and giving me dirty looks every time. She either hates her job or is so well established in this place that she could care less about the service she provides. 

I go in the restroom and it is pretty filthy.
