Dr. Roffi quickly looked at the MRI results and flatly said, "You have a torn ACL.  The radiologist missed it.  You need surgery to replace your ACL with that of a cadaver.  It will necessitate removing your torn ACL and attaching a cadaver ACL by using screws to attach it to your femur and tibia".  He then told me to make an appointment for surgery at the front desk on my way out, which I did.  The surgery was scheduled for 3 weeks out.

I came home with a DVD copy of my MRI pics and loaded the images onto my computer.  I then started to research symptoms and photos of torn ACLs and torn MCLs and compared the photos online to my MRI photos.  I could clearly see a torn ACL in the online photos, but not in MY MRI pics.  Also I could clearly see a torn MCL in the online photos AND could see just as clearly the same tear in MY MCL in my MRI images. Also, my pain was not behind my knee cap, as it would be with a tear to the ACL, but was to the INSIDE of my knee cap which is consistent with an MCL tear.

I'm no Radiologist or Orthopedic Doctor, but I was pretty sure I did NOT have a torn ACL!  I invited a GP Doctor neighbor over to look at my MRI images, and he agreed that the tear was to my left MCL and NOT the ACL!

I made an appointment with a different Orthopedic Surgeon for a second opinion. I took my MRI images with me and he took a close look at the pictures and examined my left leg.  Before telling him of Dr. Roffi's diagnosis, I asked him what he thought.  He said that by looking at the MRI images alone, and by the location of my pain, it was an obvious tear to my left MCL.  He said the radiologist's report just confirmed it. 

This new doctor also said that the MCL will heal on its own with physical therapy and a knee brace and that surgery is not necessary!  He added that my ACL was FINE!  He ordered a special bendable knee brace for me as well as physical therapy 3 times a week for 3 to 4 weeks.  He told me to take anti-inflammatories daily and to use ice and/or heat on the affected area.  It has been 2 years and my knee is as good as new!

To think I almost trusted Dr. Roffi to do major surgery to my knee unnecessarily makes me SICK!!  His license should be revoked for life and he should not be practicing!  Patients Beware!

The only thing that this store has in common with Honest Ed's across the street is a rhyming first name.

Honest Ed's has hundreds of things you need.   Ted's has nothing you want.

The first time I walked in here,  I marveled at how a store could stock such ridiculously out-of-touch clothing while maintaining a price premium for their wacky curation of style.

The second time, I was completely ignored for ten minutes as the staff talked amongst themselves.

There will be no third time.

Went in yesterday for a look around with colleagues from CSI-Annex. Haven't bought anything yet but prompted to write a review for the great service. It is obvious that David, the owner, loves his work. With a fresh espresso in hand, he showed off the unique hand-tailored men's clothing. Next time I need to make a suit purchase this is the place I'm headed. Also, there's a crazy good selection of ties, bow-ties and cuff-links.

Bought my favourite suit there. get compliments every time I wear it..
A little pricey, but worth it.
 David was great. will be going back!

I buy all my cloths here. Its not the cheapest place in town, but David knows his stuff. He is also very talented at figuring out your style and putting together some awesome outfits. He has a great tailor onsite which means what ever you buy ends up fitting you like a glove (he sells gloves too). For longer shopping visits he will even make you an espresso or pour you a glass of wine. If you like fine clothes, this is the shop for you.

This place is the worst. I've gone in a few times always intending to make a purchase (it's conveniently located to my house) but most of the times I leave because of how much of a dick the owner is.  

How rude & shitty the owner is was a topic of brunch conversation for a group of my fiends the other day.  Turns out everyone hates Ted's Style Shoppe.

Lindsay pharmacy is horrible!!  15 minutes to get a prepackaged ZPACK with prescription in hand and not one other customer in the place??!!  They need to learn customer service!  One girl was too busy ringing up her own coffee than to help me get what I needed.

I love the Lindsay pharmacy, but the rest of the store is borderline harassment. Personally, I do enjoy customer service when ask and an occasional greeting when I walk in, but do you guys really have to ask me every time you walk by me on how you can help me find something? The store has at least 6 workers on any given day and that is 6 times in less than 10 - 15 min. I am being ask a question. Why would any one go into a store to be asked an abundance of questions when no one has asked. Do you think I can't find you if I did, I mean you guys are everywhere. 

Whoever the owner is or the manager who told these employees to be this obnoxious really may want to reconsider their greeting model. I plan on using the drive-thru from now on which means Walgreens ... I am not spending money in your store.

On 06/26/15, Walgreens corporate made the decision to close this pharmacy at 4 PM, five hours early. Which left customers unable to obtain their prescriptions. We attempted to get my prescriptions at another Walgreens but they were unable to fill them due to federal guidelines. Walgreens corporate made the decision to move the pharmacist from this location to another Walgreens that is 24 hours, which would make them more money. Walgreens corporate made a decision that that could end up causing them a lot of liability due to customers unable to obtain necessary life preserving and aiding medications. Customers were not notified that the store was going to be closing early and other Walgreens pharmacies could not help many customers in need of their prescriptions. We were unable to reach Walgreens corporate and there is no direct phone number to Walgreens corporate, just the normal 1-800 Walgreens number. Hopefully we'll be able to get my medications today when the pharmacy opens, but until then I am physically and mentally impacted because I am out of the medication that I need to function daily. Not having the medication that I needed to be able to take this morning is going to end up causing me to stay in bed for a few days to recover physically. Unfortunately, the Walgreens employees that had no say in the pharmacy closing had to deal with upset customers. We understand that no one at this actual physical Walgreens pharmacy made the decision to do this or had any authority to change Walgreens corporate decisions. My review is meant to reflect on Walgreens Corporate and I will be attempting to continue to contact them regarding this incident. We have been using Walgreens pharmacies since 2003 and I have multiple medical conditions that require medications multiple times throughout the day. Walgreens ends up receiving a lot of money due to the prescriptions I get filled there. We are now going to be going to be getting all of my prescriptions transferred to a pharmacy that is not Walgreens. The decision made by Walgreens corporate is unacceptable to us and completely irresponsible on their part. They seem to be more concerned about their profits rather then customer care. These types of decisions will end up impacting local Walgreens employees more than corporate due to having to explain corporate actions to customers. So not only does it show lack of concern for their customers, it shows lack of consideration for what their employees will have to deal with as a result of their decisions. I am completely appalled with Walgreens corporate at this time.

****Please understand that what I said was not a reflection of my local Walgreens pharmacy or the pharmacist at this location. The pharmacist at this location is very helpful and caring. My husband was able to promptly get my medication today when the pharmacy opened. But the actions yesterday, of closing the pharmacy that resulted in me being unable to obtain my medication, are currently affecting me physically. This will unfortunately continue to impact me the rest the week, along with impacting my family's lives as well.

Ta hell with CVS, I pick Walgrees every time - they don't make you carry around one of those ridiculous rewards cards.  

Always very friendly staff and they have a good selection of $1 candies for the movies, so I hit up this place before I head to the theater.

What an awful place ! Came here after work to try their wings that the ppl in Cleveland rave about and didn't even make it that far. We walk in and the energy is so dead , the bartender isn't friendly at all. She looks at us doesn't say a word then asks what we "need" before we sit down. My BF buys a beer and I get a water because at this point I wasn't planning on staying. She asks if he wants to start a tab and apparently you can't unless you have a credit card lol. So he pays cash for the beer. Then she walks away. We have to wait for her to come back to ask for the menu. She hands it to us and walks away again. Never comes back to take our order so we leave and don't say a word. I doubt she noticed. We went on Thursday night at about 6-630. Wont return.

I frequent this place most Saturday evenings/nights. The crowd is a good mix of young and old and the atmosphere is fairly casual. Hardly ever any problems. It's not a dive, but it's nothing fancy either. The staff is friendly, booze is fairly priced, and the 20 cent wings are definitely worth the trip.

Stoped by this place on fri 4-21-14
Was told must try the wings.
Good lil pub Guinness on tap good pour!
Bartender had a great smile & was attentive     
But the place was not busy for happy hr!
Ordered one dz hot & one doz garlic parm 
They were good sized wings but soaking in fry oil! So much it muted the flavor. The garlic parm were not tossed so the garlic & parm were just lying on top of the wings.  
"Would not recommend the wings"
Good neighborhood bar & good wings & food, but upset that they don't allow children anymore before "bar" time.
Good food and drink prices. Dig the vibes in this place! Bartenders are nice! I always have a good time when I go there! I would recommend the wings and burgers! Wishing they would have a taco night!

This bar has you wait for 2 hours to get your wings. when i complained about the bartender said there's a McDonalds down the street. 

The beers were warm.

I can't say enough good things about Jenny Oaks and the staff of All Things Embroidered. They are a joy to work with!
I first went to Jenny in late September with a rush situation. I not only needed some shirts embroidered for a trade show, I needed the logo digitized for stitching. There was nobody else in the east valley that would even consider doing the work, based on my time schedule of approx. 3 days. Although the shop was obviously busy, Jenny took a lot of time with me discussing the logo requirements, changing the letter sizing, selecting the appropriate thread, etc. We went through several revisions, which she "stitched out" each time for me to review. Once we settled on the final image, the work was completed a day ahead of initial schedule. As if that was not enough terrific service, she refused any expediting or rush fee. I offered several times, as a business owner myself I know what it is like to drop everything you are doing for that customer who planned poorly, yet she declined. 
The work was perfect and I have already gone back to All Things Embroidered a second time. I have also recommended them several times to colleagues who have asked about embroidery services.
Do not hesitate to work with Jenny and her crew!

Jenny Oaks, at All Things Embroidered, actually approached me at a Gilbert Small Business Alliance networking event and after finding out what I do for a living, shared with me some of the things that she has and can do to help me brand my business.

So after some delay, of course, I finally wandered in to see what she had in action.  My niche as an exterminator is UV light scorpion control.  Turns out she carries glow in the dark thread.  So I had my logo put on some caps.

I was mostly impressed by her initiative (and of course the quality of the finished item).  I shared her excitement as she told me what she could do with my branding, which shows some passion, not only for her work, but in representing her clients to the best of her wares and ability.

I can't wait to figure out nifty new ways to integrate the "glow" thread into my business apparel.

I had All things Embroidered  put my logo in some shirts and a jacket.

My logo is not easy to stitch the size I wanted so they made several samples of what they could do for me. When I found one I was happy with they found ways to make it even better.

I am a pretty cheap guy so I bought the shirts & Jacket somewhere else and just paid for them to embroider them.

WOW, I could not be happier with the quality. I have washed the shirts several times and  the stitching looks like new.

I would not hesitate to go to them again, in fact it is likely I will be having some lighter weight shirts made up for this summer soon.
Most expensive embroidery service in the Valley.  Call around and get other estimates.  This place was the most expensive out of 12 other embroidery services in the Valley.

I just had a new top installed on my '06 Miata.  The work was excellent.
I had no issues or problems scheduling the work and it was completed on schedule.  The price quoted was the price charged.  I am very satisfied.

I was in the market to have my leather seats repaired/replaced and honestly, I approached this shop cautiously due to the few lack of views.  I stopped by and Mike Peterson looked at my seats, went back to get cleaning materials, and showed me how with a little elbow grease much of the discoloration could be removed.  Be aware that the shop looks like it has not changed since the 50's. He probably spent 30 minutes basically showing me how to save money.  Even the options he provided were based on maximizing bang for the buck.

I returned a few weeks later.  In order not to minimize the time my care had to be unavailable, he removed my back seat and armrest.  I dropped off the car for the repair on the front seat as few days later.  I was very impressed with the results and the price.

I haven't use their service yet. I stopped by to see them, asking them to give me a price. The people in business are nice. On a convertible top estimated for a 1986 Chrysler Lebaron is higher from other places.To restore the front seat is right price. I gave them all my contacts information to reach me. I have emailed and called them several times, they told me they are very busy. I waited two months, they didn't let me know if they are ready to do my car. They seems not care to lose a customer, It is disappointing. I found other business that is happy to take my car for much less price. Sorry.....

I wish I could give more than 5 stars! Rudy and his team did such an amazing job with my car. The inside and outside were such a mess and it didn't even look like the same car when they were done, I was speechless. I had so many stains in my seats that I was convinced were never coming out from smoothies to who knows what else and they managed to get my interior (and exterior) looking good as new. I HIGHLY recommend this place.

Rudy runs a great shop. He's very professional and has impeccable customer service. 

I had a black 2006 convertible mustang in pretty bad shape brought in and they cleaned every detail, not just the obvious surfaces but the engine compartment, the collapsible hood compartment, the spare tire reservoir, etc. I really feel the car is clean and I'd recommend his services. It even smells new. 

Overall he charged me $500, to be honest I don't know if that's a competitive price or not, but I'm very happy with the services provided.

Rudy and his team did a phenomenal job detailing my car.  We have a bulldog that sheds a lot and they were able to successfully remove all the dog hairs that have been stuck to the interior for years.  I love that they also cleaned the outside of the car, it looks fantastic!  Rudy is very personable and you can tell he is passionate about what he does.  I would highly recommend them to anyone who is looking to get their car deep cleaned.

After being referred to Sport Auto Detail from my mechanic, I brought in my 1991 BMW 318is which I just purchased from across the country. The car was in great shape overall, but had not been properly cleaned and detailed in years. I was especially concerned about protecting the paint from the Arizona heat. 

Rudy, the owner of Sport Auto Detail, and his team did an incredible job of detailing the BMW for a very fair price. I was quoted at least $100 more from other shops around the valley. Rudy is very knowledgable and does not cut corners--he has been in the detailing business for 17 years. His team works on simple quick details up to $3,000 classic car jobs.

This Tempe location is relatively new so it does not have much a social media presence. They have more photos and details on their Facebook page if you want to see more examples. I recommend giving Rudy a call for your next detail!

This is the best detailing job I have ever had in 20 years, Incredible attention to detail! Given the amount of time they spent making the car look like new, the price was very low. I was expecting to pay more since they also prepare cars for Barrett Jackson auto shows. The owner Rudy is very friendly and has you do a walk around to see if anything is missed. Hats off to a job well done!

This is by far THE BEST detail job I've ever seen on any car. Usually I'm too cheap to spend the money to have my car detailed (lol) but, as I am putting my car up for sale,  I decided it would be a good investment. I was given Rudy's name from a friend so I decided to give him a try. I'm so glad I did!!!! My black car looks absolutely amazing!!!! I've never seen it look this good! Black is a very difficult car to work on and he did a magnificent job. I would not hesitate to recommend him to the most picky customer out there! I also had a couple of dents when I brought it in to him and he arranged to have someone come and fix those while it was at his shop. He did all of this in a timely manner all well keeping me notified on how long things will take. I couldn't believe that it took only a couple of days to do all of that work! Thank you so much Rudy!!!!!

I have a 2013 black Mercedez Benz.The owner Rudy at Sport auto did a great job. I was more concerned about my exterior but he also did the interior and even the engine compartment which used to be filthy. It is like having a new car again without the expense.They does detailing with a reasonable cost which can't be beat.I would highly recommend them. From now on I'll be there regular customer.

It was hard to find a place to detail my car, but after coming to this place I will never search again. Today was my first time brining my car, and when I picked it up it looked exactly like how it did when I purchased it! They are committed to their work and it shows! I will never take my car anywhere else again. If you need your car washed or detailed take it here!
I did the detail package for my Subaru WRX. Excellent job and professional altitude. Rudy is really nice guy and easy to work with.

Brought my new BMW to Rudy's shop as I always trust them. Originally was just planning to buff out bird shit mark but eventually I decided to go with a full detail. As summer is coming, I guess my car needs more protection on paint. Most importantly I knew Rudy would make my car look great. I set up appointment easily with Rudy, dropped off my car in the morning and came back after work. Although I knew they were going to do a great job, I was still amazed. It looks 10 times better than when I pick it up from BMW dealership. Literally like a showroom car. It totally made my day again. 

It's the real detail, everything you can think of is taken care of. They clean spots where other detail shops wouldn't even care. These guys are highly professional, and detail oriented. And they use good chemical stuff to make sure there's long term protection on the paint, and make the paint shines. 

Every penny worth it and I will come back.

I have a 97 Tacoma that I love but it is on the older side. I have cloth seats and a carpeted floor. After having spent part of winter in Oregon the carpet had absorbed a lot of snow melt and the truck was smelling. The guys at Sport auto did a great job. I was more concerned about my interior but I decided to go ahead and do a full detail. The outside looks great too! They even did the engine compartment which used to be filthy. It is like having a new car again without the expense. I would highly recommend them.

Sport Auto Detail has detailed my car for the overspray. all of the work they have done has turned out exactly as promised. My car look as new as the day I picked up from the dealer. The technicians are timely, polite, and professional in everything they do. Sport Auto Detail is an excellent high-end company to detail any vehicle at a fair price.

I've always owned black cars and can attest to how difficult it is to get a quality detail job that doesn't leave swirl marks. Sport Auto Detail did a phenomenal job making my black car look new again. Rudy not only did a great job he also went above and beyond to give me some additional tips on keeping my other cars in top notch condition. I would heartily recommend Sport Auto Detail for even the most difficult detail job. You won't be disappointed.

Rudy and his team has done an AMAZING job on my GTI. When I went to pick it up, I could tell how intense the shine was. Every pane on that car was glass smooth. They certainly exceed my exceptions. My car was detailed inside and out, engine bay looked brand new. I seriously think my car looks better than when I first picked it up from the dealership, minus the chips from normal wear and tear of course. There is no doubt in my mind this is one of the best places where you can still get a traditional auto detail for a reasonable price. You will not regret going here!

Only saw 1 review on Rudy's detail business on Yelp. Seeing having many years experience I gave it a shot. Couldn't be more satisfied! Rudy the owner, looked over my car and was very knowledgeable. I have a 2013 Black Camry that I was concerned about the smoothness of the finish and swirl marks that someone previously left. Rough feeling paint when it was still shiny. Rudy and his team clay barred, multiple polish and finished. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND his shop! Totally honest and highly experienced. I will be a repeat customer forever on and I drive from Fountain Hills! Back to black with deep rich color and stand out flakes. Right off the show room floor look! Thank you Rudy! Makes me want to "Dukes of Hazzard" across my hood! But won't lol. Leave it to Sport Auto Detail to do a great job!

Bajio makes me sing "Loco Gringos Like a Party." Okay, so Bajio isn't really where you go to party I was just compelled to use Rev. Horton Heat lyrics in this review. You could say it's like that old joke there's a party in your mouth and everyone's coming. Except it's the Bajio food that's making the party in your mouth... Um, where is this going?
 Bajio is *Krills! The brightly painted walls hold the enormous and very cool paintings (Prints?) on the walls, the weathered dangling lamps Bajio's decor makes you feel as though you should be in San Diego and not next to a Home Depot off of Flamingo. 
 When you get down to business and make your order the set up is that station style (like Subway) where you get to pick and chose the variety of beans, rice, meat, etc. Everything down to the sour cream is seasoned and that's what makes Bajio different from the other chains of Mexican food joints. It's not authentic but it's a place that you can prolly bring those who don't like Mexican food and they would eat it and you'd be happy to be there.  
 *Krills is street for Crack Rock.

I was a little pissy that I had to ditch my cousin and the volleyball game with UNLV for my mom and Home Depot to pick out paints for the house.    On the way to Home Depot we decided to get some dinner first.  Considering we always eat at buffets, casino restaurants, or at home we didn't know where to go and what restaurants were around Fort Apache and Flamingo.  

I spotted an orangey-yellow bright sign that said Bajio so I kindly suggested it to my family and there we were.  I didn't know what to expect.  I honestly thought it was a restaurant where people seat you and serve you.  It wasn't like that at all; it was a fast food joint.  I thought maybe it was just gonna be another Rubio's or Baja Fresh.  The interior was very modern with the light fixtures dangling down from the ceiling, plants all over the place, wall painted with warm colors, and tables and chairs lined up almost like a small version of a mall food court setting.  

When you reach the ordering station, the menu is actually painted on the wall.  Very interesting setting.  I was torn between the Mexican Pizza and Shrimp Tacos.  The Mexican Pizza had "a layer of rice and beans, with your choice of chicken, beef, or pork sandwiched between two crisp flour tortillas, smothered with enchilada sauce, melted cheese, salsa and sour cream".  As for the Shrimp Taco it had "Two 6" flour tortillas stuffed with shrimp sauteed in honey butter, topped with cheese and fresh mango salsa. Served with lime and your choice of rice and beans on the side."   Since it sounded so interesting, I decided to get them both.  I'm so glad I didn't just choose one.  They were both so yummy!  My mother chose the Nachos, "Crisp tortilla chips topped with melted Monterey jack and cheddar cheese, choice of rice and beans, chicken, beef or pork, and topped with salsa and sour cream."  As for my step-dad, he decided to get the Veggie Burrito, "Fresh-cooked 12" flour tortilla, wrapped with your choice of rice and beans, sour cream, guacamole, sauteed chile corn and caramelized sweet onions. Topped with enchilada sauce, salsa and cheese. Served with your choice of rice and beans on the side."  They were both very good but what I chose was better.

I was very impressed with the menu and the decor.  Only thing I wasn't impressed with was the girl that served us.  She got annoyed with my step dad coz he's some what hard of hearing.  So, you gotta SPEAK UP when you talk with him otherwise you'll just go back and forth with a puzzled look and "HUH?" questions left and right.  She told the another person to help us in the middle of helping us coz she got fed up repeating herself.  I think she hates her job!  But then again, there was a long ass line behind us and she was one of those people who can't handle pressure.  The guy she gave us to was a darling.  He was awesome with a smile.  I definitely will go back for him juz coz he was super duper nice.

We left Bajio satisfied and agreed to go back again sometime soon.  I think I'll take my cousins here next week so I can take pictures with them.  Mmmm, can't wait.

Who wants to stand around and read a menu on a wall and then stand around some more and wait for your subpar Mexican food to be cooked?  It wasn't even that busy when I went there, but I still stood there for over 5 minutes. I would never come here for lunch when it might be more crowded.  Who wants to spend their lunch hour standing around when they could have a more customer friendly system of ordering your food and then having it bring it to you?  They are going for that Subway-style watch them assemble your food vibe - but it just takes too long.

The mexican rice and black beans were the blandest I have ever tasted.  Not only did I pay the extra $1.79 for this worthless crap, but it was also included in my burrito where it totally killed any taste.  I would never go back to this place.

I enjoyed my food, but I was the only one in my party that did. Nice decor and pretty decent menu selection, but I have had far better mexican food before. I'm from So Calif, so it is hard to find good mexican when you travel, nothing tastes like home. I wouldn't return and if I was a local I wouldn't go out of my way to go to this restaurant again. Maybe my expectations are too high or their standards are too low.

This is a fast food Mexican chain similar to Chipotle or Cafe Rio. The pork burrito ($5.41) I tried had a sweet taste to it. Not as good as the pork burrito at Cafe Rio, but not bad. The size of it was comparable to those other places. It's a decent little fast food place, but if I had to choose among the three, my favorite would still be Cafe Rio.

2.5 Stars

Very quiet here (few people) & multiple times we've been here the same staffers have been here with consistency in both food & svc.  I should rate it higher but I don't eat Mexican that often out.  We actually were taken care of by the owner who was very pleasant.  He even checked on us & the other patrons.  We were entertained by his telling of some of his humorous work situation real life stories.  Oh, the food?  It's not bad $7.95 for a smoked beef salad with 2 sides & $7.95 for a shredded glazed chicken burrito.  We cared enough to share some of our marketing ideas with him.  See, we make the world go round.

Bajio is my favorite place for a yummy, quick, cheap dinner. I've gone at least once a week since I found out about the place. Their beef is delicious, and I just tried their sweet pork and am now a huge fan of it too! The only not-so-fabulous thing about Bajio is their rice. It's okay, but definitely not the greatest. Everything else is phenomenal though, and you can't beat the price; an enchilada with two sides and a taco with all the fixings for $7 and some change.

"Welcome to Bajios!" - That's what the people behind the counter exclaim as you walk through their door.

Bring a larger-than-life appetite or be prepared to take your left over food with you when you leave!

This place is clean, the service is top notch and the food is fresh and rather tasty!

My weapon of choice?  The Chicken Chimichanga: Lime Chicken, mexican rice, black beans, green sauce.  Then they toss it into the fryer right in front of you.

While the chimichanga is attaining crispiness, your pan is prepared: I choose more mexican rice, black beans, fajitas (onion, bell peppers) and the green sauce.

Once the chimichanga is done, they place it on your pan and adorn it with more green sauce (whatever salsa you choose), sour cream and guacamole.

With the chimichanga and drink it comes out to under $11.

Another worthy mention is that the ice in the ice machine is crushed ice... the good kind.

When you tip them, the person at the register yells "Propina!"  and the rest of the crew answers "Gracias!"

We frequent Bajios enough to where we know the servers and they are very friendly.

Good food here!  My beef tacos were awesome a lot of flavor in the smoked beef.  The sweet rice was OK not really my favorite but i wanted to try something new.  

Ill be back for sure.

Got my first spray tan a couple weeks ago because I'm taking some medication that doesn't let me lay out in the sun and being pale is no fun. I  tan pretty easily and was really worried about being blotchy or orange but they were super helpful here and I got so many compliments!

It's only $29 if you are a first timer too!  You can be in and out in 10 minutes too. I didn't use the San Tropez... I used the Bronzed product and loved it! Mine lasted around 10 days.. It doesn't come off very evenly but I hear thats with any spray tan.

I had only had one other airbrush tan before coming here.  Boy was there a difference!  I love the "self-contained" machine they use so that the spray is not getting everywhere.  Additionally, the service was very prompt and professional.  The method the gal used was also very thorough and covered every inch of my body.  Even hard areas like hands and feet were flawless.  The tan itself was natural and gorgeous.  I looked like I spent a week in the Carribbean-- not the Jersey Shore.  Love it and will def be returning in the future!!

Every time I go to Naked beauty I have a great experience! The staff is friendly, helpful and most importantly my tan always looks very natural! They are also very reasonably priced for an airbrush tan! I have been to other places that charged much more and they didn't do nearly as good of a job!

I have been going to Naked Beauty for over a year now, and would never consider going anywhere else. The quality of their tanning products are outstanding, the spray procedure is quick and painless, and the staff is extremely personal. Holly, the owner, is informative and accommodating to her business patrons in every possible way. Plus- I've never received so many compliments about my skin "glowing". I absolutely recommend visiting Naked Beauty if you are planning a trip, attending an important event, or if you simply want the UV-safe tan to enjoy for everyday life. You won't regret it!

This place is suppose to be a mall, but it more so like 5 stores all selling Steelers gear and a pizza place. The pizza place staff was pleasant, place was clean. I read the review for this place and was not willing to try, we were going to dinner in a hour but I was hungry now. So we decided to grab a slice and split it. It was ok, not the worst ever but surely not the best. Im from jersey/ny so pizza is very different. There was too much sauce and the sauce was not good, taste like from a can. Cheese was weird even though she put it in the oven to heat, the cheese on the pizza was still not melted. So not a fan but meh

DiSanto's is a good place to grab a quick bite on your lunch break. I eat here 2-3 times a week, and the food is decent. Jeff has different specials every day, ranging from pasta to Shepherds pie, or beef tips over noodles.

One thing that always delivers is the stuffed chicken, but the rest is hit-or-miss.
Poor excuse for pizza. Ordered 2 toppings which were tossed on & pizza slice not re-heated. Pizza was "dry".  Service was prompt.

Watched the women here handle money and touch your food with unwashed bare hands right in front of my eyes.  I had a sub - they pulled the meat from a steamy water bin and put it straight on the bun making it really soggy.  Was tempted to ask for my money back but just played through the pain.  The place just looks dirty and dingy. I'll never go here again.

This place isn't bad.  I think the pizza is decent.  The specials are hit or miss, but there is always something.  The people are friendly and get to know us "regulars".  He's a small business owner trying to make a few bucks. I stop here a couple times a week and have used his catering for office lunches.

The pizza and subs are excellent but I usually stray from the "lunch specials" because they are too expensive to be considered specials. 

You just can't charge a customer $11.00 for a handful of tater tots and four bites of chicken. Also why is white meat more expensive? That's tacky.

The pizza is not good at all. The pepperoni rolls are ok, but more than the food the people that work there are miserable and rude. It's not a pleasant experience at all. Most of the food is not good, however in a quick pinch and your sock of the other places to eat around here it's fine. Given other choices I would go somewhere else. Working in the building leaves you with limited option. It does appear pretty dirty.

Working for a company with offices at Station Square gives limited options for lunch and it's easy to grow tired of the selections. I like this pizza shop because you can get a decent slice and they offer a variety of daily specials to help rid of the same old, same old.
My 7year old daughter and I go for a pedicure every 2 weeks ... great staff, professional and clean

Very unorganized!!!!! They do not know how to work efficiently while busy. There's a lady with a tattoo in the middle of her chest who accommodated me. I came in for lip wax and the lady left wax on my face and hairs still behind. They initially wanted to do my service in the middle of the salon which I found very weird and uncomfortable because they were busy. I certainly will not be returning because of them being  unprofessional!!!!
Will not go back. 2 days later and my nails are already chipping and I got SNS nails that aren't supposed to chip for at least 2 weeks.

Great service, friendly staff, and affordable prices! This is the best nail salon in Gastonia. The salon is very nice and clean feeling. They do a great job with gel manicures. I won't go anywhere else.

Update as of October 31, 2016
TIna is the sweetest lady. She did an excellent job. I told her no one else can every touch my nails. Best days to come in us Monday's when it's not as busy. The atmosphere is so relaxing. The chairs massage my back so well. I love this place. Ask for Tina!!! She is off on Tuesdays.
Great place! Inside is huge and nice-they have 22 pedicure chairs. They are fast, nice, and did a great job on the gel mani I got.

I actually found somewhere that tries to get out my ingrown toenails! This is literally lifetime dream. I know I'm over exaggerating but I'm so happy. I'll update once I'm done with my pedicure with a picture. EDIT: they look great. Pola- is amazing! Ask for her!!!

The prices are on par with the area.  The spa is spacious and lovely.  The techs are friendly but the experience was pretty awful. My mom and I went together for mani/ pedis. We each had two techs working on us at the same time which is great for fast service but not very relaxing.  To make it worse the techs were talking and laughing with each other so that my mom and I could not even talk to each other.  They did this the entire time we were there My pedicure lasted very nicely but my fingernails chipped in two days.  I think there was too much polish thinner in the polish.  I'll give it another chance and hope the techs focus on customer service and not each other.

If I can give them a negative star, I would. Called them at 8:30AM to confirm my appointment,  as I mistakenly wrote down the appointment date in another calendar I don't have access to. So wanted to confirm, as I live very close by at Carlton and Ontario,and could have easily arrived on time.

I didn't receive a callback until 9:01AM. Then was told to rush in there in during rush hour traffic, and if I didn't get there within 20 mins they will cancel my  appointment. I Ubered there and arrived at 9:24AM, as my Uber driver got lost. Finally arrived, and was told I can't get my services with an insane amount of attitude from a blonde young lady 20's.

I was willing to use my benefits here too, as I have amazing coverage, but it's their loss. For $35 from Groupon, I've spent now $18 on Uber's to get here.
Be careful when you buy a groupon with them because they're gonna charged you more than 25% for the gratuities anyways

This establishment is affiliated with liberty clinic. This location is liberty clinic but Toronto colonic also uses their facilities from my understanding. I was very disappointed with the service I received from liberty clinic but Toronto colonics called and apologized  and cleared up any misunderstanding. I appreciate the receptionist from the Sheppard location offering to forward my concerns.

"Tell your friends if you like the food!"

Ok so the samosas are good and cheap. I will probably be back for those! If I only had samosas, I'd give 4 stars. Partially because you don't need a fork to eat them. 

But I ordered the Daal combo with curry, a samosa, rice, salad and a pop. And I didn't get a fork, or any napkins. Also, I wasn't given any salad. When I went back to acquire these lacking things, I was told I didn't pay for them. Ugh. 

When my meal was finally up to standard, and I was granted cutlery to consume it, I was under-impressed. The curry has a weird aftertaste, the rice was cooked with too much water and is falling apart, and the salad had a base of parsley. 

I had high hopes for this place, but since it's one of the only grange standards that is open on Sunday I'm sure it will do well. Just needs some fine-tuning.

I visit the grange when I want some cheap but filling food.

I just saw that the Curry Kitchen had recently opened (it used to be an extremely overpriced Greek place), so I decided to try their spiciest curry, which they said was the beef curry for $6.99.

It came in one of the usual take-out boxes, half filled with salad and half with rice + curry.

It was not what I expected, tasting like Chinese style curry (mild & non-spicy) as opposed to Indian style curry (rich, thick, spicy curry).  I did not taste any spiciness at all.  It wasn't bad by any means, but I can't say it was good.

Overall, I would say 2 Stars because the price point is high for the amount of food.

Compared to the other Curry places close by:
- Yueh Tung (2 blocks away) has a beef or chicken curry for $6.50, with 3x the amount of meat/rice.
- Quality is the same as Indian Biriyani House, at a slightly higher price point.
- Amaya Express (Urban Eatery @ Eaton Centre) is also much better, but slightly pricier at around $10.
- For authentic spicy Indian curry, go to Matagali Restaurant (but be aware price is essentially doubled at the $12 price point)

- I love this place! I always get a beef curry and salad- the flavors are really nice, the staff are really friendly, and they have a 13% student discount- so my meal comes to 8$ with a salad. One of my faves in the Grange :)

So, no one likes tax time, and when you're unsure about whether you're going to owe money or not, it makes it even more nerve wracking. But dealing with Sanford "Sandy", and his staff was an absolute pleasure- and I'm not just saying that because I ended up getting a refund.

After an unpleasant experience with H&R Block, I was a bit leery, but was able to easily make an appointment with Sandy, and his assistant was so friendly and pleasant that I was instantly put at ease. The office is a bit hard to find, but they gave great directions when I called and I still arrived a few minutes early.

Sandy saw me right on time and knew all of the deductions to help me get a refund and avoid an audit. Besides that, he was funny and personable and got me in and out in less than an hour. His fee was quite reasonable too! I will be happy to use him as my tax professional for years to come!

Last year I used an accountant named KELLY TATE.  He was absolutely horrible and submitted my taxes with the wrong social security number which caused me some strife with the IRS.
I was very fortunate to meet sandy who is a true professional.
I was referred to Sandy from several friends who have him do their taxes.  He is extremely affable and good natured person.  I liked him the minute I met him.  He understood that I am a tipped employee who needs special write offs.  He is a knowledgeable accountant and gave me a great return.  I will definitely recommend him to anyone who needs a good accountant.

Sandy has been doing my taxes for 5+ years and I would never go any place else, even though I have moved out of state!. He is knowledgeable, accurate and pleasant to work with. Diane in his office is wonderful as well.
Sandy is an amazing accountant, we've used him for the last 5 years and always gives us great advice.

This place is the best! The trainers are amazing and so are the workouts. Being an ex collegiate athlete the workouts are filled with intensity and depth. This program takes dedication and willpower like any program and they do w great job of keeping you on track with daily inspirational  videos and a weight loss bible you get to have forever. *disclaimer: make sure you have time and not too many prior obligations before the challenge - the challenge promotes a true lifestyle change you don't need extra obstacles trying to hold you back ! *

I had been searching for something to inspire me and kick me back into working out regularly and after having a baby 7 months earlier, I couldn't seem to get motivated. Then I had noticed a friend and his checkins on Facebook and thought 'I should try that....if he's seeing progress maybe it'll help me!'  I started seeing ads pop up on my page and it was the answer I needed! I joined right away. I didn't know what to expect when I arrived at my first workout. I was scared and nervous to get started working out but soon realized that my trainer (Regina was awesome, btw!) allowed us to go at our pace and kept us motivated and going. Soon, I had lost 3 lbs then another 4lbs and so on. I was getting so excited about my progress that I didn't want to fail and didn't want to eat anything that wasn't on the meal plan. The only thing I hated was that I hadn't completely lost what I needed to by week 5 and had to resort to an emergency diet. Thankfully it went by quickly. I have finished my challenge successfully and lost more than I needed to. I can't thank Kirk & Regina & crew enough for the motivation needed to get me psyched about working out again! Today, even though I've finished my challenge, I meal prepped like I had during the challenge and will be working out at 6am. I'm ready to continue my journey. Thanks Heroic Fitness!!!

If you can't get excited about going to the gym... maybe you are just going to the wrong gym! 

Let me tell you - incase you don't know from my reviews. I love fine dining and gastronomy in general... I hate to work out, I hate athletics and I hate sweating, sneakers, etc... If you look up "indoor girl" in the dictionary = my photo!  

BUT I actually look forward to going to the gym now. I miss it if I don't go. The work outs are different every single day and the circuit moves quickly, so you never get bored and there are people of every size and shape at every fitness level, so you never feel out of place.

They do a 6 week challenge that you can be part of and if you lose 20lbs in 6 weeks, it's free - you get your money back. If you follow the plan and do the work outs, you'll lose the weight.

But you can just come to the gym for work outs too, you don't have to do the challenge. It's located in Area 51 which I'd been to before for acting or screenwriting meetups - there is always parking on the street or in the lot and it's pretty easy to get to from any part of town.

They offer work outs at many times too - I go to the 6pm, but they have a 7pm too and also morning ones.. i think 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9am - I am not a morning person, but good for you if you are. :)

Sylvester (the trainer at 6pm and 7pm) is very good, he pushes you but he also shows you the different ways to do the exercises if you can't do the most difficult version - so you never feel like you are left out or frustrated.

I recommend this gym for anyone who wants to learn to love working out or who is bored with just getting on the treadmill and watching tv while you run or walk...

I'd  like to say that at first I didn't know what expect when signing up for the Heroic Fitness Challenge.  Several friends had completed it and looked great after. Although I had a pretty good fitness routine and diet plan, life happens and I saw numbers on the scale I've never seen before. This was my motivation to do the 20lb challenge. It got me back on track with the meal plan, the workouts were fun but tough and there is a great sense of community at Heroic Fitness!
I'm proud to say I lost my 20lb!

There are lots of options for challenges, whether it is 10lbs, 20lbs, 5% body fat loss, so you can find that fits your goals.

Thanks Kirk and the whole Heroic Team

When I attended my orientation on October 29th before my challenge started, I had no idea what I was getting myself into.  But I did know that I was ready to make a change in my life.  After a cancer scare back in August, I had been desperately seeking ways to get back in shape.  I was ready to give up and just let myself go, when I saw the post on Facebook, seeking challengers for the next class.  I took a chance and attended the interest session.  While I was there I went through a series of emotions, doubt and worry, and questioned myself on whether or not I could actually do this.  I talked to Kirk Huggins Rogers who assured me that I would be fine, and answered all the questions that I could think of.  My primary concern at the time was not having to get up early, but Kirk told me he would make me a morning person (which I now am; I have no difficulty getting up anymore).  But when you get that nervous feeling of the unknown that lets you know you're doing the right thing, you just take that risk. I got that feeling and made the decision to make a change.  Over this six weeks, I didn't really have ups and downs, just ups AND I lost 22.8 pounds.  The trainers WILL keep you motivated, and they WILL challenge you, but it is worth every effort. You get out what you put in, and as long as you FTDI you will be successful!!!!  Thank you SO much for everything and this life change!! I will forever be grateful!!
I had PV Interiors out to clean and color seal our grout and the floors look better than I expected!  I will recommend them to my friends!

I called this company based on reviews I saw on Angie's List.  When I called I think I talked to a "Sharon" we started off ok and then things went south rapidly!!  I tried to explain to her that this property to look at was in escrow and that there was a lock box on the door which the realtor would give her the code to so she could gain access. Easy enough or so I thought.  She suddenly acted very put out and started quoting prices without even looking at the flooring -not to mention she couldn't  see the property for two weeks!!  Her blatant lack of enthusiasm and overall "sour attitude" led me to quickly end the conversation and move on..Maybe she was tired clearly she did not want or need my business...

After 6 years with 4 kids and 2 dogs, our tile was looking pretty rough so I decided to call Painted Valley Grout to see if they could help.  I'm so glad I called.  Painted Valley Grout just finished cleaning our tile and staining our grout and I couldn't be happier with the results. They did an amazing job and our tile looks like new again.  I was very impressed with their timeliness, professionalism, and work ethic.  I highly recommend Painted Valley Grout!

After receiving three estimates to refurbish our travertine tile floor, I decided to hire Painted Valley Grout. Their estimate was very competitive and Shannon arrived on time for our appointment. She recommended a light polish and a colored grout sealing. The crew arrived on the scheduled day and got right to work. I could not be more pleased with the results. The floor looks beautiful and I would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone.

This company is amazing.  I was seriously about to demo my tile floors because of the badly stained tile and grout even though I had just installed them five years prior.  I've had other companies simply try to clean the grout but Pv Interiors process of cleaning and then color sealing is far far superior.  They took my tile from being an eye sore to, literally, as good as new.  And, they were a pleasure to deal with.  Don't go anywhere else.

These guys are amazing. Our travertine floor was pretty dang dirty. It had been about 8 years since the last cleaning and sealing. They brought it back to looking brand new. The grout is the same color as when it was installed. We did not do the grout color sealing, just the scrubbing did the trick for us. I love my home again.

2 quotes total, the other was a biz already rated on Yelp.  I was turned off by the other b/c 1) overquoted my sq footage by 150 ft (he did a haphazard very quick laser beam test) 2) suddenly lost eye contact w/ me in determining the price and 3) everytime he talked to me (he followed up w/ me almost daily.. I'll give him credit for that), it seemed like he'd drop the price another $150-200.  By the end, after I thanked him for his time and told him I'm going somewhere else... he called me up an hour later and offered to undercut this company by $100.  By now, we were at 50% of his original quote... SHADY.  It's ok to make a profit and have some play, but constantly driving down your own price in high pressure tactics to get into the door just made me feel ripped off.

My dad is an indy contractor himself, so even w/ the undercut, I thanked him again, reconfirmed I've committed to someone else and couldn't do that to the other company.  Why I went here...  Owner Shannon quoted over the phone, price by sq footage (not a size-you-up-estimate).  When she came to actually measure, all the pricing was std and straightfwd and her good ol' tape measure was 150 sq ft less than the other guy (I did not even tell her about my experience w/ the other guy until the job was done)... I was impressed from beginning to end.  She worked around the other 5-6 contractor schedules I was juggling, with her and family coming in an doing the work directly.  As far as I can tell (since the other guy literally grilled me when I told him I'm passing), she was providing the same exact service and product for cleaning and re-sealing the grout.

What a difference when you choose to re-seal!  Years of grime has vanished under the protective coat (cleaning itself does not save the grout).  Shannon kindly left me some addtl silicone grout and leftover seal, as she knew I'll be needing touchups and addtl repair before all the contractors were done. 

Great customer service!
Love PV Interiors! Excellent work, professional friendly staff at competitive prices..

Loving how fabulous our carpets look and FEEL!!!
My husband has been remarking all evening about how efficient and thorough the guys were. The estimate was more then reasonable, based on the level of service, efficiency and thoroughness the techs (one of whom is actually the owner!?) provided. 
PV Interiors continually exceeds our expectations regarding our carpet and tile needs!!

So I have nothing but good things to say about Wayne and Shannon and PV Interiors.  

We hired them to clean the floors in our primary residence initially, and they did such a great job that we subequently hired them to clean the floors at my parents' house and at our rental. 

They are fast, prompt, professional, and do good work.  They took care to safeguard any wood furniture/cabinets they were working around.  The floors they cleaned were spotless when they were done, and we even discovered that the grout at my parents' place was actually an off-white instead of brown (which was the appearance after years of no cleaning).

The only caveat is that I can not speak to the quality of their tile installation work, because we did not utilize that portion of their services.

In summary, I highly recommend PV Interiors for your tile/grout cleaning needs and we will definitely use them again when the time comes.

I originally called Shannon to give me a quote for cleaning the tile floors and carpet in our current house and ended up using her services (first) at the new house. Such an amazing difference! I can't wait to see how the 'old' house cleans up! Outstanding!

Shannon and Wayne Erting are very professional, timely and do superb work.  They cleaned and repaired 1150 sq ft of travertine, used a high gloss, and grouted with very white grout.  And it looks fabulous!!!!! I absolutely love my floors and highly recommend Shannon and Wayne.

Absolutely amazing.  Can't say enough about Wayne and Shannon. Was prompt for appointment and the work they did was incredible. I can't believe the difference my tile looks like it was just installed.  I would highly recommend this company to anyone. Honest, hard working team of people
Food always freshly cooked and delivery generally very quick.

Mr. Rice is located to Mr. Chips as they're ran by the same owners. Mr. Rice is ok Chinese Food in Inverness but again just ok considering that I'm eating Chinese food in the most northern part of Scotland.  I would suggest ordering the chicken fried rice and the spring rolls.  As I'm use to American serving sizes be sure to order plenty of food  if your hungry.  I'm always a fan when the food is ok and the cost is low.

If u lime MSG coated gloopy food this is the place for you, if you have never tasted authentic Chinese food and enjoy paying for cheap rubbish ingredients, have no concept of what Cantonese food is and enjoy paying over the odds for it then this is the dive for you

I've been too three amigos in downtown a few times and I found that it was a lot different then the one in Laval.
The ambiance is very different of course the one in Laval was recently built and everything is new.
As for food, I didn't order the same things as the one in downtown and I don't wanna compare too much. Overall the food was good, I ordered vegetarian tacos and it was delicious but the salad was just some kind of lettuce with 3 strips of carrots and one olive. It was so disappointing. I also got non alcoholic drinks and they were very good. My friends daiquiri tasted better then the one I had (margarita). 

The waiter looked like he hated his job. He was not communicated at all with us. I asked him for nachos at the beginning and he said okay and left then I later discovered that in the menu there are several kinds of nachos.. Which one did he think I want? so I had to chase him and tell him before he gets me any kind of nachos.
As I was paying, I told him thank you have a nice day and he responded k thanks. Very very dry and honestly that really makes me not wanna go back.

I was expecting 3Amigos Downtown and I was soooo wrong ! It's not even Mexican food. I was extremely disappointed with the food. The service was good as well as the decor but what's the point of the food was bad.

This was my third and last time at a poor attempt at expanding a franchise. On a weekend evening the wait time is excessively long. Weekdays is the opposite, you get your table right away but your service is extremely slow. It took 15 min just to be served a glass of water and a simple hello. The waiter was totally out if his realm. He was confused, impolite, bad breath and couldn't even crack a smile. The food was served quickly as if it had been prepared in advanced and sitting under a heat lamp. Very bland chicken fajitas. Dry chicken with very small portions of condiments. All 4 of us did not like the service that evening and I for one will never be returning again. P.s. I heard there is a Carlos and Pepe's near by. I will give them a try instead.

Je tiens à m'excuser d'avance de ne pas avoir pris de photo...j'avais oublié mon téléphone sur mon bureau bref..passons à la critique..

Dîner de groupe entre collègues. Nous étions environs 25. Oui 25 c'est vraiment beaucoup...mais quand le restaurant n'a que 8 autres clients....Ils ont un menu très variées le midi, incluant soupe et café. La plupart des plats viennent avec salade et frites ou riz.

Quand je suis arrivé il y avait une dizaine de personne qui étaient déjà assi à notre table. Nous sommes arrivés (nous etions 5) et ensuite deux autres groupes de 5 qui sont arrivée, environs 5-10 minutes plus tard..Imaginez-vous que le serveur a été voir ceux qui sont arrivé après nous. Ils ont même eu leur soupe avant de venir de voir, et les gens qui étaient déjà la se fesait servir le repas principal. Je comprends ils sont arrivés avant, mais au moins nous dire que ce ne sera pas long ou qu'il s'en vient...mais non..

Le serveur est finalement arrivé, nous et un autre collegue avons commandé une bière. Nous l'avons reçu après la soupe en entrée. Un oeu long pour une simple bière, nous avons même du lui repéter. J'ai commandé un wrap au poulet avec du riz mexicain, j'ai bien aimé. Par contre, il fallait fouillé dans la salade pour trouver la vinaigrette. Le service de nourriture à quand même été rapide. Faut préciser qu'il y a comme 5 bussboy qui aide le serveur...

Les autres collègues on reçu leur café et les gens avec qui j'étais assis,  nous avons encore été oublié. On a attendu 10 min pour recevoir la facture, sans qu'il vienne nous voir. Une madame a même été payé au bar, car elle était tanné d'attendre. Je le voulais ce café, car manger du mexicain ça bourre!!! Mais non pas de café....la facture est arrivé. Un de mes collègues m'a dit: "ils nous ont même pas offert de café... "

Le serveur a entendue et me dit: "Vous aviez d'l'air pressée" Je me suis permis de lui dire...Quand nous attendons 10 min pour une facture, oui on est pressé car notre pause est terminé...

Bref, un 3 amigos à éviter.

My wife and I have eaten here in the past and the food was "meh". Last night we had a fantastic meal. Everything was full of flavor and tasted fantastic!  Sat down with the owner and he said they were in the process of a revamp! Well if the food gets any better... Wow!

If you have been here in the past and didn't enjoy it give it another try!
If you've been a patron of the downtown franchise, well this is carefully synonymous barring for the sad view of suburbia. Agreeing in food and being one the same service, this place is just ok.

We went to 3 Amigos in Laval. I understand that it's a long weekend and its busy.  But there is no excuse for bad service. People in the restaurant business are aware of how busy their establishment can get. They should have experienced staff working during busy hours. Our hostess was lost when she was trying to seat us. The waiter came and immediately told us he was going to give us a few minutes. I had to interrupt him to give our drink order. We got our drinks 25 minutes later and they STILL didn't take our food order. IT'S AS IF WE'RE INVISIBLE TO THE STAFF!  I was so upset I just left the restaurant.

Fünf Sterne gibt es von mir für das griechische Restaurant Hermes in Ostfildern-Kemnat. Über das Gutscheinbuch sind wir auf dieses Restaurant aufmerksam geworden und wurden nicht enttäuscht! Lage
Das Restaurant liegt mitten im Ostfildener Stadtteil Kemnat und ist somit gut erreichbar. Parkplätze findet man direkt (ausreichend) davor. Das Restaurant ansich ist im ersten Stock (im Erdgeschoss befinden sich die Toiletten). Restaurant
Das Restaurant ist sehr gemütlich und hell (große Fenster). Die Tische sind gut verteilt, so dass man nicht zu viel vom Gespräch des Tischs nebenan mitbekommt. Ein Salatbuffet (jeder Hauptgang hat einen Salat dabei!) ist ebenfalls im Restaurant aufgestellt. Das Restaurant verfügt auch über eine Terrasse  diese befindet sich im Erdgeschoss und lädt sicherlich zum gemütlichen Genießen & Verweilen ein (aufgrund des Wetters konnten wir diese leider nicht nutzen). Essen
Die Speisekarte ist umfangreich und jeder Gast sollte hier fündig werden. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist mehr als nur angemessen! Die Preise sind human und die Qualität ist 1A. Von Vorspeisen über Hauptgerichte mit Schwein, Rind, Pute oder Fisch bis zum Nachtisch gibt es alles.
Als Vorspeise hatten wir das Tzatziki (sehr lecker und angenehme Dosierung mit Knoblauch) und das Knoblauchbrot, welches auch sehr lecker war. Auch die schwarzen Oliven schmecken hervorragend und sich nicht vergleichbar mit Oliven aus dem Glas! Alle drei Vorspeisen können wir nur empfehlen. 
Als Hauptgang hatten dann mein Freund das Bifteki mit Reis und Salat (wie vorhin erwähnt vom Salatbuffet) (Preis ca. 10,40EUR) und ich das Souvlaki mit Reis und Tzatziki und einem Salat vom Salatbuffet (ich glaube 9,60EUR oder so ähnlich). Das Salatbuffet war (entgegen anderer Meinungen hier) sehr gut und meiner Meinung nach ist ein Salatbuffet auch besser als ein Standardsalatteller. Beim Buffet kann man sich wirklich nur die Salate nehmen, die man auch wirklich mag. So gab es z.B. grüner Salat, Tomaten, Gurken, Krautsalat, Bohnen, Mais, Karotte und einen sehr leckeren griechischen Kartoffelsalat. Zwei Salatsoßen und Essig/Öl-Dressing rundeten das Salatbuffet ab. Getränke
Die Getränkekarte ist umfangreich und beinhaltet leckere griechische Weine. Wir entschieden uns für ein Mineralwasser und den Imiglikos rosé. Der Imiglikos war wie das Wasser auch gut temperiert und schmeckte sehr lecker :-) Personal
Wow, so eine Gastfreundschaft und Freundlichkeit haben wir schon lange nicht mehr erlebt! Der Chef, der auch (unserer Meinung nach) alles rund um den Gast managt, war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Es entstand im gesamten Restaurant eine nette, familiäre Atmosphäre  einfach griechisch nett. Während wir gegessen haben verteilte der Chef mit seinem Tablett Ouzo an die Gäste. Der Ouzo war gut gekühlt, schmeckte sehr lecker und war nicht (wie so oft in griechischen Restaurantsleider) verdünnt :-) Von daher war dies ein sehr leckerer Abschluss unseres Essens. Nach dem Bezahlen wurden wir mit einem Handschlag verabschiedet  dies trug zu unserem sehr guten Eindruck bei! Für mich zeigt diese Geste, dass dem Inhaber die Gäste wichtig sind. Schließlich ist ein Gast nur ein guter Gast, wenn er wieder kommt. Und das werden wir auf jeden Fall. Das Hermes in Kemnat wird ab sofort unser Stamm-Grieche, denn kein Restaurant in Esslingen kann hier mithalten. Wir freuen uns schon auf den nächsten griechischen Abend im Hermes. (=Tschüß) Hermes und bis zum nächsten Mal!

Wir hatten einfach mal wieder Lust, griechisch Essen zu gehen ... und da sind wir durch Zufall hier zum Restaurant Hermes gekommen.
 
Und ich muss sagen, lecker wars.
 
Besonders das Zaziki, einfach gigantisch lecker.
 
Auch das Bifteki, das ich gegessen haben, sehr lecker. Mein Freund hatte eine gemischte Grillplatte, es war alles drauf, was drauf gehört!
 
Mittlerweile waren wir schon mehrfach hier Essen; und ich muss sagen, wir wurden von Anfang an mit Handschlag begrüßt! Sehr angenehm.

Griechenland pur-könnte man fast glauben, der Chef ist sowas von bemüht und freundlich- man glaubt nicht in Deutschland zu sein.
Was auf den Tisch kommt-lecker ob Lamm die Spezialität des Hauses oder Fisch. Egal du triffst immer ins Schwarze. ...aber Leute nicht weitersagen..sonst bekomme ich das nächste Mal keinen Platz......

she gastfreundlicher Besitzer Christo. Der typische Ouzo beim Griechen als Aperitif fehlt hier auch nicht.. Ob Fisch, Fleisch oder Vegetarisch für jeden ist etwas dabei, schmeckt echt fein. Typisch griechisches Ambiente, was die Musik angeht und die klassische Einrichtung. Lohnt sich!

Klasse Essen, super freundlicher Chef, der auch selbst bedient. Wir konnten gar nicht verstehen, dass außer unsrem nur noch zwei weitere Tische besetzt waren. Lag vielleicht dran, dass es mittags war? Oder ist das Restaurant doch ein Geheimtipp? Preislich war es für Stuttgarter Verhältnisse auch schwer in Ordnung.

Spontan beschlossen wir essen zu gehen und entschieden uns für griechisch...
 
Vor dem Haus gibt es ausreichend Parkplätze.
 
Die Begrüßung war sehr freundlich und wir wurden direkt an einen Tisch gebracht.
 
Obwohl es dann nach und nach voller wurde, war der Service weiterhin schnell und aufmerksam.
 
Die Tische dort sind etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig. Die Beinfreiheit ist durch einen komischen Balken an den Tischen eingeschränkt. Sonst ist es sehr gemütlich.
 
Die Karte beinhaltet alle nur erdenklichen griechischen Gerichte.
Wer hier nichts findet ist selber schuld :-)
 
Sowohl Getränke als auch das Essen wurden schnell gebracht.
Die Vorspeisen: Gebackene Zucchini und Feta im Blätterteig, beides sehr lecker.
 
Hauptspeise: 2x Athen-Teller mit extra Tsatsiki.
Sehr lecker, jedoch hätte das Hackfleisch etwas länger gegart werden können, es war noch leicht rosa innen, leider nicht so ganz mein Fall.
 
Nachtisch: Galaktobouriko --)Eiercreme im Blätterteigmantel & Vanilleeis.
Die Kombination zwischen Blätterteig, Eiercreme, Vanilleeis und Lebkuchenmischung und Schokosoße war sehr gelungen.
 
Zum Abschluss gab es dann noch einen Ouzo auf's Haus.
 
Zum weiterempfehlen...

Allgemein
Allgemein ist das Lokal nicht zu empfehlen, das Essen ist nicht besonders, auch wenn es nicht all zu teuer ist, stimmt das Preis/Leistungsverhältnis nicht. Die Bedienung hat zudem gedrängeld und altes Brot serviert, am schluss gab es kein Ouzo wie sonst üblich.
Bedienung
Mittelmäßige Bedienung, nicht besonders freundlich aber auch nicht besonders negativ. Nur das mehrfache Drängeln zu beginn, sich eine Speise auszusuchen, war störend.
Das Essen
Sehr enttäuschend war das uralte Brot das serviert wurde, es war nicht mehr genießbar. Der Vorspeisenteller war ebenfalls eher nicht zu empfehlen, und das Hauptgericht war lieblos angerichtet (Gyros überbacken mit Käse). Es war einfach eine Scheibe Käse auf Gyros mit Tomatensoße, die sehr an den Geschmack von Fastfood erinnerte. Meine Frau hatte Bauernplatte, mit angebranntem Gyros. Der obligatorische Ouzo nach dem Essen wurde uns auch verwehrt, vermutlich weil wir mit einem Schlemmer-Gutscheinbuch da waren?! Wir werden mit Sicherheit nicht mehr dort essen gehen, und können den Laden kienesfalls weiterempfehlen.
Das Ambiente
Ambiente war ok. Altes Fachwerkhaus mit uriger Außenfassade, innen eher rustikal. Wohlfühlatmosphäre würde ich es aber nicht nennen.
Sauberkeit
Durchschnittlich, nichts zu meckern aber auch kein Highlight

Das Restaurant Hermes ist ein typisches griechisches Restaurant, wie man es in einer Vorstadt erwartet. Jetzt kein super tolles Restaurant oder der Geheimtipp schlechthin, aber man kann bedenkenlos hin, wenn man Hunger hat und einen Grieche mit einem guten Preis-Leistungsverhältnis sucht.
Die Gaststube ist rustikal, der Service flott und zuvorkommend und das Essen lecker und reichlich. Würden wir wieder kommen? Definitiv ja.

Wenn man zum Griechen will kommt man oft nicht an. Aber hier schon.
Schönes griechisches Restaurant im beschaulichen Ostfildener Ortsteil Kemnat. Das Restaurant befindet sich in einem gepflegten Fachwerkhaus an der Hauptstrasse in Kemnat. Parkplätze sind ausreichend vor und hinter dem Haus. Das Restaurant selbst befindet sich im ersten Obergeschoss und ist sehr gemütlich im rustikalen Stiel eingerichtet. Viel dunkles Holz kombiniert mit einem weissen Rauputz das den Raum ein angenehmes Ambiente gibt prägen den Raum. Ein Kachelofen in der Mitte des Restaurants passt sich wunderschön an. Die Tischdeko ist schlicht weiß und Mintgrün ohne viel Tam Tam wie mans vom Griechen kennt. Auffallend waren frische Blumen auf dem Tisch. Die Toiletten sind im Erdgeschoss und sauber, so kann man das auch im Restaurant sehen.
Die Speise .- und Getränkekarte ist schön aufgemacht nund bietet eine schöne Auswahl an griechischen Speisen und Getränken. Die Weine sind einfach und sehr gut. Die Qualität stimmt auch hier. Das Essen selbst ist hervorragend gewürzt und frisch. Eine kleine Salatbar wird zu dem angebot die man nutzen kann oder nicht. Den griechischen Bauernsalat sollte man aber aus der Karte nehmen. Der Chef bedient hier noch selbst und das merkt man auch. Ein aufgeschlossener und freundlicher junger Gastgeber
Wir kommen immer wieder gerne hier her. Die griechischen Platten sind Super. Und der Wirt ist einfach spitze.

Das Hermes ist eine Empfehlung wert. Es liegt etwas außerhalb von Stuttgart jedoch lohnt sich die Fahrt nach Ostfildern-Kemnat. Ob Fisch, Fleisch oder Vegetarisch für jeden ist etwas dabei! Das Lokal ist für kleine wie auch für große Anlässe geeignet und natürlich auch für den Hunger zwischendurch. Das Ambiente ist klassisch, halt wie in einer griechischen Taverne. Im Hintergrund spielt in angenehmer Lautstärke typisch griechische Musik. Wer die Hellenen mag, wird das Hermes und seinen freundlichen Betreiber Christo mögen.

Guter Grieche mit allem Was man braucht! Olympia Teller, Gyros, Pita, Tsatsiki etc. etc. ...Salatbar ist OK und kostenfrei dabei. Besonders zu empfehlen ist Gyros und Bauern Teller. Griechisch zum verlieben!

Hallo,
Hermes ist unser aller Lieblingsgrieche. Wenn Grieche dann nur nach Kemnat.Man sitzt sehr gemütlich und das Essen ist einfach traumhaft. 
Es gibt eine Salatbar, wo man sich seinen Salat selbst zusammenstellen kann . Die Vrospeisen egal ob Tsatsiki oder Taramas oder Weinblätter, einfach lecker. Die Hauptgerichte sind exellent und werden von der Cheffin in der Küche mit Liebe zubreitet.  Bedient wird man vom Chef persönlich. Er ist einfach super, immer fröhlich, gut gelaunt und es geht alles immer schnell egal wie voll es ist. 
Im Sommer gibt es eine schöne Gartenwirtschaft.
Wenn griechisch, dann nach Kemnat zu HERMES
Gemütlicher Grieche mit schönem Ambiente und netter Bedienung. Essen ist ok, die Karte lässt keine Wünsche offenalles in allem eine gute Adresse.

Wir waren mit einem 2:1 Gutschein hier - hat super funktioniert. Sehr und ich meine wirklich sehr netter Service. Superwitziger Kellner und auch der Chef sehr freundlich. So ein leckeres Lamm habe ich noch nie gegessen und ich mag eigentlich Lamm nicht so sehr. Das Gyros - ein Traum. Keine Knorpel und nicht zu viel Fett. Zart und saftig. Wir waren begeistert und kommen  wieder!

If you're looking for a good Greek good at a reasonable price and good customer service Hermes is the restaurant for you. We have eaten here 3 times and it's our go to for Greek food. The hot feta cheese plate is delicious. And the plates (like the Gyro) comes with a salad which is a sweet surprise. The owners are what really make this restaurant. Very friendly and out to give you great customer service.

Sehr Gastfreundlicher Besitzer, jeden mit Handschlag begrüßt. Der obligatorische Ouzo vom Gastwirt spendiert,hat natürlich auch nicht gefehlt. Bei der Vorspeise haben wir uns auf seine Empfelung verlassen und sind nicht enttäuscht worden. 
Zu den Hauptspeisen kann ich nur sagen, dass das Lokal wirklich auf den Wunsch des Gastes eingegeht und die Zusammenstellung nach dessen Geschmack zulässt. Zu der Hauptspeise konnte man sich an der "Salatbar" selber seinen Salat zusammenstellen. Es war für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei(sehr frisch). Auf eine Nachspeise haben wir verzichtet, weil die Hauptspeisen schon so üppig waren, dass beim besten Willen kein Platz mehr für eine Nachspeise war.
P.S. wir haben mit VISA bezahlt obwohl hier steht, dass nur Bar akzeptiert wird.
Great doctors; staff very helpful..my son loves this place. Great location; convenient scheduling..

A Good Dentist Makes all The Difference 

Today was my first visit to West Valley Pediatric Dentistry and Orthodontics.  Usually, my sister will take her son to the dentist.  However, today was my turn and I have to admit the experience was pleasant.

West Valley Pediatric Dentistry and Orthodontics has a small waiting room however, it is well suited for children.  There are fatheads of sports players, trucks, and logos all over the walls.  There are even video games for the kids to play and help keep them entertained until their appointment.

When my nephew was called for his appointment he was treated very well by the dental hygienist and dentist.  They  explained what they were doing, gave tips on brushing, spoke about the importance of brushing, and gave him a tooth brush, toothoaste, floss, and token for a toy prior to leaving.

The staff were friendly and welcoming.  I.am glad my nephew has a great dentist to go to, a good dentist makes all the difference.

Do not go here if you need more than a cleaning. The office and staff are nice and inviting, and that is all the good I have to say. I read good reviews, but I do not thinking any of them had to have any actual work done. My daughter was told she needed 19 cavities filled, we paid 1200+ dollars. Two months later we go to the orthodontist and those cavities were still there. They quickly refunded my money after the new dentist contacted them with all the work that needed to be done. I just wonder what would have happened if I did not get my daughter seen so soon again. Very stressful, very agitating. I do not think this was a mistake, like many dentist, I think they were trying to make money for nothing. rather disturbing. My daughter sat through hours and hours of procedures, just to have to do it all over again. Not fair for kids. DO NOT GO HERE!

We've been going here since our daughter was three bs every experience has been terrific.  They are always professional and caring and make my little one feel very comfortable through all the procedures!  My daughter does not fear the dentist at all!

Update..this place has new office staff that is so new and not very well trained. The office is looking run down and no perks for parents waiting in a very small old waiting room. Customer service is huge. You fail there you lose patients. That's healthcare now. I think it's time we find a new pediatric dentist for our kiddos. I'm bummed this place got this run down. My kids go to Hilgers orthodontics and I think it's time I try their pediatrics dentistry office now.

Setting up our initial apt was very smooth and easy- however it seem to go all down hill from there. It was partly my fault for not reading the address correctly, however when we arrived to the Litchfield office, I didn't know that they switched suites from 100 to 1000. I just second guessed my self and assumed I wrote and additional 0, as there were NO signs indicating they had moved. I just figured they didn't open the doors on time, Needless to say I was finally able to get ahold of the office and they were able to tell me where to go, but now I had to reload my 14 month old son back in to the car to drive around to the correct area. then because of this error I was late for his appointment, which means I had to wait to be "worked in" so what should have been an in and out appointment took an hour. The staff was extremely cold towards me and acted very inconvenienced that we were late. Even the tech that we had was very cold- cold enough, my son who is normally open to new people, was terrified of her and wanted nothing to do with her. When we did see the dentist he was great. When all was said and done the tech handed me a coin for my son to get a prize. Mind you this is a small child- when I look at all the prizes there was NOTHING he could have, they all had age limits and were indicated as choking hazards for his age... ok seriously? Not that he had any clue, but what's the point of even giving out the coin if he can't have anything anyways? why not have an alternative? (now they did give him a small plastic dinosaur during his exam to distract him during the exam, but personality goes a long way with little ones- something the tech lacked in)
Then when I went to schedule my sons 6 month check, I was told he had a balance on his account. I paid it over the phone and the girl was gracious enough to fax me a copy of the receipt. When I received the receipt it was for a different childs account. She found an error in the billing and instead of asking me if it was OK to put the payment toward another account, she just did and sent me the receipt.  The child was not even my child! It was to my ex-husbands other child. I get that the mistake was made, but clearly, I am not her mother and my name is no where on her account, and the fact this assumption was made was frustrating. I'm a single mom who cannot afford this mistake. It was corrected, however I didn't received the money back in my bank account for 5 days.
This was the last frustration for me, I decided to change offices. When I sent a request to have his records transferred I was informed he was too young to really have any records so they didn't have anything to send. I'm sorry was my son NOT seen?
