There were also a lot of Indian people, so you know that's a good sign too.  They have a little bit of everything to suit all tastes and spice levels.

I love this place for lunch! Never a big crowd, and they get you in and out quickly. But, if you're not in a hurry and want to sit and check emails or play or your phone, they're cool with that too. Service is quick and the food is amazing. I've only ever had the lunch buffet, but it's on the top Indian good I've had. Must try's are the lentil soup and the garlic naan. Both are the best I've ever had.

I have eaten the lunch buffet about 6 or 7 times before and decided to Yelp my most recent visit.

Really enjoy the cool and laid back vibe at Mint.  The lively Bollywood style background music adds a nice touch. Also, the creative art on the walls contributes to an air of whimsy.

Now, onto the food. The buffet starts out with a small but nice selection of simple lettuce salad, various chutneys (mint and mango are my favs) and plain yogurt to tamp down the heat of the curries which aren't really that hot anyways.

While I didn't try all the the entrees, a few of my favorites included: Paneer Tikka, Veggie Korma, and Chicken Tikka.  The basmati rice is always a nice addition and works well under the entrees.

I always look forward to the garlic naan bread and it did not disappoint. Just a nice pillowy, but crispy bit of deliciousness. Yum!! I'll take another order please! And another...so addictive.

Found the servers to be attentive and courteous. They are always sure to bring another carafe of ice water.  All restaurants need to have carafes of water as it's a major time saver for the servers and keeps customers happy. 

Can't wait to return, but could do without the three children who kept screaming during my lunch.

Authentic Indian Food! AYCE lunch buffet from 11am-3pm for around $12.

I had a little bit of everything and to tell you the truth dont remember the names of any of the dishes Lol. 
Poultry seemed to be their main ingredient meat wise. They were all good and a few were great such as the Goat, and you cant judge it unless you taste yourself.
 
The funniest part i must add to this review is my friend had never ate Indian food before and had the shits a couple hours later. I had the exact same dishes that he had so moral of the story is.. if you have a uni-cuisine stomach, dont go hard on new ones Lol.

Finding Mint Indian Bistro is like finding an oasis in the desert. Where the oasis would be a really good Indian restaurant and the desert, well, is Las Vegas. My experiences are based on dinner and not the lunch buffet. Their staff is very accommodating here and are experienced in dealing with large families and groups with small children. On busy evenings, you can flag down any of their waitstaff for assistance. I've never made a reservation here and have not waited more than 15 minutes during my last few visits. 

I love the extensive and almost daunting menu filled with northern and southern Indian dishes. We usually start off with some samosas and the Bhel Puri, which is an Indian snack food made of puffed rice. I always have to get garlic naan with my meals. The naan is an Indian flat bread that's served hot out of the oven and has a wonderful texture. The bread is great for sopping up the sweet curry sauce of their Tikka Masala. Another dish to try is the smoky and aromatic lamb dish called Rogan Josh. If you're adventurous, they have plenty of other delicious dishes to choose from and also serve vegetarian fare.

Absolutely tasty!!! This place is one of the best Indian restaurants I've been to. There mixture of Indian, Tibetan and Nepal is a  refreshing blend. The first time I went there I asked for paneer pakora which wasn't on the menu and the owner went to the kitchen and made me up a plate which tasted amazing. They have lots of beers from India and alot of lassi drinks. Just to prove my taste buds are on the level I recently brought a friend who's wife is from India and she said very tasty and top notch. Well worth it. Nice atmosphere as well.

This place is awesome. They have so many choices of things to eat and drink. From rose lassis to tamarind rice, my bf and I have tried new things here when we come. The inside is nice. I highly recommend calling to make a reservation as their waitlist can get long (because they're so popular)

OH MINT HOW I LOVE YOU!!!

Best service and best food!

My husband and I have been going here since we first started dating and now our two kids even love it!

Forever a Mint lover!

Awesome. First time ever eating Indian food because I've always been afraid, but the only word that comes to mind about my experience is awesome. The Chile Chicken and Lentel soup appetizers were perfect, and the main course dip-like stuff was all seasoned perfectly. I can't speak for it myself but I also hear the lunch buffet is fantastic.

The buffet is great! Lamb korma and chicken tikka masala are my faves and it is included in the lunch buffet! The interior of the place makes you feel like you're in a fine dining restaurant. Prices were reasonable. I will be coming back"

I've just turned Vegan and I am still figuring out what to eat. A friend and I split the Vegan Prix-Fixe dinner. It was just wonderful. I never knew eating Vegan could be this good. I look forward to my next visit to Las Vegas. I will definitely come back to Mint Indian Bistro.

The food is awesome!!! Really what I expected.... Nice ambiance too!!!
We ordered for different fried rice, and all items were too good!!! Best restaurant for indian food!!!

If I could give this place more stars I would .. The buffet was AMAZING .. I had curry chicken and goat and two types of soup ,I don't eat goat but this goat was better than the chicken .. I will be back

Great great food.. Fresh crispy nun.. Delicious rice.. All dishes are simply FABULOUS..
the sweets & fruit salad are great...
& the buffet was only $10.99/person
RECOMMENDED x10

A year ago we visited and I thought, "It's okay, but there are too many places I like better." This summer, finally taking heed of the restaurant's "You Yelped. We Listened." comment, we came back.

And back. And back.

This review only covers the lunch buffet as I've yet to make it out for dinner, but don't think I don't have my eye on that Paneer Makhani.

Speaking of paneer, it's my thing. I like pakoda/pakora, dal, aloo anything, and malai kofta, but what gets me on my feet and the car keys in my hand is the promise of paneer in a creamy sauce.

Oh, but it can't be sag or palak paneer. I've got a spinach issue. (It's what keeps me off the Galactic Council of Vegetarians.) And muttar paneer (peas and cheese) is nice, but everyone does that. My bar is set above that and getting higher all the time.

And Mint has met the challenge. Every visit this summer has been met with a different creamy-sauced paneer dish. Sometimes a tikka masala, sometimes something I've never heard of. And when there is a spinach-y paneer, there's still a non-spinach option as well.

I'm going to buy a choir robe just so it looks less weird when I walk the Mint buffet line shouting "Hallelujah!" 

In addition to the paneer is the fresh salad offerings (fruit, chutney, raita, the usual), vegetable pakoda, lentils, and then a few surprises. I try everything because nothing has let me down yet. Oh, except for the meat, but my husband has that covered. You can probably hear him "Mmmm!"ing across the restaurant. (And maybe across the street at the Atomic Museum on the days they serve chicken pakoda.)

Flavour was an issue with me a year ago. Mint's taste was strong and samey to me, not clearly made with a careful hand. Good, but not as great as other places. But now? It's easy to savour every bite, and I find myself so, so, SO sad when I'm full. "But the party is still going on!" my mouth says, but my tummy draws a velvet rope and suggests that next time maybe I eat less naan.

(But the naan is so soft and garlicky! You can have plain naan as well, but this is one of the few places where I really enjoy the garlic naan and don't find it a little acrid/burnt.)

For dessert, there's always (at least when we've visited) gulab jamun. If I were a mad scientist with preteen fashion sense, I'd freeze-dry a ball of gulab jamun and wear it around my neck to show my love for this fragrant, rosy dessert. The syrup at Mint is airy but strong, and the spheres are porous and squishy, just how I like it.

Service is always hospitable and swift. I especially dig the carafes of ice water on each table, the condensation a pretty sight on a hot Las Vegas day.

It has taken me two months to write this review because I can't start thinking about Mint without finding myself driving across town for a reasonably priced lunch. This time, armed with a full stomach, I have made it to the end of the review.... but I think I know where we're going for dinner.

Some of the best Indian food I've ever eaten. Go with a big group and order everything. You can't miss. 

For those with a weaker stomach, go with the level 2 spice. It's pleeenty.
Food was great and love how easy the menu is for vegetarian/ vegans- Amazing!

I've been here many times for dinner, but not buffet.  This review is for the lunch buffet.

There were many items in the buffet line, ranging from vegetarian to meat courses. 

The quality and taste of the dishes exceed my expectations even more now.  I love goat karahi.  I have been to many Indian restaurants where the goat karahi isn't consistent.  I know I can count on Mint to make sure that each piece is tender and flavorful.  I mixed my tender chunks of goat meat with slices of onions and cucumbers, then squeezed lemon on them and tossed it around some more. It was delicious, and the naan was great as well.  

However, goat karahi wasn't the only star on today's menu (according to me, of course).  I have tried tandoori chicken at many places, but I find it lacks flavor.  When Debbie said that the tandoori chicken is her favorite, I decided to grab a piece to give it a try.  Boy was I glad Debbie raved about it.  It was SOOOOO GOOOOD!  I tore off a piece of this delicious chicken that bursted with flavor and put it on top of freshly baked garlic naan. I then dipped it into the tamarind chutney and wala, yummy-in-my-tummy.  

I was full at this point, but still had to eat my favorite dessert, khir.  I was super excited to see this in the  buffet line.  I love the basmati rice, slow cooked in milk with a dash of cardamom.  I got two servings, one for Roland, and one for myself.  Somehow, they both ended up being consumed by me...Oops...Khir...I can't help myself.

I also had the Lal Mohan.  Again, tried this at other places, never liked it.  Luckily, Debbie also raved about this so I gave it a shot...thank goodness I tried it because it is DELICIOUS.

And the staff, attentive and friendly, as always.
I hv been there twice, they hv good customer service great food and my fav is butter chicken n naan. Must go place for variety of north and South Indian food + more. I will definitely b back.

I never really had Indian food in Vegas, but wanted to try some nice place. The reviews for this place and Tamba were nice, but wanted to find some place off the strip and with easy parking so picked Mint.

The place looks little shady from outside, the plaza was dark and the restaurant did not seem very brightly lit from outside. But don't worry it's a great place from inside. The decor is nice and upscale. It's a quite place, with comfortable seating. The lights could be brighter. There were few other table's occupied (All by Indians) - A good sight if you are looking for true Indian spicy food and not tamed down for the American population. 

The waiter was nice, pleasant and took out his iPhone while talking to us. Realized within minutes he was noting down our order with an app from the app store. Also said they own a software company and are going to start using their own app in some time.

Coming to the main part! FOOD! It was really good. 
We ordered Mint Lassi and Masala Chhas. Both were very Indian and really tasty. 
Their Menu is very well organized. Great for Vegetarians and Vegans since each item says if its good for vegetarians or vegans. Very happy to see how they describe each item in the menu really well. One of the best organized Menu's among all restaurants (Comparing to all Indian, American etc. restaurants).

For the main course we ordered Paneer Makhani, Daal Makhani and Chole With Naans. Everything was really good. Daal Was very tasty, although the color might make you think its not the best, but trust me the taste is nothing short of what you find back home. Naan's were also very good. 

They also have Nepalese  food but did not try it, but would love to try that too. 
Overall great place if you are looking for true Indian Food. Would definitely go back again.
All fire and no flavor. Vindaloo was pretty hot, but no complexity.

Went in for a dinner on a Saturday night! Heard some good reviews from the hotel staff and Uber drivers so we had some big expectations from this place!! 
Unfortunately it was nothing close to what we expected! 

The interiors: okayish! Nothing ravishingly amazing to talk about. 

The staff and service : this is a very mixed review I would have to put in. Some of them were very nice and polite but some although not being or server were so so loud that we could here them talking to other guests and servers loudly and it was irritating. 
The service began smooth and was quick in the beginning. They took out drinks order, food order quickly. 
Got our drinks out super quick. Got the starter out quick but here is where they failed, we had order a thali which has starter, soup, main course included. 
So, starters served, soups served. We got done with both, and then had to wait for 35 mins for the mains to be served!!!!! 

Food quality and quantity: for the price the thali quantity is ok! Probably having unlimited rotis/breads would be a better with so many curries to finish. They only serve 1 garlic naan each thali (small) 
We did not like any curry, vegetable in particular to be honest. We did ask them high spice level which they probably forgot! 
The lamb was undercooked and the curry tasted like raw onion and tomato paste! 
The dessert served was good though.

Only this I would recommend here their lassi cocktails/mocktails.

Ever since my beloved Bollywood seemed to take a turn for the worse a couple years ago, my husband and I decided to change it up and give Mint a try. Um, I may have been back here 20 (or 30) times since then. 

They always start you off with free (and yummy) papadum with mint and tamarind sauces. Their mango lassis are soooo good and the lychee lassi that my husband randomly tried one day was pretty tasty as well. 

I'm boring and always order the same thing: saag paneer. Theirs never disappoints, however. And you get lots of paneer which makes me extra happy. We've also had the korma and saffron cauliflower and they are both great as well. I have dreams of the garlic naan. 

I would say that the samosas are not so great, and if I was rating this by the buffet only (and the vegetarian food only), I would probably give it 3-stars. Maybe non-veg have a better experience at the buffet, but I'm not sure. 

We wanted to try a new Indian place one Sunday afternoon, but got fed up because they are all closed between the hours of 2-5. So we finally decided to go to our old staple, Mint, for the buffet. We had to laugh because the place was jam packed with Indian customers... we said that all the other restaurants must close to come eat at Mint for a late lunch. 

Most days the food is amazing and occasionally it's just good. Some days the "medium" spiciness is too mild and sometimes its too hot. But we've never had a bad experience here and the staff are wonderful and very friendly. Definitely give it a try, and seriously... order a mango lassi. 

Note: their menu specifically states what items are vegetarian, vegan, and gluten free. They even have vegan lassis! And they also have a great beer selection.
Wonderful food and service! The buttered garlic naan is the best. My favorite dish is the Malai Kofta and the Lassi menu has every flavor imaginable.  I tried the Rose Lassi and it was delicious.

We were visiting Las Vegas and were craving Indian food. Mint had a lot of good reviews and we decided to check this place out. The crowd was extremely young and the place was lively. The decor was okay with muted sounds of Indian cinema music in the background. The menu was very innovative -- almost every appetizer and entree had a twist. We are vegetarian and so this review won't help if you are looking to hear about the chicken tikka masala (which I am told is good...). 

So, we ordered the Organic Samosa and vegetable pakoras. We also ordered the mahakali mango masala (yes that is the real name), Dal Maharani Balti, and the Hariyali Kabab. After a long day of gallivanting, we were hungry and would have eaten anything cooked :-)

For the food then... While the names were innovative, the food not so much. The Hariyali Kabab was green (as expected), but was bland. The chutneys were basted on a bit too much and there was literally no spice. The Mahakali Mango Masala was similarly taste free and bland. We had ordered this with paneer and it was undercooked. The Dal wasn't bad and probably the only item that was tasty enough. The breads, on the other hand, were fresh and nice.

Also there were a lot of innovative lassi types. These were very nice as well. 

Perhaps the items with meat were better and the crowd was generally having a lot of fun! So, we might have been the unlucky group. This place is definitely worth a visit just to see the creativity in the menu.
My first time here and it was absolutely amazing!! Surprisingly superb beer selection. Our server was very helpful, made great suggestions and was genuinely kind.. Great place!!!

It was a bright vegas night when i tried to catch some indian fare, and i was not disappointed. They had some of the juiciest chicken biryani and fried okra with yogurt. Their mint chutney was heavenly. and rightly priced. i would give it a second visit when i am back in the strip.

It's been a while since I've treated my inner Indian, so I tried this based on yelp reviews. I was not disappointed. Ordered an appetizer of samosas. They were not quite as crispy and bursting with flavor as the ones I remember from my early years In South Africa, but would definitely have them again.
Ordered the lamb Karma Korma for the entree. I asked for the mild spice, since i don't normally like the really hot dishes, but I probably could have gone with the medium spice. Flavors were well blended with a hint of sweetness. Accompanied it with a side of garlic naan, perfect for mopping up the left over sauce.
I'll definitely come back again when I'm in town.

Told fiancé I been wanting Indian food for a while! We decided to head this way after the gym considering it was just down the street!

Service was great! At no time did they try to
rush us and was helpful & patient when we were deciding on what to order. Refilling our waters and even offering more basmati rice when we were out.

As far as food, we ordered Lamb Samosas to start with, a bit dry and needed some type of sauce but still good. Our entrees were Chicken Breast Tandoori for me and Lamb Korma for my date. We also ordered their infamous Garlic Naan! I love anything on a sizzling plate! The chicken was moist and tender! My dish was not spicy at all, which is a plus for me because I can't handle TOOO spicy! Paired perfectly with the basmati rice and I even made a little sandwich bite with the Naan, grilled onions, cut the chicken up and topped with yogurt sauce! DELISH! 

The Korma was a "7" and I guess it wasn't too spicy either but he likes spice so ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ , he said he might go "10" next time. They also have an inferno menu where you have to sign waivers! I wonder how serious that is! Lol

Overall a great experience! Wish we had room for dessert! Until next time...

Simple review for this place.

13$ lunch buffet that is awesome. Great quality food with a decent variety. They also offer 10% off if you show your UNLV student ID. Lack of 5th star because if you order any drink that is not water it takes them a long time to bring it. But the decor is nice and the staff is friendly and the food is good. Great place to get your indian fix in. 

Oh and if your into the whole Vegan thing they have a lot of options for that on their menu.
Good decent indian food Mahraja chicken tikka was yummy gulab jamoon was not that good

A wait list for an empty restaurant on a Friday night....hmm seems they wanted to keep tables free for parties larger than two. Their close proximity to the strip leaves them hopeful that others will come. But in the meantime, alienate the customers who are already here and ready to pay....very stupid practice! The place is all pretty on the inside. Cute decor and the sexiest buddha sitting in the midst. But the service was horrible. We decided to sit at the counter and watch the shenanigans. Parties of two constantly being wait listed or sent to the bar then looking around and leaving. Larger parties being sat (without a reservation mind you). Our food was brought out over spice, cold and tasteless. They made the list of worst Indian food I've ever had, and I eat plenty. All pomp and circumstance. Not the place to go if you really want to eat great Indian in Vegas. Tourist trap....

I finally dragged the hubby out to try indian food with me, yipee! Their menu is quite extensive, and for us newbies that have never had indian food in our lives, we were a bit overwhelmed with the options. Our waiter was great and helpful in helping us narrow down what was spicy and what wasn't. We ordered the garlic buttered naan (yum!), chicken Maharaja tikka masala, and chicken chetinad curry. The naan was delish! The masala came with a small side of rice - although the flavor was decent, I didn't love it, it was just okay. I tried hubby's curry though (which also came with a small side of rice) and I actually liked that a lot better. The flavor of the curry was bold but not too overkill. 
That being said, I was a little disappointed that the portions seemed a bit small for the price. I guess I expected a little more than a small bowl of chicken and small side of rice for a $13.99 and $15.99 meal. However, even though their portions were disappointingly small, I think I'd still come back.

This is my favorite place in Las Vegas right now. It has some of the best and most fresh tasting food as well as an extremely welcoming and accommodating staff. I have had a positive experience EVERY time I have eaten there
I have even tried their lunch buffet. I was a bit apprehensive about a buffet but, Mint did not disappoint. It was such a lovely collection of foods and I was totally satisfied. 
I am getting hungry just thinking about how great everything is at Mint!
I tried many Indian restaurant they were average but this one has a very delicious food specially checkin masala. Love it

my boyfriend surprised me on valentines day and took me to this restaurant. it's been awhile since i had indian food and so far this is one of my favorites. i haven't try their kabobs but the curry's are to die for! i will definitely come and dine here again. The servers were so nice!

Decadent, Some of the best Indian food I have ever tasted and I live in sf bay area home itself to some great food. Suggest try the sampler items..Will be back next time in Vegas or might just come to Vegas for them.,

This is a great little Indian restaurant or maybe I've lost how to rate Indian restaurants since the Indian restaurants in Austin just plain suck (at least most of them).

The lunch buffet had a decent variety of vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes, along with a salad bar and two desserts(it was gulab jamun and something else). I don't like desserts so I can't comment on them; the vegetarian dishes, kadhai paneer, Saag, mushroom potatoes, dal, sambar, idli, rasam, pulao were all great. In the non veg section there was chicken tikka masala, chilli chicken, tandoori chicken, goat curry and another chicken dish. They all were great; I ate a bit of each coz it was that good. Also they bring your choice of bread fresh at your table unlike other Indian restaurants who leave theirs at the buffet table.

Oh yeah, if you're Indian and drink iced/cold water, you need to tell them that. The default water for us folks is warm water :)

On of the best Indian food I had in US. The taste was really good and the variety in the lunch buffet was great (both veg and non-veg). The Naan and Tandoori Roti were hot and crisp. Plus the price for the buffet is actually a steal. If you are in Vegas and craving for good Indian buffet this is the place to go. Perfect for family. I am going there again when I visit Vegas.

What better way to try different dishes than a buffet.  

I was finally able to convince my husband to try Indian food.  The lunch buffet was a decent price so let's go.  It's located in a small strip mall off of Flamingo.  Parking here is tight and very few spaces.  The dining area itself is very clean.  The buffet area was also kept tidy and presentable.  Service was good with very polite employees. 

Since spicy food is right up the hubs alley, he liked the Chicken Chilli.  This dish is listed on their fusion items.  Very spicy loaded with chilies, green peppers and onions with soy sauce and Indian spices.  I tried a variety of their vegetarian options which I enjoyed! Of course you do have your choice of naan bread that is made there in house.  Fluffy with butter and garlic made this my favorite. 

But Let's call it how it is,... A buffet is a buffet.  This one is small and not the best I've ever had.  Just ok in my book.

The garlic naan is exceptional!  Stopped in for the lunch buffet and the selection was wonderful -- had all the basic Indian dishes.  There were a lot of vegetarian dishes I winced at.  For $10/person, it's a great deal.
Nasty food I ever had. They serve stale food. Food is severely bad. When I complain to manager he was  very Rudy. Hate this place!!!... Don't waste your time and  $

Having recently been burned by overpriced terrible tasting food at another Indian restaurant in the area *cough* Bollywood *cough* we were hesitant to try more Indian cuisine. We were having a tough time coming up with a new place to visit so I went to Yelp. I started looking up various ethnic cuisines and I did a search for Nepalese food. Much to my surprise a place called Mint Indian Bistro showed up. After reading the reviews it seemed like the place had a mix of Himalayan and Northern Indian cuisine. So we made a resolution, we'll try some appetizers and if we didn't like it we would go to a different restaurant for our main meal.

All that plan B contingency stuff went out the window when I looked at the menu. They actually had menu items marked as vegan and vegetarian such that for once I would not have to ask about the ingredients they use in each of the dishes. So we made the plunge. We decided to share the Vegan Sampler and it was good. I want to say it was great, but there were a couple of items in the sampler that I did not enjoy as much as the rest.

Additionally the decor and feel of the restaurant was very nice. They even turned the lights up for us temporarily while we were perusing the menu so my mother could see the menus as she squinted without her reading glasses again.

With full disclosure and all that jazz I would say the food was in the four star range, but the addition of the vegan friendly menu really pushes the rating up for me into the five star range. I gotta help promote any vegan friendly place here in Vegas because they are not as prevalent as they are in other towns.
We always come here when in Vegas. The Mango Curry is incredible and the vidaloo also, get the garlic naan and some yoghurt. Great place and very nice choice of beers.

This place wasn't Mint when I originally reviewed it so it isn't fair that they get the reviews grandfathered to them when this business was called "Himalayan something something".  

Decent buffet.  4 stars if you eat meat but 3 if you don't.  They do offer a few unique dishes I don't see at any other Indian buffet like their version of lo mein, chaat and 3 kinds of naan and soup.  I just prefer the overall selection a little more at other places.

Just awesome food.

We ordered
1.mysore spicy masala dosa 
2.Idly sambar 
3handi biryani  (chicken) available in veg and mutton also . Ordered twice ;p
4. jeera rice 
5. dal tadka 
We loved handi biryani and dosa of all too different from other restaurants we had before in US. 

Definitely will visit next time.

Delicious food. Great service across the board. 
Lamb Vindaloo=excellent 
Tandoori Chicken = full of flavor but a bit dry. 
Mango Lassi = yummy 
Pakoda = perfect
Butter chicken = fantastically properly prepared. 
Nice chutney's and Naan.
The lunch buffet was excellent with some items I've never seen at other restaurants. Also, every item was labeled for dietary restrictions: vegetarian, gluten free, etc.

The manager would not allow me to place an order for pickup.  I have lived on this planet 32 years, and this is the first time I have ever heard of this.  This was not a small order either - I guaranteed a $200+ order, and they turned it away stating that they were too busy.  What a complete an utter joke.

#trulyafirstworldproblem

Food is very good but the staff is 'out to lunch'. Management has a bad attitude. When you walk in the will turn their back to you and later turnaround and have this look on their face like 'what do you want'? Have also experience sitting down to a dirty table with what looked like food from the night before. Also, I asked for a spoon and they handed it to me holding the cradle end.

I haven't been here since it was a Himalayan place. What took me so long to come here! I had stopped down the street at India Masala for Dosa Tuesday, only to find out their chef quit and they're no longer serving South Indian food. So I left and came here.

First thing that caught my eye was one their first page of the menu, inferno naan. YESSSS please. We were asked to sign a consent prior to ordering. What the? Made with ghost peppers and habanero chills, it came out looking so plain, but when you open up the naan, it was loaded with peppers.  I took one bite, it was horrid. I love spicy food, but I like a good taste with the spice. This was pure nastiness. I had to spit it out. My nose, lips and tongue immediately started burning, thankfully I had a full lassi in front of me that cooled down the heat. 

Onto the next one. I was excited to see that they served Northern and Southern Indian food. I ordered my favorite, Mysore Masala Dosa, red chili chutney and potatoes, and onions. This was by far the best dosa I have ever had. The chutney served with it was really good as well. 

We also ordered the lamb kabobs, these were nice and tender, great flavor too. Of course we had to order cheese naan, every americans favorite. I love naan. I could eat it for days.

The most exciting thing tho, they have a lassi bar! I tried the mango and rose lassi (two, don't judge). I love a good mango lassi. I've never seen a place have a lassi bar, there were so many different flavors to choose from. I will most likely be trying all of them. 

I like this place, a lot. Good Indian food. I like that they serve both cuisines. Kinda like when you go to a Thai place and you can get Northern and Southern style. I like options.
Food was beyond incredible. Hospitality was pure class, This is by far Las Vegas best Indian restaurant, It's on the higher side but worth every penny.
Don't expect tasty biryani over here...  Breakfast food kind of okay.  Went to this restaurant based on ratings,  but taste is not good as rated.

Cool half moon booths. Great service and attentiveness of staff. Food was solid all around. Extensive menu, including Jain, Gluten free, Vegan, Vegetarian options. I had the lamb vindaloo which I give a 7 out of town. Naan was good. The owner was very interested in feedback and once he found out how much I love vindaloo asked me to come back and try it after he made some subtle changes to improve it. Orders were taken on ipads. I will be coming back, had a great experience overall.

Was looking for a lunch place near the National Atomic Testing Museum and up popped Mint on Yelp. Good choice.  The lunch buffet at $11 was more than we are used to paying but there were more and more-varied selections.  Everything was good but be warned, a lot of things were HOT!  (Even the saag was hotter than the chicken vindaloo!)  They have a large selection of beers and wine, including organic choices, and lassi cocktails.  The bill for 2 buffets and 2 glasses of Loma Larga chardonnay came to $50.  I wouldn't make a special trip here if we return to Las Vegas but I can recommend it if you are in the area and have a hankering for Indian.

when in Vegas if u want Indian food only place to eat is this ..,...Best Indian food in town.....tried their lunch buffet surprisingly it's very good.....just that the chicken curry(Andhra curry) as stated in buffet tasted more of Goan style otherwise impressive menu. Great service and clean place.....
Good wholesome buffet selection. Lassi and chicken tikka masala were good. Garlic nan another plus. Good attentive staff.

met up with a friend for lunch. its been a while since ive been here but the buffet is still really good. 

$11 or $12, i dont remember.

they had mint chutney! very good stuff. not spicy though. 
they had an interesting basmati rice with cashews, dried cranberries, and other stuff. it was pretty good. never had anything like that before.
all of their curries were excellent. i really liked the mutton on bone the most. 
the tandoori chicken was a little dry, but it usually is. lunch had just started so everything was fresh.

last time i ate here i dunno if i ate too much but i had really bad food coma. this time i had 3 plates but feel good.

maybe its the waiters thick indian accent that makes the food taste better at mint, but this place is definitely one of the better places to get inidian food in town. 

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tNwXReoaCKQ

Great service and very good food.
Everytime we visit Vegas, we always go here for   fresh and hot vegetarian Indian food. Especially idlis!!
Staff are very courteous and ensure we enjoy our meal.

Lunch buffet, dinner.. I've done it all.  I really like Mint and all their veggie selections for us non-meat eaters.  The menu is easy to navigate and is coded with abbreviations to let you know which is vegetarian friendly, gluten-free, etc.  I usually opt for the aloo gobi or the chana masala with a side of garlic naan and always end up leaving happy.  Like I mentioned earlier, I've stopped in a few times for the lunch buffet and always leave happy as well.  They can a bunch of great choices for lunch and they always like to keep the "veggies" in mind with a bunch of meatless dishes which are all labeled, warmed up, and ready to go.  Definitely a favorite of mine and definitely a step up from the Himalayan joint they used to be.  Coming back soon and definitely coming back hungry!!
Really average food in buffet for lunch. It was a good selection but food was a little less than I would expect.

On the advice of Yelpers, went to Mint last night. Was very impressed with the room, though small, it is lovely. Was greeted by a cheerful fellow and seated in a booth while waiting for my date. Prompt water, and after a little confusion trying to order top shelf vodka/soda/lime. 

I had looked forward to trying either the Vegan or Vegetarian Chef's Dinners (crazy amounts of food, a bit a of everything for $44 $38, respectively) he was reluctant so we went a la carte, which ended up with far less food. They also offer Gluten Free Chef's Menu & have one of the most clearly marked menus I've ever seen describing each item and what categories they fall into, awesome. 

The waiter takes your order on an iPhone, which took us a few seconds to register that he wasn't just Yelping :) When I was taking pictures of menu & food, I was asked if I was Yelping and copped to it. He proudly pointed out Yelp sticker on door. 

Now, down to food:

I ordered a cup of yellow dal : light, herbaceous and delicious enough to keep around to mop up the last bits with nan. Date had never tried it before and loved it, too. 

Two orders of Nan: yummy (too much bread for me, but guess he likes carbs) 

Brown Basmati rice: yes, please! They happily informed us it would be refilled on request and it was. 

My main course was vegan tikka masala which I ordered at level 8. Some heat, but I'd go 10 next time. Complex, full of veggies and spices and I took half home. 

Date had Mango Lassi, which he enjoyed and a usual lamb korma guy tried the vegetarian version level 8, too and ate every bite, most of the nan, and surprisingly, his first brown rice?! 

In all, service was attentive, water glasses were filled and we thoroughly enjoyed everything. In my pictures is a cute "Happy Face Rating" which came with bill I thought was adorable. Thought it a bit pricy at $65 + change but that would have been easily remedied ordering the Chef's Menu for 2. Another funny thing: we were trying to figure out what "1 Russian $10" was on check = it was my cocktail ( guessing Stoli)

My date went back today for the $10.99 lunch buffet, which he really dug. Guess he enjoyed Mint as much as I did. Once I try more items, I will update review and am pretty sure it will hold up or bump to 5*. Another plus: half orders! Keeps making me crush on you harder, Mint, you charmer. How flirty is it that they thanked me on the Facebook (c'mon y'all want to say THE Facebook so let's do it...) 

Directly across the street from the Atomic Testing Museum: perfect place to hit for lunch before or after. Yummy.

Had dinner here for a couple of days and felt that the food is good but some dishes seem stale.. maybe reused from the lunch buffet.

Tomato soup was tasteless and crude.
Chicken tikka was dry and felt stale.
Mix veg in the thali was very average!


Butter chicken and lamb curry was good, liked them!
Daal tadka was also really nice, had a nice hing flavour!
Loved the food and their service .. spice level was perfect !!! Will visit this place every time I am in vegas ...

The five star rating is for dinner, I would drop a star for lunch. The dinner was perfectly cooked, we had a combination of Indian and Nepalese dishes (amazing shrimp dish). 

Service was excellent, fast enough (for Indian food) and customized for my needs (extremely spicy!).

The lunch buffet on the other hand was very mild and some even bland with a lot of sweet options, which I guess is to be expected with the audience for the lunch buffet but I and my wife was not super happy at lunch.

This is a good option if you are in Vegas with a car and would like to get away from the crazy buffets and try some real food.

The best Indian food I've had in Las Vegas so far. 

Don't get me wrong, Mint Bistro's food is not the best Indian food one can find, but well above, for instance, Gandhi Indian Bistro, which is just a short distance to the west.

Four stars is probably a little high for the food, more like three and one-half. The cons: in every chicken dish that I've tried, the chicken is overcooked. I routinely expect that in chicken tandoori, but not in tikka masala, or even the chicken chili at Mint Bistro. Additionally, the food is definitely toned down for American tastes. I have to load up on the chili paste at the salad bar.

I do the recommend the chutneys here, all of them but especially the mint and coconut chutneys.

The service and smiles on the staff merit five stars. I like to see happy people in a restaurant. That makes me believe the management cares enough to consistently produce a good product.

Finally, the beer selection is very good, though for some odd reason, Mint Bistro carries no American beers, not even some of the premium micro-brews.

I definitely recommend Mint Bistro and my criticisms are only offered in the hope that the management will strive to improve the minor deficiencies I have listed.

Excellent buffet and ala carte options ! Varied menu. We were in Vegas for 3 days and had 3 meals at this place including lunch and dinner. No dish disappointed. Definitely recommend this place to all my friends.
Good food lunch buffet has food value.   Staff is helpful and polite.  Worth trying

ok here is why I am giving Mint 5*. We walked in 10 before the lunch buffet was about to close. The owner offered to keep things as long as we like and even cooked up more food that got low.
He personally came over talked to use and went the extra mile, to make this a great experience.

Woooo! 400th reviewer! 

I've been here twice now - the first time for dinner and the second time for the lunch buffet. I'll just go over the overall points.

Generally good service. Sometimes the waiters are awkward and there was one young fellow in particular who looked like he hated his job. Everyone is knowledgeable in the food and readily answers questions though, which is great for me because I barely know anything about Indian food.

The food is bomb and I'm seriously craving it right now. One time, the chicken in the chicken Marsala was dry though, so that was strange. But overall, everything is seasoned to how I like it (a rare occurrence) and I was delightfully surprised by the mango yogurt! So good.

Outside of the lunch buffet, it's a little overpriced but you get a good amount of food made with quality ingredients and care. I like that they label things in categories like vegan or gluten-free. Very helpful for those who have limited diets.

My favorite was probably this lamb dish during the lunch buffet which I cannot remember but I assure you, it was awesome. I love the garlic naan, which I wish came in some heated basket (in my dreams) because it gets cold so fast! Tastes so much better warm.

Great location by UNLV and I'm trying to get a group to eat lunch there with me right now!

This review is for the buffet only. Unbelievable! Everything is high quality and consistently amazing! Stylish décor, fantastic friendly service. All the entrees are labeled so vegans and vegetarians know what's up. I'm addicted to this place Best Indian buffet in town! I wish they would open up one on the west side. It would be packed!

THis place is the best Indian food I've had in all of Vegas.

Except it being super cold in there, everything else was perfect.

THey actually make the food spicy here.

We ordered samosas as an app. The tamarind chutney was the best I've ever had.
For dinner, I got the chicken tikka masala at level 8 HOT! and the hubbs got a veggie khorma at a level 7...also supper hot!

the raita (yogurt) was a smaller order than I would've liked but it was really good.

Hands down, Mint Indian Bistro is the BEST Indian food in Vegas.  I'm originally from SF, I'm Indian, and have been searching for a good Indian restaurant in Vegas for years.  Mint has authentic, fresh, some organic, and most importantly, amazing flavors that give me the perfect curry fix, if i'm too lazy to cook myself ;)  The service and team there is also VERY nice and attentive...

5 stars all around: ambience, cleanliness, service (shout out to Biru who helped us order the dishes we couldn't remember the names of), quality (SO, SO FRESH), and flavor (we tried the papadum crackers with chutney, garlic naan, chicken tikka, tandori chicken, garbanzo bean dish, rice pudding, and chai). My husband and I will be a regular!

This place was recommended by a friend. Didn't disappoint. Can't do Indian food more than every other week but this is the place to get your fix.

Lunch buffet has a grt selection. Chicken, goat, vegetarian, salad, dessert, naan bread. Can't go wrong for around $15/pp.

When I need my Indian food fix, this is the place.

Prolly one of the best Indian restaurants in Las Vegas area.. A variety of cuisines made in the most authentic manner. The service is just wonderful and food quality is just amazing ... Every time I go to Vegas I go to this place without fail...

We visited this place twice during our stay at Vegas. They have a variety of options on their menu. We ordered Masala Papad, Schezwan fried rice, and dosa. Everything was freshly cooked, spice was perfect as per our request and the dosa was very crisp just the way I like it. Based on our first experience, wanted to give the food another try and went for their lunch buffet next time. We were not disappointed on our second visit too. They have a good number of choices on both veg and non-veg dishes. The food tastes delicious, the ambiance is very quite and comfortable. The service was great too! I would definitely visit this place on my next trip to vegas.
Very accommodating staff.  They put me in an empty section just so I could avoid loud music and then checked on me frequently.  Food was good.

I love Lal Mohan, I love Lal Mohan, I would start and finish with those during lunch buffet. so gooooooood!!!! for dinner you have to prix fixe it for sure so you can get everything. and if you like spicy ask for so of there inferno spice on the side. if you can stand heat like me you can get a $50 gift card by eating their Inferno Curry $20 about 14oz. I would do it but i don't want to rob them, I like them too much. =)

One star, and there's good reason for it.

Visited Mint today. I love Indian food. I grew up on middle eastern, Pakistani, and Indian food. The food here is NOT Indian, it's Indian made for American taste buds. Yaddaddaimean? But let's get down to the *critiQUE.*

Service:
There hasn't been a single time that I have come here, in which I have felt comfortable walking through the door. It's always a depressed / emotionally challenged man who takes us to our seat. Water, at first, is there quickly. Refills are scarce to none. We wait 5-10 minutes for the check every time. Never half-a-smile cracked by the server(s)...and everyone who works here looks, plain, miserable. 

Food:
I'm a huge curry fan, and a huge goat fan. Both of these are garbage, here, and this is why: all curry tastes the same, jus different levels of spicyness. The goat is terribly undercooked, chewy, and has NO FLAVOR (as everything else, here, is flavor-less). Today was the last straw. There was hair in my food. Done. I don't pay money for hair.

After the fact:
Ive been feeling like crap all day. Stomach is not right. I am unbelievably, and strangely fatigued. I regret this.

There's nothing here for me. I don't trust this place's discipline in cleanliness at all! I don't trust that it "matters " to them until they get caught and shut down! (which they already have, as far as I've heard, for sanitation) they're here for the quick buck. It seems that There's no "moral standard" in this business.

Best Indian food in Vegas, I ordered via postmates from here and then came back the next day for the buffet, it was awesome 

Have come in and also eaten alacarte, it's awesome

Food is mediocre. We did the lunch buffet. Also service is not the best, waiter made us a nasty face when we asked him to split checks. Tiki masala was too spicy. Atmosphere is modern but loud. There are howeverba lot of vegan options which is pretty cool.

Food was decent for a corner pizza place. Garlic knots were not good, they were both burnt and chewy. The stromboli was made more as a calzone, so not what I expected. The calzone was amazing! Toppings were high quality, but I paid an extra dollar to have black olives and there weren't any to be found. Good flavor, but greasy. Delivery person couldn't find my address, very friendly and apologetic when he arrived.

Super happy with my experience here. Called in an order 10 minutes before closing expecting the employees to be unhappy.... Instead we had the pleasure of dealing with Joey who owns the place. He was extremely happy and pleased to help up. We ordered a large cheese pizza with a side of knots. The crust was cooked to perfection and the pizza was simply amazing. Not an ounce of grease on or under the pizza. The ranch was homemade and delicious. Nothing worse than a good pizza served with hidden valley ranch - not here!! I will definitely be back to this place to try some other options. They have vegan options for those interested. A++++ can't wait to eat again.

I tried to order pizza here because they're highly recommended by the Homewood Suites but the guy hung up on me twice. When I tried calling back the third time he picked up the phone and set it down. We had a huge order of 10 pizzas for a party. He missed out on our business. I still have no idea why...

Always skeptical about new vegan places, but was extremely happy....  Our server was beyond friendly, helpful, and attentive... 

We loved the pizza and the pasta.... 2 dishes had enough to share, and enough leftovers...  Definitely will come again soon!

Great food. Also, the amazon delivery driver apparently grabbed the wrong half of out order and the resturant called before the order arrived and actually brought the corrected part of the order right away. Great service.

I can't believe I've gone this long without trying here! I was so eager to find more spots with vegan pizza, and this place popped up when I searched for vegan pizza on yelp. 

My friend and I stopped by on a Monday during lunch, and got a medium vegan pizza with garlic knots for $20. The garlic knots came out quick and fresh. The pizza followed shortly and was delicious. They even let us choose three veggies to put on top of it! Overall I was impressed by their vegan selection and their kind staff. I will definitely be back.

Joey is awesome! Great good, friendly employees. Awesome lunches!!! Great prices! Joey always greets us with a smile and great conversation. Friendly atmosphere and perfect little hideaway. I always recommend when others ask where to go to Lunch.

We ordered the vegan pizza and it was absolutely wonderful!  We also had the vegan brownie (each vegan brownie order has two brownies in it!) and they were very good as well.  I liked the vegan brownie warmed up a bit.  I have to say that the people were very helpful and the service was very good.  While I live too far away for delivery, it is well worth the drive to pick up the pizza!  I am looking forward to trying other vegan options on the menu.  FINALLY! A place where my non-vegan friends and I can all eat and have good options.
Pizza Company is the best pizza I have had in Vegas so far. The owner is super friendly and the pizza speaks for itself. Highly recommend the buffalo chicken pizza

Ordered a couple pizzas delivered. Delivery was fast and hot. Pizza was not bad. The crust is tough as leather. The toppings were not ample but sufficient. Somewhat pricey for what you get. Flavor was good.

Using Eat24 we just received and ate our first "Delivery" from Pizza Company on Sunset, 89119.
The whole family is sitting around with huge bellies and bulging eyes. The food was wonderful. Ordering on line through Eat24 was easy. There were places to ask for extras and change pasta. Our order arrived within the time period provided. Everything was hot and plentiful. 

#1 16" Margarita Pizza with Pepperoni. We asked for well done. That is how it came with a topping of fresh mozzarella and basil. Luscious, with drippy cheese, and great spices.

#2 Sausage and Peppers.  The sausages had been saute'd prior to being put with the peppers and onions. They were sliced thin. Each fork full was sausage, peppers (red and green bell) and some onion. It was wonderful. Mixed in was Ziti and a great "juice" or sauce that was light and not "tomatoey".

#3 Spaghetti and Meatballs. Yup, four regular sized meatballs. They, like the sausage had been saute'd prior to going in the sauce. Thick tomato sauce and instead of spaghetti We asked for capellini. It was a wonderful meal split between two kids and one dog. We did order a couple extra meatballs to insure all three were happy.

#4 Chicken Parmesan with Capellini. I ordered the extra chicken by checking the box when I ordered. There was enough chicken to feed a school of piraña. I ate until full and there is still enough for a lunch tomorrow. The salads that came with the dinner were cool, crisp, and eye appealing. The italian and the Balsamic dressings were perfect for the salads and with our meals.

Garlic knots, dried pepper flakes and cheese for sprinkling were supplied for us all.

This meal was absolutely perfect. We will be ordering here again, and again, and again.

Pizza Company 2275 E. Sunset, 89119.

This place is REALLY good and has the BEST vegan options out there(we've tried almost all of them). Owner makes his own sauces with real whole-food ingredients along with many other things. Well worth the drive for us.

Decent pizza, super nice staff, I'd totally go back of I'm ever in the area! It was on the pricey side for pizza, but I understand that they aren't a huge franchise and probably can't keep the prices low. I appreciate small businesses.

Surprisingly good pizza!! 
The location is small and out of site but wow I was impressed with the quality of their pizza. 
The prices are reasonable too. I got the 2 slice + drink lunch special for $6 even. It wasn't until I threw away the box that I discovered they make all their sauces, dough, salads, etc from scratch!! (It's written on the box) No wonder it was so good! 

"I will be back" -Arnold Schwarzenegger

Visiting from Napa CA we stayed at La Quinta Inn. Lady at the desk suggested Pizza Company around the corner. We shared small cheese pizza, chicken Parmesan sandwich and sausage and pepper rustica. All made from scratch and you can tell. Nice folks and great value. You will not go away hungry but will be smiling!

Vegan pizza is hard to find and GOOD VEGAN PIZZA is even harder to find. & the Pizza Company has PHENOMENAL VEGAN PIZZA! The dough and the sauce and the cheese and the fresh veggies are extremely tasty! Also, the vegan garlic knots and the vegan baked ziti were also super yummy! So happy this place is down the street from me because I'm addicted!!!

I have been going to Pizza Company about once a week since this place has opened, and can say I have never been disappointed.  Location is very convienent to many airport hotels.  Menu is diverse, but find myself always coming back to the medium pepperoni.  The crust makes this pizza.  Crunchy on the edges and chewy in the center.  The owner Joey is ALWAYS friendly and welcoming when I walk through the door.  

Personal tip... Order pizza... Run down to the 7-11 for some beer and by the time you come back it'll be hot, fresh, and ready to go.  

A nice end of the day when you're away or at home.

We had gone here curious of the vegan garlic knots.  After looking at the menu the gentleman behind the counter asked if we were vegan and then offered us a special they had going on.  An XL pizza with vegan cheese and 3 toppings with 12 garlic knots for $26.99.  Umm yeah!  Everything was delicious, both people working were friendly and went above and beyond to make sure we were satisfied.  Having been dreamin about more vegan garlic knots since we left ..we will be back.

I had high hopes for this place but I was let down. Wanted to grab some pizza and eat it at sunset Park. I placed my order through Yelp it was ready in thirty minutes. They did not put any utensils, napkins, red chilli flakes in the to go bag. I did not get the ranch I ordered. The pizza was relatively bland, I got a Hawaiian. The salad was good, I got the antipasto. Ordered a tirimisu because it was made in house. By far the grossest thing I have ever eaten. First, it was frozen;then it was covered in some old crusty cocoa powder. It was bland and completely inedible. I will not be back.

This place is the best!!! It might not look like much but the food & the customer service is better than most places. I'm vegan & I felt really well taken care of, the guy working there was very attentive despite the fact he was running the whole place by himself! I was impressed. He even gave us samples of their vegan ricotta. For only 20 bucks we got 6 vegan garlic knots, a medium pizza w vegan cheese & 3 toppings, & 2 sides of vegan ranch. It was one of the best pizzas I've had in years and I've had my fair share of vegan pizzas. The only con was they didn't have any vegan proteins, but not a huge deal. A+ food A+ service 

Thanks pizza company!!!

The pizza had a weird aftertaste,when I attempted to get my money back for the uneaten portion,the cook? Told me no one else complained,even going so far to ask a patron in the restaurant if there was anything wrong with her pizza! I pointed out none of this mattered,concerning the taste of my pizza,and I just wanted my money back,he told they already made it and delivered it,so that was that. Very unprofessional and rude!!

My friend and I have been wanting to try this place for a while because of a Groupon I had and it is a good spot to watch the planes come in at sunset. We tried a little bit of everything. We ordered two medium pizzas one Margarita and a Hawaiian the crust was just perfect not thin or thick and crispy. The house salads were good with their homemade vinaigrette dressing. It just needed some more vegetables and less onions. The wings were nice and hot with lots of sauce as well as the garlic knots. The knots could of used more garlic, but don't let this discourage yourself from ordering them. I love garlic, so it is never too much. Over all the food was down to earth, the staff was accommodating, the place was clean, and the ladies bathroom was spotless. All this will have me returning again even though I live across town. It is just a simple pizza whole in the wall place with good food. Oh they just need an ice machine too for the cans of soft drinks or a fountain machine. All in good time!

Ordered pizza and salad for a birthday party at kangamoo. It was delivered promptly and tasted delicious. We were a little nervous because we had never eaten there but our guests loved it and the dressings and salad were delish! Would definitely recommend this place. Thanks Joey!

I am staying at the Hampton Inn just around the corner from the Pizza Company. I walled over last night. It is located next to an old Las Vegas strip center (which contains the Village Pub with it's excellent fish and chips). Pizza Company makes pizza the old fashioned, New York, thin crust well done, good sauce way. The taste is fantastic and the prices better than reasonable. 

My name is Tony so fuggedaboudit! Order from Pizza Company!

So I haven't wrote a review on here in a LONNNNNNNGGGGG time (I'm talking like FOREVER, do you see how old my elite status is?). So let's call out that this food was so terrible I had to write one this instant. My roommate and I have ordered from all over the place in our little 89014 area. Joes Philly, Super Pizza, Napolis, and none were great, this one though, just bleh! They use some sorta seasoning on there that we couldn't get passed, one slice and trashed the large pizza. 

The fingers reminded me of something left out for hours and hours, put in the fridge, and then microwaved (I know what this is like because I do this often). Even though I do it, I don't want it to taste like that upon arrival! 

The cheesy fries, or FRIES I should just call them, lacked any more than 1oz of cheese and to top it off they were cold, bleh! 

Fried zucchini was meh, and so were the cannolis. 

The one good thing, and the reason why this has two stars and not was is the ranch! I'm a ranch connoisseur and I'm always searching, this is great, not vinegar based!  

Let me also mention I told the people I needed to break a hundred, yet they didn't communicate it with the driver. So it was pennies on then dollar on my WASTE of 50 bucks or I gathered quarters for him; which I did, because I used to be a driver myself and didn't want to be a jerk.  

You can see photos of this hot mess on EAT24 as well as my not happy comments. 

Overall- never, ever again Pizza Company!
Ordered while at the Hampton Inn nearby using the app. Food was hot and tasty and all items were well packaged and accounted for. Delivery was friendly and fast. Would order here again.

The vegan pizza here is fantastic. Daiya Cheese, fresh veggies and perfectly crispy crust. Can't forget to mention the vegan garlic knots!! Service is absolutely amazing as well. Best vegan pizza in Las Vegas.

Great many vegan options on the menu from pizza, pasta, garlic knots, rolls, burgers, and even a brownie!  Staff extremely friendly and knowledgeable.  Interior lacks finesse, but it's a pizza joint designed primarily for take-out/delivery.  Good food, good people!  Location easy to miss on first pass.

The pizza was great, I ordered a alfredo chicken pizza and cheese garlic bread. I must say it's different from what I normally have in Chicago and it's definitely different than your favorite pizza chain. Everything seemed fresh and host was friendly enough, though a bit deserted on a weekend lunchtime, it's a small place, just enough for 20-25 people, but worth a try. And yes, the menu is pretty economical too.
Joel is an amazing restaurant owner and does a great job. Pizza is always hot, fresh, and delicious!

Pizza Company has been on my list for awhile now and I was finally able to try it last night as we were in the area on errands. 
I've heard rave reviews from a vegan group I follow, claiming they have great vegan options and even homemade vegan ranch (be still my heart!!).
I ordered the vegan Stromboli w mushrooms, bell pepp, and spinach and an order of garlic knots w marinara. The food was SO tasty!! And the service was so friendly and attentive. 
My daughter loved it, too. 
Will definitely be back to try more vegan options!
great pizza. has deals for our apartment complex on wednesdays

No way this place gets 4 stars.  The best thing about this pizza is the price - and you get what you pay for.  We got a pepperoni and mushroom pizza and the pepperoni bites.  Both were bland and pretty tasteless.  Costco pizza is way better, heck a Digionos would blow this one away. Skip it and save your money.

I loved Pizza Company! It's great when a restaurant has clearly marked vegan options, my favorite was the vegan roll. The best part was the service, the owner and all the associates were very friendly and helpful and looked like they take pride in what they do and enjoy it. I feel like the location is not the best, which is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5. A better location could help improve the atmosphere but overall great food and service!

Joey and crew put together a good tasting pizza and they've always been very friendly. However, the prices are just too high for what you're getting now in my opinion.

They upped the prices a few months ago which is understandable but now they've reduced the size as well. What used to be the large is now the XL, so you're paying the same price for a large, but you're getting a smaller pizza when you order the large.

With that being said, I still think they make a good pizza, but we'll be looking for cheaper options in the future.
My favorite pizza in Las Vegas.  Also love the calzone and stromboli.  I'll be back soon.

This is a great place to have lunch, order to go, or even cater. the food is excellent, very fresh. Talking about its making my mouth water lol. In overall is great costumer service, very welcoming. I most definitely give it a 5 STAR!!!
Lots of vegetarian and vegan options with good fun service. Come here, eat food... Smile.

wow. this is the worst place I ever order food from. 1st the food came cold, & when spoke to the manager Joey he said - WE ARE TRYING OUR BEST,  then he insulted me, & was as unprofessional as a manager could be. He thinks making excusing & insulting people is part of saying sorry. I would tell everybody do not order from this place, as long as this guy is in charge. He is a joke of a mamager.

This place is pretty unbeatable for lunch. Their lunch specials range from $3.49 up to $5.99. Today, I picked up a serving of their Spaghetti and Sausage Link special for $3.99. You get a good amount of spaghetti with a whole sausage link--some of it is thinly sliced with the remainder still being in whole sausage form. It also came with a couple of garlic knots on the side.

The sauce wasn't mind-blowing, but it was tasty enough. The sausage was well-cooked and had good flavor. They put a ton of sauce in my serving. I almost wish it had less sauce (or more pasta on the side to eat with it). The garlic knots served as a nice vessel for the extra sauce that was left over.

Overall, while not the absolute best spaghetti meal I've ever had, the $4 price point is the kicker. The taste to price ratio works in their favor.

Minor Update: I went back the next day and got the same lunch special. Strangely enough, it tasted even better, though the sauce was definitely on the greasy side. In any case, this solidifies their 4-star rating for me.

Completely disgusting! I ordered the Philly cheese steak sub and my husband ordered the meatball sub. My sub was very dry, the meat was tasteless and tough. My husband on had meat balls and marinara sauce on his sub no cheese at all which usually comes on a meatball sub. The fries were tiny and appeared to be refrozen then baked. This is the worst restaurant I have ordered take out from since I moved to Vegas! How can you ruin a sub? I mean really its sandwich! Come on you guys have to do a better job with your menu.

Love this place! They are friendly and helpful. Their customer service rocks! The food is delicious! I love their garlic knots and garlic knot sliders. They pepperoni bites are amazing. Their garlic fries are awesome. I cannot get enough of their tiramisu and cannolis.

Three words: VEGAN GARLIC KNOTS. Yes, I would come back for that alone. The employees are also very accommodating for my party of 10. My side of the table opted for a the special, which was a relatively large pizza that came with about 12 garlic knots. These garlic knots are probably one of the most heavenly pieces of buttery, garlick-y bread that I have ever continuously plopped into my mouth despite its tongue-scorching temperature. It's that good. And for someone who eats a plant-based diet, I have truly missed pizza that isn't thin crust. Will definitely be coming back to Pizza Company!

I reeeeeeaaaallllly love this place for all my pizza style-cheat day-dough-craving needs.

We order a 16" vegan with very light on the cheese, mushrooms, kalamata olives and fresh basil.  *disclosure* I can not stand Daiya cheese :) I just avoid the cheese when I ordering it and sometimes I leave it off all together.

We always order a full order of vegan garlic knots and WOW it's honestly my fav part because I love love love garlic, the more the better. Next time I order a pizza from here I need to get garlic on the pizza too :)

I will disclose that their sauce is a little bland...I think I'm just accustom to my own sauce that I simmer all day and use fresh herbs. I just like a punch of intense flavors and their sauce does not have that.

Their side salad it always fresh mixed greens and their in house balsamic is amazing. I always dip the pizza crust in it because it's just that yummy.

If you want pizza and you like a Slice of Vegas....(ick and overpriced) you will be hooked on the Pizza Company. It's just better. Hands down...it's better.

Oh and this place is a real deal! I think with we order all three items the total is $24? Wow what a steal.

My friend said their vegan pastas, rolls and other items are amazing. I'm just not that into ordering pasta when ordering out so I don't think I can see myself ordering the pasta.
Good pizza and outstanding service. These guys act like they own the place...maybe they do. Found them on yelp and glad I did. Decent price, good food and great service! Who could ask for more?

We ordered delivery tonight and it was delicious! It came quick and hot-with some courtesy garlic knots thrown in for good measure (thank you for that!).

My spaghetti and meatballs was delicious. The balls were a good size and the sauce was mild and fresh tasting. 

The Big Guy got the double meat sandwich with no onions. He says he would get it with extra cheese next time, but he really enjoyed it with the french fries. 

The mushroom bites were also very tasty! We expected fried mushrooms, but it was cheese and pastry wrapped with mushrooms in them, dipped in marinara-yum!

Thank you for giving us another delivery option.

I heard this place had a few Vegan options so I decided to try it out today, and I'm definitely glad I did! Very friendly staff, and the food was really great & fresh! We tried the Vegan GarlicKnots, the Vegan Baked Ziti, and a Vegan 3 topping pizza. All the food was awesome and we definitely plan to come back, it's always nice to find places with a good menu selection for Vegan, Vegetarian, or any plant based options. My only minor complaints might be that the food did take a while (about 45-60min) so don't dine in if you're in a hurry, but everything is obviously made fresh to order. It's not a glamours place by any means, but it's worth checking out. I will definitely be back and would recommend it to any Vegans looking for good Italian food.

This is going to be my new go-to for pizza!! I'm so excited I found a place that myself and my non vegan boyfriend can enjoy pizza together.

My boyfriend ordered a regular medium pizza with pepperoni. He absolutely loved it and ate all but 2 slices.

I ordered the vegan stromboli with black olives, mushrooms, and green peppers. I also got an order of the vegan garlic knots(!!!!!) with an extra marinara. The stromboli was delicious and the cheese was completely melted all the way through. Their marinara sauce was to die for. I enjoyed the garlic knots but they were kind of spongy. 

When we arrived the guy working the counter was really nice. He asked if we had been there before, which we had not. He gave us some coupons and insisted on giving me a free vegan ranch that they make in house. I personally never cared for ranch but it did taste really good! Definitely spot on as far as ranch flavor goes. He told me that they also do a vegan tiramisu that sells out really basically as soon as they make it.

It was a little pricey. Our meal cost us $26 but to me it was worth the price. 

We will be back very soon!

I don't understand iv been so excited to come for the vegan options I walk in told the guy we're excited for the vegan options and he says" oh great more vegans" he then starts to tell me the specials I asked if there was vegan meats and he looked at my like I was a damn idiot.. and smirked and said no. Only daiya cheese.:never coming back

Best East Coast Pizza in Vegas by far! The service is fantastic, delivery is super quick and its easy to order online. Seriously order from this place, you wont be dissapointed!
Love,
The Jersey Girls

For the price and the fact that they delivered in the time stated was a great start.  To add to the value, I could get a small pizza since my husband prefers pasta and I hate that I have to order at least a 12" from other places and I throw half of it away.  All this being said, the food was very good and I would totally order from here again!!!

I go to this place every time I come to Vegas. Great food, great prices and the people are great, especially the owner. I travel all over the western us, and I do not believe I have had a better slice in all of the West.

First this was delivered by Eatstreet. Quick,  foods always hot and the delivery guy is friendly. 
Pizza Company is near Sunset and Eastern. I live near Mountain Vista.  But quick delivery and hot food! 
The pizza; the sauce, the cheese, the meat the mushrooms are All tasty!  Usually on pizza something is not good. Here all is good!  The chicken fingers were big n meaty n moist and tasty.
Dessert, a cannoli covered in chocolate called a Larhe, Delicious!!! This was my 3rd time ordering and I haven't been disappointed yet.
An 2 topping pizza with 4 chicken fingers, chocolate cannoli,  liter of soda, and an extra ranch plus $5 tip cost me $35.84.  Its worth the money and then some.

On pictures notice the plate, napkins, parm-cheese,  red pepper flakes packages. The food comes in foil bowls with plastic lids so the food doesn't sweat or sog thru plastic containers. Ive got to go meet the owners cuz im impressed.

These pics are of wings and garlic knots. Yum yum

We had a regional meeting and ordered pizza and salad... The food was very good and Joey (the owner) was so great...we had a large amount of people and I called last minute and added more to the order... They were very professional and everyone was happy. 
Thanks so much, we live all the way across town but we will be back.

Excellent experience. The venue is not the biggest, but they make up for it with excellent vegan food and great service. Their omni options look cool too. The food is so exceptional because everything is fresh and hand crafted. We ordered the vegan bites (damn! they were delicious and when you dip them in the red sauce, wow "simply divine"), 2 house salads with vegan ranch (the freshest tomatoes and julienned purple onions! and the vegan ranch is some of the best we've ever tasted), and a small (6 slices) vegan pizza with pineapple, mushrooms, and purple onions. $30 very well spent. 

They had a few more vegan options, vegan Stromboli(?) and a vegan brownie. We're thinking about going back tomorrow to try those too.

I'm still eating and writing this review... 

I travel a lot for work and prefer not to rent a car, so when I'm out, it's hard for me to find good places within a reasonable walking/cab distance. And I'm vegan... so it makes it double hard! When I saw that a pizza place offers a vegan option I was all about it. 

I ordered the vegan garlic knots and the vegan "roll"... holy cow. It's not bland, the flavors are great and the roll is so much food, it's too much to eat! 

Some reviews I've read said the crust isn't great, but on the roll, I was really impressed. 

Thanks Pizza Co.! You made a happy, full girl outta me!

Update 9/2015. I was back in Vegas for work and I called Pizza Co. I didn't have the menu in front of me but by my phone number they were able to pull my previous order. Talk about customer service! Also, I needed it delivered at a specific time and they were able to, even during the evening rush. Again, a satisfied, full girl!

Pizza Company is terrific! We are the owners of Kangamoo Indoor Playground (a few blocks away from Pizza Company) and HIGHLY RECOMMEND Pizza Company to our patrons. Good Pizza -- My husband is from the East Coast and he's very picky about his pizzas and he really likes Pizza Company's New York Style Pizza,  Great Customer Service - Joe and his staff are wonderful, always friendly and service with a smile!  Pizza Company is the official Kangamoo Birthday Party Pizza Vendor for the kids parties and every customer has been very happy! Delivery is always PROMPT, as promise and PRICES are amazing! Keep up the great work Joe!

Everything about this business deserves 5 stars.  The food is delicious, the service is incredible and genuine.   The owner has a real passion for what he does and it shows.  This is a company I can truly feel good about supporting.

This place is awesome, ive tried several of their pizzas and all of them have been delicious. You must try the Garlic Fries, they were spectacular. The staff is super friendly, you really do get treated like family.  If you have a concern about the traffic, remember they deliver!

First off,  asked about specials and all I got was "We have Vegan this or that", which is awesome to have that option but not what I was looking for. So the struggle to have the answer for non-vegan special options was like pulling teeth. Whoever took our order over the phone had a very difficult time and asked 4+ times for the card info.  We asked multiple times for ranch and peppers,  even had it repeated back to us.  Pizza comes, no peppers, no cheese,  no ranch, etc. delivery guy didn't have a pen because "They don't give us pens" so had to search for that.  Pizza was bland,  MAYBE,  MAYBE one step up from cheap, generic,  frozen grocery store pizza.  Marinara wasn't much better... tomato sauce with some Italian seasoning?  Will never go back.

Don't judge this place by its curb appeal. Once you go in, don't judge it by the atmosphere.  The pizza is DELISH!!! Incredibly accommodating service and top notch pizza. Next time - I'm trying a sandwich.

Came after graduation with a huge party of people and staff was amazing. We were taken care of, food came out in a timely manner, and best of all delicious vegan options. We got vegan garlic knots and vegan pizza.

I'm so excited for any company to support a easier time for all to live on this planet. Choosing to comsume less animals and their fluids is a easy choice when you head over to pizza company!!! They have quite a few vegan  options. Pizza, garlic knots, stromboli, browies and I  hear they made a vegan tiramisu!! They even make a vegan ranch in house!!! They also have a vegan burger and vegan bites i look forward to trying!! Staff is friendly place is clean. come check them out!!!

I've had the pizza, sausage roll, Stromboli, and sausage and peppers rustica.  I give all of them 5 stars except the pizza was 4 stars but that's just personal preference. If I could give more than 5 stars for service I would. Friendly, helpful, and after 4 visits the 3 different employees I dealt with, all acted like they owned the place.  That's a rare thing when you have employees with an ownership mentality these days. Awesome!
Unoriginal, bland and boring.Review is for Joey, not the pie. Did not want to try after talking with this guy. Congratulations Joey!!! You are a 1 star human being. Off to Grimaldi's.

Ordered delivery first time, super Glad i did the food was great and my burger was amazing my wife and i for the first time had no complaints about our delivered food. Definitely will order here again.

In town for a tournament and Yelp'd to see a good pizza joint in the area... We brought 15 people and they did a great job getting the food right and on time.  I had a stromboli...which if you don't know... is basically a sandwich (just the meat and cheese) wrapped in pizza dough and baked!  Edible...but wouldn't order again.  Garlic knots were pretty good and pizza was pretty good!  Service was 5 stars!  Food was about 3 stars.  Location was 1 star...WTH?  Creepy much?  
Overall 3.5 stars for me... I'd return if close by otherwise I'd try other locations to see how they stand up.

The food was delivered over an hour and half after I placed the order. I called the restaurant twice and explained my kids needed to go to bed, only an apology was offered. The restaurant blamed the driver and suggested the food was just waiting to be picked up. Hmmm doesn't sound fresh after an hour and a half. The fee and tip had already been added to my order. I will not order from this restaurant again. I order at 630pm pizza arrive at 753pm.
