I could actually pick the spot most convenient to me and they keep close contact with the vegas office to make sure appointments are honored and no extra charges for the distances whenever a crown or other material is shipped to my location of choice. Could not be happier with the consistency and courtesy of Dr. Tran and his crew and colleagues in Newport and la Jolla.
Excellent craftsmanship.
I've been coming here for many years and the staff here have been amazing! They always make excellent decisions and make sure my mouth is top notch!!

Dr.Rana and Dr.Tongsiri are always smiling and happy. The staff here are awesome!!! Especially Mario, they always follow up. Sometimes crown do break, they got me in ASAP, didn't charge me extra or nothing they finish what they started to my satisfaction. Mario took customer service to a whole new level. My van battery gave me problem and wouldn't start, he came down and gave me a jump start, highly recommended!!! Oh Doctors are great too !!!

So... We used to see the dentist at Silver State Smiles-- Dr. Tongsiri and her crew. They were gracious, honest and a really nicely ran little office. Oh yes, our appointments sometimes ran late, but the feeling of the office wasn't customers coming in for an appointment-- but family popping by and being taking care of. Since I have four children-- I truly enjoyed knowing that we were being taken care of and not simply customers. The crew also never tried to 'upsell' procedures.

Well-- as things do-- all good things must come to an end. Silver State Smiles merged with Image Dental. Now, my family member went in for a cleaning-- normal cleaning-- no biggie and expected to see Dr. Tongsiri. Who did he see? A stranger. Well, that's okay, right? As long as they're good at what they do and honest. Even though they merged with Silver State Smiles-- they demanded a redo on his current xrays. Okay-- it's not a huge procedure and the insurance company will pay for new xrays-- go ahead. That's fine. But then they said he needed a deep cleaning-- which isn't covered by dental insurance and they know it-- and he actually does not need a deep cleaning.

Warning bells ring out! I am sickened by dentists who try to upsell procedures that are not necessary to clients. This family member is already very leery of dentists and it took me many many years to find a dentist he'd be willing to go to-- well, hey, guess what? Not anymore.

I'm also very irate that they are demanding new xrays on everyone even though they merged with the other office. It's enough work to get my kids' cleanings done on time, but to demand xrays that don't need to be done just so they can pad their pockets with the new clients? Draw your own conclusion.

So I had a family appointment for me and my children to go to the dentist this week. I called to cancel and when I talked to the receptionist-- I stated that I was not satisfied with my family member's treatment there and the receptionist? She yawned. I said I'd like to cancel, but if Carla or any of the other members of the staff from Silver State Smiles would like to call me and discuss the issues my family member had, I could literally hear the receptionist's eyeballs clacking back in her head as she rolled her eyes at me. "I'll just cancel the appointment."

They really do care about their clientele at Image Dental, don't they?

I'm not a big fan of dentist (as I don't believe anyone is), but Dr. Rana is awesome. I've been coming here for seven years and will continue to do so. Dayna has been here for a while and I appreciate seeing her familiar face at each visit.

I have been coming to Image Dental since April 2015. I began my relationship with Image Dental by first receiving their teeth cleaning services and eventually I asked about a consultation for braces and they were able to provide the consultation for free. Since then, I have been coming regularly for my orthodontist appointments and teeth cleanings.
 
The staff is most welcoming, everyone from the front desk to the doctors are incredible and are genuinely concerned about how satisified you are with your smile. They are always prepared to alleviate any confusion with insurance coverage, co-pays, etc...
 
Have a busy schedule and don't have time to see the dentist? The Image Dental staff does everything in their power to work with your schedule and address your needs.

I used to be so scared of dentist and anything related to dentistry. At the same time I am also in dire need of dental care. My overall dental health had transformed to its best over the course of 3 months, thanks to Dr. Farranesh and team. They made me no longer scared of dentist and the whole process really taught me that it is important to take good care of your dental health. Thank you for fixing my smile. Image Dental really is the best!

I am prompted to write this review to warn others of unethical practices engaged in my Image Dental.  In my specific instance, the practice booked me for additional cleanings beyond what my insurance would cover.  When I pressed, they made it clear that they knew all along that I would have to pay out of pocket for the cleaning in question, yet I was not warned of this at the time of booking three months prior.  The office's tone and demeanor made it clear that this was a standard practice.

When I asked why I was being booked for quarterly cleanings, rather than the standard bi-annual covered by most insurance, I was given a mealy-mouthed excuse about having "gum disease" (beat in mind I have never discerned the slightest sign of this or been told this was the case by other dentists).

Save your money.  Save your integrity.  Go somewhere else!

This dental office is very good. I am planing to stay with them because the prices are reasonable and the staff is great. Just had my cleaning done and Hazel was my hygienist and she did an excellent job.  I am nervous going to the dentist but with this place I know I am in good hands so just relax

Bait & Switch! Dishonest, sloppy, unorganized business.

Booked specifically with Dr. Amy Tongsiri via Zoc Doc based on the great reviews I read for her online. All the texts and email confirmations I received--from both Zoc Doc and Image Dental--noted I had an appointment booked/confirmed with Dr. Tongsiri. The office even called me the day of, about 2 hours before my appointment, to confirm my insurance information yet failed to mention that Dr. Tongsiri does not work on Mondays! 

Even worse, when I got there, they didn't tell me she was not in that day or ask if I would be okay with another dentist. Also, they insisted I get x-rays done despite my having had them taken a few months earlier already when I was just there for a cleaning. I explained that I relocated from NYC but can have my old dentist send over the x-rays and reschedule if they really need them for the cleaning as I don't want to take another set and expose myself to radiation unnecessarily. Their response? "Well I guess we're not the right dentist for you." Obviously, they have too much business to care about customer service.

The icing on the cake, the receptionists never actually told me Dr. Tongsiri was not in until I corrected them after they kept referring to the dentist as "he"  and called them out on it saying that it should be "she" since my appointment was with Dr. Amy Tongsiri--only then did they admit she was not even in the office Mondays and was only there on Wednesdays. No apologies or remorse for the false advertising and misinformation. Simply "Ok, thanks for coming, guess we're not the right dentist for you" again.
The staff at Image Dental was amazing. Very friendly. The hygienist was great, she was very helpful and informative.

I definitely liked the smaller friendlier office of Dr. Tongsiri better.  But it wasn't the atmosphere that made my decision to never return.  My 9 year old child has had routine check ups, cleanings and x-rays taken the past 3 years or so with no issues. No cavities or gum issues ever. Daily x2 minimum brushing and flossing mostly daily.  The last appointment there was for another check up and cleaning.  Dr. Tongsiri wasn't in the office, which doesn't really matter, but she IS the reason we choose her practice initially.  After a 30 minute wait, and a literally 10 minute exam/cleaning, we were out of there.  No problem. When the bill came  there was a charge for "ORAL HYGIENE INSTRUCTIONS" $130.  I immediately asked my child what they told her, she didn't remember. So I asked if they showed her how to brush or said anything about brushing. She said the Hygienist told her something like "make sure you floss everyday".  $130 WOW!  How many people have they charged this? How many have paid it?
It's unethical and seems criminal to me and a downright shame really.

When looking for any health care professionals, the most important thing for me is the doctor's respect for patient's questions and time. I tend to ask a lot of questions and expect professional answers. Drs tend to feel like I'm questioning their credentials which I am not. And usually when they feel offended because of my questions I know they are not the doctor for me ( sadly it has happened before where I had to walk out and call state regarding an eye doctor). Also my time is just as important as the doctor's, so I do not want to feel like I am being rushed and the wait is reasonable. And most of all the care I receive. 

Dr. Lisa Hoang was above and beyond. Aside from graduating from one of the top dental schools in America (UOP in SF), she was polite, professional, caring, and respectful. 

I had 5 cavities filled, a deep clean, and had to get an impression done for my night guard. 

She didn't try to sell or push any treatments on me. She explained everything she was gonna do before she did it because I told her I get anxiety (not with the pain but the thought of someone in my mouth and not being able to move or do anything about it). 

She also asked about family history and educated me about how to care for my own teeth and mouth to delay the inevitable. My son was there and she was really patient with him too, they let him play with the office's ipad. I would think she is good with children even though they are not pediatric dentists. 

Overall, she was VERY knowledgable, did not push or make me feel to get treatments done. But with being so knowledgable, she would sometimes use medical terms I did not understand, so I had to ask her to simplify- which she politely did. It was a  not-as-scary-as-i-thought-it-would-be experience. 

Parking is also tricky, make the turn into a round-about, dont park in the storage facility.

Yeah, I moved to Scottsdale almost a year ago. Yeah, I drove all the way to Vegas, just to see my old dentist in Las Vegas. Why, you ask? Because he IS the best.

I paid my first visit to Dr. Tran almost a year ago, and saw his deal on Yelp back when I didn't have insurance. You can see my old review, where he only charged me $40 bucks for a cleaning and X-Rays.

Yesterday, I was proud to come back to him and bring him my problematic mouth to fix again. I won't go into the gory details, but I knew I could trust him, and once again, he came through with his awesome professional care!

This office is great. Dr. Tran and the staff do a great job in making sure that you feel safe and painless, if you are getting a cleaning, or even getting things drilled. The digital X-rays are pretty cool because you can see close-ups of EVERYTHING.

The staff is very chatty! This is a MAJOR MAJOR strength and helps ease any anxiety you may have. You'll feel like you are hanging out with friends. And if you are lucky, you might even have the chance to pick the movie they are playing in the office. I chose the Tom Hanks classic, Big. 

Score for me!

Thanks Dr. Tran! You guys are awesome!

Great job I went to dr amy before and they are now in different location. Sahara is nice office, very clean and have tv in room. Thank you hazel for great cleaning. Everyone is nice. Will keep coming back.

PLEASE SAVE YOUR MONEY AND TIME!!! Fist off Dr. Hoang at the Dental Image on Sahara is unfortunately very unprofessional and the place is dirty. Secondly they are sadly scamming people. I went for a cleaning, they had me pay upfront which i thought was odd. I know why now. I sat down in the dentist chair, waited 45 minutes for the dentist to come. Finally the dentist came over and looked at my teeth and said you need a "thorough cleaning" and costs $785!! I said no thank you, I came in for a standard cleaning and which is what I already paid for. They said well I can't give you a standard cleaning if I need a " thorough cleaning ". I said no thank you, that I will just take a refund. They laughed at me and said there are no refunds and for me to just finance the $785 if I couldn't afford it.  You would expect this scamming style of business for a car salesman but from a dentist???  If they can straight out cheat people like this with this scam would you trust your teeth with them?

Amazing practice.  The front end staff is great and very nice.  Very helpful.   The doctors are just plain fantastic.  They educate you and help you understand what is exactly going on in your mouth. They give you the knowledge you need to make the best decisions for your teeth.  

I love this practice.  I recommend to everyone

My whole family switched to this office after being at a dentist that wasn't treating us too well. The front staff as well as the assistants and Drs are very friendly and approachable. A much better experience than at our previous dentist.

I've been with Silver State Smiles for the better part of 2 years and prior to their migration over to Image Dental they were great at both providing me with fantastic dentistry work and having a pleasant environment and nothing has changed since they've switched over. 

Yes Dr.Amy is very busy but all the dentists outside of her are just as equally as qualified and fantastic and shouldn't be over looked. 

Not only is it the responsibility of the dentist to handle your teeth with care (Which they do oh-so effortlessly) but also the staff. Again, prior to Silver State Smiles migration, Karla has and continues to be a great face for both Silver State Smiles and Image Dental and is a pleasure talk to (That girl deserves a raise!). 

If you want great and high quality service than Image Dental is the place.

I love this place! The office staff are wonderful and helpful. The assistants are gentle and compassionate. The doctor took the time to explain what I need and why, and talked with me about my wants and needs. I am so glad that I found this place! I will be bringing my partner here asap.
I like everything about this office.. Dr rana is amazing, the entire office staff is great. They're good with my daughter.

Well it's been 6 months since my last visit and once again I have only wonderful things to say. Everything in my last review holds true with one new point. The hygienist, Hazel, that cleaned my teeth was new to the office.  In keeping with the quality of services Image provides, Hazel was gently yet thorough. She removed all the coffee stains that accumulated from 6 months of morning coffee, and my teeth were significantly whiter when I left the office. She was also very diligent in pointing out any areas of concern for the dentist to check during the dental exam. I would gladly schedule my cleaning with her again. 
Also, I reviewed my dad's dental plan with Dr. Faranesh, but only after the office confirmed that necessary HIPA paperwork was in order. I can't thank Dr. F enough for taking as much time as she did to explain the reason why each recommendation was made for my dad's plan. Not only did she give me a verbal explanation, but she showed me his xrays so I could see his issues. They also provided me with a written estimate that showed the insurance coverage and copay so there would be no surprises. 
Good job Image! You out did yourself once again.

This is a great place - if you want to be treated like an ATM and subjected to extortion. I've been a patient with Silver State Smiles for a few years, and they were great. Then they merged with another company to become Image Dental. I've had a couple of check ups and cleanings done at the new location, which have been fine. In fact, the hygienist was fantastic. The issue is that since my last visit and since the time I scheduled my latest appointment, they changed their pricing (I do not have insurance). If it was a marginal increase, I probably would have let it slide. But when I showed up for my appointment, I was told that the cost would be something akin to a mortgage payment on my home for a basic cleaning and check-up! Then the girl at the desk tries to coerce me into their new annual discount savings plan, where if I was to pay an annual fee, then I would have access to discounted rates, rates that are STILL higher than what I'd paid in the past. OK. Pricing can change over time. I won't argue with that. However, if you are going up your prices by over 500%, you may want to let your existing patients know before they are left standing in shock at the ridiculousness of your new business model, having taken time off work and wasted time and gas to get to an appointment they can no longer afford. There are literally hundreds of dental offices in Vegas. I'm sure there is a place out there offering good services for a reasonable fee that wants my business.

Not much I can say about Image Dental other than that they were awesome!  I hate going to the dentist, as does everyone, but Dr. Tran and his staff made me feel very comfortable.  I had a crown done and had so little pain inflicted upon me because of it... I barely even felt when the novacaine was injected.  I'll definitely be visiting Image Dental or Dr. Tran's other office as long as he is practicing and I am in Vegas!

Wouldn't recommend this place. I went there three times, and across my three appointments, I was given inconsistent advice and was forced to wait an unnecessary amount of time. Furthermore, they frequently tack on additional services to your appointment, without giving any prior notice. So, you have no idea how long your appointment will last. Better carve out a whole day if you're planning to go to Image Dental. For example, today they had me scheduled for some extra special cleaning that took extra long. After waiting 45 minutes without being seen, I requested that I receive a regular, quicker teeth cleaning. The dentist then refused to do the cleaning and sent a receptionist back to reschedule with me. Beyond the questionable ethics of such practices, I doubt this dental practice will continue to generate new clients with these kinds of business practices.

I was eating soup, I felt something hard in it and spat it out. It was my molar crown! It's fallen off before, I've had problems with that one as it was made by a pretty careless and painful dentist - the kind that scares you off from coming in for proper care. 

My dentist for my visit was Dr. Amy Tongsiri. She was just so adorably friendly and bubbly! We chatted and felt at ease- I absolutely loved her! Her whole team was so nice and gentle as well when handling my teeth and really mindful of the water/saliva stuff pooling up as I feel like I tend to choke at most dentist chairs. It's so simple, but why don't more dentist put sunglasses on people?! It was nice not to get blinded by the light.

I was hoping that I can just cement it back in, but she recommended that I get a new one made that fit better. I had it from when I was pretty young and my mouth shifted since and it's probably why it popped off again. What also sucks is that I had 2 cavities now - on the tooth in front of this crown and the one behind it. Boo! I do have cavities from when I was a kid, but I've gone a long time as a adult without new ones. 

 It's such bad timing, as I don't have insurance, but will in a few months. It's always a expensive fix to do dental work, but they worked with me to make it as affordable as possible.The cost of this crown was actually cheaper than what my original one cost. Much better made as the material is stronger, has a lifetime warranty in case something does happen and has zero metal like my old one.

Ever have something made, had to have a temporary and then come back two weeks? What's great is they have a lab downstairs and for some items can be made in a few hours and put in same day! I went to grab some lunch and came back to have my crown put in. I actually had Dr My Tran put my crown in and he is how I found out about this place. I met him and his wife years ago at a event so I've always had it in the back of my head to come here.

The office is also run impeccably well. I appreciated that my actual appointment time is when I get in to be seen as I've been to offices that was perpetually 1 hour behind. The front of the staff and billing were all friendly too. When I came back a few hours later to place my crown, they were on it of informing the dental team and I was back having it placed in no time.

Let's face it, dentist get a bad rap. It only takes one bad trip as it is a pretty vulnerable experience that is frankly scary for many people. When someone is all up in your grill, it's important to feel they care about you. I'm not scared or hesitant to come back here. This is one of the most pleasant dentist experiences I've had. 

They're doing dentistry right here. Absolutely recommend them!

I'm in town on vacation and decided to take care of some teeth cleaning while I had down time. The flexible  staff was able to fit me into their schedule. Everyone I interacted with was both friendly and professional. I may just visit this location on my next Vegas visit.

The manny is great. The wait can be long, however when I got to the back he made me very comfortable.  I bought a family dental plan I believe was $200 which can be used for a family up to 5. Children can be seen here for exams and cleaning but thats all anything else is referred. Well thats a waste just paid for a plan that cant really help my children. Other then that i really like  this dental office.

My dentist (Dr. Amy from Silver State Smiles) merged with Image Dental and I have been in for a couple cleanings.  Long story short - snickers candy bar pulled out an old filing, had my first root canal, got my NEW FAVORITE TOOTH!!  I went for the more expensive zirconium (something like that) crown and it's the neatest tooth ever.  It has ridges and edges just like a real tooth, not smooth like my filings or other crown.  Go science!

Dr. Lisa Hoang is AWESOME!

It's been a few years since I've been to a dentist so I was so not looking forward to this visit but to my surprise, Dr. Hoang answered all my questions and totally made me feel at ease in understandable language.  

The hygienist did a great job with my cleaning-pain free and showed me how to brush and floss my teeth correctly.  I had no idea I have been brushing too hard and flossing the wrong way.  

I was scared that I was going to need tons of work.  Luckily, I only needed a filling! Dr. Hoang explained everything to me before she even started. And as she did the filling, she constantly asked if I was okay.  Nothing hurt and I was completely relaxed.  

DEFINITELY FOUND MY GO-TO DENTIST!  WOOHOO!

Had my teeth cleaned by Hazel there. She was good. Efficient and kind. However, I waited 20mins in the lobby, then after the cleaning, waited another hour in the chair. Ended up walking out. I get the feeling they just don't care anymore. Used to be great service. Not feeling that anymore.

More updates: I filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau and BBB has sent me a few emails stating that Image dental has not replied back after several attempts to contact them. They also sent a list of other agencies to file with. In their complaint form I was asked if I would speak to the media and I replied, "ABSOLUTELY" Initially I just wanted them to honor the agreement, now I want a full refund as the relationship is tainted and do not feel comfortable having them do dental work due to the nature of the service. This is an update to my review of Dr Tran's office and company image dental. I spent thousands upon thousands of dollars having all but two teeth crowned. Tran stated that the crowns were far superior to my regular teeth, much stronger and I would not break them due to having a forceful bite and grinding. He strongly recommended at the time that I have them all crowned to prevent this. To keep this as brief as possible, he stated several times after breaking some of the teeth that I didn't have to worry about anything because they had a warranty for 20 years. He stated that warranty to me before purchasing also. at the time I had my entire set of teeth minus 2 of them crowned I received a bill of 430.00 approximately 2 years after completion. I was in a terrible financial position then and of course paid all along so was not expecting this bill. I could not pay it. During this time Dr. Tran expanded his company into several offices across Las Vegas and California and no longer worked on patients or even communicated with them. During a visit while they were replacing a broken tooth and actually honoring the warranty a new dentist that Dr Tran absorbed who was Dr Amy fixed the tooth and stated they she would make a new bite plate for me free of charge which is part of the several thousand dollar dental revamp. This is done to prevent them from having to fix teeth under warranty. I stated that I would come back and did not want to go through the fitting. On the way out of the office, the front desk girl stated that they were not going to continue fixing my teeth until I paid the 430.00 bill that came out of nowhere long after the job was completed. I guess dentists think because they charge 30,000.00 for work that everyone has loads of money to keep paying even after I payed for everything on the spot less what insurance paid. I stated that I would pay eventually just like I paid several thousand dollars to them and that if I did not get the bite plate I would have more problems and they would have to honor it. Long after I obtained the money and set an appointment. I paid 100.00 of it over the phone when making the appointment. After they changed my appointment time three times, I was at the office and they stated that I needed to pay the balance of 340.00 before they would look at me. I stated I would but I wanted to see what they were going to fix. The receptionist stated that we are here to help and solve this but we need the balance. So in good faith I paid before entering. The dentist who also joined the new giant of a dental group recommended a bite plate and several broken teeth needed to be replaced. I also had a crown fall off and giving me pain. She stated when I came back for the bite plate that they stated were normally 800.00 but free with the work I had done. Ten minutes before that one of the dental assistants showed me a night guard that I could get at Wallgreens for slightly around 13.50. She stated that they were very good. Also a few years back when they were still treating me, the night guards were 300.00. I guess this was a way of saying look how much we are giving you for free. I do not recall plastic going up that much in value. The bottom line was that the broken teeth would need to be charged to me at around 10,000.00 and warranty is no good. Even if I had the money to do it, I would never go back and ask for more punishment, pain and suffering for such poor dental work. Now I have to find a quality dentist to at least either extract the tooth where the horrible crown replacement failed and not honored. Once you have this type of work performed if your dentist does poor work, you no longer can just forget about it because your regular teeth are ground down. This is a long review, but it is also a honest and factual one. I strongly suggest that this operation since the giant expansion is not a business to have something so important as dental work. Who knows how long they will even be around to honor anything. I have seen to many good companies go big and loose what they started with then sell out. BUYER BEWARE!

One of the best, if not the best doctor / dentist experiences I have ever had.  Everyone is superbly professional and nice. Went in for cleaning, x-ray, and exam.

All of my questions were answered and procedures were explained. I knew exactly what was happening, how much the cost is, and I was made super comfortable.

They have very modern equipment (360 panorama x-ray machine!). Office and equipment are clean and well-maintained.  

Overall, fantastic experience. "The work" should get a 5-star by itself but staff's interactions put this place in my "highly recommended" category. 

Automatic reminders via text for appointments were much appreciated.

Freitag waren wir beim sogenannten Soft-Opening des neuen Bauhaus-Marktes, der dann am gestrigen Montag offizielle Eröffnung feierte. Im Vergleich zum schon riesigen Markt in Stuttgart-Möhringen ist dieser noch größer - laut einer Bekannten die dort arbeitet, sind es 1000qm mehr als in Möhringen und die merkt man auch. Alles wirkt geräumiger.


 Da sich nicht all zu viele Leute am Freitag in den Markt verirrten, kann ich nicht viel dazu sagen, wie die Mitarbeiter an einem Samstag, wenn der Markt brummt reagieren würden. Am vergangenen Freitag wirkten alle aber sehr zuvorkommend und freuten sich wohl, dass es endlich los geht.


 Die Beschilderung im Markt könnte - genau wie in Möhringen - besser sein, aber immerhin hängen an vielen Stellen Übersichtspläne, die bei der Orientierung helfen.

Bevor der neue Bauhaus-Markt eröffnet hat, war ich immer bei Hornbach.


 Aber inzwischen gehe ich lieber hier hin. Das Bauhaus ist sehr groß, gut sortiert, hilfsbereite Mitarbeiter (bei Fragen), sehr sauber, alles in allem echt gut.

wirklich großes baufachgeschäft. hier endlich hatten wir "unseren" wohnzimmerboden gefunden, nachdem wir gefühlt alle baumärkte der region stuttgart abgeklappert hatten! freundliche mitarbeiter haben sie hier auch, da kommen wir gern bei den nächsten heimwerkerprojekten vorbei.

As a bar this place is fantastic. As a bar and restaurant it needs improvement. 
Any place that has a wall full of beer taps is awesome and when it has a great selection and great service - it becomes my favorite.
We had a trainee as our waitress (Leslie, I think her name was). She was great - I was surprised at how attentive the wait staff was considering the place was full. The girl who was training Leslie was equally attentive and pleasant. Hopefully the level of service is a norm and not a fluke. 

The beer selection is great, although I would love to see more asian beers and couple German/Austrain ones like Lowenbrau, Hofbrau and Steigl on the list.

The place has a cool decor and comfy booths to sit in. It also has outdoor seating if you're one of those who likes to bake while they drink. 
The food needs to get better but I will say that it is an innovative menu for a bar and their pretzels were awesome. I also had their beer soup in a bread bowl and that was great as well. The bread itself isn't spectacular but the soup was very tasty.

And on Wednesdays they do a keep the glass thing, where you can get the beer they have for that day with its own glass and keep the glass. 

All in all, a good place to go for great beers served by efficient waitresses.

The flying saucer is great!  They have over 70 beers on tap that change frequently.  On top of the awesome beer selection they have a fun beer club that only costs 15 bucks.  You get a card to swipe and it keeps track of which beers you have tried and which beers you have left.
The food is also pretty good.  They have a few german dishes that pair well with the beer options and also a few other typical bar food items.  The drink specials are enough to keep you coming back as well...along with the activities on different nights (trivia tuesday night, and glass night on Wednesdays).  If you like beer and a fun atmosphere then check out the flying saucer and join the UFO club.

This is a great neighborhood pub with a fantastic selection of great beers and nightly events/specials.  If you enjoy exploring the various tastes possible with diverse brewing styles, then this is the place for you.  Not only are there hundreds of beers available on tap and in a bottle, they also have a full menu.  The Hippie burger and the potato soup are great.

If you join the UFO club you receive opportunities for coupons, specials, events and free brunch every Sunday.  It's a great deal.

Stopped through here on business, looking for local beers and a decent burger on a Sunday.  I immediately like the expansive space, very roomy and open, almost like a beer hall.  The bar was the place to be, apparently.  I waited for a while to get a seat at the bar so I wouldn't take up a table by myself (I hate when people do that).

Despite the completely full bar, the staff was on point.  I was quickly brought a food and beer menu, made aware of the specials going on, and was pleasantly left alone to go over the menu.  The bartender was really good at reading her customers, knowing when they needed something without asking and making everyone feel welcome.

The food was good, although the beer selection was much more impressive.  Between the value, customer service and liquid product, I would definitely make this a stopping point in the area.

Quick sitting and friendly waitresses. There beer selection is out of this world (no pun intended). There is definitely something, more likely two or three things, for everyone. 

The pizza was the best we have had down here. Super cheesey and gooey toppings yet the crust was still crunchy. Pepperoni we're crispy and it was hot. 

The turkey meltdown was a good sandwich, plenty of meat and put together well. 

Overall a good place for drinks and a quick bite to eat.

We visited here after it was given rave reviews by some of my friends who went to UNCC. We sat on the patio as the bar was absolutely packed for a Saturday night. They were doing trivia at the time and so that was fun. If you are looking for mixed drinks, this is not the place for you. However, there is a vast variety of draft beers. I was excited to see that that they have a dog friendly patio and will even offer your pooch some refreshing water as well! There were no food specials which was disappointing especially on a trivia night.
Great set of Drafts available. Great atmosphere for drinking. Its usually crowded on weekdays and weekends are worst.

My favorite spot to grab a drink in the University area. Great atmosphere, plenty of TVs (and beer), and the food is actually fantastic. 
There is a Flying Saucer in Raleigh that my friends and I would frequent in college, and this location makes me feel like I'm right back there. Located right of of N. Tryon right across from the UNCC campus, this Flying saucer has plenty indoor and outdoor seating. Parking is sometimes an issue, but if so you can always park in the golf course parking lot right next door. 
I've recently had the grilled cheese and the cheese pizza. Honestly, anything I ever order food-wise is great. Actual quality bar food, and of course a plethora of beers on tap.

Obviously a great beer selection but I also have no problem with the food. After eating at a TGI Fridays or the like I feel like I've done irreparable harm to my innards, but "the Saucer" offers veggie sandwiches, really decent pizzas, salads on top of the regular bar cuisine. My coworkers and I head out there every Tuesday for half-priced lunches and we're usually back on Friday nights to kick off the weekend. The saucer raises the bar on the "cute girls and beer" business model and usually attracts a very outgoing / easy-to-socialize with crowd.

We were looking for a place to grab a late lunch after an event on campus and the students with us suggested this spot. When we arrived it was almost empty and we sat ourselves at a booth inside. 

We started with the fried zucchini appetizer which was good and not overly fried or greasy. I then had a salad and the tomato soup, both of which were good, but nothing to write home about. 

The beer selection here looked good, and I loved the neighborhood feel of the place. They've got a beer club, where you can join and once you've had 250 beers you get a plate on the wall - which makes the wall full of quirky quotes and personalities of the many folks who've achieved this honor and is of course a great ploy to get folks to keep coming back. 

Overall the food is average, but seems like a great spot for beers and I'd imagine the vibe and crowd is good on the weekends/evenings.

Went to the Saucer prior to catching a concert at Verizon Wireless and met up with my two favorite people (Nikki and Bryan).  They arrived before me and were sipping on some beers.  Bryan had a Seeing Double (I sipped it, delicious!) and Nikki had a Purple Haze, on special for $3.... What a deal!  The service was good, but a bit on the slower side. We placed our order for food and while I ordered a side salad in place of fries with my burger--- and it didn't arrive that way---it was quickly corrected! We had these Rocket Tots as an appetizer and the jalapeño sour cream they serve them with is perfect!!!  Really enjoyed those spicy tots! :). My burger was great, too and so was the salad.  Overall, a great place in the University area to come chill and have a pint-or three- and have some good bar food.

My husband and I came in for lunch today(Sunday, Jan 1). We sat in a booth across from the bar in the middle of the restaurant. Over a 10 minute time frame, several waitress walked by, waited on tables beside us and across from us. We tried to get their attention 2 x. I finally went up to the waitress station at the bar. I asked 3 waitress if they could take our drink order. One walked off, one looked at her watch and said something to the other  waitress. I pointed to our booth and went to sit down. No one came after a minute or 2, so we left. Oh and it was NOT crowded. We had been regulars here in the past, but this is one reason we quit coming as often. Reconfirmed why we did not come back sooner.

I would give this place about 3.5 overall. I have been going there for 7 years, so this is not some uneducated review... This place is aimed more at rich college students than beer aficionados. Some pluses and minuses:
Food price and taste-4.5 Most everything I have had there is good and reasonable price.
Beer quality and selection-4.6 Samples are available, huge amount of selection, beers served in appropriate glasses, don't think if I have ever gotten a "funky" beer (some places don't clean their draft systems), and fairly knowledgable on the beers.
Beer prices-2.5 This is where the "rich college kids" comment comes in to play. They have specials, especially NC beer Sunday and pint nite Monday, which is about the only times I go. But the normal prices for most beers are .50 to $1.50 too much.
Wine-2.0 I know it's a beer place, but sometimes people in your party don't like beer.
The wine is overpriced, mediocre at best, and often has been open for days.
Service- 4.0Most the staff are cute and helpful but there is the occasional terrible service night.
Atmosphere- 3 Gets very loud at nights! Combine walls covered in plates with the customers and music volume knob constantly trying to overcome each other, and your throat will be sore the next day. No seriously! Drunk frat boys, noise, and on hot summer days it is 90 plus inside. Sunday afternoons and early evenings are best times to go to actually "hear" yourself taste the beer... The dark wood walls would be nice if it were not for the tacky plates.
In summary, if you want to enjoy a good meal and a good beer plan to do it earlier in the day.

Well dang, why can't we get one of these in Greenville?? I'm in love and this long distance relationship is gonna be tough but I'll manage. One visit and I'm hooked. Unfortunately, my first two choices were out but the Dark Side Flight was really good and I normally shy away from any darks as they are too thick and heavy for me but they had a decent selection offered and of course, Guinness was on there. Can't go wrong with that Mac Daddy. Alright, enough reading, just go and knock some back!

Not a great selection of beer for a place called a "Draught Emporium".  Also the food was less than mediocre and they were out both chicken tenders and pizza when we were there.  There are a lot of much better places to get craft beer and bar food in Charlotte.

Great selection of beers. Not the best food but it's a beer bar after all. Was a better place when they had pool tables but not a bad place to watch a ballgame now.  

Monday has really good specials for draft beers. And seasonal rotations offer great new selections.
Pretzels are sooo good. Beware the mustard has horseradish and your nose will work WAY Better. Great pizza but Damn, the beer selection is off the chain. Doin it again and again.

Cool, quirky spot. Good atmosphere. Pretty fun place to eat. 

Food was solid. Got a burger with avocado and fried egg. About what you'd expect from a pub like this. 

Service was good. Constantly refilled and taken care of. Food took FOREVER to come out. More than 30 minutes for two burgers. 

Amazing selection of beer. Little pricey, but great availability.

The only flying you should be doing here is flying right past the place. Do not stop in for a drink, do not pass go, do not collect $200.

Food: Typical bar food at reasonable prices. The food is actually good, but where the Flying Saucer shines is their large beer selection. This is one of the largest and most diverse beer selections that I have ever seen. I just wish the menu would distinguish between beers on tap and beers served in a bottle.

Service: This is where the Flying Saucer just crashes and dives. I have been here twice. The first time was with a large group, and the service was ok, but this past time, it was just downright terrible. A friend and I came in, were told to sit wherever we wanted, and then had to wait ten minutes before being finally served. The place was not packed, and the servers were not busy at all. One server even seemed to be so bored that she was standing in the corner massaging a customer's back. When we finally did order, we were served the wrong food and even got the wrong beer. When I brought this up to the server, the response was "Oh, ya. I figured you didn't order that." Ok...then why did you bring it to me?

I will not be back. Flying Saucer, I suggest you land and perform some maintenance before taking off on another flight.

Beer, Beer, and well yeah more beer. If you love beer and you want to try every type of beer imaginable, this is the place to go. When you walk through these doors, you will see nothing but plates everywhere. You must ask yourself, what are all these for? Well my friend, these are trophies for those who come here very often and earn it.

Anyways, I came here several times and have been procrastinating on my writing. Thus, here it is:
Beer that's unheard of / unknown + Incentive to drink = fun times.
Now, they don't only just serve all types of beers but they also have appetizers and food that will accompany your taste in beer to fill you up in that part of your stomach (if the beer didn't fill you up already)

In the end, this place is definitely a place to hang out and just conversate (you'll notice a ton of college students during the school year as UNCC is not even 5 minutes away). Hours will fly by especially if you're curious on what type of beer is good and what isn't. The only problem here I find is that it is a little pricey, especially when you're a heavy drinker. Other than, have a beer or two and join the UFO club and get that plaque!

Flying saucer has an amazing collection of beer and a wonderful ambience and top of it.. interesting and delicious food. It is THE place to hangout with your friends.. loved it the yesterday evening with my friends. The trophy shields all over the place is just wow!. Highly recommended if you are in that area!

I'd been here a number of years back, and I'm glad I came back!  Good food, great beer selection, and outstanding service (even on a busy night.)  We only went for a snack and a few beers, but I'll be going back and augmenting this review as needed!

Around 10 of my friends already have their honorary plates on the ceiling, so I go there a lot for their unveiling parties.  It's a nice open environment and they have a great selection of brews.  The giant pretzel is the way to go.  So fluffy and lovely :)

There are a lot of things to like about the Flying Saucer.  Once you join the UFO club ($18) you get a beerknurd shirt and can enjoy free brunch every Sunday.  The brunch isn't anything to write home about but they also offer North Carolina draft beers for $3.50 on Sundays as well. You can't really beat brunch and a couple of local beers for under $10. 

Other things I like about the Saucer:
Plenty of parking
Great service
Nice staff
Kids are welcome

Certainly worth a trip if you're in the area.

Tremendous selection of beers.  Fun atmosphere. Had the double brats with german potato salad.  The brats were excellent and the potato salad was the best I've ever had, including the german restaurants I've been to back home.  My wife had the Stroganoff burger which was outstanding.  I'm getting that next time!

I can't believe I haven't yelped on the Flying Saucer yet! I used to go to another one all the time in college, then moved away to a city that didn't have one, but now I'm back to a city that has one! Yeah!

First of all, I want to go on the record that we NEED A FLYING SAUCER IN UPTOWN! It would be so busy and popular, it's just what Uptown needs! 

I love this place for their: Great Beer Selection, Great Beer Specials (there's always something on sale or a special), and Yummy Food! Esp the pretzels, so great! Sandwiches, salads, apps, they have a little bit of everything. 

The waitresses are friendly, knowledgeable about beer and always quick to bring you a refill. I wish they had live music more often, but maybe I'm never there at the right times. 

Anyway, I highly recommend this place if you're looking for a new place to sip a pint - and I want to sign the petition to move them Uptown!
Tried this place out and it was a nice little date spot for me and my boyfriend. Decent food, decent service. It's fairly quiet mid afternoon which I enjoy.

I have been to flying saucer a few times now they alway have a great selection and wide variety of beer, from fruity to stouts you can find it here. 

Dinged them for a star as the food choices don't have many vegetarian options.
Not bad for a few drinks and some OK food. Service wasnt bad though. 3 stars just because the burger I had was average.

I am only giving this place 3 stars based on their beer selection and my companion's lunch quality.  When we stopped in with the kids it was a really nice big restaurant.  They have a sitting area and great big bar.  

Very fun atmosphere with all the plates on the ceiling of the adventuresome drinkers.  Service was great and fast.  I had the Saucer Dipster sandwich - man what  a let down.  It was supposed to be like a French Dip I think.  It was just two pieces of roast beef on a huge hard roll with one piece of cheese.  What a let down.  And i paid $8.49?!?!?!  

Everyone else liked their sandwiches tho so we will probably be back except I for sure wont get that again.
Not really even sure how you can bad mouth the place....its beer heaven

Fabulous!

Tried a mess of beers here today and had a great time.  Our server (they're all pretty cute and young and wearing plaid pleated miniskirts for you boys out there to get loaded and tip well) was extremely helpful with me insofar as picking out my "build your own flight" of beer.

They have a few pre-set flights, which my folks tried...  but I tried the build your own, which is basically five draught beers of your choice in a smaller size glass (photo enclosed).  It was a great way to try new things and once our server learned my taste she worked with me to find what I would like best.  

Between that, the friendly crowd, darts and pool... if I lived in NC I could see wasting a lot of time here.

Didn't try the food so I can't comment on that.

Great place to hangout for a while and catch a game. I always sit at the bar. Lots and lots of beer to choose from and if you have any questions about any of the beer someone will always be there to help you out. Very friendly staff and service is awesome. Food is great! Tasty and not greasy which is a nice change from typical bar food. This place has definitely opened the "beer door" for me. I've been trying lots of different beers that I don't think i would ever have done if not for discovering this place!
Love this bar and the idea. Tons of beer and interesting people.

Awesome for beer, food and hanging out. I went here on one sunny Saturday. They have outside seating. The ambience sets up the right mood. The staff is very friendly. We had a relaxed lunch.

They serve good pizza and the queso dip was delicious. We had chicken pizza, and it's good. They have huge selection in beer. I am not a beer drinker but I can tell and my friend had a pint of good beer, and was impressed.

The place is big and very spacious. 

Overall this place is awesome.

Round 1, Question 1: What restaurant has more beer than you can shake a stick at, the best beer cheese soup I've ever had and runs trivia on Tuesday nights?

Round 1, Question 2: How many different beers does a Flying Saucer U.F.O. club member need to drink to get a plate on the wall?

Round 1, Question 3: Who would you rather have guide you on which of the delicious libations you should try next than a friendly, knowledgeable gal in knee socks and a short skirt?

Answers: The Flying Saucer, 200, Nobody

The Saucer is routine stop for me, both for dinner and to just go have a beer and play some trivia. I couldn't, in good conscience, give it 5 stars because there are only a few things on the food menu that pique my interest (you MUST try the aforementioned beer cheese soup and the rocket tots!) and I have a thing against their pizza, though the slice my roommate ordered last week looked tastier than what I remember. Food is in the $5-$15 dollar range and beers run the scale from $5 on up. 

Whether you are a lager lover, all about ale, or drool over dopplebock The Flying Saucer has many an option for you, so come on down and try one or two...hundred.

Went here last Sunday. The place seems pretty nice and have a good collection of beer. Unfortunately, their beers are insanely expensive. The cheapest beer is $5 and there aren't many $5 options. The average price for their beers is $6-$7. A little steep IMO. They do have $3.50 domestic beers on Sundays and I *think* all beers are $3.50 on Mondays but I could be wrong about the latter.
We ordered the pretzel-bratwurst board to share. That was more than enough food and good bang for your buck at $15. You get two pretzels, two brats, sauerkraut and bread with queso and mustard dips.
They do allow dogs out on the patio, and the patio is really nice, as long as you aren't sitting right next to a party of 8 in their mid-fifties, totally drunk and openly flirting and getting touchy-feely with the servers. Not sure how they tolerate this behavior? Must be regulars, I guess.
We will probably be back, but this might not be our go-to spot for beers and hangouts. Not at $6 beers... Ain't nobody got money for that.

The flying saucer has a great atmosphere. Hard wood, and nice decor render a great pub feel. The flying saucer offers a nice draft selection as well. 

However, the wait staff and food is below average. An exception is made for the pretzel, but the cheese served with the pretzel was stale. The saucer pies (12 inch pizza) is among the worst I've had in Charlotte. The sauce had a bitter taste, and the ingredients used didn't taste fresh. 

Our service was slow. Definitely could have been an off night for the wait staff. I'm skeptical though. I gave our waitress the benefit of the doubt until I repeatedly spotted her behind the bar chatting with co workers. Meanwhile she neglected refills, messed up food orders, and forgot drink orders. 

If you are only interested in grabbing a few beers at a pub, then the flying saucer is the right spot. If you are looking for dinner and drinks, then you're better off spending your money elsewhere.

The best place to get a beer in Charlotte, period. I used to live right down the road from the Saucer and went there several times a week in order to earn my own gold plate up on the wall (something you get after drinking 200 different beers). The selection is unmatched in the Charlotte area, and the wait staff is usually really knowledgeable about all the new beers they get in. Monday nights are $2.75 "pint nights" where everything on the wall (and we're talking nearly 100 beers here) is only $2.75, and considering the quality of some of these this is almost impossible to beat ANYWHERE!

The glass program on Wednesday night is really cool, and if you go to their website there is even a big trading community so you can find some pretty cool stuff that the local one doesn't offer. The tracking system they use is actually really great too. It's awesome to be able to see every beer you've ever had there, including the date, and your rating and comments about it.

The food at the bar is, well, bar food. If you're expecting something amazing for dinner here then you're definitely here for the wrong reason. While not quite as bad as you would expect, it's still the standard grease-laden goodies that just seem to go great with beer.

The one detriment to this place for me was that they allow smoking inside. I would dock them a point for this normally, but the reasonable person in me still realizes that it is a bar, and it is in NC, so it's almost allowable. The saving grace is that there is a great patio outside where you can go if cancer isn't your thing.

One final personal note: if you come here and order Bud Light (or some other equivalent) you're wasting space and need to be eradicated.

Their beer selection is amazing...Waitresses are not always so great! Paige is really good through! She is super fast and never leaves you with an empty cup! Overall it is an amazing little place. I have never seen so many options for draft beers! If you go try the Rocket Tots, they are amazing!

Happy New Year, my only regret is missing the other beers in the "Demons of Ale" series at the @flyingsaucercharlotte because this is the first beer I have had from @averybrewingco and it is the best beer I have ever had. I am turning 31 soon and I've just had the best beer I have ever had and I can only imagine how good the other beers in "The Demons of Ale" series must have been. I'd also like to thank @flyingsaucerraleigh for being my first Flying Saucer experience and where I got my Beer Nurd card! Happy New Year everyone, today was the best day of 2016, ending on a high note at the #flyingsaucer !

I like the beer selection and love the Colorado beer connection since I have roots from there. However the food side needs a little work. More pizza selections and sizes wouldn't hurt would they? Appetizers aren't bad in general. Overall it's a decent place to go for a chain joint.

Food was ok, but one of our items took over an hour,  even though it was the first thing we ordered.  They said they would send it to go, we were headed to a concert.  Over 30 minutes later,  still no food. One of our guests had to run in after our server to get our check,  after we asked for it twice. 
Line cook screamed at her and server when they asked for togo food. 
If I could add a photo to the trash we received,  I would. 
Wasn't expecting much and was disappointed

Great place for beer lovers the best selection I have seen.  The plate for 200 beers cool concept. The staff is nice and know their beers.  Good service and fair prices.  The food is only ok. The ambience is fun. Overall  a great place to drink.
Great selection of beer, if that's all your here for sit at the bar.  Poor service and low quality food.  I really wanted it to be better.

I'm not a beer drinker which might be horrifying to some that I even go here... But I'm addicted to the pretzels and for the first time the other night I tried actual food -Hippie burger was surprisingly delicious! Had no idea it wasn't a meat patty it's so flavorful and filling! (Newly vegetarian going on 3months and have had a lot of disappointing vegetarian and vegan options elsewhere) this burger was a pleasant surprise
The beer selection is amazing...definitely a place to check out if you are a beer person...all types of beer from all around the world...and I can't forget the food is pretty good too!
We come here often. Great beer, good food, friendly service. Good place to go for a relaxing and fun atmosphere, where you can have a conversation.

First night in Charlotte and just wanted some bar food, nothing fancy. Thought it would be dead on a Monday night, didn't know they offer $3 draft beers on Monday night!  Service was great, Emily stopped by the table consistently to see if anything was needed.  When you ordered a beer despite how busy it was, it was on the table in a minute or two.  Had the Sheboygan Side-by-Side with fries instead of potato salad.  The fries were a little cold, but Emily quickly addressed the situation by bringing out hot fries making this a five star review.  If you like a a variety of beers, good brat's, and great service come to the Flying Saucer.

Poor service.   Waitress refused to serve us because she misread my friend's license and said it was expired.   It doesn't expire for two years...   we were kicked out.   I realize this location is next to a college and they must be on the alert for shenanigans but being denied service when you are  28 and have a valid license is very frustrating.

been here a few times over the years, never have had the food, but always enjoyed good conversation over many a good brew.  Selection is pretty vast, they even do an ok job making sure to include the local stuff.  A little pricey, but I think I need to change my perception of fair prices as I have found myself writing that a lot lately, ha.

I'm not one for beer, but i have to give the Flying Saucer an awesome score. If i could do half points I'd give it a 4.5. The only thing i can say about he Saucer is that they are on top of it.  The staff is as friendly as a bar staff should be even when customers are being somewhat suggestive and just down right gross. 

The menu promotes some typical bar fare, some that's good some that not so good. I recommend the beer cheese soup that comes in the bread bowl. Its smooth and creamy with just enough of a bitter bite and spice that let's you know its made with the restaurants name sake. 

You won't find a lot of pampas jerks in this bar like other places in the university which make for a pretty nice time for the non-fratty crowd young and older alike. Try the standard Monday night Pint Night or Trivia through out the week. You will not be let down.

Came up from Atlanta for a show. This place felt like home. Kaleigh, Ashley and all the staff treated us awesomely. Played darts with some locals, made friends, and had great beer! 10/10 would do again (we actually went back the next day).

I don't miss much about living in University Area- but this is one of the few gems that I do miss (and occasionally go back to)

The beer cheese soup is delicious. The beer menu is extensive. They have great specials. The waitresses wear cute short skirts. There is a lot to love about this place.

It is comfortable and laid back enough to bring a kid during the day. It gets rowdy at night.

The strip mall is a dreadful location- but that is to be expected in University Area. The outdoor area is ok.

For a bar, it's a fun place.  As far as an eatery, I definitely don't recommend their shepherd's pie.  Portion was small, the seasoning just wasn't there.  Atmosphere wise, like I said, it makes a great social place.

Best beer selection in the area. Wait staff is so friendly and knowledgeable.  Heck the waitresses know more about beer than I do! That's saying something. The brat con queso  is a an awesome appetizer.

If you are a beer connoisseur, you need to go here.  

Personally, I love this bar.  This place is 5 miles from my office and 5 miles from my house, no wonder I made it to 200 beers so easily!  

The Flying Saucer literally has approximately 300 unique beers, with at least 100 on tap, and some of them are rotating beers.  Additionally, they have daily specials, like pint night with $3 pints and biggie beers for the price of a pint and even beer poker.  Their loyalty program is also rad, drink 200 unique beers and get a $100 tab on the house to have a party with your friends (I'm 421).  Fear not non-beer drinkers, they also have liquor drinks.  

Their food menu is decent, I mean, it's bar food...The pretzels with queso dip are the best!  And the scenery, aka the waitresses, aren't bad to look at either...in their school girl uniforms.  They have pool tables in the back and good music streaming, unless a crappy band happens to be playing.  If a band is playing and there is a cover, Beer Knurd members get in for free.

Prost!

For a fun, low key hang out, I've gotta give this place 5 stars.  I think for bar food, it is terrific!  So far I've tried the cheese fries, spinach and artichoke dip, and their pizza (with bratwurst, mmm).  I can't find anything that I think is mediocre.  It's always been better than expected.  As for the beer - I can't think of anywhere else you can go to find as many selections.  I'm not a huge beer drinker (check out my profile - Bacardi always makes my party :p ).  However, that being said, I've had some pretty damn good ones here!  On Monday it is $3 pint night and on Thursdays they feature a $3 beer.  

On top of the good food and drink, Flying Saucer also does Trivia nights, DJ nights, and live music nights!  

Not a huge fan of the servers in mini skirts but I have a feeling that may be a gender related bias :)

i've had this several. the staff seems to be a bit distracted most of the time which makes it hard to get an order in but the beer is endless and good and the girls are smokin hot. Pet friendly outside. The food isnt so bad. Also cool promos and glasses.

Where do I begin to describe this place? I always get so thirsty, and this place always leaves me quenched and drunk which is what I love. Sunday and Monday nights are hopping because of the $3.50/pint specials. The wait staff is friendly and the bar tenders are extremely nice. Many people who go here have a plate on the ceiling. The taps change daily and very fast which keeps things exciting every time I come back here. I would bring my own 65 year old father here who hasn't drank since his wedding day to drink wonderfully crafted draft beer here. WWCKD ? Also I love this place and it might love me back.

This place was ok.  It had its good points and bad points.  First off, if you don't know where it is, it's super hard to find.  It's kind of tucked in a corner and you don't see it really until you are right in front of it.  They had a great beer selection and a lot of the beers I had never even heard of.  I liked how they had them grouped on the menu.  The brats I had were good but the service sucked.  It took forever for my cousin and I to get waited on and the waitress didn't seem that friendly.  I'd probably give it another chance because I liked the beer selection.
I always come here after playing a round of Par 3 golf next door.  How can you go wrong with hundreds of beers, pretty girls and descent bar food?  You can't!  Cool spot - check it out!

Five stars for being exactly what it sets out to be: a beer lover's ultimate experience! I am now on a quest to drink 200 different beers from all around the world to get my name on a platter. The burger was good, but it came all-the-way (without mentioning that it would). So if you do not want mayo, mustard, pickles, lettuce, tomato and onion you need to tell them when you order. My friend ate a wrap and loved it, but the beer is the reason to visit.
Just checked this flying saucer out and overall it is very subpar compared to the Raleigh one.  It's in a strip mall with very poor service.  Would not recommend this one to friends.

Not good for vegetarians.... Nothing too special to me, though the concept is cool. With not a lot of vegetarian options, I had the Hippie Burger and it seemed to be a standard veggie burger patty that you could find at the grocery store. There was not a lot of flavor to my meal which was a disappointment, but at least the food was not over-priced. Would recommend trying a different place if you're vegetarian.

Just average.  The atmosphere is bar-like, which I guess they want.  They have many beer selections.  The soft pretzels are pretty good.  I would definitely go back for a casual night out. The service has always been decent.  Nothing special or different about it.

The Saucer has a "je ne sais qua" the other bars in University City have yet to acquire. It's much more than the thousand or so saucers on the walls and ceiling and almost as many taps behind the bar, although both are quite impressive. The best description I can pull off that contradicts itself is a classy, yet non-corporate atmosphere, with scantily-clad waitresses that remind you of anything but Hooters. The staff has a camaraderie with each other and they invite their patrons to join in, which can make for a playful evening. 

The menu offerings are largely conventional, let it suffice to say you are not going to The Saucer for food. The big pretzel with cheese is always my standby when the draught flows more than anticipated. There are a few great options to keep you occupied throughout your visit: Join the U.F.O. club, try your hand at a dart competition, shoot a game of pool in the back, or relish the trivia and live music several nights a week. 

It is imperative that I elaborate on the sheer multitude of taps that twinkle like stars behind the bar. They beckon you over to try the trendy name of the month, or the same old lover you've had for years. It's a steep price per pint, and I like to be well acquainted with what I'm drinking. A good option, if you're not an ale aficionado, is trying the beer sampler to see which flavors perk your interest. 

You can't say you've toured the University area without a stop at The Saucer. Experience that "certain something" it has on the competition and let me know what you think!

Place was packed on a Wednesday night. Bartenders were probably the most attentive and friendly that I've met in awhile. Bartenders were very knowledgeable about the different beers and made good suggestions. Food was good and the beer selection was mind blowing. Would definitely go back again.

Great place and enough beer there to please anyone. You have to join the beer club and try to drink around the world. I am in the process of this now and I am having a lot of fun doing it! The food is ok but when you do go there you MUST get the pretzels the dipping sauce is great. You can either dip it in Cheese sauce or spicy mustard. I tell you, it is real hot. Go on Football game days they have great drink specials.

A penny-lined wall of taps. Egyptian Pharaohs watching from the bar (who, for you historical types, the Egyptians fed their children bread and beer). And walls and ceilings covered in plates, physical manifestations of the most ambitious revelry of those who grace the dark-stained wooden stools. You see, for each flying saucer above your head, a person has had at a minimum of 200 beers at that bar.

The Saucer is a staple in University City and has the best beer selection in East Charlotte, hands down. Local brews? Check. Big-name crafts? Check. Imports galore? Check. During the school year it can be overrun by UNCC undergrads, but hey, you have to learn how to drink somewhere, right?

Come have a beer, join the UFO club, and start working your plate!

Well it was my first time back here in a good long time- probably close to a year. As you can read from a past update, the service was really sub-par on my last visit. But I wound up meeting a friend for a few drinks and ordered some food. 

Even though the place was jam-packed on this particular Thursday night, service was still very quick, and we weren't kept waiting long at any point. 

Our server was overly-knowledgeable on the beers, and everything she had recommended was pretty spot on. And not like it was ever bad, but food was a little better than before. 

Don't know if they were just having a good night, but they have totallllllyyyyy redeemed themselves in my opinion. And yes, I had to ask about the particular manager from my last encounter and found out she was no longer with them. Added bonus!

This place is great if you are looking for a big variety of beer, although I have heard Taco Mac has more (have yet to go there).  This is a good locals spot for UNCC students, workers in the area and folks that live nearby (you get some walkers like myself).  The beer can be a bit pricey if you plan on having more than a couple (beers average about $4.00-$5.00 a pint) unless you go on a Monday, in which they have "Damn Near All" for $3.00 a pint.  The girls dress nice (for a guy like myself - Hey! I enjoy the atmosphere).  They usually wear some type of kilted dress and that gives the place some bonus points in my opinion.  The food here is pretty stellar too for a bar joint.  Bratwurst, pretzels and the spinach/artichoke dip is pretty of the chain here.  Overall, a good experience except for the pricing.  Beers are a bit steep but that's what you pay for when you want craft beer from across the world/country.  If you are a beer person, step right in.  This is the place to be!

I am a HUGE fan of the Flying Saucer brand. Lots of beer and great food! It is a chain, but it feels more like a local bar. 

We came here on Saturday evening, since we were in the University area. (I wish there was one walking distance to our apartment in Uptown!!!). We sat at one of the small semi-circle booths....these are cute cause we can sit side by side and watch football. There was a wheat beer on special so I immediately ordered that without even looking at who brewed it. It was delish so I drank that the rest of the night. My husband ordered various beers throughout the night. They have so many beers on tap! We are huge microbrewery fans and love to support local breweries....so we usually stick to the NC ones (Lonerider, Natty Greens, NODA, etc, etc, etc). 

The food is basically German with some American dishes. We ordered the soft pretzals with beer cheese. We have ordered this many times in the past and new it was a winner. Dang those pretzals are awful for you but so good. The beer cheese is some of the best we ever tasted AND we recently went to Germany! 

Spent the evening drinking beer, watching football, and playing darts. It was great! Service was spot on as well

Been going here a few years now and I'm working on my second plate.  The best beer selection in Charlotte, I don't think you can find a place that has more beer on tap.  The food has always been good.  I love getting the rocket tots.  Overall the service is good.  If you're a beer person you need to go to this place.  You'll enjoy yourself.

I need to preface this review with I was visiting from Austin and the Flying Saucer there is my Cheers, so I had zero expectations for this place other than I could print my chits and get 3 beers counted towards my 4th plate.

This place was pretty packed for 11:30pm on a Friday night, but thankfully I found an open seat at the bar. The bartender was initially cold and all business (which is not what I am used to at the one back home, but apples/oranges), but she warmed up in the end. 

It was definitely sports bar vibe here, but that did not bother me one bit. Same food menu as the Austin location, so no surprises there. 

I am happy to report, however, that I was very impressed with their beer offerings! I had 3 highly sought after draughts that were big ABV beers that I could not have gotten back home and the pint price points seem to be a bit less than back in ATX (DuClaw's Devil's Milk, New Holland Dragon's Milk, and Oskar Blues Ten Fidy), which was also a pleasant revelation. 

I was so happy to discover they had an FS in CLT as family had just moved here (thus the reason for my jaunt from Austin) and that I already had a beer bar to go to whenever I visit. 

I hope to explore more of their local beer selections as they seemed to rep quite a few NC brews.

Food: 2
Beer: 5  
Atmosphere: 4
Service: 3
Culture: 1

Overall = 3 stars

Saucers as far as the eye can see....I can spend an entire evening just drinking and reading the damn things on the walls.  Very cool place and THE best beer selection in the city (PERIOD), BUT  service is not that great and food is just ok.....and culture.....mainly college kids, so not some place that will inspire me in casual conversation.

But if you want to get your beer on...then this is THE place.

Went there for the first time last Saturday. While the beer menu is impressive, being out of a couple of beers I wanted to try doesn't help. And our waitress, while cute and helpful, was new, so she needed our help in getting the right beers ordered.

We then ordered food. My GF's "Rocket Tots" were tasty, although she only got like... 14 of them for $6.99 so it wasn't a good value at all. I ordered a burger, which was the worst I've had since I moved to Charlotte in 2003. The meat had a sour, "off" taste, and the meat was cooked within an inch of its life. It was so dry that it was impossible to eat without liquid. What's more, I ordered it with Red Dragon cheese (and extra $1), and it was a depressing, congealed mass on top. The 9 fries that came with the meal were served at a less than ideal temp, but were nice and salty in spite of this.

The bottom line is that the waitresses are cute and in skimpy outfits, and the beer selection is good. But if you want to go here, eat somewhere else before you come.
I'm also (literally) offended that the Flying Saucer charges 99¢ for their iPhone and Android apps... but that is neither here nor there.

This is a pretty cool place, came here to watch the game. My boyfriend and his roommate are in the UFO club so they come here pretty often, from what I understand it's a pretty cool deal if you are local. There's a  $18 membership. After you try out about 200 varieties of beer you get a shirt, name of a plate with they will hang on the wall (or ceiling), free brunch every Sunday, discounted beers and a $100 bar credit.

The beer gets a little pricey, but it's not ridiculous. Yesterday we ordered the chicken strips and pretzels. The chicken strips and fries were good with ranch and ketchup sauces included. The pretzels were huge! The queso that came with them was not as impressive. Felt like theater style nacho cheese and not spicy at all. 

Will be back... Maybe even join the UFO club when I'm local.

First let me disclose that I joined their beer club.... So, you know it must be good.  Still, despite my membership, I do not visit that much because it is always overcrowded and very hard if not impossible to get any seating during popular times ( Friday, Saturday, certain week nights).   Seating is a first come, first served basis so you really do have to fight to get a seat when one becomes available.  People are freaking aggressive!!  So, make sure you wear your running shoes and maybe a helmet.

The last two times I went I ended up leaving with out eating or getting a beer.  Once I had friends with me and after waiting 45 minutes, gave up on getting any seats.  The other time I went with my wife and my 18 year old cousin and we had to leave the premises because despite being a restaurant, if you are under 21, you must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.  Seems stupid since they ID and there is no way we would have let her drink anyway.

Bullshit aside, this is a fun place if you manage to get seated.  There is an immense selection of beers.  In fact, there is nearly anything you could possibly want.  I am craving a beer thinking about it!  The food is pretty good too!  I have had most everything on the menu and have enjoyed it all.

Aside from the beer, it is the atmosphere that sells the place.  Picture a cozy pub, sometimes with a live band, plates all over the walls and ceiling - mostly to do with the beer club,  hot young women in tight shirts and plaid skirts, etc..

The only thing I would improve is the building itself.  It should be 3x the size and maybe have an upstairs that is like a huge wraparound balcony so you can see and be part of all the action below.

The Flying Saucer offers great beer, great food, and good service. Most of the waitstaff is knowledgeable about the beer selections they offer, which is a nice touch. They have an incredible goat cheese salad, and the kitchen is very accommodating for substitutions and add-ons to the menu. Overall, a great place for casual dinner and drinks.

I am obsessed with the hippie burger here. It is just so amazing!! 

I have had the pretzels and they are just as good. The staff is a little slow but usually when I go it has been busy so it is understandable. 

Great beer choices

as a girl, i love the saucer!

first, the food is pretty outstanding. jalapeno cheddar tater tots with habanero sour cream! the french dip is out of this world. burgers are also really good. 
they have like 400 kinds of beers and you can get samplers called "flights" where you get maybe 2oz of 5 different beers by country or region (there is a german flight, a UK flight, a US flight, a NC flight, etc). there is also beer poker, where the 'tender selects a beer for you (for $2) if you're really into beer you can join their beer club and if you drink ALL the different beers then you get a numbered plate on the wall.

try the lost coast downtown brown-- i think it might be my favorite beer. a friend bought me a shot that the 'tender said tasted like a white gummy bear. the man didn't lie and the shot was fantastic. 

the music played is great; a lot of 90's-00's. last time we went was a saturday night and there was live music going on. 

and the girls wear super short plaid skirts (if you're into that sort of thing) :)

This place makes me wish I lived closer to Charlotte! Perhaps they will put one in Lake Norman...

Both my fiancée and I joined the UFO club. 

My thoughts: if you are going to be here more than once, it is worth the $18 to join the club. Shoot, even if you will never be back, you get a cool t-shirt when you join. But, if you will be back, your goal is to try 250 different beers. You can only add 3 every time you go, so all you crazy binge drinkers are just going to need to make multiple trips like the rest of us! (I jest, but it is nice to know they discourage binge drinking) What do you get after 250 different beers? A saucer on the wall. The coolest part, you get to add a quote to your saucer. So, start planning now! The other perk of the club: you get free brunch every Sunday.
