They have great deals on six-foot tables, belly bars, linen, stanchions, and pretty much anything you could possibly need for hosting your next Quinceanera or Game Of Thrones viewing party. Yes, RSVP has life-like torches and severed heads that you can rent that will really add that extra flair to your GOT nerd out bash.

Day of delivery and next day early am pick-up with no extra charge, I'm into it, but I wish they were clearer on delivery times. They give you a large time range; mine was 8am - 1:30pm. Make sure you're clear on the start of your party or this could be a big hiccup, also their payment is a tad funky. 

I was told to make a deposit in order to hold the party date and the items I needed. I did this about month before the party and was also told to make the remaining payment day of delivery, which I thought was weird, but OK. The Friday before the event I'm making few calls to vendors to verify other delivery. I call RSVP and I'm told if I don't make a payment by E.O.D. my order would be removed, wow thankfully I just happen to call. I'm surprised RSVP doesn't have a plan in place for people who haven't made their final payment. 

This small mistake would have had made for dire consequences. How very Game Of Thrones. Minus this situation, everything else with RSVP Party Rentals was the cat's jam jams.

Maybe I have a thing for working with people with fun nicknames, but seriously, renting table cloths and other various things from Yogi is as hassle-free as I can imagine. She is friendly on the phone, replies to my emails instantaneously, and never seems perturbed by my endless, random requests, additions and changes. I have also found that their prices are the same or a little bit cheaper than other rental spots in town, and who can complain about saving some dough here and there? Granted, I don't have a ton of experience working with a multitude of rental spots around town, but I can't imagine why I would want to go elsewhere. So, until further notice, Yogi is my go for party rentals. She's not your average lady!

RSVP Rentals came recommended from our wedding planner and they ended up delivering an amazing range of beautiful rentals for our outdoor wedding. We'd highly recommend them to anyone and everyone - no matter what type of event you're having.
This is a nice easy transaction!  I reserved over the phone, and when I picked up, I went to door #9  The guy that helped me was quick and polite!  I will be using this place in the future!

I used RSVP for my son's 1st birthday party and I was happy with the overall experience. Since I submitted the quote request online we were originally communicating via email, which didn't seem convenient or efficient because they didn't respond quickly. But once I called I started to get my questions answered and we got the ball rolling quickly. I rented tables, chairs and some supplies for a 25 person party. Their delivery and pick-up was reliable and quick. One of the coolest things about RSVP is that our party was on a Saturday, but they delivered on a Friday, picked up on a Monday, and only charged us for one night. It gave us plenty of time to set everything up before the party and pack it all in afterwards. 

Biggest complaint is the delivery charge. It's 80 bucks, whether you're getting supplies for a 300 person wedding or a 25 person backyard party. It was so frustrating but we didn't have access to a truck big enough to pick up and drop off ourselves. 

We will continue to use RSVP for future parties and events, but we will see about picking up and dropping off our rentals.

My mother received a Williams-Sonoma Le Creuset stock pot in the color OCEAN which is exclusive to this company.  There was a lovely display for this in the Biltmore store, so I purchased it for her in November for her birthday.

In December, my father called from Scottsdale to ask me about the color and the company that produced the Stock Pot. My mom apparently loves it a lot and wanted more pieces.  He drove to Williams and Sonoma in Scottsdale Fashion Square and it was an unproductive trip. The store staff was not familiar with the color, and didn't have anything to offer him - they told him to purchase it online.  

Upon hearing this, I called the Scottsdale and the Biltmore Stores.  The Scottsdale store person had never heard of this color, but he indeed had some pieces in stock. He actually made me to go the website and give him model numbers of things I was hoping to find. It was really crazy.

I called Cindy in the Biltmore Store and she was quick to respond that she knew EXACTLY what the color was, she knew they had a floor display of the color and the pots and various other pieces (frying pans, tea kettle, etc.)  She also agreed to put a few pieces aside on hold for my Dad so he could look at them quickly and easily without any confusion.  My Dad drove down this week and found all the items he wanted to purchase super quickly and he said he did not deal with Cindy, but that the experience he had was very good.  He also loved the Biltmore mall and found the parking easy and meandered over to Macy's to get her some Estee Lauder perfume as well.

Thank you Williams-Sonoma!!!  My mother is going to have a great Christmas.  And yes, this is a spoiler, but my parents are not likely to check yelp reviews...but if you run into my Mom, keep this a secret for a couple more days!

I was treated like trash by Kristine ???? a sales woman when I went to return a Nespresso Milk Frother that I bought at the Biltmore store. It stopped working. I had the receipt, the original box and even the original William Sonoma bag. When she found out I needed to return something she said "you'll have to wait." She went to a computer and did stuff and even made a phone call.  She kept saying "I have one and my daughters have one and they work perfect for years." I finally got store credit. Don't go there. You will get better service at Wallmart !!!!!

Attended the 12/4/2010 Technique Class (complimentary) : The Holiday Dinner
a) Eggnog with Nutmeg and Cinnamon
b) Standing Rib Roast with Yorkshire Pudding
c) Creamy Gratin of Winter Root Vegetables
d) Chestnut Panettone Bread Pudding

All very tasty and very informative plus price was right...

If I were so inclined to cook  a standing rib roast a remote meat thermometer would be useful.  Remove roast when 125 is reached and let it rest for 15 minutes.  Don't poke meat or juices will escape...

of course this place has the best and coolest kitchen stuff. a stop on our Elite Yelp event, we were treated to a miniature cooking demo with some of their products. the chefs were funny and very personable. they cooked up some pies and pizzas for the group. 

i do like browsing. it's a bit out of my budget (sorry honey, i know you love kitchen gear). something i didn't know about williams sonoma....they host artisan and technique classes....and even will show you how to use a real chefs knife for free if you are like me and normally use whatever is handy to chop things.

a great shop, great products, great service.

This store has been here at the Biltmore for as long as I can remember.
 When I bought my first house. This is where I came to get all the things I always wanted. 
I had shopped here before ,but this time I could really go to town, and yes I got myself in debt doing it. But, it was awesome!
Here we are in 2013 and this shop is still going strong. I have always loved all the wonderful things here that you really cannot find anywhere else.
I have so many cool little gadgets from this shop.
The best part is ,I DO NOT COOK!
At least not very often. One day I will,but I love going out to eat so much.
But, I still love Williams-Sonoma, because, they even sell food here.
Plus, they gift wrap as well.  YES!

The Williams-Sonoma Difference

While visiting a not-named-here competitor, the helpful and friendly assistant did not know what a mortar and pestle was. 

Christine of W-S knows what a mortar and pestle is, plus alternatives performing the same crushing snd grinding tasks. She also found Occam's Razor in the back and diced out a finely filigreed, well constructed conversation on ethics with roots in Locke and Rousseau. 

Meanwhile, Chef Tom supplemented the impressive Christine with a depth of cooking knowledge reserved for the dedicated and well educated food fanatic.

This store fulfills culinary and cooking wants.

Wonderfully useful, supremely cool. Williams-Sonoma will take you to school.
I wish I had a lot of money that I could spend in this store. They have so much cool baking stuff here. They have great cookie cutters Star Wars ones even. Everyone is always nice when I come in.
Gorgeous kitchenware & VERY friendly and helpful staff! No lines during check out & the store was kept up very well. Love this place!

I LOVE THIS PLACE !! They have anything and EVERYTHING you could possibly need for cooking baking and anything that has to do with preparation of foods. Its a little on the $$Pricey side of where your coins might be at the time but chances are well worth the money. They have spices, unique brands, imports, gadgets, scrubbers...... I could go on but I am sure I missed a few items, but once you go and check it out for yourself,  what I may have missed could be your new surprise !! PS THEY GIFT WRAP FOR FREE !! BONUS ! (and its the professional shrink wrap style too)

I like this Williams-Sonoma best.  It is always the cleanest, best stocked, and quietest location.  I think the fact that Biltmore is not as frequented as other larger malls helps.  The employees here are always friendly, and thankfully I have never found them to be pushy.  They greet me and then leave me to do my lusting... I mean shopping.  Great store if you are in the need of higher-end, fantastic quality kitchen products.

This is one of the nicest Williams-Sonoma stores I've seen in terms of how the merchandise is set up. The store is clean and immaculate. Everything is so well organized, and it isn't too cluttered. The people who work there aren't the friendliest, but it's such a well displayed store (and it's so close to me) that I'll go back.

If you're looking for high quality cookware and bakeware, or maybe some specialty food items, definitely give Williams-Sonoma a try. It's pricey, but the products are excellent.

Williams-Sonoma, how I love thee....  Rather than counting the ways, I can say it all in one sentence - it makes me want to cook.  If you knew me, you'd know how much that was saying....

From the pots and pans to the cook ware to the appliances to the cook books to the linens to the pre-made mixes/sauces to the freaking cookie sheets!  I love it all!  All of it!  I'm a microwave kind of girl, and walking out of here I find myself pining over the perfect cast iron pot.  I'm telling you, it does things to you.  I've bought SO much from here for Christmas gifts!  

And - they usually have great sales!  Selling dreams of the perfect kitchen/meal/home - every day....

The delicious smells that come out of this place drag us into this store against our will!  But seriously though, it smells awesome - especially at this time of year when the pumpkin spice smell drifts out onto the sidewalk some distance away from location!

This is a well organized, clean and friendly location.  It also happens to be in a great location with other shops that you can visit and make a trip out of it!  

Overall: A
Great location.  Great smells.  Go.
Attempting to shop here and no one is around to help. Waiting I while to have someone check us out

Everyone has a vice and I am quick to admit that mine is Williams-Sonoma.  It started off innocent enough.  I would browse every now and again and marvel at the array of products.  Back then, I would never really buy anything, but I would promise myself that I could have whatever I wanted once I renovated my kitchen.  It took me a long time to achieve that goal, but eventually I did.  Then the flirtation blossomed into my first purchase.  My torrid affair with Williams-Sonoma has been raging for a couple of years now.

In Phoenix, the Biltmore Fashion Park store is my favorite Williams-Sonoma location.  The one at the Fashion Square is okay, but it feels cramped.  I travel for business and I seek out Williams-Sonoma stores on the road.  The one in Oak Brook (suburban Chicago) is nice.  The store in Walnut Creek, CA is also nice.  The new flagship in Union Square in San Francisco is like Williams-Sonoma Mecca!  It's four floors of everything Williams-Sonoma carries as well as artifacts from Chuck Williams' own kitchen.  It's like a Williams-Sonoma museum combined with the entire product line.  As a side note, the original Williams-Sonoma store that was on the square in Sonoma has been closed.  The Union Square store replaced it.

Williams-Sonoma is the best!  The products are all of the finest quality and they stand by everything they sell.  If you ever have a problem, they will take the item back with no questions asked and give you store credit if you don't have your receipt.    
I've bought everything at Williams-Sonoma from my Le Creuset Doufeu to Fleur de Sel French sea salt.  If you love to cook, this is the place for you.  If you bake or cook a lot, be sure to check out their All-Clad Stainless Steel Measuring Cups & Spoons.  The measuring cups are adorable because they're miniature versions of the All-Clad saucepan.  For standard measures, they offer sets of both four cups and spoons: 1/4, 1/3, 1/2 and 1 cup; 1/4 tsp, 1/2 tsp, 1 tsp and 1 Tbs.  The really handy items are the odd-size sets.  They offer sets of both cups and spoons in the following odd sizes: 2/3 cup, 3/4 cup and 1 1/2 cups; 2 tsp, 1 1/2 Tbs and 2 Tbs.  All the spoons stack together into a cute space-saving group.  All four sets of measures make an awesome gift!

Don't overlook their website.  Sometimes they will have Special Offers for products online that can be upwards of 50% off of the same items in the stores.  This drives the BF a bit crazy because he thinks their pricing should be consistent across all retail channels, but I'm willing to check their website frequently as I have found a number of bargains online.

I used to love going here, but they've diverged from the Biltmore's policy of being dog friendly and don't allow dogs anymore. They've lost my business. If people are bringing poorly behaved dogs into your store, ask them to leave on an as-needed basis. But to penalize all dog owners in an otherwise dog-friendly mall is bad business.

My husband and I went to the Camelback Williams Sonoma location to 'browse' at some coffee makers. We were fortunate to meet a knowledgable and friendly employee named Rose, who went above and beyond the service we expected. On a mildly busy weekend day, she offered to demo several different coffee makers as well as a frother I was interested in. We went home with a Moccamaster coffee maker, an electric Nespresso frother, and a Cuisinart burr grinder. A few weeks later I received an unexpected follow-up call from Rose, asking how things were going with our purchases! We are extremely pleased. I recommend this location for it's outstanding customer service.

Fancy  shop with great kitchen items that I would use for our kitchen. 
It seems whenever I go in there their products don't work. 
Avoid ordering any of their coffee pots because we had to return them twice in a row. It seems like whenever we walk in there the employees don't seem to be knowledgeable about the products there. 
I give this store three stars for having a variety of kitchen items and an enchanting place to visit.

What a great shop! As crazy as it sounds, I've never been in here! For a cooking nut like me, that's just bonkers. They have every single awesome cooking toy you could ever want and WAAY more. They also have tons of sauces, rubs, seasonings etc to play around with. The only draw back is it's VERY pricey, although it's all super quality stuff. They DO have classes every Sunday at 11. The wife and I are going to attend a pasta making class this Sunday!

I love W-S. I do. I just wish I could win the lottery.  I could get caught up in their gadgets and thingamajigs all day. I recently watched a demo with a freaking awesome pizza oven. It makes a pizza in 7 minutes. 7 minutes!!!!  And it was gooooood.  But it was like $200.  Can't do it.  Mostly because I'd eat pizza all day, everyday.  

My all time favorite thing about W-S is the turkey brine that only comes out during Thanksgiving time. This brine is amazing and you absolutely cannot make a bad turkey if you use it.  

While I'm not someone to buy 'mixes' for soups, chilis, etc (I"m a from scratch kind of gal), I do like to buy their starters, mixes, etc as hostess gifts and such.

I recently found out that on the first Saturday of hte month, This particular location has local artisans come in and sell their stuff.  Kind of like an indoors farmers market.  So that's pretty cool!

Just when you thought your kitchen was stocked, one visit to Williams Sonoma and you will think otherwise. I've always enjoyed this store, as they have so many fun gadgets to make your at home culinary experiences so much easier. My husband and I registered here for our wedding, and there's nothing more fun than shopping for all of the quality kitchen items they offer with someone else's money. Not only is it fun perusing all of the items in the store, but the extra enjoyment comes from the delicious samples they always have. 

What's also great is that they offer free cooking demos every Saturday. I went to the one last weekend, and learned how to make fresh pasta and then got to sample it! The staff here is always very accommodating and helpful. I will return many more times for that kitchen item I never thought I needed.

I have a serious crush on every Williams Sonoma, but this one in particular is close to my heart. The staff is always very friendly and welcoming to me anytime I shop there. I've had fun buying items off our registry with gift cards and when the toaster we received didn't work, they happily exchanged it for a new one. 

Like other Williams Sonomas, their quality of products is great but they also incorporate a local feel into their shop as well. They host artisan and technique classes on the weekends and when they do, they bring in local products to use during their classes and the local chefs to do the demos. It's a great local touch!

First time here and I gotta say theres wayyyy to many dishes here needing a home but are too expnsive.  Boyfriend and I ended up getting a grill pres for our bacon and a rock salt plaque to cook on.  Didnt realize we needed other things as well to make it work, i knew it wouldnt work in the oven.  i'd shop here again if i actually had hundreds to blow or was getting married

This place has the most amazing kitchen gadgets. Things I would NEVER even fathom having in my kitchen. It's so fun!  I wish I had the money to buy everything!  I usually do come in here to buy their silicon with wooden handle spoon and spatula though.  They are sturdy and I can use them on just about anything.  

They do have free cooking classes on Sunday's at this location.  They recommend that you call and RSVP though in case it's a popular course and they don't have enough food to go around.  

They are all really friendly there and very helpful with any questions that you may have.

I don't always go shopping for kitchen items...but should I start, I'd probably go here. Great selection of useful cooking items. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. And, apparently there are free classes on the weekends. I would definitely like to check one (or some) of those out in the future.

I've always loved Williams-Sonoma!  It is more than a kitchen store; it is an experience! A great place to buy presents!

Yes, you can just go in there and buy whatever you need for your gourmet kitchen, or a unique gift for your best friend or your mother. But WS staff is there for more than just to sell you high end kitchen delights. They will teach you how to use your new purchases and the many options that are available that you had no idea you wanted or even needed.

The staff is well-trained, not your usual retail sales clerks, but men and women who know their inventory and how it can make a difference in your cooking life and they aren't afraid to tell you.

The WS staff at the Biltmore are on the top end of the sales scale. They are there to teach you what they have in the store, what you might need to fulfill your every kitchen desire and what you cannot live without. Yep, I challenge you to get out of there without buying at least one thing, or learning how to cook something you didn't even know you wanted.  Williams-Sonoma is a playground for cooks of all levels. And, if you are like me and not a chef . . .it is a great place to buy wedding and Holiday presents.

It's been about a year since I needed a cell phone repair and I'm glad I came back to these guys. I definitely see an improvement in both this business' craftsmanship and timeliness. I came in this time with my iPhone 5S. I dropped my phone a few days and I damaged my screen and the mic, and after quickly realizing I was unable to talk on the phone, I had to get it fixed asap! After unsuccessfully attempting to get Apple to fix my phone I took it to Cell Lab. They explained all my options before offering to sell me a new phone, and even after I had explained that my phone was dying at about 24% they threw in a new battery for only 10 more dollars! After about 45 minutes I was given back my phone with it feeling like I just bought it. They were friendly and made me feel at ease about my embarrassing episode. Definitely coming back. And a tip for you anyone reading this, don't jog in the rain!

Real jerks!!!

Knocked over my signs, disrespectful

I don't like when people try to harm Others to make their business better

I was working in Phoenix and needed my galaxy 6 screen fixed. They were amazing!  Very professional and had my phone fixed in 30 min and the price was very good!! Very pleased customer!! I would give them a 10 star...

These guys are total class acts. I had a 5s with a dead screen. They replaced it in under an hour while I was there. Totally professional about it. 

They seem totally knowledgeable about phones and are even setting up a YouTube channel to teach others how to fix phones. Awesome right?  That's what I thought. 

I Even like how the wall display have little twinkling lights. Just give the place a certain... "We are hi Tech and possibly from the future but we are totally cool about it and won't rub it in your face" kind of way. 

Will go back any time I break any other device.

Bobby did an incredible job on my 6 plus. Dropped it off, came back within a half of hour and it was fixed! I'm as satisfied if not better than going to the Apple Genius Bar! I recommend them without a doubt! Solid spot and price.

Quick service for my 6plus. I went in during my lunch break and I had it within the hour, which was great! The guy that was working seemed to be quite knowledgable and gave me a reasonable price for the repair. Overall, great customer service!

I love my new haircut and Vita!  I've only ever been 100% satisfied with the services I've received at Vita, and can't imagine leaving to go to any other salon.  Whether it be highlights, eyebrows, or a haircut, Connie, Sandi, and Aimee are all the best at what they do.  Connie has been doing my hair for the past 8 years and can honestly say that I've never met another hairdresser with as much talent or passion.  I would highly recommend Vita to anyone who wants good quality services and products in a friendly, upbeat atmosphere!
My favorite salon in Sewickley! Professional stylist, up-to-date with hair knowledge and it's affordable. Kate always does a wonderful job coloring and cutting my hair. Highly recommend!
Atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a very upscale feel (but not upscale prices!) Amazing staff who are friendly and take the time to do a good job. I would highly recommend this place!

Two words : Top notch !! 
Seasoned stylists with tremendous experience. The staff was friendly, kind and all wore smiles. I was very pleased with Jen ! I requested full highlights with a hair cut. I was very pleased with the final product. Jen talked with me the whole way through - making sure to gage my exact preference & personality. 

Highly recommend!! Ask for Jen :)

This review is purely based on todays horrible walk in experience. Came in to see one waitress at the bar working. I smiled at her as I normally would expecting for her to atleast say hi. Instead, she looked at me in straight in the eyes FOUR times and did not bother to greet us. She went on to serve the four other men at the bar and let us stand there for another 15 minutes. I'd understand if it were busy however, it was not. It was obvious she would rather drink and chit chat to get her tips, then to service to a family. After standing there being as polite as possible, we decided to walk out. Maybe this place wasn't a great idea for young ones, but the least she could do was her job! I've been so excited to try this place out, and thought for sure based on the reviews I'd enjoy it. Im sad I couldn't give the food a try, I am hopeful it's better than the horrific service though!

Came here for the first time with a group of 10, for the tragically hip last concert showing. 

There is no a/c. We asked the waitress. It was hot as hell in here.

Aside from that the food was good. We got the platter for $26.99. Was actually a good amount of food and tasty.

The drinks were made really well and the staff were friendly and on point.

Only reason for the star loss is the a/c. With so many people in the building investing in fans or a/c would be a good idea.

This a pretty nice British pub in Sauga, the bartender/owner has an fantastic English accent, very friendly and welcoming customer service, great comfortable seating ( I love couches ) that got some good ones, I think they have a fire place too. Patio is also nice in the summer time

I have not tried their food, maybe I'll stop by soon and update

Keep on yelping
relaxin. expect on Thursday nights. the karaoke guy rocks the place and that relaxin vibe is replace by fun and excitement
The food is excellent and a much better value vs The irish pub down the road, great British pub atmosphere ideal for groups but what sets it apart is the service. Glen is a star!!

So this is the second time I ordered chilli. And again it was tooooo salty. The first time I returned it after taking a bite. Last night I just had a little of it and left the rest. Never order chilli there.
Also I hear a new owner has taken over. I strongly suggest they improve the quality of food. It is really bad. Even the club sandwich I ordered was just blahh
The staff was good though. They usually are. The new bartender was very sweet. I forget her name

TL;DR: good quiet place, usually not too busy. Food is good, try the BBQ chicken wrap. Upgrade to Greek salad is $2.50.... Money grab :( . Feels understaffed, a.k.a. waitress doesn't continuously check for things you may need. WiFi locked, no sign of password written down or offering of free WiFi. 


Yorkshire arms is a great place to go if you are looking for a quiet place to hang out with some friends and get a few drinks. Normally, I am part of the largest and loudest group there.

Their selection of food is definitely more orientated towards the drunken bar crowd, but if you are looking for a decent meal I have almost always had good experiences with it. I have religiously ordered either the BBQ chicken wrap or the bangers and mash entree. It is nice that they have delicious healthy alternatives too such as salad, However, to upgrade from garden salad to Greek salad costs you 2.50 which feels kind of like a money grab... 2.50 to add 2 slices of tomatoes, maybe 2 olives, some feta cheese and a different dressing?!?!?! -1 star...

The biggest problem is that they have locked WiFi, so for a shy person like me, I did not ask them for the password since I felt like they were always very busy. I did not feel like I had the chance to ask for it. It would be nice if they posted the password somewhere in the store such as the menu. -1 star
Took my dog there once. Never again. The place is covered in about an inch of hair and the groomer was a total mess. Crying uncontrollably!  What?!?  Haircut was fine but the place is filthy.

FINALLY! ....A groomer that I have returned to the 2nd time and intend on returning to many more times.  I have a 7lb Morkie that I take to her, he has Maltese fur so I grow it out long on his body but i keep everything else short. I don't know why that's so hard to understand at any other groomers, but they keep messing up! Here are the selling points...

1.) Prices range between 15-25 for the trims. This includes nails, sanitary areas, paws and face trims and of course the bath and brush out.
2.) She welcomes constructive criticism and always tells me if there's something I don't like or want done, I have to tell her...she promises after a few times we will get his style just PERFECT for me.
3.) She offers standing grooming appointments (these are trims only) that are 2 weeks apart and charges only $15.  For someone's dog who needs a FULL groom ...the first time will be the more expensive groom then everything afterwards would be to keep up the cut.

Teddy gets so tired by the time he gets picked up he just usually sleeps. She doesn't kennel her dogs so they get to run around and play with toys and other dogs there. I love going to Lori and her daughter. I 1000000% recommend them to EVERYONE who has a pet. So far, I've recommended them to 2 of my neighbors already!  Lori says her business does not advertise so it's all word by mouth referrals.....I say if that's the case, she's doing a pretty damn good job seeing that she's been in the same location for 7 years.   :)  Come visit Lori. She's gonna make you AND your pet very happy.

Lori's has been the only place I choose to take my dog. This is the place to go if you want to get your dog groomed at a place that actually likes dogs. There are always a few that are running around the room and mine is one of them. My dog can not handle being in a cage and they understand that. I feel that when I drop her off they actually take care of her and not just the overgrown mess I am handing over. I love these ladies.
My dog is besides himself with excitement every time we go.   They do a great job and it is very reasonable.

Just got our lil pup groomed here and he looks adorable. They certainly have worked very hard, listened to all we had to say and didn't just conveniently shave off all the hair. We've found our 'go-to' pet groomer :)

I found them here on Yelp and have been twice so far and love them! Great prices and very talented. Easy to make appointments on short notice as well. They do a great job grooming my little guy  and was able to give him a nice Mohawk the second time :). I'm so glad to have them near my home.
I've been taking my dog to Lori's Snip & Clip for over a  year now and I have been ecstatic every single time.  My dog seems to love going and they do an amazing job.  The price can't be beat either.

I have been taking my 2 dogs to Lori's for a few years and have always been satisfied.  The cuts are ok, and the prices were way more reasonable than anywhere else. Watch out - there has been a MASSIVE price increase.  It used to cost $85 for both, but is now $115.  I get raising rates a bit, but almost 40%? I don't think we will be returning.

We have been taking our pups in to Snip-N-Clip for three years now and we absolutely love them! The staff takes such great care of our pooches and they always look FAB when we pick them up.  Reasonably priced, very easy to make an appointment, and talented groomers - you cannot go wrong with Snip-N-Clip!

We've been taking our poodle, Princess to Snip and Clip for over 12 years.  About 7 years ago we moved across town and we still only take our dog to get groomed here.  Their knowledge, skill and love for your pet is increadible and it shows!

my 4 legged furry child mackers...never looked sooo handsome! i am a more than satisfied customer and i will be returning to have jennifer do my mackers from now on! they made me feel so comfortable and i just love that mackers is not crated and can play!  world class service from jennifer! i'm on a fixed income and i love the prices! you can tell the compassion they have for god's little creatures! i am so blessed to have found them!

OMG!!! Linda is absolutely awesome! Not only is she an amazing human being but she is the best at scar revisions, hands down.
This is the first treatment that has worked for me. I have tried them all, lasers, microneedling etc, none has worked the way Linda's method has, and I'm only at my first treatment. After her treatment I felt like everything else I had tried before was just pampering. This is serious, with actual RESULTS. I have traveled to go see her and I can't wait till my next treatment. Love love love Linda! Catch her now before she becomes too famous and doesn't have time for new clients. Thank me later.

Linda is the first person that has actually helped me with my stretch marks.  She has worked on my stretch marks with her patented process of camoflauging the scars.  I highly recommend her for skin care concerns. She cares and she is educated on the skin healing process.

Linda works miracles!  The most offensive scars, disappear!  She has such a talent and passion for helping people!  Even wrinkles disappear!  Linda is a master at anti aging as well!  Anything related to the skin, Linda is the best!

She's has a great personality and everyone may be different but in my experience my stretch marks actually became worst after treatments now I am left with wider stretch marks. The ink was temporary lasting only a few weeks. Not to mention she overcharges way too much. Look elsewhere or save your money. I wish I would've found a reviews like this before wasting so much money to look worst.

I have been seeing Linda for about 3 years now. She is amazing, and my results are unbelievable. I had a few chicken pox scars, but my main issue was my dark spots and inconsistent skin tone on my face. I used to have to wear Mac studio fix foundation just to make my skin look good. Now I only wear blush and sometimes a little bronzer. Thanks to Linda I can wake up and not feel like I have to hurry and put makeup on my face. People don't believe my age- Lindas methods fight the signs of aging, while keeping your look natural. I love this alternative to fillers etc. I look like I am ten years younger. So many of my friends now go to Linda too because of my results. Thanks Linda!

Scottsdale Skin needling is the only place in AZ which offers dry tattoo needling for scars. Linda's DC method was developed by her - so she definitely knows what would work on a patient and what wouldn't. I found her online while I was searching for an acne scar revision specialist. The best thing about her is that she prepares a treatment plan for you and orders products based on the conditions that she is treating you for. She is not a promoter of some big-fancy-branded products. I really like that about her. She just did my first skin needling last saturday and I'm really optimistic about the results that I will see in the coming months. I should say that she is an expert in her field !
Great food, great service.  Only thing I wish is that they wouldn't allow smoking, but that's every Vegas bar.

Who says the food deals are dead in Vegas? Shucks' entire breakfast menu is $3.95 and you really can't do better than that.  I had Shucks Breakfast:  2 eggs, choice of ham, bacon, sausage, brunch potatoes and toast. My dining partner had the Chicken-fried steak breakfast.  I had a bite and it was really good.

As other reviews have mentioned, coffee is $2.50 which nearly doubles the cost of breakfast, but it's still cheaper than Denny's!  Highly recommend this place for breakfast.
Stay away. This place serves you 12 ounces of beer and charges you for 16 oz...

Came here to meet up with friends. We just wanted to eat, drink and catch up. Sorry to say I don't know our servers name, but he knew we were there to talk and enjoy  the company.  We ordered round after round of appetizers over a three hour period and he was great.  The oysters were so good, we ending up getting three dozen by the end of the night. Most places like to turn tables quickly, but they were patient and courteous with us. We asked for tortilla chips for the dip because one of our group could not eat the flour chips, which have a great spice sprinkle, with the amazing crab dip, and their response was immediate.  The shrimp ceviche was fresh and flavorful. Mussels had a fantastic broth. Thank you for an amazing night.

Coming from the Northeast, you learn what is and isn't a good a New England Clam Chowder. Shucks is near the top of my favorite list in clam chowder. It's thick, creamy, and most importantly, it's meaty and there's a good amount of potatoes. I can say that their $5.95 bowl of chowder beats all of the $8 to $12 bowls that some fancy seafood places might charge. 
I also had the Crab Alfredo. Creamy and a lot of crab meat. It was really filling. Looking at the menu, there are a lot of combos and other dishes too. I can not wait to come back and try more. 
Just a note before you pack the family in the car to come here: you must be 21 to enter and the bar allows smoking, the dining area is completely non-smoking.

Was here again during a Bear's game. I mentioned in my last review that I didn't care for their raw oysters--they didn't taste very fresh. Well, put those babies in a shooter with some vodka and bloody Mary mix and they are not bad at all. They are normally $5 but during Bear's games they're only $2.

For a restaurant/bar type dive, I think this place is great! I always have great and friendly service whether I'm sitting at the bar or in the restaurant side. I personally am not a huge fan of seafood but I enjoyed most of what they have to offer. The bacon wrapped shrimp was good just not very much for an appetizer! The prices are very cheap in my opinion. This is my favorite dive in the area based on food and atmosphere!

So this was the WORST  service I've ever had here. I live around the corner and this is my favorite place to go to. But I'm seriously considering goin to timbers next time. 
I usually order food and hang out with friends. Tonight we all  ordered appetizers and entrées, had a few drinks. Built up a pretty big bill. But still we were having a good time. Our server was nice and she was cute. Had a nice smile. She could have come around to check on us a bit more often but what ever that's ok with us. She got what ever we needed fast so that's all that counts. 
She ended up leaving before we were done and told us to go to the bar for anything we needed. Ok sounds easy. NOT!
The bartender wes a freaking asshole. We're trying to get our checks (my BF is trying to get them) and the bartender is giving him attitude about what's on what ticket. He doesn't know he was at the bar gambling most of the time. So I walk over and began to try and fix things. My BF turns around and walks away and the bartender throws his arms up and makes a face. (Like woah wtf) so I'm trying to work with the guy he prints up the ticket and throws it to the side then he walks of mumbling something and goes serves other tables. HELLO! I'm trying to get out and pay my bill. (Witch for the table was around $120) after he was done gave us a list of tickets we paid before he could even make drinks for other people. 

Needless to say leaving took way longer then it should. Service was shit at the end. Food was ok. Overall I haven't left a place this upset in a long time. Ugh. Good luck.

My boyfriend keeps reminding me that you have to review a place for what it is.  Meaning, I can't review Shucks Tavern next to Sage restaurant.  

With that said, for a 24 hour gaming bar with an oyster bar attached this is top notch.  The seafood was all super fresh.  The boy ordered clam strips and a crab bucket.  Both were delicious and fresh.  I had the fish tacos, heavy on the cabbage, but I like cabbage.  It was a celebratory dinner so we had carrot cake and it was flavorful and moist.  The service was great and the drink specials were good for a Friday night (half price martinis?  Yes please!).  

We would definitely go back, especially since the boy often gets a craving for crab.

Kind of skeptical when I went here with the parents. The food was pretty good. Fried food done at its best and the Caesar dressing had a lot of lemon juice in it which is my favorite. Our order kind of lagged but I have nothing else to complain about...It's 24 hours and its not denny's

They lose a star because the service is just OK....but for bar food I have ate at both the centennial and the flamingo location (for paint nite) and both are great, but I do think the portions at the centennial location are larger. I always get the scallops with ginger glaze and it is a HUGE portion and always very tasty. The garlic fries are AMAZING!! Family friendly also! I definitely choose Shucks over a PT's or Timbers for a good, reasonably priced meal.

I have been pissed at this place for a while but decided to give it a chance tonight.  Kind of let bygones be bygones.  The reason I was pissed is that during the football season I called them to see if they were showing the Chargers game.  They said yes.  So we drove there and before we parked I went in and asked them again and they said yes.  So we went in (in our Chargers shirts) and sat at the end of the sports bar next to someone else in a Chargers jersey and told the female bartender what we wanted to watch and she said no problem.  We ordered beers and after a while noticed that the Chargers game should have already started.  So we mentioned it to the bartender and she went to check and came back and told us the owner would only let her put the Bears game on (there are a milllion tv screens in there and it shouldn't have been a problem to have our little end of the bar watching the Chargers).  So by the time we fpund another sports bar we missed more than the first quarter of the game.  Seems to me I did enough checking and they should have stood by their promises.

Anyway.... we tried the place again for the food.  It was only OK.  We had calamari appitizer which was OK but I would have liked cocktail sauce instead of marinara for dipping.  Ordered the Shucks salad which had crab, a few shrimp and a decent size peice of seared tuna on it.  The tuna was only so-so but the crab and shrimp was good.  My guy had a bowl of the seafood bisque.  He asked if they had any sourdough bread to go with it and they brought him two pieces of sourdough toast like you would have with breakfast.  Seems to me a seafood place should have some good crusty bread, don't you think?  Do not order the ice tea.  It is not brewed, we had to send it back.

Just gross. Went there for breakfast because it was near me. The food was very poor quality and the restaurant area smelled like cigarettes smoke. My boyfriend didn't like it either. Go to The Cracked Egg, The Egg & I or Jamm's instead. TRUST me!!!

I literally walked in and out of this place. There was no one to help us be seated at the front to the point that we had to search for the host/waiter even though the place was dead.

Did I mention this place REEKS of cigarettes? Like, really bad?
I love seafood but I didn't feel like I'd be able to taste the quality of the food accurately here while inhaling clouds of smoke.
I lost my appetite immediately and left.

This place is AMAZING with late night orders to go!! My hubby works late and I had him go by TWICE this past week on his way home. (I'm sending him again tonight!! ) A lot of times when you order to go (especially late at night)...you know your food isn't very fresh but this place cares about their food and you can tell!! 
Their Seafood Louis is so yummy! The lobster, crab meat and shrimp are fresh and the Louis Dressing is fantastic. The Coconut Shrimp was served with a coconut dipping sauce...it's delicious!
If you want yummy seafood late at night...you should check this place out!!
There bus boy although he resembled Ellen Degeneres was very helpful and polite. Food was amazing and service from them employees was phenomenal. Trevor well done son.

I've liked Schucks food but the trip there tonight reminded me why I don't go there except to remind myself why I don't go there. 

The customer service is atrocious. I sat for over 5 minutes at the bar and not once did the brunette bartender acknowledge me in anyway. She got a couple of drinks, went into the kitchen, and then played with her phone cord on a strip outlet by the register. Never once looked up and said she'd be right with me or anything. This reminded me that this has happened to me before there. You basically have to be a regular to get anything resembling adequate service at Schucks. 

What is the dysfunction at this bar that they can't get employees to practice just adequate customer service?

Great spot to just stop in and get some pretty good food at any time of the day. Beer is nice and cold and they have great specials.  If you sign up for their email listings they will send you the weekly specials with free play.  Great food, great service.

Great chicken fingers and there 75 cents a piece  on Monday.  Loved them

The beer is great too

My wife and I recently moved into the area and haven't had a chance to hit up the grocery store. She has been craving Clam Chowda ( east coasters :)  and i just happened to come across the menu for this place and saw they had it.  Wife yelled SOLD!  

Walking in , its the normal bar , tv screens tables and booths. 
It was a little grungy in there , but nothing i havent seen before. 

They have a decent amount of beers on tap , i ordered a New Castle , the wife had a Coors light ( EWWW ).

Ordered up a cup and bowl of clam chowda ! ,  it was very thick , had the right amount of clam to potato and veggie ratio and was very tasty.   

Out came the rest of the food.  My wife ordered the Boston Cod Sandwhich. Its basically a upscale McDonald fish fillet , but was outstanding.  Had alot of flavor and the fish , didn't taste fishy.  I ordered the Fish Fry .. and man was i in for a treat. I had a HUGE plate of fried haddock which was extremely flavorful and tender\moist.  I enjoyed it completely.   

They have alot of non fried light choices on the menu such as crab stuffed tilapia.  We will definitely be back to try these !. 

Try it , you wont be disappointed.

Alright, so I came here sometime around May of this year and it was alright. On my first visit, I had the rockafella oysters which I believe triggered my allergic reaction to shellfish. We sat at the bar and I had a lot of beer to drink... good times.

I ordered some chicken- type sandwich on my following visit which by the way was humongous and I was unable to finish it. Now this place is located in North Las Vegas so it's more of a hangout spot for the locals, there's nothing fancy or fantastic about it.
Have been here many many times and we love this place as it open 24/7 great fresh and juicy food, great selection of liquors and pretty comfortable.

We eat here all the time and it is one of our favorite seafood places in Vegas.  The portions are large, the food is fresh and the value is good.  Fridays have appetizer specials for $5 each and we usually chow down on all of those.  The crab is always well prepared and the oysters are tasty.  The service is generally prompt and professional.

We ate here yesterday and everything was fantastic. Our server was Nicki and she was awesome. She was friendly, personable, and recommended items that turned out to be excellent. They have a really cheap priced kids menu (you have to ask about it). My son had chicken fingers and fries. They have like 4 different French fry options. My hubster loves oysters and she recommended we come back for the dollar oysters on Thursdays. I had the ginger soy scallops with baby bok choy and rice, hubby had 1/2 dozen Texas oysters (steamed with tequila, lime & Tabasco), the lobster roll with waffle fries and 2 oyster shooters.   We plan to go back kid free and sit at the bar once college and NFL sports season begins.
Worst customer service ever! Took 45 min to order, you need more employees? Hit me up, I'm free.

Holy tamale batman.  Their combo plate is gargantuous.  You should have a few people to share it with.  The lobster fingers are melt in your mouth scrum-dilly-umptious.  The clam strips were pretty sandy and I coudn't really eat many of em.

Even though I'm reviewing the one on N Durango - my kickball team is sponsored by the one on Flamingo/215 and they have super yummy crab stuffed shrimp and good beer specials.  :)

Whoa move over Joe's Crab Shack, Shuck's has been discovered. The first time I came here I wasn't sure about how the food would taste, but I am glad that I tried it anyway. I tried the lobster bites and the crab dip both delicious. 

The second time I came here I saw a couple that ordered this big shell of seafood which was the clam bake. So my bf and I ordered it since it seemed like it would be enough food to eat. Of course it was...it has clams, crab, corn, potatoes, and sausage! MmMmM just the sound of it makes my mouth water.  

Totally worth the place to go to eat some seafood and watch some games. Great location, clean, and friendly staff!

i expected a lot better food considering the other reviews. I ordered the fried oysters and the fish and chips. Both were bad, bad, bad. The oysters were not pan fried, rather deep fried and cooked so hard they literally broke into pieces under the fork. The color was way too dark meaning they were overcooked. The fish was cooked so hard I needed to work the knife hard to cut it open and it split in pieces. The breading was not fluffy like one expects from a beer bar. It was a rock hard shell. I believe they just took frozen factory  made fish planks and threw them into the oil. The fish was billed as cod but it was so dry and stringy I couldn't tell what it was. True, one could say, "what would you expect from an oyster bar in the middle of a the Las Vegas desert?"  Well. I'd expect at least to find good tarter sauce. Nope, it was like cheap mayonnaise with pickle relish thrown in. 

The mark of a good place is their pride in food and service. Insult was added to injury when I complained about the quality to my waiter, Gregory. I stated my dissatisfaction in an obtuse manner just to see what effect it would have. I told him that now I have something to write about. He said,"what?" I said, "how bad the food is here." Without a comment, he turned to take my credit card to the register. I paid for the meal at full price. I was never asked any questions nor introduced to the manager. I will never go there again and recommend against this place to anyone else.

Tried to give this bar another chance, and they found another way to make it even worse. We ordered two martinis other than taking a lot time to bring them they were a total joke, see picture. Never again, horrible service.

Went here 3 times now, and it has NEVER been good! This will definitely be the last time I try...
The freaking crab was hollow, wings were soggy and sandwiches were awful. They brought out three different clusters and none of them had more than one or two legs with meat in them...they said it was because of a bad order??? Whatever. On top of that, only one that was even hot...and it was the very LAST one, and by then I was over it! 
Gaming is also terrible. We both played hundreds at the bar EACH time and never saw anyone else hit anything either, which is so crazy. To sum it up? Mediocre food that they WILL comp when you lose at least 600.00, lol. No thanks!!!

Okay place when you're in the mood for seafood and don't feel like driving to the strip. Although we've never hung out at the bar, it does look very enjoyable to have a nice conversation while sipping on a long island iced tea.

When we do visit, we enjoy the fish sandwich and anything crab they sell. And don't forget to get the criss-cut fries...

Food was horrible my husbands fish wasn't all the way done. Oryster shots was horrible for the price not worth it. This is my first and last time going to shucks tavern on Durango. Not to mention we kept having to wave down there server
I lived near this place for 3 years but finally made the trip there a few weeks ago.  I Love it.  Great food.  Plus it's a Bears place.  I'll be there when the football season starts.

Stopped in tonight at my local spot. It is Saturday. There was a full bar and only one bartender on shift. I never had to ask for a drink and neither did anyone else, Brooke is a rockstar ... 21 people at the bar and a full lounge . All Pistons firing ! Great food and even better service !

The wife and I have lived in this area for 2 years and never gave this place a chance.  Now we really wish we have come here before now.  There is a nice bar and the dining area is separate enough to really enjoy either side of the house.  I would not hesitate to bring my kid here.  I had the shrimp po boy and the wife had steamed crab and fried shrimp.  All of our food was very good and the service was great.  Good key lime pie too.

a seafood joint less than 2 minutes from my house in a neighborhood filled with chain restaurants and their kitchen is open 24/7 with daily and graveyard specials?
this pescetarian is as happy as a clam at high tide!  =D

i must admit, i had low expectations of shucks on my first visit.
i'd read all of the reviews, some by people i trust implicitly, so i was willing to give it a try, at the very least.
i was pleasantly surprised as the food was delicious and the service was friendly and accommodating.
i ordered the scallop sliders which are prepared on hawaiian sweet rolls!
imho, sliders should really only ever be served on hawaiian sweet rolls.
the scallops were tender and flavorful and the wasabi sauce has a nice little punch!
crunchy waffle fries on the side were yummy as well.

shucks has quickly become my neighborhood spot.
i've since ordered several different items and i've never been disappointed.
the mahi mahi is one of my favorite items on their menu.....prepared perfectly tender and flaky, served with wild rice and cooked veggies that are still crisp.

two of my biggest pet peeves: 
1. overcooked fish
2. soggy cooked vegetables
you won't find either of those here.

the prices are already extremely reasonable but the daily specials are where it's at.
tuesdays - $3 tacos
wednesdays - b1g1 sandwiches and wraps
thursdays - $1 oysters

i'm so glad i gave shucks a chance and even happier that they exceeded my expectations in every way.
i'm totally a fan!

Came here on a Thursday night to have a bite to eat.  I guess the football game had just ended and this place was a ghost town.  I thought it would still be full of people having drinks and hanging out, but I guess I was wrong.  

We seated ourselves over by the bar area and it took a couple minutes for the server to come over and take our order.  We ordered a couple beers and the fish tacos, steak salad and a cup of seafood bisque.

The seafood bisque was super salty!  I wanted to take it home and mix it with canned soup to dilute it.  

The fried fish tacos were actually pretty large and filling, and the flavor was good being not too dry and not too fishy.

The steak salad was good except for having too much bleu cheese.  Luckily we asked for the dressing on the side or else the flavor would have been too overwhelming.  The steak was seared and cooked almost like tartare which we liked.  But the rest of the salad was unremarkable in my opinion.

Next time I will come back to try oysters in some form, be it raw or rockefellar.  Maybe during a football game where they have discounts on food and drinks.

So good and so simple.  I love their oysters.  The mothershucker burger is huge and always cooked medium rare when I order it this way and the jambalaya has just enough kick to it that keeps me coming back.

Shucks is faithful to me in the sense that they're open 24 hours and not that run down of a place. 

I think I've posted a years worth of pictures before writing this review but whenever I'm in the north west area of Las Vegas I know for sure Shucks is always a good option for me to fall back on.

Let me wrap this up by saying the Salmon entree is excellent, the pork chop appetizer is always good, and the black cod/catfish dishes are gravy too.  

Do not hesitate ever to walk in!

I love this place and I come here all the time; excellent seafood!  It's open 24hrs, so its convenient when you want seafood at 3am!  They have a large selection of seafood here, everything from shrimp platters to crab legs, oysters, mussels, wraps tacos, clam bakes, gumbo and pastas.  The prices are very reasonable too.  The bartenders are awesome.  The atmosphere here is very chill/low key.  Great place to grab some beer and seafood with friends.  They also have great deals on breakfast; I think the breakfast is priced around $4.  Its definitely worth checking out!  Its kind of hidden though; its near the corner of elkhorn/durango; across from Smiths.  You'll have to drive around to the back to park.

Tough to review this place

The service has always been terrible. The food quality always amazing.

Dark and dingy is it a seafood place , a dive bar , late night hang out, or gaming spot.

The staff is always running around looking like it's their first day on the job. I have been seated and waited twenty minutes before acknowledged. And that was because i passed out from hunger

The waiter seemed stressed and didn't want our table or order. The manager seemed perplexed by it all and the ambiance was loud and fun. It's unfortunate that it always seemed like amateur hour because the food is so darn good

Don't think I have ever had a bad meal. The peel and eat shrimp is to die for. 

The happy hour seemed to change from my visits. One time I was allowed to order food Togo one time I wasn't on happy hour. The drinks are comped if your playing the machines which is nice and the bar staff had always been friendly. 

For the area and late night food it is some of the best around. If you can have a few beers ( if you can get them ) and not stress about service you will enjoy yourseld

I first learned of Shuck's a couple of years ago after a friend told me about their fantastically inexpensive breakfast specials. Until now I had only visited the Flamingo/215 location and only for breakfast. When looking for place for the midday meal, the Mrs. and I opted for Shuck's. The only disappointment here is that I hadn't previously tried their lunch menu. They have a burger called the Mother Shucker that features a full pound of beef.  I opted for the smaller version or the "Baby Mother." It came with fries (you can get garlic fries) and I added a side salad. The side salad was one the larger ones I've seen and featured red leaf lettuce, tomato and onion. Even the Baby Mother was huge and some kind of tasty. The waitress, Ashley, was very friendly and attentive, offering her advice on which fried fish the Mrs. should get. Good call on the Haddock Ashley. It was fresh and crisp, complete with garlic fries. I left stuffed like a Thanksgiving Turkey, with a smile on my face. Next time I'll attempt the Mother Shucker.

So, this is a bar. For anyone that might be confused (we were). We thought we'd found a cool local seafood joint, but no. They even have a kids menu. But it's one small room, half is a bar and half is booths. The "bar" is smoking, dining area is non, but there's absolutely nothing dividing the two. So you'll be breathing in smoke while you eat. Not good for kids at all. This is not a family place.

I would have given this place 5 stars except for the graveyard bartender on SUNDAYs is by far the worst bartender I have ever encountered and I work in the industry.  Don't got there after midnight on Sundays unless you want to spend the rest of your night wondering if your food or drinks will ever come.. He does seem to be really good at avoiding you when you need him though.. It's too bad because we're regulars there and he's served us several times and we still haven't had a good experience with him..

Any other day this place is AWESOME the other bartenders are great! Food is great! Atmosphere is great as so are the prices!

Tonight was not a great night at this Shucks as the Cigar smoke got to us as soon as we walked in the door. We went to a booth but still had to move farther back. The fish fry was not as good as a normal Friday as the fish was very Greasy and the cole slaw so dry that even the waiter agreed but did nothing to correct it. Going to stay away as this was our Friday nite fish spot but we are going to try some other places.

The seafood here is very good, but the dish you really need to try is the black and blue salad. I'm not usually much for salad but this one blows me away. Romaine lettuce, grilled and sliced steak, blue cheese crumbles, onion straws and sun dried tomatoes make this one of the best salads I've ever had. Service is acceptable, food is very good.
I am giving this place one star due to fact that on arriving there was a sign stating no one under 21 was allowed in the building despite the profile on Yelp stating the opposite.

I live in the area and wanted somewhere different to get some food, drinks, and play a little keno. 
Reviews were not very good but, I was pleasantly surprised. Service was perfect. We were greeted as soon as we sat down, asked by numerous bartenders if we needed anything, and very friendly. We happen to go on $1 oyster night which was a plus. The oysters were very nice sized but, a bit gritty. I had the gumbo which was no compare to Oyster Bar quality but, still good. I'd definitely return.
a good place to catch a Chicago Bears game and food and service is pretty good as well.

It's like that meal you eat when you're really hungry and all of a sudden your full and grossed out.  The crab and spinach dip was runny and simply not good.  It came with toasted flour tortillas cut in triangles.  The crab cakes were salty and full of flavors that shouldn't go together.  The Rockefeller oysters and fried shrimp weren't bad.  Garlic fries were greasy and salty.  Ceviche was plain.  Snow crab and peel and eat shrimp was ok.  My advice is stick to the bar and have yourself a beer.

I've been coming to this location for a few years and have always been extremely happy with the food and the service. They have a nice bar area and then booths and tables. I usually always grab a booth because when I come here I'm so hungry I want to order a few things and it all doesn't fit comfortably on the bar. 
We have had the exact same server for over a year now and he's great. Brings us our waters and beers quickly and keep them refilled. All the staff is pretty awesome and friendly and makes sure to never forget you. 

My foodie date and I were starving so we started off with the crab and spinach dip. I personally do not like the pita chips it comes with so I had them switch it to tortilla chips instead. Always a favorite. Then we also ordered  the calamari this time. This was the first time ordering that appetizer here and I have to say that was some of the best calamari I have eaten anywhere in Vegas. It was so light and crispy that I savagely ate the entire plate by myself. If you come here definitely order that. 

Now on to the entrees! I think I have tried almost everything on their menu now but the Steak and Crab is by far my favorite. It's a flat iron steak( seasoned perfected) which is delicious and 1/2 pound of crab. The steak is always so tender you can cut it with a fork and my crab was exceptional. Huge pieces of meat that didn't even need any lemon or butter because it tasted so good on its own. They were out of my favorite sautéed summer squash side so I got broccoli instead. My date had the new Clam Bake( I think that's what it's called..?) which was amazing! It had a generous amount of clams, andouille sausage, corn, snow crab, and these deliciously seasoned potatoes. Not only did I eat all my food but I ate part of my dates as well. Haha it was just extra good. 

Even after all that food I had to have some desert. Their cheesecake and brownie is to die for but I decided on the fried cheesecake and let me tell you I wasn't disappointed! 

2 appetizer, 2 entrees, dessert and soda/beers our totally bill came to $85 which I thought was very reasonably for seafood and steak. Great place and if you are a sports fan they always have the games playing as well.

If I could give no stars I would!! This was the worst experience EVER!! Being in the service industry I usually put up with a lot and give the bartender a break but he was seriously the worst bartender in the world!! As soon as we walked in we were completely ignored and treated like nothing. There were only 9 people in the bar including us, so not busy what so ever. We looked over the menu for a few minutes ordered a salad and sandwich and seriously waited over 40 minutes for our food!!!!! The couple that came in after us ate and left by time we received our food! Instead of telling us our food was taking awhile or checking in on us the bartender completely ignored us and wouldn't even refill our drink, he dodged us wouldn't make eye contact. When we received our food it was luke warm and tasteless but we decided to eat it cause we were starving. When I asked if the food usually takes 40 minutes he said yeah at night it always does if we're busy...THERE WERE 9 PEOPLE IN THE BAR!!!! YOU'RE NOT BUSY!! He rolled his eyes and acted like I was asking a stupid question. I asked for the check and he said he took care of it, but at this point I would of rather paid the check and stiffed him. Don't act like a douche bag and then expect the world cause you decided to take care of something because you should of at the beginning. You're graveyard bartender is a prick and shouldn't treat locals like shit in a local bar! Seriously I will tell everyone not to come here!!

The first time I went here about a year ago the food was ok. Had the lobster finger appetizer and they were pretty good. 
So, last night when I went I was so disappointed when I ordered the lobster fingers again and they weren't that great. Overlooked, over breaded, dry, and chewy. 
Then I got the pan roast with clams. On the menu it says that there is also shrimp, crab, scallops, and white fish in the bowl. There was 1, ONE, scallop, 2 shrimp, 2 tiny pieces of white fish and NO, crab!!!!  For $18.95!!!!  What a ripoff!!  
Also this place is a borderline dive bar. It reeks!!!  I mean literally the place smells disgusting!!  There is no barrier between the people smoking at the bar and the tables where you eat. And that smell hits you as soon as you walk in the door.  And this place is also so loud I was starting to get a headache!!  And I'm hard of hearing!!  Do not go if you want to speak to the person you are going with!!  It's that loud. Big screen TVs everywhere and I swear they had the volume turned up on every single one of them. They weren't all tuned to the same station but they were all tuned to some kind of sports!!!  
Oyster Bar?  No!!  This is a sports bar that you can get some substandard food that resembles seafood. 
I won't be back!!!

Favorite night to go here is for the Monday night special buffalo Chicken strips and always order fries with them. It is a great place at night not a lot of people and you can get whatever table you want. Its a great locals place. 
The food we have tried here is good. Worth checking out.

My husband and I have been here many times. The service can be hit or miss, but the food has always been good. My husband is especially fond of the lobster rolls. I have also been here a few times with friends to grab some drinks. Prices are pretty average for the city.

My family and I always eat at the other shucks location and the food and service is great. We came here because we were on this side of town and I don't know if it has a different owner or what but the service was horrible and the food was worse then bad. I hate to leave such a negative review but I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.

I was watching a re-run of Bizzare Foods recenlty and saw Andrew Zimmern diggnig up clams in Rhode Island.  Suddenly I found myself with a strong craving for fried clam strips.  I used to share a basket with my mom at our favorite sea food place when I was a kid.  I had to have them again.  It had been too long.  After much searching a failed attempt at a restaurant that no longer exists, I found myself at Shucks Tavern.  

It was about 9:30 AM when I was in the area and I knew Shucks to be open 24/7.  So in I walked and was immediately handed a menu for breakafast items.  I gave the guy a funny look and asked if they were serving only breakfast or if I could order from the regular menu.  He said I could order anything and must have been confused by my request.  I mean who wouldn't be.  I'm sure most people don't tend to order fried clams at 9:30 in the morning.  But I've never been one for breakfast foods and I had a craving.  So I ordered my fried clams, a side salad with Italian dressing and an ice tea.  

What seemed like many minutes went by and were fewer than it seemed.  Soon I had my salad and a nice plate of fried clams.  They were impressive too.  Dark golden brown.  Big and meaty.  There was a large cup of cocktail sauce and a couple of lemon wedges on the side.  The salad was perfect for a side.  Mixed greens, tomato, onion.  The perfect amount of dressing.  The vinegar woke up my taste buds and got me ready for the good stuff, the clams.  And they were good.  Tender but still chewy to let me know they were the real deal.  None of this chopped formed garbage.  Perfectly fried and crispy.  The cocktail sauce was amazing.  There was enough horse radish to make me sweat.  A little extra lemon juice mixed in and it was perfect.  I ate down those crispy little bi-valves and felt this sense of euphoria wash over me.  My craving had been satisfied and I was ready to begin the rest of my day.  Everybody else can keep their Wheaties.  For me, fried clams first thing in the morning is the true breakfast of champions.

We really liked coming here! My husband is a huge fan of seafood. He got the swordfish special and I got fish and chips. We also got mussels as an appetizer. The swordfish was amazing! I am jealous I didn't get it. The fish and chips were good. The mussels were very good and there were a ton of them! We will be returning. The service was a little slow when we were there, that's the reason for the four-star review.

I was pleasantly surprised when I arrived at Shucks. I'm from New England, and it's certainly difficult to find decent seafood joints in Las Vegas. This place has a good feeling, local dive, but clean. The service has always been friendly. I usually go for cold oysters and beer/wine, but definitely enjoy other selections. The stuffed shrimp appetizer is very good, I often find myself scraping the dish for the last of the mushrooms and rice/butter. Crab legs are fun, and this is the first place I've ever eaten dungeness crab, pretty good! I only wish they had Alaskan King crab! The mix and match of cold/hot plates is always a great idea if you can't decide and feel like sharing, too. This is my go-to seafood bar :-)

The front of this restaurant faces a parking lot, with the back facing the road, so you have to be paying attention to find it. Once inside, it reads like a typical sports bar - smokey, lots of TVs, with half of the interior taken up by a dining area with some booths and low tables. The menu is EXTENSIVE. Usually not a great sign, but the food we got was acceptable. I had the Shuck's salad, which has a little piece of tuna, two shrimp, and a tiny scoop of crabmeat on a romaine salad with a vinaigrette dressing. It also came with a piece of cheesy texas toast on the salad which wasn't my thing. We also ordered the crab cakes, which in my opinion were small for the price. They tasted fine though, and the two came with a small salad of slaw in between them on the serving plate. No one got sick, extra point for that. My soda didn't ever get refilled though, so that was a minus. 

They have specials which are listed as you walk in, mostly things like X for half price on Tuesdays kind of thing. They also have rotating daily specials on a board inside the door. Overall, I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here, but if I am in the area in the future and have deemed all other options less desirable, I might come back to try the crab legs since that seemed to be the most raved about menu item. Maybe I'm just not that used to eating in a bar where people are smoking and my server doesn't refill my drink, but given that, the food was just fine.

Agree with the John Taffer comment, I think we encountered the dumbest and laziest bar staff in Vegas. A crowded bar with a lot of unhappy people. So sad we just got up and left

Don't waste your time or money.
I'm giving this 5 stars for one reason; I love Florida style fried shrimp and this is the only place in Vegas I've found that has it like I like it. I would come just for the shrimp.

I had the Shucks fish fry. It was great! My only complaint was that I could have eaten more of the fish. I wasn't too find of the coleslaw, but Im not a fan of that in general. The service is also great, and my baby loved the clam chowder.
A little smokey at times, but the food is good and service is great.  Definitely a neighborhood favorite!

Does this place ever disappoint?  Not so far for me!

This time I began with a dozen cold and very delicious oysters on the half shell and a side Caesar Salad that was fresh, cool, and enhanced by a surprisingly good zesty Caesar Dressing.  This was followed by a generous portion of nice and flaky fresh Parmesan Halibut with drinkable Lemon Butter Sauce that was paired with tasty moist Rice Pilaf.  Meanwhile my dining companions enjoyed Fish & Chips with colossal Onion Rings, and a Crab Bucket containing equal parts of Dungeness Crab and Snow Crab, along with great Roasted Red Potatoes.

We again enjoyed fine service and an overall five-star dining experience!
